This would be a terrific place for a little indie movie theater...

Nice store location, small and comfy. Lots of choices on the menu, I've tried the butter pecan ice cream & the mint shake, both were great. Customer service could be a little better but overall good experience.
Favorite ice cream spot hands down! Really happy it's located at my side of town. Rarely order ice cream, but when I crave it, I get my fix here

I love Jarlings! Every time I come and visit Champaign, I have a craving for Jarlings. Their ice cream and custard is the epitome of comfort. It's nice to grab one of their shakes for the long ride home on 57. Their peach shakes is one of my favorites. But don't forget, they accept cash and personal check only. No plastic.

The ice cream was delicious and the atmosphere was fun! Lots of yummy options , which we loved because we get bored with usual flavors that chain and franchises offer. However, the employes working that day hated their job and were rude and short with customers , lots of eye rolling. Although I anticipated the price, I had hopes the scoops would be slightly larger. Unhappy employees don't give out nice scoops! I hope to visit again and be surprised by happier employees !

Yelp challenge #3 Sloan's is probably a new ice cream place? I am not sure but I ran across this place while visiting Vegas. Ordered coffee bean which tastes like coffee, and the circus ice cream. The circus ice cream is very interesting. It's cotton candy flavored ice cream with gummies. It's kinda like a kids dream to have cotton candy and gummies all at the same time. The ice cream tasted yummy, but the gummy twist was weird because it was very hard. Don't get me wrong, i love gummies but it was too hard and chewy. Overall, I loved this little shop!

I was dying to try this place after reading yelp reviews. I was so happy one night when my husband came home from work early-ish and said he was feeling ice cream! I instantly knew we should try out Ninety's. He got an oreo milkshake. It was large and very thick. I thought it tasted OK. It wasn't the best milkshake I've ever had. I got a kids cone of banana cream pie. It was actually really good! It's the same cost to get it in a cone or a cup, so I obviously got it in a cone. I look forward to coming back and trying some of their more fun menu items. The yum-ee buns look interesting and I think I would like the macaroon icecream sandwich too! The shop itself is small and there isn't a ton of seating. There was a line when we got there, but it moved very quickly. We have plenty to come back for and look forward to trying other treats here!

Ew. Anyone who can bake at home following a free recipe from a cookbook or blog can produce higher quality and better tasting baked goods than this. Why does this guy have a show...artistic flare? Stuff was pretty but Ew.

First time here. On a chilly Mid March Saturday night, the place was packed. If you love big soft serve sundaes with all the fixings, this is the place to come, just be careful getting in and out of the lot.

Can't go wrong with the cereal milk soft serve! It is absolutely delicious and I'm salivating as I'm typing this review. The cookies are really good too! I got a dozen of them as gifts and while it is kinda pricey, it is also worth it, imo.

We arrived at the Ghirardelli store at 10:50pm , only to be greeted by an employee, telling us the store was closed! Why would closing time be advertised as 11:00pm. My husband, two kids and I were disappointed. We were looking forward to a delicious Ghirardelli treat.

Carrot cake cookie was amazing. Macaroons were very good and huge (about the size of 4 regular macaroons -- the French kind). Pumpkin macaroon!! Also had great strawberry croissant which you have to see to understand and had a great latte.

Crack Pie over Cereal Milk, hands down.. Seen this place all over ig and the hype of it when they had a pop up in Seattle lol. Anyway, was able to try both samples and both my kiddos and I agreed, crack pie is better. The cereal milk tasted like it sounded.. cereal milk but more milk lol. Crack pie had a different flavor to it. I devoured it so quickly I forgot what it tastes like now lol $1.50 for the crunch topping is absurd so I opted for the sprinkles for $.50. With tax it came out to a little over $7 which is pricey but I guess sometimes you got to splurge on stuff like this.
It's amazing and super delicious, they have very fun and unique flavors my personal fave is the half Thai tea half Oreo and the little fish they put out are so good!!!

The deserts are really good. We really love to get the macarons when we go there. It is really awesome that they have a wide array of flavors and they rotate out so you get something new everytime. The place is usually busy so there is a bit of a wait in line, but it is worth it in my opinion.

Service was good went monday around 2pm. I can totaly see where the parking issues are. I had no problem. I got a scoop of salted carmel and a scoop of peanutbutter both toped with chocolate. cost seven dollars. Scoops were good sized. My boyfriend inhaled his salted carmel. I ate my peanut butter a bit slower. I did have a few ice crystals in the PB. It was rich creamy and delish.. Would I go back ... YES.
I love their stuff. Cute shop and lots of chocolate to choose from. Mix and match your own box. Friendly staff and small seating area inside. We enjoyed the hot chocolate and brownies.

Somisomi does it again! New location in Henderson!! My baby loved his oreo ice cream, and I got to try their Thai tea ice cream (forgot to take picture because I inhaled it, lol) I haven't seen this flavor at any other locations so I was excited to try it and glad I did. It was bomb!! Not overly sweet but I could definitely taste the Thai tea flavor. Their ice cream is always on point no matter which flavor you get. Super creamy and not too sweet. Cute and simple interior. Currently they serve ahboong upside down to limit contact, but I like it that way way anyway. Not a problem! You get a free taiyaki this weekend if you get one ah boong, but I made sure I got a box to go. Their taiyakis are so chewy inside. So good! Just like the location in the Shanghai plaza, staff here was friendly and nice, too. Will definitely be coming back soon!!

Turned to Yelp to find a dessert option while in Phoenix and was not disappointed by Novel Ice Cream. We were intrigued by the Leslie Knope (ice cream sandwich made on mini waffles), which was every bit as good as it sounds. We arrived around 8:30 PM on a Saturday and street parked because the nearby lot was full. There was a short line outside of the shop that was a bit slow-moving, but the level of individual attention we were given inside explained the brief wait. When it was our turn, the owner himself waited on us. When he learned it was our first time, he explained the shop's background, walked us through all of the flavors, and encouraged free samples. I wish I hadn't come straight from dinner --- I would have loved to order the Indecision, which allows you to get scoops of multiple different flavors. BF and I split a double scoop with Fat Elvis and bourbon caramel toffee crunch and it was phenomenal. I was nicely surprised at how affordable it was, too --- we ordered 3 different things to be split amongst 3 couples and the total was under $15. Wish I lived closer --- there'd be a lot of donut-ice cream sandwiches in my future.

Give me one of everything! Every time I come here I end up going home with way too many baked goods and everything is stellar. I haven't tried one thing that I wouldn't buy again. I've custom ordered birthday cakes here as well as just picked out things from the bakery shelves. This place will not disappoint either way!
The BEST donuts. No comparison. No argument. No matter where I move in the area, I always find my way back to Jack Frost. Always a treat.

This place is so dope (that's what we say in NY) on so many levels! 1. Location. Plenty of on street parking 2. Jeni's itself is just super cute and adorable. Love the set up outside and inside as well. Very welcoming. Lots of lightening and just super airy and open. 3. The staff is amazing! Super friendly, warm, and inviting. I can't wait to go back! Love their honesty. If they didn't know something they didn't pretend to know. They went to ask the manager. 4. Being allowed to sample as much as as little as you pleased was a HUGE surprise but greatly appreciated. The portions were super gracious. 5. THE FROSE is life! All of the ice cream I tasted was amazing but man oh man the Frose!!! I am just speechless. Honestly thought the first time I had Jeni's was in Charleston just a couple months ago. Best ice cream I ever tasted. While there, one of the workers asked me where I was from and when I told her Charlotte she told me they would be opening a location there this year. I never dreamt it would be this soon. The opening of this place has totally made my summer. We were all warmly welcomed and the atmosphere was just super chill, laid back, and friendly.

This place is awesome! The only downside is that it's busy. They have more seating in an atrium area, but it is hotter than the main seating area. The coffee is pretty good but the bake goods are outstanding. The internet connection is reliable and free. The cliental is mostly hipsters. The staff is friendly and have always thanked me if I leave a tip (even if it's only a dollar). This place is worth a visit.

I had such a great time here!!! The staff is so friendly (honestly like chatting with friends) and the whole place just exudes joy and warmth. They aren't just there to serve ice cream, but seem to really want to get to know their customers and what we want. They usually have a board up of flavor suggestions that customers can contribute to and they actually make it happen! Mason's has so many unique ice cream flavors, as well as plenty of vegan options. I got the pineapple upside down cake (with pineapple chunks, YUM) and marzipan and it was DELICIOUS and creamy and smooth. They also gave us a complimentary egg waffle, and that with ice cream? AMAZING. Would recommend 100%!
I really like this ice cream shop! The ice cream shop is so cute! I love the flavors!!!! I just love the area where it's located! I love the cookies n cream and birthday cake flavors the most!

Super clean, decently priced and kid friendly. We love all the options and the boba is amazing. It is a great place for a daily treat. There are so many Ice cream choices that are all amazing, but also really good ice tea blends. Check out their daily tea specials.
Raised prices to 24.95 per dozen from 18.95. A 32% increase! Good donuts but not worth that price. Way to stick it to your customers.

I grew up in California, home of the original Ghirardelli chocolate factory so must admit to being spoiled. When you went on a tour of the factory at the end you got an entire chocolate bar. Seems as though this place could give customers a piece of candy. The portions have gotten smaller and we found that the hot fudge must have been so warm it almost melted to the sides of the plastic cup. Who eats a hot fudge sundae out of plastic. That said they do have the best hot fudge in the world and the ice cream is smooth and creamy. You can certainly share a sundae believe me.

4 star! nothing bad i kinda just expected better because of how popular it is. but i feel like that's how it usually goes with popular restaurants. i has the strawberry and corn milk quake and it was super good but i feel like i could've went somewhere less expensive and got the same thing!
Went around 9pm, service was great, parking was a bit of a chore, but was a great find as I got lost while driving and decided to stop to eat.
I go to the Mitchell's in Rocky River, Ohio. Ice cream and offerings delicious. Staff is excellent in customer service. Portions great. Love Mitchell's!

I got the full BLT sandwich with the salad as the side. Delicious! The BLT is a pretty basic sandwich, and I'm my opinion pretty hard to mess up, but the fresh bread with just the right amount of crunch and fluffiness makes this sandwich to die for. The vinaigrette for the salad was also really tangy and nice! At first, I didn't order a drink, but the saltiness of the bacon just made me order an iced jasmine green tea. On its own it can be a bit bitter? Strong? I don't know how to describe it, but it's not bad. I just added some honey to it, which was perfect for my liking.
Awesome flavor selection and nostalgic, retro candies. The line can be long but if you can pop in for a quick scoop it's great and worth the money.

My sister in law and I are fans of Christina Tosi after watching her on Netflix, so we were both excited to stop by while we were in Vegas. The Milk Bar pie and cereal milk ice cream were just as delicious as we dreamed, and the birthday cake was to die for! The cookies were a bit disappointing, as they are all prepackaged and you can even buy some of the varieties just like that at some grocery stores, but the Fried Apple Caramel Crisp cookie was something different, so that one was worth a try! The Birthday Cake Truffles were pretty good too. We definitely are planning our next trip back!

I stopped by at the ATM machine. It was a cool concept and very cute and modern set up. However, with not knowing how long the cupcakes being put in their machine, or how the cupcakes were handled. I was hesitant to spend 5 dollar on a cupcake that's been operated on a 24/7 basis. Would rather walk in and buy my cupcakes there then take the pictures outside!

Was excited to discover a Carlo's Bakery across from the hotel I was staying at. Planned to hit it first thing in the morning for my much needed coffee and a pastry or pastries...don't judge. Got there about an hour after they opened and was pleasantly surprised on my a few people ahead of me. The line took longer then I thought it should take govern the amount of people but I was ok with it as I was able to fully decide what i wanted when it was my turn. Everything looked absolutely delicious. After resisting to order one of everything I settled on mini connolis, cannoli tart, peanut butter chocolate cupcake, and a variety of cookies. EVERYTHING was delicious. Melted in your mouth good. Minus a star for not having coffee. Apparently the machine wasn't working? ? Bakery with no coffee is just a sin in my opinion. Next time I'm in this neck of the woods I'll be back to try a few more things. Hopefully they get the coffee thing worked out.

Wonderful little ice cream/candy joint right next to the Windsor Restaurant. The interior isn't very large, but it's super inviting and has a very clean/kiddish vibe to it. I think it's the perfect atmosphere for a candy/ice cream joint! They do have a wonderful back patio that is right next to the Windsor patio, but is still separate from it. The patio is very clean and inviting. There are plenty of beautiful flowers and trees to enjoy while eating your meal. The seating and shading are comfy and there are misters to keep you cool. Their menu of ice cream is not very large, but the flavors are unique and are created daily. There are plenty of topping options as well. They have a wide selection of coffees (lattes, cappuccinos, teas, Americanos, etc), as well as toppers to include Soy Milk! I ordered an Iced Americano (12oz for 2$), and my husband ordered an ice cream sandwich. You can choose to create your own sandwich using any of their delicious cookies and ice cream options. They have waffle cones, pretzel cones, and a variety of other options to pair with your ice cream experience. Unfortunately, they do not serve yogurt or sorbet ice cream at this time, a deal breaker for those of us who can't/won't eat dairy! My family has been back several times as they can't get enough of Churn's unique and tasty goodies. Churn is a must try for any ice cream lover !
I love fruity flavored ice cream and this place just hits the spot with just that! That torched marshmallow tho is just perfect!
Such good ice cream. Such good donuts. Such nice people. I think the rest of reviews speak the praises already so I'll keep it brief!

Obsessed with this bakery! After seeing this place mentioned a few times on social media, I decided to give it a try. I love how much this place feels like your neighborhood bakery. Everyone is so nice and passionate about their eats! Currently, they are limiting the number of people in the shop to two (COVID), so there may be a line. Be patient, it's well worth the wait. Looking for coffee? Give their latte a go with oat milk, you'll thank me later. Now, hands down my favorite thing from here is the olive oil loaf. My gosh. Like it so much I have now ordered and gifted the loaf 3x to people who are now hooked! A runner up for me? The Chocolate Croissant - omg. Chocolate is throughout the croissant and just sooo good. The macaroons, rainbow cookies, everything bialys (warmed with cream cheese) are also notable and YES way treats. I'll continue to support this fantastic bakery and I hope you do too!

Picked up some ice cream for dessert & had to choose two flavors for a small cup. Went with the coffee and donuts and the pretzel ice cream. The flavors were really good, but the mix in tasted stale. I would most likely go with a flavor without chucks of a topping.
Really, really good! Taste homemade and fresh. Had the Butter Pecan, so yummy. Sorry no diabetic options, so bring your insulin!

Such a cute place! I love the ambiance and decor. Unfortunately I already bought a sweet drink in the area so I didn't get any ice cream here however the strawberry sandwich I ordered was yummy. I took a star off because it was super pricey and the bread was a little hard like it was left out too long. $4 for half a crust less sandwich with 1.5 strawberries and cream - it should've been made fresh.

Originally went to their Concord location occasionally and was thrilled when they moved their location to Charlotte. Forget Amalie's--these sweets and the people are even better. They have the best brownies I've ever had. Also enjoy their macarons, cream horns, and olive oil cake. The staff are also very friendly. I've never had their coffee but it always smells really nice.

If you're looking for a good dessert, I don't recommend this place. It was super pricey for what you get. I don't mind spending money on good food but this place missed the mark. I had the Fruity Pebble ice cream, it tasted nothing like them. I was expecting sweet fruity flavors but it was super bland. My husband got the Golden Knight Shake, for $15 I was expecting it to at least be topped with whipped cream. I really should have looked at reviews and the lack of line here. Should have been a dead giveaway.

I totally devoted an afternoon to trying to find this place. It is not easy to find. Especially when the hotel is under construction and the signs in the hotel kind of suck. I eventually found it behind the escalator. It's a tiny counter, reminiscent of a Starbucks inside of a grocery store or airport. I hoarded my cappuccino maracrons. They had a buy 5, get a 6th free special going on. Score! I carried my babies in my hand onto the airplane and put them under the seat. Then I ate them all. The end.

Great late night place to hang out, have a coffee, catch up on work or homework. Great sweets choice, eclectic decor and eclectic clientele (at least at night - it's midnight as I write this). I'll be back.
Amazing donuts! I'd commute for these they were so good. Lots of variety and new flavors. Friendly staff and a clean facility. A bit pricy but unlike any donut I've had before

We went here after hearing about it on Social Media. It's not something I'd want to go back to. Workers weren't very friendly and I think it was pretty overpriced for toppings. The ice cream was too sweet for me, not the greatest experience.

Discovering Jeni's has completely changed the ice cream game for me. Every time I've gone to a store or bought a pint from Publix it's as if I've found a new favorite flavor - seasonal and staple flavors, I've never been disappointed. My go to has been to do both Gooey Butter Cake and Brambleberry Crisp together, it never disappoints. I love this location, and while there is always a line down the street, it's always quick and perfect for a sweet treat after visiting one of the restaurants nearby for dinner.
Love their soups and sandwiches. A really fun place to hang out. Love most of the pastries, but sometimes they seem a bit too chilled or even somewhat stale.
Let's skip right to the point...the service was slow. They didn't get our order right. But in the end the ice cream was fresh and mouth watering. - Couple's Critic

Love Pages! The ice cream is well worth the line! I love that they incorporate other local treats into their menu and think it is great to see everyone supporting each other. It is always so sad to see them close and I look forward to them opening! I love the Nancy B cookie sundae!
Every time I am in Champaign I make sure to make a pit stop! This custard is so yummy and smooth! Amazing flavors and friendly service! Can't wait to be back for more!

Batch will never let you down. They always have a wide assortment of delicious goodies for the fan of both savory and sweet treats. The coffee is also really good, a little bitter and strong. Try the ham and gruyere croissants! Or any of the croissants for that matter! I have never had anything from here that I didn't love.

Ugh finally one opened close to me! Normally I always go for their taiyaki and never really cared about their soft serves -- I changed that today. Got their upside down ah-boong with Oreo and another one with their Milk Tea/Thai tea combo and it was so good! One can definitely not go wrong with their taiyaki here, as well -- Nutella, custard, and taro is my fave! They had an Oreo flavor in this location which is v new to me. I dig it. Please note that this location just opened so the line is friggin' long! Despite that, customer service is great!

Great selection of goodies! The hardest part is deciding what to get from the vast variety offered. Just had a pecan pumpkin arctic swirl-deliciousness is a cup! Fresh pumpkin, pecans and vanilla wafers all blended together. It was So good I forgot to take a picture.
Capt. Crunch Ice Cream with a toasted 'mallow was I'd definitely recommend this place if you're looking for a unique ice cream joint.

Wow wow wow. No amount of superlatives could do my description justice. Just absolutely AMAZING!!! This is just an amazing place with some amazing dessert. Go all the way and get a cookie cup. You won't be disappointed!!! Come. Eat. Be happy. It's delicious!!! My son and I have a new favorite place!!!

Churn is adorable. They have amazing ice-cream and a great selection of other things as well. They have such a unique shoppe and cute outdoor seating that is very inviting and different. It's great after a date or a night out, and the workers are very friendly and know how to serve all the people in there in a timely manner! They are very family friendly and I believe pet friendly!

Amazing cup of coffee!!!! The coffee lover in me says YES! The chocolate almond croissant was the perfect partner. Take the escalator up, sit on a bench and enjoy at the end of the canal singing and all. Life is good.

Well, if you're on a diet you better forget it because this place will have you saying goodbye to that steel cut oatmeal in no time. My first experience with Jack Frost was at a Yelp event - that maple bacon donut was life changing. Since then, there's been no turning back and I'm as much of a fan of this place as you can get. When you walk into this place of amazingness, be prepared to feel overwhelmed with the incredible options you have. Flavors you've seen, flavors you've never heard of, flavors you can't imagine living your life without tasting. Trust me - there are so many you want to try and double up on that hitting your dozen comes faster than you expected. My office is hooked on these incredible doughy treats topped with everything from salted caramel to a pile of delicious frosting. Until Jack Frost I was completely unaware of what a fantastic donut should taste like. The dough itself is heavenly - perfectly soft and moist and will rock your world. So what are you waiting for? You know you want one (or three). P.S. Remember to bring some cash because they don't take plastic. A $10 bill will get you a dozen.

My kid had a birthday and we live long distance from Madison. I called Chocolate Shoppe Ice Cream and asked if they could run an ice cream cake across the street to my kid's apartment which was within eyesight of their store. The lady I spoke with was so nice telling me she would deliver it herself. My kid got a big surprise and it made his day. I'm so grateful for Chocolate Shoppe Ice Cream for making the extra effort to help me make my kid's birthday special. These are good people at this shoppe.
The service was fast and good. Everything was clean, but very over priced. Prices aren't listed either. We paid $35 for 3 small peices of okay cheesecake. Not overly impressed.

There's simply no going back to Dairy Queen or Cold Stone after going to Sweet Republic. The flavor combinations available are often surprising but always amazing. Particularly the sugar and spice ice cream has taken over the top of my favorite ice cream of all time list. Service is friendly and quick even with heavy queuing you move right along. Don't think twice stop and order something, you can't go wrong.

Terrible customer service. Overpriced, mediocre food (at best). Stopped by about 10AM on a Sat for a snack and some juice. There were 6 people working behind the counter, and every one of them was dismissive and unfriendly. They all seemed as if they hated their jobs. I get that customer service can be a frustrating job, especially in food, but I expect to be treated with kindness and respect. After I ordered and paid, they forgot my food. I had to ask for it about 10 mins later. The bottled orange juice was good. The toasted turkey and cheese baguette was not. Dry. Cold. Tough. Disappointing. Maybe their coffee and espresso drinks are better, but I'll never stop by there again to find out.
So cheap but also so good. Best bakery in Vegas hands down. Could eat here everyday. I wish there were more locations.
Wow!! Amazing desserts. Loved the red velvet cake and smores bar. With that being said, everything looked delicious. I can't wait to come back and try more of their delicious offerings.
Their food is excellent. I'm from San Francisco and whenever I'm in town I try and visit.

Most delicious ice cream I have ever had and I have had a lot of ice cream! I had the hangover helper; sweet cream ice cream, brandy, and frosted flakes. AMAZING! The double chocolate and strawberry were great as well.

Our new ice cream favorite! Cute little shop homemade ice cream flavors and toppings. Decent sizes too to get your ice cream fix. Fresh and clean and a small outdoor area to eat. No dine in though. Old time candy for sale along with cookies freshly baked. They also serve floats and milkshakes. Our first visit won't be our last!
Love 85 bread!!!!! It's the best in the valley! Finally they came into the town! Especially the cake they are offering right now is the boba milk tea #85clv

Very good custard as always, if you like rich frozen goodness. Look no further. I would recommend getting your custard in a waffle cone, you get a little more bang for your buck. You seriously can't be in the Champaign-Urbana area with out getting some!
Good and friendly service. An institution. The custard seems different, perhaps sweeter than I remember. But good and worth the effort if you have a taste.

Not to long ago I tried donut bar for the first time at the farmers market at downtown summerlin. I enjoyed just about every single donut they had and the guy who had helped me pick out some of them was super nice and friendly. So today I decided to drive from the other side of town to get some more of their donuts cause I enjoyed them so much the first time. Well I got there, first off the building is way to small they need to have a bigger space to walk. People kept running into each to get to the line or from the line to check out. Second off we were waiting in line and no one was helping us it seemed to be they were helping everyone around us, including the people that were behind us. Finally I had to ask someone to help us. Third after I had gotten home I dug into the donuts and they weren't as good. I had bought some that I knew were good from my previous experience at downtown summerlin and some new ones to try. I had gotten a maple bar, how can someone mess up on a maple bar? Honestly their donuts need more flavor. The donut itself is amazing, it's soft and moist but they have lack of flavor from the fillings and from the frostings. Honestly you'd be better off going to a grocery store than here.
They are way over priced. Sorry people, hate to bust your bubble, but I've had better and not for this price. $36.00 on a few pastries is insane!!!!!!

Wow. Just wow. Tasty little hidden gem in Scottsdale! There is absolutely nothing better than a toasted marsh mellow on top of Captain crunch ice cream with captain crunch cereal bites with a caramel macaron. Good variety of ice creams and sorbets. Overall, cute little shop with friendly staff.

This is such a long, overdue review that I keep remembering I need to write because the customer service was THAT stellar! I've been twice and both times two different people who were working were incredibly patient, joyful and explained the ice cream with such a passion you don't normally encounter at a dessert shop! The lines get pretty long (worth it) and they still take the time time to not rush you and make sure you order exactly what you want. The ice cream is AMAZING! The donut sandwich has all the right textures and taste especially when you add a cereal mix! Lovely concept and energy at this place!

This place is so fun! Amazing combo of ice cream macarons and toasted marshmallow! Full of mix and match options so you can get creative sand create your own yummy goodness. It's so fun watching them torch the marshmallow

Maple cake donut. Smiley donut. Both are the must haves. One bite and you get, a mouthful of icing and fried warm cake - and I'm not talking just the royal icing, but a creamy dollop of additional frosting covering the "hole" of the round donut. This is a must when I visit Cleveland, and Weight Watchers isn't going to stop me! A new addition: Maple Bacon Cake Donut, absolutely divine.

Why do I always do this to myself? Okay, I'll admit it. I had high hopes for Amelie's. After viewing their website and reading the rave reviews, I expected something...else. Maybe my hopes were too high, but I was ready to die in chocolate heaven, float on my blissful boat of yumminess and celebrate another year of being alive. Alas, it was not to be. My $50 chocolate chocolate birthday cake was anything but heavenly, and not at all blissful. In fact, I'm pretty sure that Harris Teeter makes a better chocolate cake. That being said, however, I still have hope for Amelie's, and won't dismiss it until I've tried some of their other sugary confections.

Had the mint & cookies and butter pecan flavors, which were both delicious and creamy! I loved that there were actual pecans in the butter pecan flavor, and did think that the cookies were a little bit lacking in the mint & cookies option. A little bit overpriced, but the ice cream is good and would definitely recommend!

Simply the best! Just went to an event and was blown away by every little detail. Not only were those donuts just decadent, but just the way they came out and looked won huge in my eyes! I'll be at donut bar tomorrow morning for that French Toast donut in the AM and some good ol coffee

Small, local business with high-quality ice cream and a friendly staff! The flavors are constantly changing, so it's always fun to go and try new things. And they are generous with their free samples to ensure you pick one that is just right. Does it get any better? Actually, yes.... You can choose to smush your ice cream between warm, fresh cookies, waffles or churros. Last night I went for the butterfinger and brownie batter flavors between chocolate chip cookies, and as usual, I was not disappointed. Give it a go!

Ice Cream: Pleasantville Edition. Coming to this ice cream shop gave me flashbacks to an old place I visited in Kansas City when I was just 15 or 16 years old. It really doesn't seem to fit in the modern age, and I love that. There is no establishment to enter, just windows that face the outside so they can take your order and hand your dessert off. There are some metal benches outside, but they aren't comfy. I took off a star because I would appreciate some seating so that this could be a date night. At the moment its just kind of a pick-up and go home place. Still, if I am completely honest, the vibes I get from ordering at the window are cool. All the employees are friendly and chill (get it?). Actually, I think I will give that star back. I would like chairs, but I appreciate them for what they are. Judging by their other locations, it looks like they originated in Ohio. I am so ecstatic they chose to start up a shop in our own little city of Vegas! Do yourself a favor and get the sampler. You get four very decently sized scoops so you can try more than one flavor for only slightly more cash than a single scoop. Boyfriend and I always do the sampler! My favorite flavor is Ore-Dough. It's an Oreo/Cookie Dough mix that gets everything right! It isn't listed on their website so they may be late at updating.
I love the Knope! Iykyk. Cute area ! Great service always. You can hang out in the patio where there's more shops to browse.

I wanted so much to love this place! But for the price and taste, 3 stars is as high as I can go. Pros: fantastic service - staff were friendly and knowledgeable Cute shop - set up/ decor Ginormous donuts and vegan choices Free Jiggly puff donut for my son Vegan apple fritter was yummy Cons: Aside from the apple fritter the donuts were just ok. For the elaborate toppings the actual donuts were alright, nothing special. Price varies per donut...I paid $18 for 6 donuts ( vegan: 2 creme brulee, 1 strawberry split, 1 apple fritter, 1 cake batter, 1 chocolate euphoria, and a free Jigglypuff donut) Music was a bit loud and it made it hard to hear donut descriptions and specials from the staff Had this place bookmarked for a while and decided to try it out. Apple fritter was good...probably only donut I would go back for.

Been here a few times and the desserts are definitely good. There's always a crowd and they can run out of some of their more popular desserts. There's a good variety, unique decor, and the line moves pretty fast. If you come during peak hours it can definitely be hard to find a seat and you may have to stand in a line that goes out the door and wraps around the corner. The prices I think are high for Charlotte, they're pretty much what I would pay in LA for the same thing but the desserts are good. And it's one of the few places in Charlotte that's not a bar but open late.

The best thing about Mitchells? Their vegan chocolate ice cream is literally better than any dairy-based ice cream I've ever had. Hands down. It is so creamy, velvety, and chocolatey - and all of my friends have said the same thing once I make them try it. That being said, I've also never had a bad flavor at Mitchell's. Their seasonal flavors are always on point (e.g. the coffee porter, the mint chocolate truffle, etc), and their classic flavors can't be beat (black raspberry chocolate chunk, pistachio, peanut butter, cookies and cream, bing cherry chocolate chunk, etc). Their staff are also super nice and knowledgeable about the flavors, which is fantastic when I can't decide what new flavor to try. Case in point: one day I wanted to try a new non-dairy combo, and per the staff's suggestion, I got the best smoothie I've ever had - a vegan chocolate, raspberry sorbet, and banana smoothie sent from the heavens (picture attached). When you come here, you honestly can't go wrong!
Just had the Oreo cookie B-day cake donut Idk how many calories I just consumed but that thing was just outrageously delicious.....good thing that I live pretty far from their shop.

Everything LOOKED delicious...I got the strawberry shortcake. The only good thing on there was the strawberries and the whip cream. Cake was dry. My friend got the cheesecake and he needed water to wash it down because it was dry. How can cheesecake be dry?? My other friend got a cupcake and she also said it was dry. All the cakes are the same batter. Not worth the money. We ended up finding a fountain to sit by since there were only 4 stools in the place.
it was great, got a box of goodies and intended on taking them back home for my family to enjoy but for some reason they never made it, we ate them all!

I am very glad I found out about this place. This was my second time there. First time I got the Italian Cream Cake. It was superb. Tasted as good as the one passed down in my family for generations. This time I got the Lemon citron cake. OMG!!! It was just the right balance of sweetness and slight tart from the lemon. Can't wait to try more treats from this place.
The blueberry soft serve was so good! I'm a little grateful this isn't super close to me because I would have no restraint!! Glad we checked this out- we will be back FOR SURE!

Jarling's a darling. J: ust so you know, this is my #3 frozen custard place. Pretty rockin'! A: vailable seating outside. Even in November. :o) R: edonkulous amount of items on the menu, including a bajillion variations of snowstorms (like DQ's blizzard or McD's McFlurry). L: eery of overblended ice cream treats, the only downside to my visit was that my snowstorm started melting before I even got it. I: f you're reading this, Nov. 22 is the last day Jarling's is open for this season. You're too late. :o( N: ever too cold to eat frozen custard. Why are you open seasonally??! G:ot daily flavors of vanilla, chocolate, lemon, orange, and something else. S: uper smooth frozen custard!

Looking for a bite to eat in Ohio City? I highly recommend stopping by Crepes De Luxe located in the West Side Market. You definitely get what you pay for in terms of flavor and filling your stomach. Whether you have a sweet or savory tooth, they have a variety of ingredients to satisfy your craving. They have a menu to choose from but you're more than welcome to make your own. I usually go for the savory crepes. For an extra tip, if you ask for salt they use the pink Himalayan salt which makes a huge difference for flavor than just regular table salt.

I don't think people who rate 5 4 stars knows what the hell they are talking about trust me being from NY Brooklyn can tell you Carlos bake shop is rated low on Brooklyn New Jersey great chart. The reason people think it is great and taste YUMMY as a lot of you call it is because your mind tricks you in thinking you are tasting something great since slice bread! Trust me he's pastries are ok but not great just below avg.

Came in for a sundae on Sunday! This place is located at the LINQ, right by the High Roller. It was packed at 1030pm!! The shop is pretty small, and the seating is all squished together, but they move pretty quick and the sundae was PERFECTION! Try the Treasure Island with chocolate ice cream - chocolate brownie, ice cream, tons of fudge and whipped cream! At 12 bucks, it definitely isn't the cheapest place to go, but I highly recommend. Plus they give out samples... who doesn't love free chocolate?!?

4.5 to be precise. It's good to know that this place pays true respect to its own state's title of "Dairyland"!! Nestled right in the heart of downtown, it's a perfect spot for everyone be it college or corporate! The ice cream options are quite the handful and extremely fun as they mostly stay away from the bog standard usual's (Vanilla, Chocolate etc). Take your sweet time to read the descriptionS carefully coz many of them are delightful concoctions with interesting flavor twists! I tried their Strawberry Cheesecake and Zanzibar and man o man both rocked! It was soo nice to have a "cheesecake" ice cream with LOTS of cheesecake in it! The strawberry flavor was nice and not overly sweet and complimented the cheesecake bites. The Zanzibar was a medley of chocolate flavors and the result was this very rich but not dense chocolate taste with a hint of brownie after taste to it. Texture of both ice cream was pleasantly gooey which I much rather prefer than hard or custardy Ala yogurt. My only critique I'd say would be the presence of icy crystals in both the ice creams. They weren't that many but do mar the otherwise exquisite experience. All in all, please do give this place a try if you, like me, have an ENORMOUS sweet tooth!!!
Love love love this place!! Great service, out of this world ice-cream & other treats. The BEST thing on the menu...toffee banofi!!! Unbelievable & worth every calorie!

I was fortunate enough to visit Carlo's bakery without the long lines (I went close to closing). We ate lobster tails probably everyday of our 4 day trip, they were so so good! The cream inside is amazing and the dough is flaky and just the right amount of sweetness. We did not try anything else, but I highly recommend the lobster tails.
Delicious and adorable! (The ice cream shop, not my daughter). Plenty of choices and incredible toppings. Super friendly owners makes me want to come back again soon.

Lots of great sweets options! Latte was great as well. They have gelato, but I've never tried it. They have food options for a very reasonable price. I love to go here for their tiramisu cake and cannolis!! My friend came to visit me from out of town and I took her to Prestis and a man in front of us paid for our order!! Too sweet. Great place to study, go on dates, nom on sweets and food, and people watch. Love to go here all the time.

Hella expensive and it did not meet my expectations. Lol the worker tried to convince us to buy two lobster tails because as he put it "is like a piece of heaven"... idk about him but if that was his heaven then that's pretty sad. The lobster tail looked good don't get me wrong, but the taste and texture wasn't amaze balls. The outer shell was crunchy and hard, not flaky and soft. We also got an individual strawberry cheesecake with crumbs and for the size of my palm (and I have a small palm) you pay $10 for okay cheesecake. I wouldn't mind paying if it was a GOOD pastry but I did not think this was at all worth the money.

This is the best new addition to the ice creamery landscape in the city. The flavors are unique and delicious. Their prices are in line with the rest. Expect long lines in peak hours but worth the wait BRAMBLE BERRY CRUNCH is delicious.
This place is located at the linQ...we were walking by and stopped here to check it out... And got to try one of the best cupcakes ever!!!! So moist and so perfect!!

Very disappointed with my last visit to this bakery which is really sad given I live nearby. I ordered the coq au vin soup which i was told was a hearty chicken soup, the croissant sandwich with ham and cheese as well as a fruit tart. The cup of soup had absolutely no pieces of chicken in it, just a lot of broth and onions. The croissant was a mess, one side was not the entire croissant, seems most of it felt out or got burned so removed. The only thing that was good was the fruit tart as always. As I ordered all to-go, I didn't noticed all this until I got home which was extremely irritating. And this is not a cheap place!

Such a lovely and charming place! Really felt like I were in Paris. :) I loved their decor and their pastries. So yummy! Very filling though. We've got a vanilla eclair, chocolate cake (don't remember the name), and coconut macaron. We will definitely be back when we're in the area.

i'm not an ice cream person but i find myself asking to go to honey hut more and more. the workers there are young, so mistakes are made but they are always courteous and fix any issue one may have. i recommend the whipped cream - it is homemade and the absolute best whipped cream i've ever had

Here's why I love AZ: With 100+ reviews, 4.5 stars rating, hottest day of the year so far, there is not a line to be had at this delicious place. If this place with this rating was in the Bay Area we would be waiting in a block long line in the rain (ahem-ici!-ahem) for pricey ice cream. The Coconut Sorbet (with fresh coconut) and the Mint Chip (with lots of fresh mint!) were out of this world. The Salted Carmel could have used a little more of the salt, though. Will be back when we return to AZ.

I love macarons. They have large sized macarons for 3.25/ea. I purchased vanilla, raspberry and chocolate. Vanilla was more of a vanilla bean super light, chewy, fluffy and just delicious! Raspberry was ok, it wasn't as good as the vanilla, the coloring on the cookie was half faded so I don't know if it was the light in the case that caused it, or it was a little less than fresh. I probably should have stuck with the coffee flavored one. Chocolate was fabulous, rich flavor, melt in your mouth macaroon cookie goodness. I also purchased a blueberry muffin around $4. It Had a crumb topping with powdered sugar. Muffin tasted like a muffin, not too dense or cakey. Lots of luscious blueberries inside, definitely not lacking. I waited to indulge on these goodies until my last day in Vegas. I anticipated them to be delicious, and they were. So they were a nice end to my vacation. My next trip here, I'll definitely be trying more

Great place for a quick breakfast and coffee if you are staying at The Venetian. I tried a bit of the chocolate almond croissant and cheese danish and of the two I think the cheese danish was better. The filling wasn't too sweet and the outside pastry was crisp and flaky. Chocolate macaron and better nutter cookie are rich and decadent. Now time to walk the strip and walk off those calories!

All of the baked goods are made fresh and individually wrapped to maintain freshness until you eat them. A large selection of flavors and different types of pastry's. A definite must try if you like breads and pastries.

Finally got to try this place. Yummy describes this sinful obsession of imaginative donut flavor combinations. I regret that I didn't check out the online menu to see what types they had before going there. So it was a bit over-whelming trying to view/choose what to order because the line moved too quickly. I tried the lemon cake donut drizzled with a cream cheese frosting glaze & took back a huge blueberry glazed donut (I forget what there actual names are). If that wasn't enough, I was fortunate enough to try the Homer Simpson pink donut w/ sprinkles (they always sell out, so go early). Well...they were all wonderfully delicious. But, I'm glad they are not located close to where I reside otherwise, I would be there at least once a week & that wouldn't be good for my waist line (yikes). Yet, I do think about & crave those fried desserts since I've tasted them!!
For those who ever watched Cake Boss on TLC or other channels but never made it up to Hoboken NJ to try it out. This place is great. Same great treats with a little Vegas price.

This is the cutest little bakery in town. Due to COVID only one person is allowed in the shop at the time. They have a nice variety of baked goods. Sorry I didn't take a picture of it all. But trust me you won't be disappointed. From cakes to all types of pastries, macaroons, and cookies. I finally decided on cookies. They sell by each piece or by the pound. I got a variety of cookies by the pound. They where delicious fresh and full of flavor. I'll be back.
Great service incredible pastries and food. If you've ever been here, there's no need to explain 5 stars. I've been a customer of theirs 30 years. There is no substitute.

Popped in to try a vegan doughnut and tried the creme brulee. I'm sure it's more traditional creme brulee so the topping was crisp and hard. Not my cup of tea BUT someone else may love it. The vegan selection was smaller than I thought because there were only 2 options at the time I went in but it's nice they have some. The filling was good and the people nice. Again the review is based on my taste and preferring a glaze versus the crust of the creme brulee. So don't hesitate to try it.

They believe 85 Celsius is the best temperature for brewing coffee. How interesting and scientific! I love this bakery! I visited one in Pasadena in the past. Their pastries are affordable, presentable, and flavorful. They offer nice variety of pastries as well as cake desserts. I also tried their house coffee which was light and smooth. Their house coffee comes with sugar and cream automatically so if you don't want sugar or cream make sure you tell them so. Customer service is also excellent here. They have sitting area available.

I am a huge ice cream fan and it's my go to when I want to splurge. This place has amazing ice cream with very unique flavors. The gentleman working told us that the creator of the flavors was one of the most decorated in the southwest. I didn't get their signature donut ice cream sandwich, but instead the classic waffle cone and two flavors. I got the honey lavender and fat Elvis, so good. You're in for a real treat.

I can't hate on a place the focuses on cupcakes and fancy's them up to try to justify their cost. Yes, the cupcakes are good and yes, I would consider taking a guest to try them out if interested, but I wouldn't go there just to satisfy a craving due to the price.

Ask to sample the soft serve flavors and choose your poison. My group and I came back to this place 2-3 times during our trip to Vegas because it was that amazing. DON'T SLEEP ON THE CRACK PIE. It's one of the best $7 you'll ever spend (second to that $7 ice cream you're about to buy hehehe)

My mom had the lemon pistachio donut which was large. She felt like it was tasty and delicious. A nice lemon my glaze that was not too sweet. Could have been lighter but she liked it. Sister had the Samoa which is like the Girl Scout cookie. She said it was dry but it did taste exactly like the cookie. The Oreo was delicious and had Oreo in the middle. We all said we would certainly come back for more in the future. The location is convenient and it's a cute little store front with a courtyard we sat in with our little Yorkie.
I'm obsessed with milk bar!!! I got the cereal milk soft serve with cereal on top, I loved it so much I wanted it again after I finished it lol.

About a year ago I tried their famous cereal milk ice cream and it totally didn't do it for me. The texture of the ice cream is more on the icy than the creamy side - not my favorite. But on my most recent visit I got to try their compost cookie ice cream and it had a completely creamy and satisfying texture! I will also mention that it really does have a strong kick of salt. But I thought it was delicious with the sweet cookie flavor. I think I'll have to return for more.....!

AmÃ©lie's French Bakery was the place to be growing up in Charlotte. After a long night clubbing and eating too much cheese at the cheese and wine party, you tend to want something sweet at 4 in the morning. As big as Charlotte is, you'd think there'd be more 24/7 places. AmÃ©lie's has always been a staple delivering fresh handmade pastries, my favorites being the chocolate hazelnut tart and the salted caramel brownie. The workers are always helpful and don't mind telling you what things are. And after seeing the lines wrapped around the building, they still greet you with a smile. The only thing I hate is the parking, although it looks ample, you may be looping around a few times till someone leaves. This by no means will stop me from coming here or giving a 5 star.
We love the Bouchon! We don't go anywhere else for breakfast when in Vegas. Yum!!!! Every single thing is on point. See my photos.

It is definitely worth trying. We really enjoyed the drinks we got. The Kinoka Mochi Shokupan was alright. But the lattes were creamy, rich, not overly sweet and delicious! Also the powder room was so cute and clean!

Went on Saturday afternoon around 3PM in January, I had Baileys Crunch and Vietnamese Coffee in a cup. Baileys was super creamy and smooth...divine! The coffee had very nice unique coffee flavors but was a bit grainy or icy. My wife had Toasted Coconut and Double Chocolate, both excellent in flavor and texture. Prices were very reasonable. Sat outside in the patio next to the Windsor, very pleasant, mix of families and AZ hipsters, with kind of loud indie music. Wanted to try just the ice creams, but the cookies and other toppings looked enticing for next time!
Highly recommend My mother ordered a slice of confetti cake from here and it was delicious!! What a way to celebrate 50th with a slice of something so delicious! Date of visit 3/6/22

Waited in line for ten minutes watching the cupcake I wanted sit there only to order it because it was still sitting on the shelf in the display case and find out someone else ten minutes earlier bought it and the employee was incredibly slow at performing their job.

Was in the hood and in the mood for ice cream Saw Fatty Daddy's pop up on a friend's Bookmarked list and was having dinner down the road. Worth a stop! Ice cream flavors here are cool-- Lucky Charms, Cherry Amareto, Netflix and Chill, and on and on... Very creamy and the butterfat makes for a smooth spoonful. The Cookie cups looked amazing, but we decided to skip since we were so full from dinner. Raincheck! It's a small shop with lots of staff and a good amount of sitting area. It is on the backside of a shopping area, off the major road, though. Don't panic when your nav leads you around the corner, seemingly away from where the shop should be. It's only yards away.

Okay Mitchell's, I see you. This place was so yummy. The peach ice cream was DELICIOUS. The single scoop is actually huge and helps justify the higher price. Everything I tasted from friends was also yummy. BIG TIME RECOMMEND!

4.5 stars. Really cool ice cream location - a renovated old school theater. I actually didn't order anything from here, my buddy did and I proceeded to try a bite - then it went down hill from there for him as I crushed more than half of it (yeah, he was kinda pissed). He opted for butter pecan which would not had been my first choice. But let me say it was the best butter pecan I've ever had. This ice cream is sooo rich - probably the creamiest and thickest I've tried. This truly is a dessert ice cream and not the refreshing variety. Either way, well worth the visit and I will get my own next time (maybe).
Best sundae anywhere :) very fresh ice cream delicious choc. Sauce. Nice large portions. Friendly service.

Our desserts for our wedding were made by Butterwood Bake Consortium, and weeks later our guests still cannot stop raving about how good everything was! We had a blood orange cake with vanilla mascarpone buttercream wedding cake, banana spice cake with mocha buttercream mini cakes, blondies, and brownies. Everything was AMAZING! I don't know how they do it, but their cakes are so dense and moist, and the brownies just melt in your mouth! Ally was amazing with answering our questions, and making sure everything was absolutely perfect. Butterwood is now my go-to bakery in the city. We'll be lifelong customers!

Got two mochas. They were overpriced, small and tasted like warm milk. I asked for a refund and the cashier got offended. Go get your coffee somewhere else. There are plenty of places at the Cosmopolitan

Was here a month back in the morning, and had breakfast before heading to LA. Had a crÃ¨me brulee and it was so good that I ordered two more right after the first bite. The donuts were fresh and soft. Coffee was good. Friendly staffs. There's a backyard patio with a few tables.

Glutton heaven. I feel fat after gorging on a "kitchen sink" filled with chocolate ice cream, chocolate pretzels, peanut butter chocolate chips, peanuts and a mountain of whipped cream. I'm not sorry, though. I'll be back because I can't stay away.

Ice cream cookie sandwich. Best bang for your buck in terms of quality and price. This can be shared with another person for a normal people or if you're overly ambitious and don't care about your health, then this can be eaten solo. The cookie selection has great variety, I opt for the salted chocolate chip. Would be a cute date place. Then, if you're 21, can get blasted next door at the Windsor.

Not often do I give 5 stars but this place is up there! They have a good selection of product and it's all delicious. My wife and I grabbed an ice cream filled donut. We had the animal cracker and Cookie Monster. The ice cream is really made with natural products. I did not end up with that bloated feeling or sweet after tastes that other ice creams leave behind. Besides the delicious treats, the owner was super nice and took his time explaining the menu. The women before us sampled all the flavors, which was the fing annoying but, he was courteous and very patient with them. Will definitely go back!
Comparing to diddy riese cookies in los Angeles... nothing special imo. The cookies.... don't taste like anything special... the ice cream too. Its a fun dessert area though.

I grew up watching Cake boss buddy was an inspiration! I finally got the chance to go to one of his bakery's in Las Vegas, I was so excited!! Only to be disappointed by his product. Obviously I know that the majority of his product is factory made now because of the demand for them. But that doesn't mean that the cake should be dry. I was very disappointed I got three different slices and the only one that wasn't dry was the chocolate. The cannolis were frozen before purchase they weren't fully thawed out I was disappointed because I've had better cannolis at my local shop in California and Buddy is known world wide they should've been amazing. I also purchased some cookies and there wasn't anything special about them. The little moose cake was amazing. Overall I was disappointed maybe going to the original Carlos bakery the quality of his product is better.

Amazing! I am not an ice cream person but I will make an exception for Sweet Republic. I love the Toffee Banofi Sundae. Also the Salted Butter Carmel and Almond Buttercruch ice cream are just wonderful.
Sweet sweet lemon basil sorbet this place is a hidden gem that I will not stop coming to.

Yelped about this place and i love desserts! So, I wanted to try a macaron for the first time. So I walked to the Venetian and found the bakery all the way at the other end from the entrance. It is a small place, I saw different colored macarons: green, orange, white and brown macarons. So I asked what flavors were the macarons and he said pistachio, orange, vanilla and chocolate. So i got the vanilla and chocolate (original flavors) to see how they taste. The macarons were a decent size, took about 4-5 bites to finish them. As I tried the vanilla... it was sooo good!!!! the inside is like eating ice cream and other outer layers was soft and a nice chewy texture. The chocolate one was good too but it was too chocolatey and rich for me. But, i slowly finished it throughout the day.

Yummy! Loved the ice cream and service here. Staff was friendly, nice, answered questions, and worked efficiently to fill orders for the many customers that were there the same time I was. Popular place on a Saturday afternoon! If you coffee, get the dark roast ice cream. So creamy and delicious! Wow! Very impressed with both their coffee flavors. Ate a scoop of each. Spouse enjoyed their turtle sundae! Mitchell's ice cream is fresh-tasting, smooth, creamy and delicious. Worth the trip!

The croque monsiuer here are delicious! Even with the huge glops of mustard. But the lattes are wwwwwwaaayyy too sweet and I even overheard a customer sitting behind me that he couldn't finish his drink because it was too sweet. And the mosaic table will scratch the ish out of your phone :(
Ice cream was good and housemade cones were good. Line was long but went really fast. Fun atmosphere. We will go back for sure!

My husband and I were excited to take the pilgrimage to Las Vegas to visit Milk Bar. We'd heard multiple outstanding reviews and couldn't wait to try out their unique creations. I left disappointed. While my husband enjoyed his Fruity Cereal Milk shake, I wasn't overly impressed with my Cereal Milk soft serve with flakes as my topping. The soft serve itself wasn't overly flavorful, which made the overwhelming saltiness of the flakes unpalatable. I ate a couple bites and couldn't stomach any more. It wasn't sweet/savory; it was bland/salty. Funny enough, a more significant part of what made our experience lackluster was the disinterested staff. They weren't excited about their product, they weren't happy to be there, and their lack of enthusiasm shone through. I won't be returning to Milk Bar in the future.

GOURMET CAKE & PASTRIES AT ITS FINEST! The Butterwood Bake Consortium is one of my favorite places to stop for dessert if I'm in the city. The shop has this super cool vintage speakeasy type of vibe and the cake and dessert assortments are incredible. This is not just a place you go for a slice of chocolate cake, however, no, no.... These flavors are anything but ordinary - pictured here: Lavender cake with agave buttercream. Or how about Rose Poppy seed with a vanilla frosting? Olive oil cake with a orange honey icing, brown butter blondies with a cinnamon/sugar "pixie dust" topping. And these are just to name a few I saw last night. The flavors and assortments change every time I go, and I promise they never disappoint and are all "melt in your mouth" Incredible! Bonus: they also are open late and have wonderful coffee and tea options to go alongside your dessert! It's the perfect evening spot after a nice dinner if your in the city/Lawrenceville area!

Great bakery with fresh authentic Chinese bread. And there are so many choices. But too bad it's in the worst plaza ever where there's never enough parking. Driving there and finding parking is a nightmare. This entire plaza needs a better parking solution.

Unique treats to be found at Ninety's. It's like a local version of ColdStone, but with character. Choose your ice cream, style, and toppings. Shakes look better than they taste (unless you like thinner milkshakes), but the ice cream sandwich made of brownies - the browniewhich - is amazing!
its alright, a little pricy, floats also are available.

Stopped in here for some sweets while walking back to our hotel. Got a small box of milk and dark chocolate strawberries mixed with milk, dark and white chocolate cherries. Outstanding, especially the strawberries.

We have been Mary Coyle twice and both times go the cherry ice cream its sooooo good. Next time we will have to try some more flavors We were a little disappointed in the waffle cone though. We were really excited to try it when we saw them making them fresh but they were not as good as we hoped.

This place is a big surprise in the city! Shop is clean, nice view on the factory behind the windows. Ice cream is tasty (at least all flavors we tried). Quick service, do not be scared by the size of the line...

Very rude, ice cream wasn't that great. There was 1 family in lobby of 3 and 2 in drive thru and 6 employees yet it took more than 10 mins to get a simple order. I will not be back ... highly recommend avoiding

We had a great time visiting this place and enjoying the fresh ice cream and cookies. There's cute little seating area outside. Perfect place to sit and enjoy when there's beautiful weather outside. My kids enjoyed looking at all the decor and goodies they had on display as well as the ice cream they chose. They switch out cookie options, so not all of the types of cookies are available every time, but the ones we tried were delicious.

What a nice find for ice cream! I visited with my wife and parents on Sunday and was happily surprised to see they had fall seasonal flavors. The pumpkin roll arctic twist was amazing and came with a slice of pumpkin roll on top. I can't wait to visit again soon!

There's a saying now that we eat with our eyes and this place is a prime example of picture perfect dessert. Not only the dessert is well put together, the interior as well. Now there's a big trend going on with grassy walls with neon signs and there's one implemented here to show off your dessert! These places are definitely a reminder that we're slowly started to get all the "Cali-like" boba/ ice cream places. Phoenix is really needing more places like this and I'm very happy it's in a prime spot. They're located next to Pokitrition, near off the 101 and Ray. The cool thing is that the creators of Pokitrition also made this place too! I didn't get to try the boba just yet but the ice cream is great. While being one of the reasons I don't have a 6 pack yet, this just makes it worse cause I'd probably be craving this place. KITH Treats is also a place that I get reminded of about this concept. This place is going to blow up and be packed. I'll be back for more. CERTIFIED BANGER
Staff not friendly. There's a person control door. Won't let you in event you just want to use Kiosk (note: you are next person to go in on the line)

One of the best ice creameries in the US! I've never had a flavor I didn't like! The associates are friendly and always happy to help me try different flavors. My favorites are sweet cream biscuit and peach, salted peanut butter w chocolate flecks, brown butter almond brittle, salted caramel, sage buttermint, lemon & blueberry parfait, goat cheese, peanut butter & strawberry jam. Also love that they have waffle cones and waffle bowl options!
Very busy, but understandably! The cannolis are amazing and cookies very soft. Reasonably priced and we will be back for more!

Hello delicious! They were the vendor for a previous job of mine where I discovered black sesame ice cream...who would've thunk? Amazing. When I visited this business, I tried the honey lavender ice cream and was blown away. We ended up leaving with a pint. Try something unique at this great business!

I had the apple fritter and blood orange (which was a special this week). Definitely not the best donuts in the world. Apple fritter was overcooked and it just had a small amount of apple in the middle. The blood orange icong was GREAT but there was so much bland dough to the doughnut it was hard to enjoy. I wanted to try the french toast donut but they only have that on the weekend.

My scoop of mint chocolate cookie (a nice twist on the traditional mint chocolate chip) was tasty but not life-changing. The ice cream is on the creamier side (versus icy), which I like. The prices are reasonable ($2.75 for a single scoop) but the scoop is also not that big.

I love the ice cream here. Nothing beats sprinkles ice cream. I do miss the flavor that they had a while back that was a monthly special the creme brÃ»lÃ©e flavor last year. I hope they bring it back. I always get the red velvet waffle cone with red velvet or captain crunch. Those are my top two. Now if they bring back creme brÃ»lÃ©e that's my number one favorite ;)

This is the ice cream spot! I mean, now, since Mrs. Mary C. closed, but this place is great! Excellent ice cream that is made by them and great flavors that are always changing. The employees are very nice and are ready to help even when it's packed and crazy. I like to pop in before dinner, because I'm an adult, or after dinner, because I try to be an adult, at one of the many restaurants around Churn. The location makes it another great place. Awesome ice cream parlor design complete with checkered tile. Lots of great toppings, except fresh bananas. You get bananas in there and you get that star. Until then, you're a four at of four, perfect, but a four at out five in this current moment in time because you chose not include fresh banana fruits on your menu. They also sell fun candy and hand buzzers. This is a five out of five star ice cream spot. Sans bananas is no problemanas.

This stop gave me mixed vibes between a modern ice cream store and an olde fashioned soda shoppe. I'd say it lived up to both standards in its own way. I enjoyed a hot fudge sundae with Chocolate Salted Caramel ice cream in place of the standard vanilla. It was creamy, not too salty, had a perfect ribbon caramel and didn't become over powered with the hot fudge. The whip cream was swirled on top by a professional. A delectable ending to my evening and I wish we had a location at home.

Talk about hidden gem. This place is literally located in an area that doesn't get a lot of traffic unless you're actually staying at the hotel. Its hidden behind one of the main escalators across from the Phantom of the Opera theatre. Selection: A-OK. Nothing like the Yountville outpost. I was at the Venetian just a few weeks ago and I actually didn't buy anything from here. Nothing looked tempting. I wanted to get the trio pack of Chocolate Chip Cookies for $5.75 but it wasn't available the next day. I assumed the cookies were left overs from the day before which is why it was priced so cheap. I say build a bigger outpost. With the new CityCenter now opened, you would think Keller would like to cash in on the action. Jean Philippe Maury built a new outpost and its bigger and better.

I've been wanting to try the Milk Bar for a while now, and I was so let down. I was not feeling the cake at all. It's definitely cute, I'll give it that, but the flavor was displeasing. I did taste my sister's cereal milk ice cream and it was not bad. Definitely something (the ice cream) that would have to grow on me.

Churn is a staple; I've been here so many times! I love checking out their new flavors and the very delicious ones that stand out to me are coconut and the hangover helper. All the candies in the store always interesting to look at while you wait in line-- and there's often a line because it's so good!

Donuts...food equals memories. One of my favorite stories from growing up was when my father would let me go on his bread route with him. He was a driver salesman for a local bread company. And every time I would ride with him we would stop at @jackfrostdonuts in Parma. Consistently rated number one or number two in Cleveland, these are by far my favorite cake donuts. Be sure to check hours and follow them on social media because they do sell out frequently. Today I picked some up for one of my clients. Although one magically ended up in my belly also

I walked in at 12:01 Mother's Day evening they told me they closed at 12 I asked politely if I could order something I was extremely nice and IVAN the manager was so rude and couldn't let 1 min slide on Mother's Day mind you ....

Loved the look of this bakery it's is delightfully different and refreshing. The dessert spread is brilliant and the chocolate mousse was out of the world . It is always packed and always open :) I am glad that we found this treasure during our trip to charlotte and even more glad now that I know that they have branch here in Atlanta. This is going to become one of our go to dessert places.

As good as others have said. Unique flavors, very friendly and acommodating staff. I had a small (one scope) malted chocolate chip ice cream with a light drizzle of caramel; my husband had Madagascar vanilla with chocolate sauce, chocolate cover nuts and whipped cream in a waffle cone bowl. Definitely will return, and bring our house guests, too!

I used to get a dozen cupcakes from Sprinkles from a friend from L.A. who never seems to remember which flavors he gets me. The cupcakes pretty much all look the same which my friend describes as "cupcakes with nipples". They have regular-sized cupcakes as well as mini cupcakes. They have regular cupcakes, sugar-free cupcakes, and vegan/gluten-free cupcakes. There's a separate door/line for cupcakes, and ice cream shop. You can go to The Linq and get your cupcakes or order online. They deliver for a fee. You can sign up for their rewards program. My last bakery box include: 1 banana, 4 banana dark chocolate, 1 black & white, 1 black velvet, 1 chai latte, 1 chocolate marshmallow, 1 cinnamon sugar, 1 lemon coconut, 2 salty caramel, 1 sprinkle, 1 strawberry, 2 sugar free red velvet, 1 vanilla milk chocolate. But my absolute favorite is banana dark chocolate. It's like banana bread in cupcake form with delicious dark chocolate on top. Sooooo good! However, it's one of the flavors that's not available daily. Meaning, you have to check the schedule and see what days certain flavors are available. You can purchase cupcake mixes, cupcake stands, shirts and other merch. I could use some banana dark chocolate cupcake right about now...

This is my 2nd visit to Amelie's and their bakery items simply cannot be beat. I HIGHLY recommend the salted caramel brownie. I seriously considered skipping lunch and just eating, like, 3 of these! Their sandwiches and soups are also fresh and delicious. Amelie's is a must if you are in Charlotte!

Yum, yum, and more yum! I only enjoyed a cafe mocha and a salted caramel macaron from the Bouchon Bakery. If I didn't exercise self control, that list would be a whole lot longer! The mocha was a true mocha: CHOCOLATE-y with some espresso mixed in. The macaron was heavenly and cooked perfectly -- crispy at the initial bite, then chewy on the inside. I regret not trying more baked goods at the Bouchon Bakery stand during my stay at the Venetian. What I did try was divine!

In a city designed to take all of your money, this place is rather fair. Maybe too fair with their pricey. Hell, the store next to this place charges $7 for a yogurt that's packaged. They have a decent assortment of breakfast foods and this place can get busy! Busy, busy, and busy. Still it's worth it, especially if you're in the hotel. The cheese croissant is amazing. Overall, if you want a decent breakfast, and don't want to waste too much time, this is the spot.
Easily one of my favorite dessert places and one of the best marshmallows you will ever eat.

Dripp it like it's hot! Dripp is the newest concept from the gang at Pokitrition but now they are serving up classic Boba and Cereal infused ice cream! Today was their Grand opening and people came out in droves. The wait was a bit but it was worth it. They offer Matcha direct from Japan, infused in several drinks as well as some other classics. I got the sweet Matcha and my husband got the Hojicha Latte. The sweetness from the whipped cream along with the Matcha was a perfect combination. The Hojicha was a nice taste since the Matcha was toasted. Their most expensive drink is the Coconut Matcha but that is because it is served in a coconut. So if you want a fun and refreshing aesthetic, hit it up! The ice cream, was absolutely delicious. You can create your own or they have 9 signature creations. Starts with a vanilla base, choose from one of 17 cereals to mix with the ice cream and last but not least, choose your toppings. We chose to do two of the signature ice creams. The cookies and cream along with the frooty tooty. The have a cool machine that blends at high speed, really helps to mix it all up. Overall, the Frooty Tooty was not only gorgeous but so tasty! The fruity combination with the strawberry syrup was delectable. Lastly, the cookies and cream was super creamy and adorable. Make sure to snap a picture against their adorable leafy wallpaper or the aesthetically pleasing neon light/boxwood combination. Tons of free parking, a decent size for seating and a great new addition to the area. Now you have an excuse to eat cereal for dessert.
I have come here now twice within just a few days. Amazing concept with ice cream inside the donut. Omg so good. The people that work here are so wonderful. I keep being my friends. Love it

Wow. The pastries here are the best I've ever had. We shared a lemon poppyseed iced cake, an orange cinnamon roll, a ham baked pastry -- everything was absolutely amazing. We also had iced chai lattes which were excellent! Everything we sampled was delicious, but not heavy or too rich. It was just perfect in flakiness and savory flavors. I will absolutely come back here!

One of my new favorite places for ice cream! First of all, it's connected to Windsor (my favorite restaurant and Old Fashioned!), second of all, they have a bunch of fun flavors (yes.. I tried them all. Don't judge me.) The service is great- they're super nice! One of the ice cream scoopers noticed my husband's Seahawks shirt and asked if we're from Seattle. He said he's headed back to Washington next week for school. It's so nice to meet genuine people who can relate to you. They have a Peanut Butter and Jelly flavor that tastes A LOT like an uncrustable sandwich. The Butter Pecan should have a "danger" label on it because you could easily eat an entire tub of it; it has crunchy pecans and melts in your mouth! The girl helping us said her favorite is the Blueberry Cheesecake, which was delicious! It tastes like a Blueberry O'cream pie that I make on Thanksgiving. They also have Floats; one is called "Caramel Apple Pie" with vanilla ice cream, salted caramel, apple SODA, and cinnamon sugar. I don't know what Apple Soda is but I want it! The chocolate, peanut butter and coffee were sooo good and perfect bases for toppings! There's also a bunch of cone options (Pretzel cone?!)! Everything was so good we literally couldn't decide. We went with the most popular (I know.... boring) and ordered the S'more's. It has chocolate ice cream, hot fudge, butter Grahams (better than any graham cracker I've ever had), and here's where it gets good... toasted marshmallow fluff! Honestly, I don't typically like marshmallows and I really didn't want a big mouth full of marshmallow. But this is not your typical marshmallow. This is that runny, fluffy stuff that's toasted to a crisp on top and compliments the ice cream perfectly. I actually don't think I'll ever get ice cream again without this toasted cloud on top.

A.MA.ZING. A must if you are in Vegas!! It's little place that packs a punch on originality. My boyfriend took me here on my birthday. We got a slice of their birthday cake, cookies, and their cereal milk. Everything was perfect and completely unique!
Very good. Staff was helpful with menu and friendly. I got an Ice cream with the marshmallow & macron. I was very happy to try this place out. Very good.

Man alive, that cereal milk soft serve is incredible. Plus, did you know that you can get a swirl of cereal milk and fruity pebbles? It's the perfect combination. I had heard so much about Milk bar, first through momofuku and then learning more about Christina Tosi. The cereal milk was for sure the item I most wanted to try from milk bar, since I had already tried the compost cookie (albeit onboard Jetblue). I wanted to try the crack pie, but since we had not quite had dinner yet, we decided against it. We will probably try it the next time we are in NYC.

So excited to try their pastries for breakfast and got up at 5:30. So disappointed i order almond chocolate croissants and it was dry and heavy. I think it was over baked.
