I stood in line for 15 min and spent $20 for fruit, croissants. They looked flat when i ordered but hoped looks were delicious .

What's not to love? They have iced coffee on tap, donuts as big as your head. When we were there, we had a buy one get one option. If I were needing a sugar shock, I might have tried the Homer (a pink frosted donut with sprinkles straight out of the Simpsons), but i wasn't feeling so bold. Instead, I opted for a chai cake donut. My boyfriend got a Boston cream. We tore through them so fast I considered getting more. This place is off of Fremont, but still worth a quick grab and go breakfast.

There are few things in life that make me as happy as really good chocolate and really good ice cream. Thus sweet republic is my personal temple to the ice cream gods, where I go to worship the two asian artisan ladies who invent the weirdest and coolest and most delicious flavours of ice cream I have tasted. Wow. Everything is made in house with real, fresh ingredients (as in real mint for the peppermint ice cream). On weekends you can enjoy caramelised bacon flavoured ice cream and their salted caramel is their overall best seller. Their sorbets are definately worth a try too. A tasty, lower "impact" alternative to their full cream varieties. Dont be shy to try exotic things such as their three cheese ice cream or chocolate turtle (chocolate with fudge swirls and cashews), my favourite. Whatever you do, order some salted caramel sauce on top of your creation if you have even the smallest hope it may go with your chosen flavour. It is THE BEST! And on a chocolate ice cream it is an absolute dream. The ladies are always friendly and happy to let you try their alchemical concoctions. A lovely place to unashamedly live out all of your wildest ice cream fantasies.

This is my favorite ice cream place in Cleveland's west side. My most recent visit was specifically to try the ube ice cream. I also got taro so I could taste the difference between the two. I prefer ube, which was more flavorful and sweeter to me. Also, it is a pretty shade of purple! There are many other unique flavors here, and it changes weekly. Vegan flavors are available too. The best way to keep up with the ever changing menu is to follow their Instagram. I'm hoping they bring back the green tea soft serve soon. The shop is small, with outdoor seating and no indoor seating. Parking only has about five spaces, so it is easier to park on the street. The shop itself is super cute and has artwork of dogs eating ice cream on the wall and on the cups. It's just a perfect spot to hang out at during the summer.

Presti's- a place I've visited 3 times already during my first week in Cleveland. I've tried their sweets; the lemon biscotti is amazing! And tiramisu. And there's so many amazing looking options that you can really have whatever kind of Italian baked good your heart desires that day- and I'll be sure to go back to try more. (One thing I would note, however, is that the tiramisu gelato wasn't as great as I was hoping, considering how much I love gelato and tiramisu. I'd stick with the actual pastry next time.) But that's not to say I'm not a fan! The service is great, even when there's a bit of a line the number system keeps it moving along. From a not-sweets standpoint, the food is also pretty delish. I tried the artichoke pizza and for TWO DOLLARS a slice was amazing, filling, and just what I was hoping for. I doubt you'll easily find a slice that as good and inexpensive as Presti's. Again, I'm hoping to try more of the menu, but the have a nice selection of Italian food prepared. It also has a great atmosphere. Tons of nicely lit, indoor seating and lovely seating along the street. You can hear Italian music if you sit outside and soak in the ambiance of Cleveland's little Italy. Great for a quick bite, a coffee, or a treat.

The line was long, but the bakery's were yummy!!! I would give 5/5. The drinks were good. I would give 4/5 If only the line was not long, I would rate this just a little higher than 3. I would have given it a 4.

The gluten free birthday cake truffles are ridiculous. Stopped by to pick some up, and was able to grab a few 3 packs. Service was fast and friendly. The cake bites are honestly perfect. They're soft and cake-y without being crumbly or having that "gluten-free" taste. No mealy, pasty texture. They're perfect, and it was too easy to get them.

I can't stop coming here, and it doesn't help that this location is minutes away from my home. I really love that the ice cream is made in-house, and the story that goes behind this business. I like to think that I'm somewhat of an ice cream connoisseur (I mean, what ice cream lover wouldn't think so of themselves), and the sweet treats here are TO DIE FOR. I can't tell you what my favorite is because they all are (except for maybe grape). When bananas foster is around, that would probably be my go-to, but graham central station is so unique and delicious that it would be my overall new favorite ice cream flavor. Definitely stop by, even if the line is long, because taking home a pint is worth it.

Donut bar is always a good choice! All the donuts are delicious and the service is great! We got there a few minutes after it opened and there was no line, it was about $22 for a half dozen but majority of the donuts are HUGE! The Boston Creme is to die for, and I would definitely recommend trying their famous creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut. They had several vegan options which is always a plus! If you are in the downtown area or even if you aren't, you should definitely check out the Donut Bar!

Here's the thing with this place: It's really freaking good. The thing is that it's so good and it's always so full that the experience takes a hit. If you go at night the line wraps around the store and it's not very organized. The napoleons are the best, but more often than not they are right out of the freezer, so you have to take it home and wait for it to get good. The macarons are good and not too expensive. Overall I recommend it, but not during peak hours
The hype about this place is spot on! The most delicious ice creams and sorbets you will taste. Brandon and staff are so friendly. Don't miss this place!

This place is amazing! It was my first time in and Angela helped me with my indecisiveness. She is fabulous at her job and it's clear she enjoys what she does. I sampled so much and left with not only ice cream, but homemade marshmallows and a cookie. Talk about a diabetic coma, but worth it!

Yum yum yum !! Thats all i can say! Its amazing atmosphere the owner is so sweet him and his daughter we are there 2x outta the week! Keep it us! Yall are a true gem in downtown phx ! Cant wait going again tonight to take all our family from outta town!

When I was asked to go here with a friend, I rolled my eyes. I'm not a "sweets" kinda guy. Amelie's you made a believer out of me! The seeded roast beef on a baguette was out of this world amazing and delicious. None of my friends that begged me to go here told me you guys also sell savory. Things I do like A LOT about Amelies: Ample places to dine with a small or larger group. Parking is adequate and close. The service is very friendly and not impatient with you while ordering. The food was great and more than I expected! What I didn't care for: Long confusing lines and inadequately staffed for lunch. It took too long for what we ordered. Looking around; that was the same for everyone looking impatient. None the less, I will return and try many more of your menu items, returning at a different time of the day.

The food is pretty awesome and I love their ice cream. However, the price is pretty hefty. We got a yum e bun and a brownie sandwich for over $12. It can add up quick and it's pretty delicious! Customer service is good and the location is nice.

We've been here a few times now. Ice cream & service is always very good. My daughter loves the S'mores Sundae. There have a few unusual ice cream flavors & the normal standbys if you don't feel too adventurous. We haven't left disappointed yet.

Overpriced ice cream BUT WORTH EVERY FREAKIN PENNY. Beat the after brunch or after dinner lines and just go there FOR lunch or FOR dinner! Every flavor I've had has been absolutely delicious, and the people working here are always helpful and patient.

Our GO-TO ice cream of all time. Seriously beats all the other ice cream shops here. There's something about this place that makes the ice cream taste so much better. Imagine a hot summer day and you're craving ice cream, you see an ice cream stand in the middle of the park. That nostalgic satisfying taste of summer is this. TRY IT ALL!
They have the best Sundaes' and ice cream desserts at this chain. They have the best milkshakes around. Nothing special in particular about this spot. Just like the others, which is to say "amazing"

The service was slow, but when I got my cookie ice cream sandwich all was forgiven! The location is so prime & great for people watching! I ordered the Chocolate Chip Cookie sandwich with Cookie Dough Ice Cream. WHAT is that even real life?! Your options are pretty unlimited here and EVERYTHING looks yummy. We sat outside and enjoyed our desserts! Try it! You will not be disappointed.

Salted caramel brownies - the way to anyone's good graces! This 24 hour bakery has savory and sweet French baked goods and you can't go wrong no matter what you order. Lattes even come with a fancy design. Quirky Parisian style - including a locks of love fence add to the fun here.

Oh My Gosh! This is my favorite ice cream place in the whole world. I am very particular about my ice cream, i do not just eat any type from a grocery store. The service is great! I go there so often that everyone knows my order. All the employes are so nice, friendly, ad they do a great job preparing everything. Everything is made by them, even the waffle, cookie, etc. I love their waffle bowls! They have different types of spoons, which is very important to me. I just love everything! The interior is very happy and nice! They also have been on food network, so that shows a lot. I always get the mini hot fudge sundae in a waffle bowl with no whipped cream, in brownie swirl. They have all types of different flavors, and are always experimenting. On the weekends sometimes they have donut or bacon ice-cream!

I have an obsession with well-crafted baked confections. On my visit to Charlottee my aim was to find a bakery that fills my caloric need of yumminess. Amelie's did not quite fill my yummy meter, in the sweet side, but the savory side they did. First, the atmosphere makes me want to give it 3.5 stars, but alas decor can only do so much when the baked goods are not up to snuff. But I did enjoy that they have different areas with different styles, and an atrium as well for louder groups. So first of all. My goto caffeine kick is a nonfat latte. Amelie's does not have skim nor lowfat milk. They only have whole & soy milk, and cream. That was already my minus 5 for me. What place that prides themselves of nicely crafted expresso not have nonfat milk? really, je n'sais pas. Anyway, so i pulled myself together because I was honestly in shock to hear this. I actually had to ask twice to make sure I heard her correctly. they have soy, so I had a soy latte. It was delicious, but still. I ordered a egg breakfast croissant sandwich with spinach and asiago cheese. It was yummy. The croissant was perfectly crafted. Not too buttery, it was just amount of flaky. It was not chewy from it being underbaked. The spinach was nothing to speak about, not sure if it was fresh or not. but the egg was cooked well and it was paired nicely with my asiago cheese. Overall, I'd order it again no questions asked. I got 2 items to go. A lemon tea cake and a mixed berry 'tart.' Though the overall tea cake was delicious. It had a nice crumb and beautiful in color and appearance-- it was not at all lemony. All I could really taste was butter. Lemon zest please? Lemon curd? Something? And this mixed berry tart was more muffin to me simply because of the overall texture of it. Tarts to me are dense and buttery. This mixed berry were neither of this things. It was fluffy and I could not even taste the berry. When I bit into it, it resembled a muffin. Pricing wise, I found some of their items a bit overpriced. But again, that is because I was disappointed. I have no issue with paying more if it is delicious and what I expected. The lemon tea cake was probably the size of a slightly larger square golf ball and I think it was almost 2 dollars. Meh, not worth it. I think the tarts were $4 and size wise it was probably the circumference of a average grapefruit and height was probably a little more than 1/2 inch. Again, if it was yummy and tart like I could careless how much it cost. Would I go back to try other items? Absolutely. But I did leave wanting and expecting more.

This place is great - great! It is also quite busy, so, admire the servers for their ability to keep the line moving, especially when they are packed behind the counter like sardines. Great selections in the pastry case (the beignets were possibly the best I've ever had), from large breakfast pastries, to small bites, to sandwiches. And, possibly more important, an excellent quality hot tea (which is surprisingly difficult to find at most bakeries). Most importantly, I needed to cater a small meeting in the morning and the staff there was able to accommodate my last-minute request for 20-ish pastries. THey were boxed up, presentable, and ready to pick up on time. You wouldn't think that should be mentioned as a compliment -- you would think that would be assumed when you place an order. But, you would be wrong. Bouchon Bakery handled it all. I went every day of my stay.
A go-to location every trip to Vegas. Enjoy the lobster claws!

Prices seemed fair. 2 cannoli and two iced mochas were under around $10. The wait was very long despite how many employees were there it seemed only a few were actually getting anything done. One woman helped our group of 4 and when I tried getting a young mans attention to add to our order he told me that I would need to talk to the woman helping us. The cannoli was amazing though and so was the iced mocha. Everything in the place looked fantastic. If I ever find myself back in Cleveland I will surely spend more time in little Italy.
Presti's is a must if you go to Little Italy. They have the best cannolis and cream puffs and it's an awesome location to stop by after dinner!

Very good ice cream and the server at the window was so kind and gave us a whole background on the sweet shop and all the ice cream. Very nice experience and there is a cute little court yard to hang out with your loved ones! Fun place to visit highly recommended if you like exotic flavors they have em for you!

I love watching Cake Boss and was excited when I found out Vegas had this spot! This place is definitely a go to! I got to try a little bit of everything...from the chocolate chip cookies to the apple turnovers to the carrot cupcake! My favorite was definitely the turnover it was so flakey and soft and the carrot cake was moist but it was kind of flavorless...

My favorite ice cream in phx! The dough melt is amazing and fresh and the ice cream is perfectly crafted. Never once have I received bad service and I have been to the downtown location as well as their Mesa location. The community in downtown Mesa is so excited to have them in the area!

We stopped for dessert with friends and thought Butterwood was such a quaint little bakery with really unique flavor combinations. The atmosphere was super cozy and more like being a guest at someone's home than being in a bakery. The employee was friendly. The desserts were like nothing I had ever had before. Typical bakeries have chocolate and vanilla, but Butterwood uses unique flavors that were delicious. We tried the mini chocolate cake with Strawberry whipped cream, the olive oil orange cake with strawberry icing, the fig cake and apricot cake with pistachio icing. The cakes are definitely denser than what I was used to, more like pound cake. Everything was very flavorful. The cakes were moist and the icing wasn't too sweet. Such a nice little place to stop and loved that they are open late!

I really love the food here. The flavors are amazing. There is a large variety of choices deli style from entrees to deserts. The staff makes me laugh. They are not necessarily the friendliest but they remind me of Seinfeld with the various characters and so I actually enjoy the personalities. Just don't take their rush personally. There is always a line to the door and it's not easy trying to take care of the customers as fast as they come for the food here. Normally I would give this a 5 stars. The only reason I can't is that for some reason, my gut is sensitive to something that is being used in the food. If it was a one time thing thenbi wouldn't say anything but it happened nthreeb try imes over a month and I cannot go back no matter how much I love the food. Sometimes the best tasting food does this to my gut. There are a few other restaurants that I have had the same reaction to multiple times and it's disappointing not to be able to go back without personal repercussions.

Went for the first time yesterday, and loved my food. I ordered the Veggie stromboli (fresh veggies- they weren't slimy, thank goodness!), my cousin ordered the Meat stromboli, and we both loved them. If I lived in Cleveland, I would be a regular!

Eh, fine in an ice cream emergency. Vanilla and cherry are sticky sweet, toasted marshmallow is a bonus on top. No option to mix flavors in a small size cup. $13 for two small scoops is too much for me.

Live on the edge and indulge yourself in a delicious cupcake! Heavy on the frosting, moist cake, and spot on with the defined flavor (lemon was incredible)! Price point $3.50 is what you'd find anywhere locally - so for Strip pricing even nice.

Make sure you go to Bouchon Bakery during the week. The food seems to be made fresh daily during the week, but the weekend seems to be leftovers from Friday's batch. We went on a Friday AM and a Saturday AM and the quality was vastly different. The beignet on Thursday was the best I had ever had and the cheese danish was fantastic. On Friday, the danish and the brioche were both very subpar.

It's a doughnut shop. If you like specialty Donuts you'll probably like this place. Personally I'm not a big doughnut fan and the one I tried was just incredibly sweet. Too sweet in my opinion but others may not think so. Service was very good and friendly. Their lattes are horrible however. On top of that I burnt my mouth on the first sip. I like giving other businesses over Starbucks my money when it comes to specialty coffees but I have to look for someplace other than Donut Bar to get one.

Located right next to momofuku is the Milk Bar. The cookies are something of a must try for those cookie connoisseur. They are priced at $4 a piece or 6 for $22. The cornflake chocolate chip marshmellow cookie was superb! They also have some delicious soft serve - get the swirl of cereal milk with the crack pie. It does the trick for the hot weather.

Wow, really? Bought one item from them, a ham and cheese croissant. First, I couldn't pay with my credit card since they weren't ready for such a strange form of payment. Then, they were supposedly heating my order up with their toaster oven press and when I got to my room it was as if they had taken it out of the refrigerator. Too bad I didn't notice it until I was already to my room. Obviously they didn't have their little heater plugged in or something. Plus, the woman at the counter who took my cash didn't even say thank you. The other lady who thought she was heating up my order did say thank you to me. That's the only reason they're getting two stars and not one. You provide lousy service; you get one or two stars from me on Yelp. Don't underestimate the power of reviews from real customers. It'll decrease your businesses if you stink. Thanks for reading.

We stopped in on a Sunday afternoon around 4PM. The inside of the shop was very cute. We ordered the butterscotch pudding and the orange olive oil cake with honey cream. The total of these two desserts was close to $14! The butterscotch pudding was served in an espresso cup so there was not much of it. We were shocked by the high price, but thought it could be worth it. We took the desserts home to eat. The butterscotch pudding was okay. Most of the olive oil cake was pretty dry, although some portions were moist. We did pick up the cake later in the day, so we may not have come at the best time. We would like to return again, but earlier in the morning.

Always a line, but so worth it. Over a dozen flavors of soft serve. They even have one made from oat milk so you can bring your lactose intolerant friends. A small cone here is what most places consider to be a medium. Yes, it's worth the wait in line. Besides, you are going to need the extra time to consider all the different options of soft serve flavors and sundaes.

The location is very easy to find and the staff is very friendly. My family and I picked what looked good to us, but we're most impressed with the strawberry and whipped cream donut. It is so BOMB! I could eat it everyday. My kids got an Oreo cookie donut and I believe a strawberry cheesecake one. The lady that helped us also put in a few emoji donuts. I'm not sure if I paid for them or not but even if I did I was impressed with what I got. Will definitely be returning :)

I had a sweet tooth while in Scottsdale and SR did not disappoint. I ordered the Pecan Turtle sundae. I traded a scoop of the Salted Butter Pecan (comes with 2 scoops) for a scoop of Strawberry Buttermilk. It was a great combination.

I've been to Sloan's a couple more times since I posted my original review, and those visits were pretty disappointing. First, there seem to be less employees working than there were the first time I cane here. Needless to say, there were no employees offering to give samples of their ice cream on those visits. Also, it's not very clear where to line up to order or ask for a sample, since the registers are in the middle of the counter, rather than at one end of the store or another. And they don't seem to have their Chewy Pralines fudge anymore :( I tried their Kitchen Sink brownie (chocolate, peanut butter chunks, butterscotch pieces, toffee, and caramel) which I found to be moist and tasty the first time I had it. However, it was hard and didn't have enough caramel or toffee pieces in it on my next visit. Please bring back the Chewy Pralines fudge and have clear designation of where the line begins!

This place always has great deserts 24 hours a day. There is always a line, but it moves a lot faster than you'd think. Good coffee too. The hot chocolate has got good flavor, but is more like room- temperature- chocolate. And usually has enough seating for all.

Best milkshake I have had in a LONG time and I am a big milkshake fan. Definitely go for the shabooya brownie and if you like mint the mint one was SO GOOD. I love when a place knows how to do a milkshake right.
Peanut butter chocolate chip cookie sounded a lot better than it tasted
Fruity pebbles ice cream!!!!! You can't go wrong. Best ice cream in Scottsdale! Adorable inside seating area and the outside patio is cute and shaded. Lots of parking and the staff is so sweet.

YES! I was so excited when I saw that there's a Bouchon on the strip. The restaurant is by the hotel lobby and check-in area. Bouchon Bakery is a short walk away and is accessible from the strip side of the Venetian as well as from inside. I wanted coffee as I was walking along the strip, but as expected, a latte will run you $5. I gave up on that. When I got to Bouchon, I wanted a macaron (just one since they're probably the equivalent of 2.5 regular macarons) and something to drink. Ok, under $3 for an iced tea, woohoo; funny how I consider that a win...oh Vegas strip... I was STOKED that they had a pumpkin macaron, perfect for fall and winter! Unfortunately, it got smushed in my bag before I found a spot to sit and gobble it. The foodie IGer in me was upset, but I devoured the macaron and forgot all about it. Bouchon macarons don't disappoint; they're a bit too sweet for my palate, but that's why I got the iced tea. I also saw that they had the Oh-Oh (Thomas Keller's version of the Ho-Ho) and the TK Oreo at this location, woot! Yup, this is definitely going to be a regular stop for me when I'm in Vegas since I end up in Vegas more often than Napa, haha.
Desserts were great! They used have great coffee terrible now though. But I gotta have those fresh desserts just going to skip the java.

We found this gem recently and so happy about it. We have tried halo halo and taho...so delicious! They also have very interesting ice cream flavors that are very tasty too. Can't wait to go back again and try everything. A huge bonus that everyone there are incredibly nice and helpful.

I stopped by in August for a drink, thanks to the extreme heat! I ordered a White Chocolate Mocha. Unfortunately, no doughnuts were on display. Basically, I was getting to know the neighborhood. I was mesmerized by the doughnut ornament inside the fishtank.

Giving three stars because I am extremely sad and disappointed by my most recent experience. I live in Vegas, my boyfriend and I think Carlo's has THE BEST cannolis ever, but we went to the strip last night with friends who came into town and we seriously hyped up the cannolis for them and the cannolis were horrible. Truly disgusting. We had to all just throw them away. Had we tasted them in store we would have asked what the issue was but we didn't taste them until we got home. There was maybe 1 chocolate chip inside mine and the rest had none, also the cannolis filling had sort of a rotten taste. Maybe it was an off day because they're normally AMAZING. But I'm just sad we all spent $25+ on something we were stoked for and couldn't even eat. I was so disappointed I may have shed a tear.... maybe next time!

This was my first day in AZ and wanted some dessert and found this place on the maps nearby so I went to go check it out since it was highly rated and the ice cream that I have tried there in this photo was all amazing, I definitely would recommend to anyone that wants different flavored ice cream that you can't find in stores.
This great gourmet ice-cream place was a great Cleveland find. I got a scoop of Lavender Honey, Toasted Pistachio, and Fetish Sessions Maple Walnut ice-cream.
So yummy!! We had the macaroons, bread pudding and a nut roll. I also had the French Coffee and loved it!!! I highly recommended this spot to sit and relax.

I came in the place assuming that I will come out feeling like crap because most dessert places serve humongous portion. Surprisingly this place didn't made me feel like that! For me the portion was right. Not only that, the ice cream is worth the calories because it's just that good! I had the Maltesers flavor ice cream with the red velvet macaroons and melted marshmallow on top. And it literally tasted like melted cold maltesers! Me and my coworkers found our favorite dessert spot in Scottsdale!

Novel ice cream is hands down one of the best spots in Phoenix! The owner Brandon is awesome and super friendly. The staff are always very friendly and welcoming too. I love that they use a lot of local ingredients in their ice cream and are very knowledgable about their product. My favorite is the honey lavender - so tasty! Can't wait to go back and try more flavors.

I'll be honest: I had never heard Sweet Republic until recently. I'm not sure how I let that happen; it won "Best Ice Cream" from the New Times in 2008. Failing to try ice cream that can be described as "Best" is unforgivable, in my book. But at long last, I got my first taste. I'll be back to taste again. Descriptions of really good ice cream seem clichÃ©: rich, creamy, smooth, clean, flavorful. But even so, they apply. They make their ice cream and sorbet from quality ingredients, from scratch. The only flavor I tried was the salted butter caramel (or something like that), and it was fantastic. And they have many more flavors to try. So I'll be back.
This is probably my favorite ice cream store in Phoenix area. Attentive staff and really nice and clean dining area. Definitely will come back with my friends to try different scoops.

After dinner at Momofuku, we stopped by Milk Bar for dessert. They also serve most of the items at Momofuku, but we wanted to stretch out the experience. After trying samples of the Cereal Milk and Crack Pie soft serve, I hastily made the decision to go with the Crack Pie soft serve ($6) as it was more flavorful at the moment. I quickly regretted my decision as it got heavy very quickly (as I was still finishing my samples after paying). I +$0.50 for sprinkles. Should've gone with Cereal Milk. Very disappointed as they yelled out my order to find my soft serve in a non-distinct clear cup instead of their famous MILK cup. Also, they did not roll the sprinkles onto the side as they do with the corn flakes (+$1) like I saw in the pictures (WHY!). I wanted the full Milk Bar experience, but feel like I only got half. Noteworthy mention was definitely the sprinkles. Conflicted if I should return or not..

I could not get enough of this place! I've been to the original Milk in NYC, so I was hoping for a similar experience. I was not disappointed, the Vegas location tastes just like real thing! All the ice cream is made from cereal milk and it tastes A-MAZE-BALLS. With or without the cereal crunch toppings, this place won't let you down! Located inside the Cosmo, just up the escalator, it's in a great location next to many other food options. My only gripe is that it's a bit pricey, but so was the NYC locale.
Very friendly and helpful staff The selections are great. So many try amd it did not dissappint at all.

PROS: -convenient downtown location -fast friendly service -strawberry split donut is amazing CONS: -vegan donuts are more expensive than the non-vegan ones -loud music (like nightclub loud) which makes it hard to communicate orders or chat with friends -creme brulee donut is blah, & the strawberry split donut is pretty heavy which leaves one other vegan option. I wish they had better vegan selection (ie: simple options like glazed, eclair, sprinkle, etc) If they had better vegan options I would frequent this location weekly, for sure. I've only seen the vegan sprinkled donut on 2 occasions. So far the strawberry split & sprinkled is my fav

Really great ice cream, plain and simple. Not sure what their secret is. It's just really creamy, rich and full of flavor. Haven't had a bad one yet. If you're looking for some good, old-fashioned ice cream, give this place a try.

Mmmmmmmm Iiiiiiiiiice Crrreeeeam! I have a bit of a sweet tooth and places like Melt are dangerous places to have so close to where I live/work. When you add the fact that all their flavors are natural and locally made [Superstition Farms, I believe] that is a double scoop of local love right there. Every time I go in the young lady behind the counter is passionate about the flavor offerings and when I am looking to try something new is more than eager to hand me a sample. The flavors may change seasonally but the local favorites remain. Their sorbets are so refreshing. If you are not into a cone or a scoop or 3 in a container (chinese to-go container) try a shake or one of their other sweet offerings. I personally enjoy stopping here after having eaten at Aside of Heart. Or take my lil container over to Lost Leaf and enjoy my ice cream with a beer/cider or 3.

I love love love the ice cream here! I am in town visiting, found out the snap-o-lantern(pumpkin ice cream with ginger snaps) was available and made a trip over. I also love the green tea, blue moon, zoreo and horchata. It is always difficult to make a decision, but it always has to be in a waffle cone. My one complaint about the place is the service tends to range from aloof to snotty.

If you are willing to wait in the line, you will be rewarded. I love Milk Bar. I've been to a couple of the store locations in NYC and always like to get a slice of crack pie, if I can. This recent visit to Las Vegas was no different. We had just gone for cocktails at the Chandelier Bar and Milk Bar was still open so we bee lined over for a slice of crack pie, a Thanksgiving croissant (this was new for me - turkey, stuffing, cranberry and gravy goodness, tucked in a warm croissant for $8! Perfect post-bar food) and a couple of cookies to bring back for the kids (confetti cookie and cornflake chocolate chip marshmallow cookie). Nothing is cheap, but everything was delicious and tasted just as good as it does in NYC.

This place sells out everyday so get there early! I like that they always have a vegan option and I am pretty sure you can order online if you don't want to risk them selling out of your favorite. It is definitely worth trying one of their big pretty donuts... I don't have a photo because I think I was trying to hide the fact I was eating it from my boyfriend LOL.... they are closed with the city shutdown.

Talk about a cool experience! We went when we were in the area for a sweet treat, and it sure was! The owner Brandon was there and as nice as could be and very informative. We tried almost everything and each one was better than the next! I ordered a scoop of sweet cream and honey, it was delicious! I'll be back when I have more room to try a donut sandwich- their claim to fame! Super great experience and quaint place! Will be back again!

Awesome! Awesome! Awesome! I've been in Charlotte for 3 years and never knew a place like this existed...nice job Charlotte! I'm not sure what to recommend to try, because everything looks SO GOOD! I recently had their White Bean & Ham soup and a Salted Carmel Brownie...YUM-O! Also, make sure to get a cup of their coffee...it's nice and smooth! LOVE IT!

My daughter ordered the mint chocolate chip in a cup. I ordered vanilla. Mine had a sour taste to it. Like spoiled milk. I had her try and she said it was awful. We threw both of our desserts away. Not sure if the sour taste is their "thing" or it truly was spoiled. Either way, we won't be back

I've said many times that there just isn't a good place to get a classic sundae in Phoenix. Well I stand corrected! Mary Coyles definitely delivers if you just want some classic, tasty ice cream and old fashioned sundaes. The shop isn't huge but it's nice, cute and was very clean when we arrived. There were two younger guys working but they were so nice and helpful, explaining the menu to us and promptly making our treats. We got a coffee milkshake and The Cookie Man "A Monster" with vanilla ice cream instead of cookies n cream. Their "showboat" sundaes come in either 5 or 7 scoops but they did say they could do them in 2 or 4 if that was too much. Let me tell you, if you aren't sharing, go for much less than 5!!! The milkshake was honestly perfect. So tasty. The cookie man was HUGE but satisfying. Again, I would highly recommend sharing their sundaes or ordering smaller ones. They also have several extremely large options (one called the Grand Canyon which is more than $100 I believe) for groups and the novelty/fun. If you want no frills ice cream or need a break from the fancy, unique flavor trend, this is the place to be. Great service and good product. I'll be back!

Fantastic ice cream. I go to First Friday at least every other month, and every time there's a line that goes way out the door of this small ice cream joint. Since it's gotten colder, the line was a little shorter yesterday and I'm extremely glad we finally experienced Melt. First off, dude! They were playing 80's dance pop and people were dancing. As soon as you go past the threshold, it's almost impossible not to shake your leg to the fun retro vibes going on. The decor is pretty cool too. I don't like the description 'hipster,' but that's what this place is. A hipster ice cream joint. And it totally nails it man. So, let's get to the ice cream. There were flavors like grasshoper lemongrass, key-lime pie, and other weird flavors. The most normal one was vanilla bean, and they even spelled it a different way so that the level of normalcy was kept at a minimum. I went for 1 scoop of fruity pebbles, and 1 scoop of cookie monster. The fruity pebbles tastes exactly like the cereal. Imagine mixing milk, fruity pebble cereal, and maybe oreo icing together and chilling it-- that's what it tastes like. Then there's the cookie monster... DUDE, I'm in love with the cookie monster flavor. It tastes like oreo mixed with some kind of delicious batter-flavored ice cream that is just difficult to describe. It's seriously tasty though. I'm already craving it, and now Baskin Robbins is basic. Thanks Melt, for ruining other ice cream for me. You raised the bar way high!

I'm anxious to try more from Batch. I have a feeling my rating will be 5 stars once I do. Their stuffed brioche rolls are quite good if you're into savory things. They also make the best apple cake in the world, which you can purchase at the Willy Streep Co-op (West, not sure if they have them at the East location). If anything, you must try that. Excited to try more.

Aaand... I'm dead. I must be. I've died and gone to fat kid heaven. Popcorn, pretzels and cupcakes oh my. And free samples of every flavor of popcorn. They have mastered the art of salty sweet with there delectable puffed kernels of goodness. The best by far is dichotomy, it has the richness of Carmel and the savorieness of cheese. It sounds weird but most amazing things do.

Can't get enough of this place. Wish they had another location this place is always pack and very hard to find parking. This is located in a big plaza with dozen of other restaurants. Worth the wait just to have the salt bread. So very buttery and a hint of sea salt. Ham and cheese is a great snack for on the go. The custard bread is really good too if you need something sweet. The bite size cheese cakes are so cute and delicious. I tried their mango slush and that was really good too and not too overly sweet.

Great customer service. I was helped by Jessie for a phone order of a small price point order that took a good 20 minutes. She treated me as if I was ordering a wedding cake. So rare you get great service like that these days.

This place was delicious!! I was in town visiting, and a friend took me by here, raving about the pastries. Not only were the pastries delicious, but their sandwiches were good too! I had the chicken salad on a croissant - the croissant was unbelievable. Wasn't stale, wasn't hard - it was just perfect. I'll definitely be back!

A great addition to Lakewood! Stopped by for some unique cupcakes for my Mom on her birthday. Lots of delicious choices. I loved the buckeye and red velvet especially. They also carry complimentary coffee for patrons from a local roasting company. I will be back for popcorn next time!

I usually go to the Sprinkles location near my home in Newport Beach. When I met with family in Las Vegas I was so excited to show them my favorite cupcake spot. I was extremely disappointed with the service we received. It was extremely disorganized and the staff seemed too flustered to properly take care of the customers in the store. There was no clear line and we were told to wait somewhere else after having stood there for some time. The associate took the order of someone who had entered after us and we waited patiently for a cupcake to be brought from the back that associate forget to even give us. I'm so use to such a great experience at my home location! Sad I couldn't show my family that.
Cool spot. We tried an apple crumble and a crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e. Would highly recommend. Make sure you get there early. Once they sell out, you've gotta wait until the next day.
Awesome place! Always come by! but be warmed they are super busy and very long lines on weekends and around midnight! lol
Thank you yelp for helping me find this gem! Every donut was delicious!! Best I've ever had! Please open one in San Francisco!

Fabulous! Best ice cream in the valley. We tasted almost all the flavors on the display and each one of them were pretty tasty and "novel". Our favorites were strawberry, German chocolate (best of all), butter pecan and fat Elvis. Would recommend everyone to try this place, you won't be disappointed.

What a charming bakery! They really have delicious desserts. Love their lemon bar, sfingi, pistachio cheesecake, lobster roll, cream puffs. Their tiramisu and Napoleon are also delicious. There is no place to sit but you can't wait to go home and stuff your face with sweets after coming here ! Owners and cashiers are super nice. Come and support your local bakery !

I was so excited to come to this place! And I am so glad I did. The line was long but well worth it. I have visited Jeni's a few times and I just love the look and feel of this place. Although the customer service is not great, they are by no means rude. My favorite flavors are the gooey butter cake and the brown butter almond brittle. All of the other flavors are so delicious and creamy. The waffle cones are amazing! I am not a waffle cone person, but the smell of these freshly made waffle cones alone will make your mouth water. They have cute banners placed on the out side that make for a great photo spot too.

We stopped in here for an after dinner snack. The young guys working there are helpful & friendly. We got a small serving of salted butter caramel, coconut sorbet & almond butter crunch. They were very good & could have easily eaten more!
Simply the best ice cream you'll ever have. The tall kid that works there, the tall guy that looks like Sideshow Bob, is an awesome worker.

Cinnamon Cherie def doesn't look like the picture. Plus cold. Plus had to be remade. Sad because i first came here and it was wonderful, today i brought my sister visiting from Miami and was embarrassed. Not only was everything slow, the drinks were cold, her same drink for here was given in a Togo cup. We asked for our croissants warmed and that was not to the servers liking. Just uncomfortable experience today.

I was originally just going to get one donut because my pastry threshold is usually one but after stepping inside Donut Bar you quickly realize how hard it is to just buy one. That's why we have two hands right, to double fist in morning sugar rushes? I ended up getting their signature Creme Brulee and a Nutella bar with a Cold Brew. If the donuts didn't do me in, the coffee did because it rocked my Friday morning. It was all so good I bought a round back for my co-workers to share the wealth. TIP: This cute, cramped donut shop is literally always popping so make sure you strategically find parking beforehand!

Definitely a one of a kind dessert place. They have so many different creative treats to try! I haven't tried anything that I don't like yet and you definitely get your money's worth the portions are huge! The customer service is always great as well they are so friendly and helpful! I would give this place 10 stars if I could it's my favorite dessert place and I HIGHLY recommend!!

BECAREFUL WITH THIS PLACE. The customer service is zero. The price is pricey but the cake quality is poor. I bought the birthday cake for my husband ( coffee cream brÃ»lÃ©e) the coffee cream taste like medicine, very strong bitter taste. I drinks coffee & I know how coffee taste. This is not the taste of coffee. I called & speak with the manager ( her name is Edna) & she not try to accommodate me with anything. She said nothing she can't do that is just the way the cake tastes. Becareful with this business. This is my first time & it's going to be my last time order cake from this 85 degree bakery shit. We only eat the strawberry & try the cream & we throw almost the whole cake away.
The best donuts in town. The history and the kind service you receive it's an Old Brooklyn staple

Wow, I cannot believe how bad this cake is. Bought 4 pieces of different types for my birthday yesterday, to share with my family. Every piece was dry, flavorless, and honestly the worst cake I have had. Should have gone to a grocery store and saved the $50

Yes! Best ice cream in Cleveland. Tons of delicious sounding, unique flavors. I had the tarimisu, which I believe is seasonal, but I definitely recommend it if it's available! I went on a Wednesday night in Jan at like 9pm and it was packed, so I imagine this place gets pretty crazy in warmer months or on weekends.
Everything is made fresh and you won't leave disappointed. There's also a dog bowl outside for pups on walks on hot days
Warning warning do not get the malt unless you like salty and sweet . My waffle chocolate dipped cone was off the chart , I was mourning every bite !

I got the crack pie slice and the bday cake truffles. The crack pie slice was so buttery and gooey; it was good! The bday cake truffles are another one of their signature items, I think? Those are just okay, sorta dry and too sweet. The problem I had with this place was the prices! The teeny slice of pie was $6 while the 3 little truffles were ~$7. I feel like for this prices it maybe should've a bit bigger or maybe baked fresh? I'm not sure about the pie, but the cookies and truffles were already in plastic bags so they were a bit dry looking. I think what I'm going to have to do is find a copy cat recipe for that crack pie though...

Yay Food Truck Fridays! What better way to supplement your hot dog of awesomeness than with super-delicious artisan ice cream? My friend and I tried out the Arizona Medjool Date, Cinnamon, and the (something alcohol? not sure, can't remember) pear sorbet. We are big (ok, getting a bit too literal here) fans. Loved the cinnamon especially.
I loveeee this place!! Employees were super nice and quick!! Got a red velvet cupcake and they were soooo yummmyy!!! Will for sure come again!! They always have a cupcake ATM! How dope!

Been here a few times and it's a nice little place. I ordered the s'more ice cream cup and wow that sucker is sweet! It was a bit overwhelming for me lol so you might want to share it with someone. I felt there was a bit too much graham crackers and marshmallows in it so had to work my way through that to get to the ice cream. The chocolate tasted like dark chocolate. On another visit I took my son on a Friday night and the only complaint that it is so small that there was a line out the door so we waiting in the car until the line went down and then jumped out of the car to get in the line in the door before another crowd came lol there is very limited parking in the front. Like 5 spaces max and a restaurant next door so you might be walking. There is a valet around the corner but not sure if that's just for the restaurant. Anyhow, I ordered a brownie and it was so good! Again I love chocolate but don't realize how much chocolate I'm getting until I feel overwhelmed by it lol there was a good amount of chocolate pieces in the brownie and it was nice and soft. My son got a kids cup with chocolate and sprinkles. He gave it a thumbs up so that's good. It is a good place to get ice cream I just wish it were in a bigger place with more parking. Other than that is recommend it!
Graham central station best flavor hands down! We come here every couple weeks! The staff is super friendly and nice and the ice cream is always amazing!

Ah cupcakes!!!! That was the first temptation I saw when I walked into this baked goods, candy, and ice cream store. The lady was very helpful with me and explained all the goodies to me and if I wanted to order truffles individually or they come packaged as a box. Yes some of them have brew in them. With your check in you are entitled to a free choice of a basic milk or dark chocolate covered pretzel with any purchase. The ice cream looked enticing however, since we just had a major temperature drop I decided to go with a cupcake and bring a few home. I settled for the pumpkin with a cream cheese frosting. It also had liquid caramel dripping from it. It was out of this world good! Among their other offerings were red velvet, carrot cake, oreo cookie and peanut butter chocolate to name a few.Their most popular was the lemon drop. They also sell cookies partially covered in chocolate with either M and Ms or other toppings. As far as specialty pretzels go they had a dark chocolate covered one with cranberries. Different but worth trying out next visit. This is a great place to stop either before or after theater for a sweet treat without spending a fortune. I loved my cupcake and the other two I bought I'm sure will be equally as good. They have a small sit down area if you care to eat there and she will provide you with a fork if you need it.

We checked into the LINQ Hotel on 02/14/2015. Great location found in the Promenade adjacent to the LINQ Hotel. Being from San Diego, I have had my share of Sprinkles cupcakes so I have been dying to try the ice cream. Instead, I had a Sprinkles Shake (2 scoops of ice cream blended with a cupcake). Mind you, I have been doing this combination for many years already with cake and pie. I chose the peanut butter chocolate cupcake with vanilla ice cream. It was delicious as I expected but a very rich combination....LOVED it! PROS: Flavors, options CONS: Pricey at $8.50+ tax for the Sprinkles Shake

Giving one star just for the ice cream itself. Came her on a Wednesday night with excitement to try the sundaes. The cashier (lady on the picture) did not greet at all. On top of that, I know I said it maybe a second late to ask for military discount... but she completely ignored me. I could tell she heard me because i was literally next to her and even leaned over to say "excuse me do you have military discount?" Completely ignored and finished the transaction. She looked up and I asked again and she said "oh i already did it um.." and did not know what to do. Asked the manager, manager was not sure what to do either. Im not even sure if they did the calculation right. But on top of that, the line got held up. THE WORKERS LITERALLY WAITED FOR EVERYONE ELSE TO GET THEIR ORDERS THEN MADE OUR ORDERS!! It seemed like they were upset that we held up the line when it wasn't our fault at all!! WTF. My brother was medically discharged from an accident being in the military. Fuck yeah I want our discount Very bad service tbh. The manager was the worst manager I had ever met. UPDATE: we were about to post our ice creams and guess what?! The manager gave us the cups with no Ghirardelli wording/logos wow what a petty manager. I hope he's new because he did not know how to be a manager at all.

Great small batch ice cream. They have waffle cones, sugar cones, and pretzel cones. Some of the flavors rotate each month. The pretzel cones pair well with the salted caramel and the Mexican chocolate. The Madagascar vanilla is also very good. They also have homemade caramels $.50 each and they are delicious. The service is fantastic. The staff is friendly and helpful. Did I mention the Hangover Helper? there's bourbon in the ice cream, seriously... 21 and over.

Hands down, literally the best ice cream in all of the Phoenix East Valley. They have a great selection of flavors, some more unique than others, but their staff is always accommodating when you'd like to sample. You can really taste the quality in their ice cream, which I love. My favorites are their almond butter crunch, lavender honey, earl grey and their green tea. What really sold me, was their waffle cones! Made fresh on site, and they aren't like your typical ice cream shop waffle cones. They're a lot more lighter and crisp. I visit so often and I wished they did punch cards.. Also love that Sweet Republic is carried at my local Whole Foods store, which is a bonus!

The shop its self was aesthetically pleasing. The employees were very nice and polite. I tried the red velvet vegan cupcake. The cake it self was the right amount of moist. The frosting was a bit to sweet but with the cake it was just right. I would go again to try some more cupcakes.

The soft-serve is way too sweet and has a strange Splenda-like aftertaste. The flavors tasted very artificial, and I ended up with a stomach ache when I got home... I really don't recommend this place, your simple Baskin Robbins is much better.

DONUT have one!!! LOL. Amazing donuts. The crime brÃ»lÃ©e donuts are so fun to crack open, but my fave was the red velvet donut. Worth the Ã¼ber ride to get there. My 2 wishes... Closer to the strip and if they deliver to California.

I went last week on wednesday if im not mistaken i swear the service was super slow. Staff is nice but the urgency wasnt there. Anyways they had forgot my $10 cheesecake(which was tiny). I emailed their customer service asking for a refund if not then if i could pick up my cheesecake. I received an email the next morning saying i could come in and pick it up. i got to pick up my cheesecake today and Ms. Christina was really sweet and kind, very friendly and apologetic. I really appreciated her attentiveness.

With all the hype Sprinkles gets, my expectations were overpriced (I figured about 6 dollars per cupcake) but really tasty cupcakes. I was wrong on both accounts. We arrived and chose the cupcake line. There is a separate counter for ice cream and cookies. I was pleased the prices were reasonable. $3.00 for a cupcake is on par with less trendy shops. I was disappointed that they did not have most of the flavors which were listed on the wall. I settled on a raspberry cupcake as the sign said it was a seasonal favorite while my daughter ordered their specialty red velvet cupcake and we also tried their mini chocolate marshmallow for $2.00. The chocolate marshmallow cupcake was horrible. Neither my daughter nor I could finish it and it tasted like a rum based dark chocolate topping with a strong bitterness. The raspberry cupcake was overly sweet but definitely tasted like fresh raspberries were used in the making of the frosting. I could only handle a small bite of it due to the sweetness. Unfortunately the cupcake was not moist inside and rather crumbly. It tasted stale or store bought instead of handmade. The red velvet cupcake was only slightly moister but when I picked it up, the top came off and the cupcake fell to the ground. I am all for cupcake tops but this only happens with dry cupcakes. The flavor on the red velvet cupcake was good and this is the only one of the three I would ever try again.
It it amazing !! Best soft serve ice cream in town.My kid love the ice creams. Ube is my favorite flavor It is so creamy and not too sweet. Love this place. Thanks for open in Henderson Las Vegas
First Cannoli experience and it was incredible! I had the tradition and chocolate. Neither was too sweet which I liked. I'll definitely be back to try everything else!

I had no idea this bakery was so revered... This has been my favorite bakery/place for breakfast in Vegas since my first visit here. Not surprised though - Yelpers know their shit and Thomas Keller is a god :) Best croissants ever. Get them when they're fresh. The macarons are amazing. I always buy the gift box for about twenty bucks, and see if I can resist opening it and eating them until I get home. Usually makes it till about the plane ride back. More stuff you should try: the beignets filled with raspberry will put any doughnut to shame (and I AM an avid Krispy Kreme fan), the chocolate bouchons are heavenly, and as someone else said here, the best Red Velvet Cupcake I've ever had, in the world, ever, period. Better than Magnolia Bakery. Better than the ones I had in Georgia. Also, they make a damn good cup of coffee here. Don't even bother with Starbuck's.
Great customer service! The staff was knowledgeable and very open to helping us decide which treat to try. I wish they had more ice cream and cookie flavors, but I did enjoy my cupcake sundae.

I'm so glad they came to Charlotte! I've been to the one in the DMV area and this menu isn't as extensive yet, so hopefully they'll add more things to the menu. The matcha taste is the same as any other Matcha Cafe Maiko place so I'd definitely recommend this to any matcha lovers. They aren't as generous with the toppings because we barely got any red bean in our parfait, but it was still good. The interior was so cute and is insta-aesthetic for those of you who are into that minimalist feed! If you are hesitating to get the soft serve, they do offer samples so take advantage of that. Everyone was super sweet and inviting here :)
Manager reached out letting me know that the issue had been resolved so that it would not happen again. I've been back several times since and it has been great every time.

We were in town for a Wedding. The bride and groom arranged a progressive dinner, and this was our final stop for the "dessert round." Members of our group had to circle the block a few times to find street parking, but eventually we all got parked right in front of the bakery. When we walked in we were immediately greeted by many different decorations. The different chandeliers were fascinating and the atmosphere was fairly relaxed and quiet. We enjoyed a blueberry cheesecake type dessert (forget the official name) as well as a salted caramel expresso. The staff was very helpful at explaining the different dessert items. There were many things to choose from. Both the expresso and the dessert were delicious. Our only regret is not saving more of my appetite for dessert since there were so many things that I would have loved to try and couldn't due to being stuffed from our previous stops.

I don't understand the hype. They taste mediocre at best. Super bready, if you've ever been to NYC and had Dough Donuts they're reminiscent of those, but still not as good. Dough has a good balance of fluffy, bready and chewy, these are just bready. TBH they kinda taste grocery store esque with more unique flavors (not that grocery store donuts are all that bad...just "standard") I've tried a lot of donuts ever since moving to Las Vegas and so far these have been at the bottom of the list...I'd rather wait for the red sign to go on at Krispy Kreme. Again they're not bad, they're cute but not up to the hype that people have been reviewing or talking about. Is it bc they're downtown in the "cool hipster area?" I say hit up Glaze at S. Fort Apache in SW
Staff is very friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful. We had three flavored Sunday. Ice cream is really creamy. Great place to pop in to for an after dinner treat.
Amazing. Fantastic. Worth the drive - everything is and tastes fresh - and the flavors are inventive. Best place to eat ice cream in the valley - hands down - no competition!!!!

Pure Americana right here! Some of the best soft serve ice cream in all of Pittsburgh! There menu is so vast, you could probably order something different every day of the summer! Personal favorites include South Side Shakes, Arctic Swirls, and the Nancy B's Cookie Sundae (If you don't know about Nancy B's cookies in Homestead, then make sure you add it to your list of delicious places to visit!). Prepare to wait in long lines here, but trust me....it's worth it. Also a cash only establishment....there is an ATM on site for those of us like me who never carry cash!

The crepe's a super freak! I'd really like to taste it.... Let's start off that I'm not usually a fan of crepes. I grew up with Polish nalesniki which are just homemade crepes with any filling you could desire. So when the crepe rage hit the US, I was underwhelmed. But I wanted something sweet and it was late in the evening, this place was close by and open. I love the sitting arrangements in this place. They have futon couches, tables and bar seating near the window. Plenty of choices for whatever sitting mood you're in (that's a thing, ya know?!) I choose the futon couches with the sparkly pillows. That's the kind of mood I was in. You place your order, have a seat, and then they call you up when your order is ready. We split the mango-berry crepe. I wasn't expecting it to come out looking like a cone. But ok cool, easy to hold. I'm a fan. The taste was good, on the positive it wasn't too sweet or over soaked, on the negative I do wish it had more cream filling throughout and not just on the bottom. All in all.... That crepe's pretty kinky.... *continues dancing to Rick James*
You REALLY need to hit this place and try the Zanzibar Chocolate Ice Cream. You neeeeeed to! Promise is really really delicious.

This an amazing place to satisfy your sweet tooth. Tucked away behind the strip in the LINQ promenade you'll find this sweet station. This area is family friendly and moderately priced. The cupcakes are simple yet packed with flavor. And the ice cream is some of the best I've ever had. Combine the two and you're in heaven. I got the sprinkles shake which is two scoops of ice cream and one cupcake blended together. I've never had anything like it before and my taste buds were screaming! The staff is very polite and helpful. This sweet spot matches the fun and relaxed atmosphere that surrounds it.

Fantastic pastries and drinks with a phenomenal atmosphere in a great artsy district of Charlotte. A bit pricey and not worth the hour long wait you may catch on a weekend evening. I do recommend the salted caramel brownie if it is your first time. Simply delicious

Rating 3.5 TLDR: If youre looking for halo-halo, come here. However, don't be too surprised, it tastes like any other halo-halo. So, its really up to what youre craving. Please keep in mind, this rating is based solely off my order halo halo, and not a rating for their other desserts. Not TLDR: Its been a while since I've had some Filipino dessert; specifically halo-halo. Where I live now, there isnt halo halo. So, when I found out that this place had this, my wife and I had to check it out. We drove from Tempe to this little hole in the wall, and it was the perfect time for desserts since it was still pretty warm. We arrived, and got their signature dessert: halo halo. It was good, but nothing amazing. It did satisfy both our cravings though. The service was impeccable, and the other desserts looked great. However, I have to give it 3.5 stars for their most reviewed item; which left me unimpressed. Based on other reviews, I have no doubt the other desserts are good. Give this place a try based on the other reviews; however, if youre looking for a mind blowing halo-halo, come knowing that it tastes like the rest. Good but not AMAZING.
Went to dinner & decided to take a drive to try this little gem we discovered on yelp. It was absolutely delicious .

Mmmm, very good ice cream! Since there's no way to get Graeter's in WI (unless I ship it, but I'd end up spending a fortune with how often I'd love to eat it...and it's so much better at the scoop shop), this is a pretty good substitute. I particularly love the great selection of flavors - it seems like there is just about anything and everything you could be in the mood for. Espresso Oreo? Yup. Strawberry Cheesecake? Sure thing. Zanzimint? You got it. Banana or Malted Milk or Peppermint Stick or Cappuccino or Fat Elvis..... I could go on for a while.... As was previously mentioned there's also quite a selection of non-ice cream: gelato, sherbert, non-fat yogurt, soy, etc.

I heard about their cupcake ATM machine, and wanted to come here just to try it. But changed my mind when I saw that they had ice cream cookie sandwiches. I got the chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream in between two warmed up chocolate chip cookies, and it was wonderful.
My all time favorite ice cream place!! I love it here!!! The Cookie Monster with the donut is my all time fave!!!

Great idea/concept, but it's just meh. It was ok and expensive. I tried it once and find no need to try it again. The crack pie was better than the ice cream. The corn flakes provided an interesting salty contrast, but the ice cream left much to be desired.

I love their late hours! My night was almost ruined until someone said churn stayed open later than other shops. We got there just before the last min rush. It was crazy how many people line up, into the parking lot, 10 minutes before closing. It's that good! The staff are always friendly too.
The business hour says they are open till 10 pm. I went there 9 pm and 8:30 pm in two nights. Both of times, they had nothing. Change your biz hours then !!!!

I'm a wedding photographer skysimonephotography.com and I bought yesterday's bride and groom 2 cupcakes from you so they would have a cake to cut!! They loved them. Thank you. The boxes were an affordable professional touch.

after reading all the below reviews, I tried to talk my daughter out of this "promised" trip to see "Buddy's" Bakery. She is so in love with "Cake Boss" that I made a promise we would go see his shop once we were in Vegas. I read the reviews and hoped I could persuade her out of it, but no such luck... We went on a Monday afternoon around 1045 am. the line was out the entrance and had about 30 isn people or so in line. we waited about 35 minutes before we were able to place our orders. We basically picked an assortment and paid about $40 for everything. We took photos, played games and just enjoyed the experience since we knew we had n o choice but to wait it out. Here are the goods: The overall time spent from end of line to receiving the box of goodies was 55 mins. Not bad compared to what some people waited. The treats were tasty, not great but overall good. the experience was fun, since we knew what to expect based upon the reviews. The staff was super friendly, at least the woman who helped us was. she even smiled when we wanted to add one more dessert to our order after the initial order. the Bad: Pastries were good, not great. Absolutely no place to sit nearby or anything for the older crowd. (We had a 80 yr old woman with us.) a little pricey, Buddy wasn't there which disappointed my daughter, lol. Overall it was an experience I'm glad we did, but won't do it again. It's a once and done kind of experience.

I will start by saying I'm not a big donut person, and I do like icecream but I have to be in the mood for it. I'd been wanting to try this place for some time though and finally took my gf for her bday in lieu of bday cake. Needless to say she was THRILLED as she IS a donut person! Novel did not disappoint. We met one of the owners and he was very personable. The icecream was incredible! And of course the donut was crazy amazing. Not too sweet, not too much, just soft and warm enough, wow. I did not expect to like it as much as I did. My gf was out of this world and we'll definitely be returning and taking our family and friends when they come visit us from out of town. Novel, you've got yourself some new foodie fans! P.s I am a big fan of chocolate, good chocolate and their chocolate icecream is perfection. Just try it.

I love this place. It makes any ice cream place taste like crap because Churn is so fresh. I've been here several times and every time is been great. I had a pb freeze or whatever it was called and man was it good. The ingredients were perfectly mixed throughout. The customer service is always great as well. Always super friendly and helpful. I can't wait to come here again!

Fresh dairy ice cream so delightful it coats your mouth with a sweet cream taste, and the waffle cones are thick enough to have a bit of crunch as well as sweet softness you can chew just enough to be satisfying. Reminds me of Oberweis from Illinois.

I'm from out of town, currently staying downtown CLE caregiving for a family member at a nearby hospital. As an Italian/American I was craving better pasta than what the hospital cafeteria serves. Not knowing the area, I looked to Yelp for a well reviewed restaurant to get a decent pasta lunch at nearby Little Italy. Presti's Bakery had good reviews so that's where I went. Personally, I judge an Italian restaurant by it's carbs. As in... was that plate of pasta i ate worth the carbs? ---- In this case, NO! The first clue I wasn't going to enjoy my pasta lunch at Presti's was ordering at a counter. However I have had great meals at restaurants without table service so I took a number and waited to order. However when the guy who took my order returned from the kitchen with a plate of pasta which he then put in a microwave I knew what was coming. Over cooked pasta with runny red sauce heated up in a microwave. The place was very busy so maybe it's just me. If you like your pasta served al-dente with thick flavorful red sauce and freshly grated cheese, Presti's isn't what you're looking for.

This place is worth the wait, don't get intimidated by the line it moves pretty fast! The bacon egg and cheese croissant is the greatest croissant I've ever had in my life. All the sweets here are delicious. Come here every time I'm in town
The place had no donuts but about 2 on the back counter, display counters where all empty! We drove up for the Indams game and made a special stop for this place. Do yourself a favor and skip it

I just wish it was bigger! Things that are this amazing deserve spaces as giant as their customer base! when i say giant i mean on friday nights the line wraps around the entire building into the hallway and then some. Wish we had more 24 hr places like this is charlotte! Keep it up!
Crepe + Nutella + bananas + powdered sugar = LUNCH OF CHAMPIONS.
Amazing ice cream! The little fish waffles are fantastic as well i forget what they are called. Great customer service and great recommendations when you don't know what you want. Will return

Came here to try out everything matcha! I got their maiko special. I am not too familiar with Japanese desserts, so didn't appreciate the cereal cornflakes and the particular beans or the syrup. The ice cream, however, was on point. I got some black sesame inside (I tried it alone, and it was too strong for me). Overall, matcha flavor was on point, but $10 was a lot for this cup. If I came again, I'd just get a drink or ice cream alone.

Fun, unique desserts if a bit pricey. One night after visiting Secret Pizza we tried the B'Day Milkquake ($10) - this was the better of the items we sampled. It's their Cereal Milk soft serve with birthday cake mixers stirred in. Easily feeds two. This alone will bring me back. On a later visit, we also tried single servings of their birthday cake soft serve ($6) and while good, seemed pricey for what you got and just didn't compare to the B'Day Milkquake. Seating can be a challenge late night (they don't have their own dedicated space) and if you need a sugar fix after visiting Secret Pizza, make sure you pay attention to closing times as Milk Bar closes first.
Came here and was a great experience the ice cream was fantastic the staff was very friendly would strongly recommend this place for anyone and all ages can't go wrong here!!!
Great desserts and always fresh. Have not tried the food.
So good. Like really, really tasty. Probably best if you skip the not so awesome dinner wherever you are in Scottsdale and just go here for the delicious ice cream. Don't miss salted caramel. Enjoy!
I just got Netflix over a week ago and saw the owner of sprinkles on Sugar Rush awesome show
Get a combo to try all the goodies. The Milk Bar Pie is the best pie I've ever had. Everything is perfectly balanced and not overly sweet.

SO GOOD!!! Yes that was caps and exclamations. I seriously considered going back to the counter for more scoops after finishing my first two. The butter pecan crunch, sweet corn and peanut butter were awesome.
Awesome staff, great creamy texture with wonderful flavor. Monster portions, and a nice place to stop for dessert after dinner.

Nice lil' surprise on our overnight visit to Madison and the world (well, locally) famous Willy Street. As an out-of-towner, I'd recommend it to any visitor looking to top off an eating trip to this foodable city. I had a scone, and my partner had a mini vanilla swirl. Both were great, especially the swirl-- rich, buttery and flaky. Yeah. Don't forget: cash only.

What a fantastic Ice Cream shop. They take great care with each order. I got the chocolate chips added on the rim of my milkshake. Talking about adding texture to your dessert. I can't wait to go back. When you are talking about Ice Cream it is all about flavor. They have it!

Was looking for a place to have a relaxing lunch with some girlfriends and this wasn't really it. This is a counter service restaurant and the line was really long. However, a long line is usually a sign of a good restaurant so we waited. There was an extensive case of pastries and macaroons to look at while in line and as someone who is gluten free I appreciate that they had gluten free pastry and bread options. I ordered a sandwich once I reached the register. Unfortunately, this did not end our wait. We were not given a number and allowed to find a table. We had to stand there and wait for our food which took a good 20 minutes. By the time I got my food the canned soda I had ordered was warm. I ordered the chicken, sun-dried tomato and goat cheese sandwich. Flavor was good, spinach was fresh but it was just a bad piece of chicken -- really tough and gristly. Not the relaxing lunch experience we were looking for. In addition, the amount of packaging this place uses is ridiculous. I would recommend them asking if the order is for here or to go so every orders not packed in plastic containers and paper bags.

I won't say much as, well, it's all been said. Here's what I have observed: - expect a line (but it moves pretty quickly, and if you're with friends anyways, well, it doesn't really matter) - try as many flavors as you like! (so delicious and rich AND they use metal sample spoons, which they wash and reuse *heart*) - they have a variety of cones, pretzel being one I hadn't seen before - one scoop is large and you can split it between two flavors - indulge and enjoy!
We went here specifically because the macaroons were recommended. We had a chocolate, raspberry and birthday cake. They were all outstanding but we preferred the chocolate over the other two.

We went here with a friend and my hubby's cousin, and it was fantastic, yes it's a little pricy, but the white roses ice cream was so wonderful, and the lime basil sorbet, is so refreshing. It's a treat for sure, but it's worth every penny... Oh and try the bacon brittle wow is all I can say.

Love the bakery as well as the main menu. Chicken salad is incredible, and the spinach asparagus leak soup is my favorite soup I've ever had! Being 24 hours also helps for getting a bite to eat as their menu is 24/7.
Absolutely the best ice cream in Cleveland. They have so many flavors to choose from. It's also really cool to see them make the ice cream at the west 25th location
Worth every penny. Cake was so fresh.frosting not too sweet. The milk chocolate tasted so real. I wish I had bought a t-shirt.

We paid our second visi to this location of Sprinkles yesterday, and I guess I'm a fan! Service was young, sweet, and eager to please while it was surprisingly slow yesterday. We stopped in at around 8:30 after a ride on the high roller and picked up a chai cupcake, lemon coconut, vegan red velet, and vanilla minis. The minis are so cute and perfect for kids if you don't want them bouncing off the walls from the sugar. My favorite was the lemon coconut of our selection, although the chai was also quite tasty with its strong chai spices. Vegan red velvet is made with coconut oil and my friend (who is vegan) said it was very moist and delicious. I'd say the Sprinkles here are up to par with the locations I've visited in California with the exception of one thing: I have yet to see the SALTED CARAMEL cupcake at this location. Salted caramel is hands down, the best Sprinkles cupcake flavor ever, so please carry it soon. Thanks!

I asked for two scoops and I got one scoop to equal two and they charged for two scoops. The scoops keep getting smaller and smaller. Although the ice cream is good, the portion sizes need to equal the amount you pay for.

After eating at a nice sushi place in down town we looked up a dessert place. We decided on go to this place though it was not easy to find lol it was well worth it. The dishes are in take out cut which adds to the originality of the place. Five stars for originality and five stars for flavor!

I wish I could give this place 10 stars! I love how They actually treat people like humans...even the teenagers that work there have amazing attitudes and work ethic. Maybe America does have a future...#eaticecream

I was born and raised in Youngstown Ohio so this icecream was a staple for all occasions. I grew up eating it and I'm so happy that it made its way to Vegas. Buckeye and graham central station are a must!!!! You will not be disappointed. If you're a pumpkin lover like me their pumpkin cheesecake, pecan and ripple are to die for. They only have these during the autumn season. I really don't understand why everyone is complaining about the lack of seating? I don't understand how you could give this place less than five stars. I guess it is a west coast thing to want to sit down while eating icecream. Back home you stand, chat with your friends, sit on the trunk of your car and enjoy your sweet treat. People find anything to complain about. Vegas has large chain restaurants and lacks the "mom and pop" shops that you can taste the love in whatever they serve. Handels is authentic, affordable and never disappoints! To those of you people who disagree go back to eating your overpriced, boring DQ or Baskin Robbins crap and save the good stuff for us real icecream lovers!

We've tried many different boba milks in Vegas. This place is by far our favorite. Great Boba Milk, great desserts, easy to find location, very clean and great customer service. If you like tiramisu and boba milk then this is your spot!

I didn't get any of their extravagant desserts, but they seem to be known for their soft serve which was very mediocre. I got a sample of the cereal milk flavor and it was OK. It tasted a little like malt flavor, almost bland. I ultimately ordered the crack pie flavor with corn flakes... WAYYYY too sweet. Maybe it's just a preference, but the ice cream was very light, almost fluffy. Personally, I like my soft serve to be dense and creamy.

LOVE love love Handel's. I'm a huge, unbearable ice cream snob and I hate getting ice cream that isn't local to the place. BUT I'll make an exception for Handel's. It's delicious. And cheap. And so welcome always in the Vegas heat.
Really great stop in place. Good price, service, and most importantly... great ice cream!

Amelie's is a treasure of Charlotte. Although each of their locations are special, the NoDa location is my personal favorite. All of their baked treates - from macaroons to croissants to cupcakes - are incredibly delicious and baked with absolute love. I also love all of their breakfast offerings in the mornings. I was also SUPER impressed with how innovative Amelie's was during COVID-19 in order to find creative ways to still provide their treats to their loyal following. They set up delivery everywhere in the area. They even developed the cutest "decorate your own cookie" kits that I have gifted to friends with little kids - and they were a huge hit.
