I highly recommend trying what they have to offer; you'll be hooked.

It's soooo good and worth every penny. The only downfall is their hours. I haven't been there since COVID, but I have seen many Instagram posts showing the precautions they have in place. I will be going there again soon. The French Toast donuts and Boston Cream are incredible!

If you have patience, you will find it worth the wait to get a crepe from CrÃªpes De Luxe. Taking a long overdue trip to the West Side Market from Lake County, it was important to get breakfast before buying all of the tempting goodies my fiancÃ© and I could carry. First word of advice: if you see there are fewer than 10 people in line, get in line. If you decide to come back, you will likely find the line got much longer and so, too, will be the wait. Another piece of advice: before you get in line, examine the menu carefully. It will be difficult to read once you get in line. There are a number of really great options to choose from, both sweet and savory, and you can also order your own custom crepe. Our tastes this particular morning were varied, so my fiancÃ© ordered the savory Florence (egg, spinach, Gruyere cheese), and I ordered the Black and Red, a sweet crepe of strawberries and Nutella (chocolate is an option to the Nutella). The ingredients were all fresh and most of them prepped right before us. The crepes were huge, very flavorful, and a substantial breakfast both of us enjoyed. Final piece of advice: Be sure to grab extra napkins because as you get to the end of your crepe it could become a bit unwieldy and fall apart. You might even wish to use a fork to enjoy these tasty treats with minimal mess.

What can I say but WOW! Great french Bakery. The Epi's are to fantastic and you can never go wrong with the Macarons. If you ever get a chance to make it to Napa Valley, your trio wouldn't be complete without a visit to the mother ship.
Best ice cream I've ever had. It's so fresh and soft and the flavors are unique. The lavender honey is my new favorite.

We love Mitchell's and this is such a great location. It is bright and open and you can see the ice cream being made in the back! Today we took a fun tasting tour and got to learn a little more about how the ice cream was made. Our favorite is the Peanut butter fudge sundae with peanut butter chocolate chunk ice cream! But today we tried the black raspberry chocolate chunk and double chocolate chunk...both were so creamy and delicious!
My favorite place! This ice cream is homemade and so delicious best in Phoenix. Yum

How can a "Italian Bakery" run out of cannoli. Their restaurant had a plethora of cannolis. Their other pastries were good but we went there for the cannoli. There are on the don't go list now. Sorry.
Have been here every night made the drive from mgm to try the sampler. It is the best. Great service totally delicious
Cute little place that's tucked between Momofuko and a Juice Bar. Always a go to spot because we always bring back a ton of cookies. If you can, try to go for every flavor. They're all great!!
Pretty mediocre food for the price. Would expect more than machine made coffee and espresso from a stall that advertises "food fit for a king"
If your sweet-tooth is acting up, this is the place to go. Don't worry, the line moves quickly.

This place is a small ice cream place with a lot of potential but from what I saw doesn't know they have that potential. I went there twice on my visit to Arizona first time got chocolate and fruity pebbles. Chocolate was great creamy and smooth with good flavor. Fruity pebbles tasted like it but too sweet and when u got a bite of pebbles it was soggy like they churned the ice cream with the pebbles in it instead of just folding them into the ice cream. This is just a preference for me. My first time there was 1 guy working register and counter and never smiled or really said a word. If you would ask for a sample it was like you just asked him for a million dollars and his house. Just not a friendly fellow, the second time we went there it was properly 45 minutes before closing so 10:15 which is still early in this town and they were open but had zero ice cream. Now the guy at the counter was sorry and seemed it. But still litterly the only thing they sell is ice cream and you run out?? Why and how? I appreciate they make it from scratch I used to too. But why only make enough for the day? Why not big batch's fresh ice cream has a shelf life of at least 4-5 days. So ice cream is good but if you run out of ice cream before you close you either need to close earlier or make more ice cream! That's why I had to give 2 stars

It's good. But there's so much hype about it that I expected more. Indoor seating would be nice on a hot summer day. The whole establishment screams of Midwest country homemade ice cream/custard/whatever.

Disgusting. These people have never been to Paris to know how a real pastry should taste. Everything I ordered was stale. Maybe they have less turnover. Bad and very slow service, the child behind the counter was rude and wouldn't answer my questions regarding food allergies. Would not come here again and really makes me question why people go to this place. Poorly managed and went even further down hill due to COVID. I question there cleanliness. There are plenty of better bakeries in CLT- this one isn't it.

Great dinner combo! Very tasty eggplant parmesan with two rolls, salad, Italian coffee, and canoli! The staff was very friendly, quick with the order. The place was pretty busy and you do have to take a number, but that's to be expected on a nice spring day in Little Italy. I will say I have to give the edge to Corbo's on the canoli's. However, great experience here and I intend to be a regular!
Always delicious. They have lots of great seasonal flavors (like espresso!) and the the cold fudge sundae is a classic.

Credit goes to Say Hi to Matthew for this one. I saw his video about it and heard about the cardboard cutout of him, and I decided I had to go. I am very happy about this decision. The place itself doesn't look like much from the outside, and it is kinda small; there was a line out the door because of the limit of people they are allowed in there. But even standing outside you could smell the donuts. One of the people I was talking to says he goes here every day and recommended the triple chocolate donut. I went with one of those, and the french toast donut, along with a nitro cold brew. Wow. I was seriously amazed by the french toast donut. It came with a side of blueberry compote, and syrup, and was covered in powdered sugar. I sat outside (in the back) and enjoyed it. I took the triple chocolate to go and enjoyed that later on in the day. I honestly wasn't too impressed with the nitro cold brew, but the donuts. Oh the donuts. I'll be back.

So this starts up with me wanting tacos late Saturday night around 11 PM we went to go eat tacos and they sucked. So I looked up ice cream places near me Now coming back home from California I had this amazing ice cream place called Afters and I had been craving a good quality ice cream that was really local. And having experience a local spot back home in California I wanted something really local here to Arizona, so this place comes up. After the disappointment of eating tacos that weren't that good we decided to come at 11:30 at night. Parking was fairly good and we had to walk a little bit but it was fine because we were still full. The gentlemen that greeted us was super nice! I don't remember his name. He asked my hubby and I if we had come here before so we said no, he gave us the run down which was much appreciated! He let us try the amazing ice cream flavors I tried the honey lavender twice because I couldn't make up whether I had liked it or not. (Plot twist I loved it) I ended up getting the Leslie and honey lavender ice cream with Oreo topping (super delicious) Besides the point that this ice cream is freakin delicious he said "if you don't like it make sure to come back in and we'll get you something better that you like, I want to make sure you're happy." I really appreciated that as a customer Delicious and interesting ice cream concepts Even better customer service We'll definitely be coming back!

You know where to find me this summer. This was spot on. Had the toffee sticky pudding and creme brÃ»lÃ©e. Wow, amazing combo. I love my ice cream and this is on the favorites list. Perfect treat when we warm up this summer.

This is the go to spot for macarons and other French pastries. They have the best macarons I have ever tasted. Always fresh and flavorful. I also enjoy their coffee they have a small selection but it's a great selection. The flavor of their coffee is delicious . Their decorations are also a sight to be seen. I realized a chandelier can be made out of anything.

What a beautiful donut shop- shop is an understatement. It's a glamorous display of gluten-laden deep-fried sugar-coated creatively crafted creations that just don't seem to be fairly priced! Those babies should cost at least 50% more! The intense labor and attention to detail explains the wicked narrow window of when it is open... I empathize with the time demands and being a slave to crafting such treats, so it's cool to limit hours. Otherwise, they would sacrifice worker sanity, donut quality and artistic freedom to the confines of clock time. Anyhow.... they have vegan donuts. I repeat, they have vegan donuts. Not the kind that you see and think, "oh, those are the vegan ones." Oh no, you wouldn't even care they are vegan or even know the difference, dear donut aficionados! Though Judy there one day, of the 4 vegan choices, 3 looked amazingly divine, and all looked just like the rest! Strawberry split?! Apple fritter?! Creme brÃ»lÃ©e?! Who doesn't want those if you are going to eat a gluten-laden donut?! Truly beautiful donuts! I also love that they have some esteemed coffee here to compliment the divine donuts. Stumptown, baby! The line is long but worth the wait. Everyone is happy here- from staff to customers. The decor has an old-fashioned feeling to harken back to days when people didn't care about carbs as bad for the diet and brain? I love that they put your treats in an open box until they ring you up on the register. A must try if you eat donuts with gluten- truly beautiful artistic creations. You'll be so happy!

If you want to impress someone, don't settle for ordinary donuts. Instead, surprise them with treats from Donut Bar! Since it's nice to switch things up every now and then, they change donut flavors on the regular. It's a bit pricey but you pay for the experience and incredible branding!

The best ice cream I have ever had! I know have a reason to move to Phoenix/Scottsdale and the reason is Sweet Republic. The menu is like a all star list of ice cream and it took me a while to make a decision of what to try beyond the obvious everything. I went for a classic with the Madagascar Vanilla and a unique flavor with the Honey Blue Cheese to try to get an idea of Sweet Republic's range. WOW, they blew me away. The honey blue cheese was an oddly wonderful taste that I enjoy in its normal incarnation but found the ice cream version to be somehow better! The flavors were well developed and not over powering, especially the blue cheese which could have been a bully and ruined everything. A subtly savory sweet treat! The Madagascar vanilla was nothing short of perfect, the flavor was dead on, texture was perfect and best of all the silky creaminess worked together to develop my first official ice cream addiction needing intervention. The iconic ice cream flavor has a new high mark set with this one. I will without hesitation go out of my way to stop in at Sweet Republic anytime I am in the state of Arizona. My only request (dream) is that they have a tasting menu. I would gladly hand over $10-20+ for a well rounded spoonful of each flavor available. Out of this world Sweet Republic, thank you for delivering the best culinary experience during my stay in Arizona
Amazing ice cream!! They even have kid size cones which was nice. Oreo and blue monster were my favorites. Will definitely come back

Not a bad spot if you're craving ice cream! As a disclaimer, I did not visit the store in person, nor have I tried the halo-halo, so I'm unable to comment on those. I ordered some ice cream from here through Grubhub and it came cold, creamy, and tasty. I liked the cookies and cream flavor, which was fresh! Unfortunately they ran out of the strawberry flavor, and they ended up substituting it with strawberry + cheesecake (it was roughly the same, it just had cheesecake chunks in it). I appreciated them calling me first to confirm that I was ok with the change, and they wrote an apology on the delivery bag containing my food, which was quite sweet. Overall, I would come back to have more of the ice cream, as the service and food were both great!
Amazing and decadent. The concept is awesome and the flavors unique. I love that this place is open late too.

I feel bad. But I honestly didn't love it... I had the Cereal Milk ice cream with corn flakes for the topping and took the Cornflake Marshmallow Chocolate Chip Cookie. Everything was pretty expensive for me, $4 for a cookie and $6 for a small soft serve ice cream...damn. I love how trendy it is. I love how friendly the staff are but I was just eh. Cereal Milk ice cream was soft and thick- nice texture- but also very salty to me. I felt like I didn't taste much but salt. I was unsure if it was salty because of the corn flakes or what. The cookie was not bad. Also tasted saltier than I would have liked but I did like the added sweetness and chewiness of the marshmallow. I liked the different textures in the cookie. My friend has a swirl soft serve of the cereal milk and something else that he couldn't remember. Whatever it was- that one was good! Because of this I won't totally write off that this place is terrible and I'll give it another try to taste another flavored soft serve or dessert. I will say price is pretty steep for me...but also...I get it. It's in the cosmo and it's Vegas. I just feel the price is high for the amount you're getting. I was assuming it would be a little pricey. I'm just not sure if it's worth it to me. Until next time!

As long time fans of Mary Coyle, we were super excited to see that they reopened in a new location. It's a hard place to beat for an old-time feeling ice cream shop, and the best value for the price that we paid. They have a large and wonderful selection, including what is still the best peanut butter and chocolate ice cream of all time. The chocolate ice cream was creamy and thick, with ribbons of peanut butter running through. We will definitely come here again.
Solid ice cream shop in the Memorial Union building.

This Banana Bread is like no other. The taste is unique. The size is perfect for a quick snack on the go. I really enjoyed every bite. I look forward to having another slice. The freshness makes the taste better.
The line was way too long for mediocre desert items. The brownie cookie looked great but tasted okay. I wouldn't come back here.

LONG LINES! But it's so worth it. This dessert bar is every sweet tooth's dream, and it's open 24 HOURS!!!!!!! Everything I tried is delish. Their tarts, mini mousse, macaroons. They have delicious creme brÃ»lÃ©e and the best Napoleon I have ever tasted. 5 Stars and nothing less!

I went to Amelie's on a whim as I was driving by. I am glad I did. I ordered three things from the pastry section, I got a salted caramel he Claire, pumpkin caramel petit four, and a chocolate peanut butter petit four. The The service was fantastic I was barely at the counter before somebody was helping me and I was checked out quickly despite them being in the middle of a Sunday brunch rush. When I can do the food both the petit fours where phenomenal and I will probably come back again and try more of them. The salted caramel eclair was good I wasn't particularly impressed, although I could see doing many other people takes far more than mine considering I usually prefer something of the sort to be a little more "fluffy", similar to a doughnut for lack of a better way to describe it. However that is personal preference and says nothing against the eclair for eclair lovers. I will definitely repeat in the future to try some more of their pastries.

Two words ! Egg Waffle!!!!!!!! My handmade waffle was also amazing but my boyfriend got a handmade egg waffle with cookies & cream, graham cracker and whipped cream... imagine your best brunch waffle wrapped around ice cream. And when your ice cream melts and the waffle absorbs it BAAYBEEEE. This is ice cream haven...

This is by far the greatest desert! I call it fish ice cream, my friends are like gross. Then when I take them it's all over!! I love the custard on the inside, the icee cream is just perfect, and the FISH!!!! I'm gonna leave that right there, if you don't go then there will be more for me!!! I promise you will love it!!!

I went early Saturday morning on a walk from Cosmo and wanted coffee that wasn't starbucks. I came for the palm-sized macaroons after seeing it on yelp, and I was not disappointed! Followed the directions of looking under the escalators past the Grand Lux Cafe, and lo and behold a long but quick moving line. So many flavors to choose from, and I settled on a pistachio one and a strawberry lemon one to go with my small coffee. Quite a pricey little breakfast snack, but you're in Vegas and if you like macaroons, it's worth it.

I've been craving for taho for so long that I randomly searched it here on Yelp. Pleasantly surprised to learn about Scooptopia and so happy to finally get my taho fix after years! It was still warm, the tapioca was freshly made and it wasn't too sweet. We also got halo-halo, sago drink and ice cream. Everything was exceptional. Also worth mentioning are the very nice people behind the counter who were so helpful and accomodating.

What a wonderful hidden gem! I had the mini cookie cup with cookies and cream ice cream, a red velvet macaron, and a toasted marshmallow. I am not even a marshmallow fan but I loved it! Great customer service too. I'll definitely be back!

The cookies are $8 each and unfortunately they're a little less enjoyable than the cookie my local Subway gives me for free if I choose to dine in. Sure, the idea of a corn cookie seems fun, and blueberry and cream sounds great, but in the end they're just kind of stale tasting.

Well typically we are pleased with this place but today not so much. The girl that took our order was completely unfriendly and rude, and the two pieces of cake I got to go were dinky and crumbled into pieces. For about $5 each that sucks.

ICE CREAM HEAVENBest butter pecan & raspberry ice cream with banana split, butter pecan, rocky road & raspberry drizzled with Carmel & Hot Fudge, whipped cream & cherry = "Nick's Delight". Will be bringing all 12 of my grandkids to this Ice Cream Heaven next visit
I always just get ice cream cones here and their flavor options are always changing which I love. Great location to grab an ice cream or shake and walk around the boardwalk when the weather is nice.

Yummy!!! I love cookies and cream so of course I tried that flavor which was amazing. But since I also love coffee I just had to try the coffee cookies and cream. OMG!!!! The best coffee ice cream mix I've ever had. Surely recommend this place. They didn't receive 5 stars cause their service could be better and there wasn't any tissue in the restroom. But the ice cream is delish.

Nice place to get speciality french bakery items. We tried all the 6 flavors of macarons. Salted caramel (ok-ok), vanilla and raspberry (good), coffee and pistachio (yummy), chocolate (yummiest). We even got the chocolate-covered raspberry but asked the guy over the checkout to exchange it for something else as we were pretty unhappy with our plain raspberry and didnot even want to open and try it. He happily did that and gave us 2 (we just asked for 1) of our favorite macarons. Nice touch which just adds to the name of Bouchon Bakery. The staff is pretty honest about when the macarons are made and which are fresher. I would happily gulp down chocolate , coffee or pistachio again.
Over priced and over hyped. Bought a cookie and a strawberry cheesecake and it was $15. The cookie was so dry and the strawberry cheesecake tasted bad that I couldn't even finish it.
Not sure if you can be vulgar about a description, but these are better than sex. No shit. Best donuts ever.

This place is a incredibly fun date night for me and my fiancÃ©. He got the strawberry short cake and I got the s'mores they are so fun I've never seen ice cream in such a beautiful display. It is a little pricey however it's a treat every now and then we will be back!

We stopped by Amelie's after dinner and I was quite impressed. The place was huge with plenty of seating. I really like the way they have the place decorated with bright colors and lots of crazy art on the walls. They had a wide variety of pastries to choose from which automatically makes them worthy of 4 stars in my book. I tried a chocolate mousse cup and it was delightful! It was so sweet I thought I'd have to stop after only 2 bites, but before I knew it the whole thing was gone. I just couldn't stop myself! The only drawback to this place was it was incredibly busy when we stopped by at 8:30pm on a weekday. This is the type of place that I'd normally like to get a pastry and coffee and have a seat to relax for a bit. With all the commotion I didn't think we'd be able to enjoy ourselves so we got our treats to go.

This was our first time trying this bakery and I must say, wonderful so far!!! My husband gets my carrot cake for my birthday every year and our other bakery was not an option this year. We will be getting more from here for sure. The carrot cake is a 6 in and very dense and a small slice goes a long way!!! So damn good!! I am excited to try other baked goods. Ordering was easy on their website and it was ready to pick up.

Ordered a celebration cake online to be ready when I arrived to Vegas . The customer service was excellent. They even offered to write Happy Birthday on it for me when I realized my candles would not fit right on the cake at the time of pick up. I received many compliments for the taste as well. I will definitely order again while in town.

Place was amazing Cheyanne and Alanna(Great young ladies)kept me in there longer than I shouldve been(ie. Buying more milkshakes and cupcakes) but it was well worth it. Only problem is theres NOOOOOO place to sit and it seemed like theres a spot for it. Definitely recommending it.

I absolutely LOVED this place! My boyfriend and I are die hard donut addicts and we couldn't believe that this place was close to our home! The service is always so nice and attentive. It's a small little place but it's super cool!

For a place that says "open until midnight" i expected that the store would actually have a full line of products and someone to greet you upon arrival.... this was at 10:30pm. Ummmm, that was not the case during my visit. No one was there to even say, "hello," and when looking at the flavors available there were only two to choose from (chocolate and cucumber something). One of my biggest pet peeves is an "open" store that's not really open... might as well be closed right?! I went to this location with my wife with hopes to have my sweet tooth satisfied, but was disappointed due to this experience. I would give it one star, but that's just not fair because I didn't even try their goodies. Hopefully next time I'll have a better experience and arrive 5 hours before the stated closing time so I can actually see what their 4 star review is all about.
I love the mint chocolate chip! Real mint leaves instead of imitation flavoring. The peppermint is fabulous also! Really, you can't go wrong.

Finally a ice cream place in the neighborhood!! Great flavor options and fun toppings. We had the Fat Daddy and it was perfect to share! Will be back soon :) Sure it's kind of hard to find and doesn't really have a sign, but cut them some slack! (Maybe a parking lot light would be nice though)

I really wanted this experience to be the best one I had ever experienced because of the hype and it wasn't. The lobster tails were old, dry and flavorless. the Cannoli's were missing flavor as well, I loved the filling but for the price it just wasn't worth it. I can honestly say that I won't be going back to Carlo's.

I love this location. even with all the other locations they have in NC, this one is the farthest for me. But would be willing to drive up here every time no matter what time is the day. The staff are always so welcoming and nice and their French bakeries are always bomb! They also soup and sandwiches, which are my favs. And of course they're open 24/7-365 days!

They have a great selection- I typically visit the one in uptown, Charlotte. The Sea-Salt Caramel brownie is really good, and price-wise, it is competitive for similar establishments. My only complaint is that their pastries do not taste fresh-baked, it always seems as if I am having yesterday's leftovers.

We heard about Ice Cream Social from @madisonmusts on Instagram and definitely weren't disappointed. The shop is small but great to pop in, get a dish or cone, and slip out. I got the carrot cake batter ice cream in a dish. Very unique flavor but I enjoyed it a lot. The consistency is good and the scoop is generous. My wife got the doughn't cha know (cookie dough) in a waffle cone and loved it. Great to see new and fun shops like this one in Madison. We'll be back for sure

My wife and I went to Amelie's last night for desert and had a horrible experience. My wife ordered a chi latte and the chocolate mousse cup and I the apple turnover. The chocolate mousse cup had a chocolate strawberry on top but when you bite into it, it was so soggy and gross. Also, she found fruit flies in it. The chi latte was also gross and not drinkable. My apple turnover was more so filled with apple sauce then actual chopped apples. Overall, a very bad experience and we wont be going there again. Not to mention we spend $20 when we could have gone someplace else for much cheaper.

Having been to the original NYC location I knew what to expect when I joined the late night crowd at Milk Bar. I've had the cereal milk soft serve, the pie formerly known as "crack pie", and some of their baked goods. Wanting to try something different, I got a chocolate birthday cake shake, which had pieces of chocolate cake in it and sprinkles. It was actually quite good, probably the best thing that I've tried at Milk Bar. It was rich and thick enough to satisfy a milkshake craving but thin enough to sip easily, sans the cake pieces that got stuck in the straw. When I finished the shake, I wanted more, which is always a good thing. But, after paying $7 for the baby shake, I'm just not sure that I could justify paying more for a larger one.

My very first time trying this and all I can say is OMG WOW AMAZING!!! And I got there at the perfect time.... HAPPY HOUR. Staff is also amazing, very clean place. They definitely stand by their slogan. Best Donuts in the WORLD!! Wow
How could I give the Donut Bar any less than 5stars? Of course the donuts were on point. This shop is located in the Art District that is totally worth checking out.
Friendly staff, lots of different options on the menu, and it's located in the Linq area. They are really busy but the tables and floors could use some cleaning. Delicious ice cream.

This place is amazing. They have amazing hours and offer a very wide variety of food where anyone can find something that they like. This is a place that you have to stop when visiting Charlotte, as it is a true hidden gem in the city.
If you are looking for the best ice cream around town look no further. This is the best homemade ice cream in Phoenix!! The staff are amazing and super kind.

Came here expecting some delicious ice cream and was not disappointed. I decided on mint choc chip with a sugar cone and it was exactly what I expected. The wait was longer than I expected, but I did see employees wearing gloves and the counters were clean. The store was well organized and easy to see prices. Sharda was my cashier and she was very friendly!
Super yummy ice creams. Great selection of unique and tasty flavors. Why only four stars? Not very exciting frozen yogurt. I wish some of the ice creams were less sweet.

Horrible cappuccino. And the caramel macaroons were like biting a round piece of rock. I have been to Bouchon bakery in Yountville and loved it. The one inside the Venetian was blah blah and totally blah.

I am so glad they brought Carlos Bakery out to Las Vegas! Being a local it's fun to have family friendly places to visit here. Although it is a busy place that is to be expected! We tried a vanilla cupcake, raspberry tarte, a cannoli tower, and cannoli! Everything was so delicious!!! It's a little pricey but a must go to! Ignore the negative reviews, budget in a treat or two and have fun! My husband and I loved it and will be sharing this with our family and friends.

Awesome atmosphere! A lot of pastries to choose from. Could use some more sandwich/ other options. I had a turkey and Brie sandwich which was delicious! But there were not may other non sweet treats to choose from. A great date spot or meet up w a friend

I love all Amelie's. I used to go pretty regularly before the pandemic, but even when I go occasionally I always love what I buy. The macarons, pastries, salted caramel brownies, and the salted caramel cafÃ© mocha - it is so good! I have frequented the old location in NoDa, the Uptown location, and even the location near Park Road, so I had to stop in and check out the new spot. It's really cute, and full of French-inspired decor as you would expect. I love the Eiffel tower that decorates the dining room, and I think the new store is a great size not to mention it's in the perfect location. Same great treats you would expect at any Amelie's location and the prices seem reasonable. Years ago they used to sell a strawberry pistachio croissant, and it was to die for! I really wish they would brings it back, and I check every time I go into Amelie's, but unfortunately not. Anyway check out the new location and buy some sweets for a friend.

This place is always busy, the line is well worth it. I'm not a big fan of the cannoli, but the Lobster tails are delicious. Carlos bakery has a website we're you can actually have your favorite dessert shipped to your home.
Such a cute spot! Donut Bar defiently lives up to the buzz that is going around. Went here with a client after they recommended it. Will be back asap!!

Yes please! This is the perfect neighborhood icecream place. The ice cream is locally made in Laveen. The workers are extremely nice and accommodating. The icecream and the Halo halo were both amazing and exactly what I want when I go out for a cold sweet treat.

We love Hopscotch!! While we have tried many items, our favorites would have to be her chocolate cake (so moist and tasty!) and her marshmallows. Last summer we tried strawberry marshmallows which were divine! We would love to try the infamous salted caramel marshmallows, but haven't had the chance yet. Ordering is very easy online, and Kaya is quick to respond and answer your questions. She is kind and really makes an effort to connect with her customers. Not only are her treats delicious, but also gorgeous! After a recent cake purchase for Mother's Day, my mom referred to her as an "artist" and got inspired to create some of her own lampwork beads based off of the color combinations Kaya uses to decorate her cakes. Can't say enough great things about Hopscotch!!

Such a unique concept, yet so simple. Cereal infused ice cream. My mouth is watering just thinking about how good this ice cream is. They even have a dairy free option which my daughter took advantage of. Would definitely recommend this joint to everyone and plan to go back in the near future.

SO GOOD AND SO MANY OPTIONS! I had a field day when I walked in here and it took me at least 10 minutes to make a decision. I first tried the Boston cream donut and while it was delicious, it tasted a little bit too fried. I'd get it again but I'd prefer if it weren't as oily. I tried mud pie next and I couldn't stop eating it, it was so good. It has a peanut butter drizzle on it, which I don't like too much, so I'd probably try something different next time but the donut part was so good and not too fried like the Boston cream. I'm obsessed with the look of the homer donut and will have to try it someday. FYI the menu is posted every day on their instagram! Get there EARLY I've heard they have crazy lines. I went around 830 on a Monday and we were the only ones there. I'm sure the weekends are insane.

I think that Wisconsinites take good ice cream for granted. We just figure that no matter where you go in the country there are going to be ice cream parlors just like this one serving more or less the same product. Sadly, though that would make the world a better place, this just simply is not the case. Chocolate Shoppe is woven into the fabric of the state. Head up north and stop off in any small town and this is likely the ice cream you are going to find at the local ice cream shop. Go anywhere else in the upper Midwest even, and you'll likely just find soft serve and maybe a few flavors of the same Blue Bunny stuff you can buy at the grocery store. The variety of flavors is always amazing and it is damn near impossible to not find something you'll enjoy. The line can be long on weekends and hot days, but it is well worth it. And I love seeing the line here longer than Cold Stone across the street! And to think there was some concern that gimmicky excuse of a national chain would even dent the mighty mighty Chocolate Shoppe! PSHAW!
Great ice cream and the wait was not long at all!! I will go back the next time I visit my daughter.

I was very happy this famous dessert place in New York opened in Vegas. But after trying the ice cream, I think this place is bit overrated. The milk soft serve with crunchy cereal add-on ended up costing me $7 something. I was like ??? at the moment because I couldn't believe I paid that much just for ice cream. The price might work for NYC but definitely not sustainable here. There's no line when I visited. The soft serve was good but I think the cereal was a bit too salty. I'm not sure if I will come back.

Milk Bar is where it's at for dessert. First off, get a slice of crack pie to go. It is expensive at $5 for a small slice, but it's so delicious that it's worth it. Another must is the cereal soft serve. Ask for a sample. It tastes just like the milk after you've eaten all the cereal! You can add cornflake crunch to it. Another good idea is the compost cookie!

Hmmmm hmmm good, well I'm a fan of macaroons and I've had some delicious one in the past, well I've been searching the city for that same goodness and after two disappointments.. The Villani's Bakery has saved the day. When I tell you the macaroons were and flavorful, I even got a slice of carrot cake

They were at the farmers market at DTS & was our first turns trying them. Each large donuts were $3-4. Hubby and I were not impressed. The large donuts were nothing special but ordinary which I felt like it had too much bread and not enough toppings. I'll give it another try maybe the selection we had was just off.

The Bouchon Bakery is located just at the foot of the main tower elevator bank at The Venetian resort. This is a great place to grab pastries, sandwiches, drinks, and sweets so you don't max out your hotel bill with items from the mini-bar. I usually get the Grilled Ham and Cheese Baguette, which is delicious, or the Turkey Brio sandwich. The service is very fast and the price is reasonable. I usually grab something here before I head out for the day so I don't get stuck somewhere without food. It is hard to find quick food like this in Vegas. Sometimes, I just want a sandwich without a wait and this place fits the bill perfectly.

I don't really like donuts all that much. I particularly dislike Dunkin Donuts because of the icky film they leave on the inside of my mouth, and the fact that all of the dough tastes the same for some reason. However, HOWEVER, Jack Frost is on another level entirely. The donuts do not taste fried, are not greasy and taste amazing! The only bad thing is that I can only eat one per day or so because otherwise my brain starts buzzing from all of the sugar. (:

You can taste the butter! Ordered croissants, amongst other items, and both were perfection. If you like a nice crispy, flaky, buttery, soft center this is for you. Their oat chai latte isn't too sweet and paired well with my almond croissant. Located inside the Venetian Hotel in the casino food court near escalators, you can't miss it.
The mint ice cream has real mint and tastes like a mojito. Enough said, FIVE stars!

Even though they only have one vegan option, it is totally worth it to stop in if you are down this way. I thought I had saw Sprinkles listed on HappyCow, so when I walked by I had to run in and check. I asked the friendly cashier and he told me they have a vegan red velvet cupcake. I got one for my friend and I to share. They told us it would be a couple minutes as they were freshly frosting one for us. It came out in a cute paperbag with an adorable Sprinkles sticker on it. My friend and I pulled it out and immediately got excited because they add a candy V on the top for the vegan ones. The added touch of that was enough to sell me as a lifetime customer haha! Now to get to the good stuff, the cupcake was moist, sweet and absolutely delicious. The frosting had a "cream cheese" taste to it that was absolutely perfect. And honestly probably the best vegan cupcake I've ever had and that says a lot because I've had a lot of vegan cupcakes in my day haha! The building also needs mention. The outside has the most adorable flashing lights (of course, it's Vegas) which in itself entices you to go in. The sidewalks outside have adorable "Hollywood" stars that say things like dark chocolate. What a cute touch! Inside is not overly big but it was comfortable for us and they have a line of chairs looking out the window so you can gorge on your cupcake right there.

I'm typically a fro-yo type of girl, but every now and then I get a craving for the real deal (homemade ice cream in this case). Tonight was one of those nights, and Churn really hit my sweet spot! This little shop is adorable. They squeeze a ton of fun candy and treats into a small amount of space, but it works! Per the recommendation of the friendly scooper, I went for Churn's version of an "Almond Joy" (minus the almonds). I had a half scoop of Toasted Coconut and a half scoop of Double Chocolate in a cup. It was delicious. A few bites in, I decided to add one of Churn's homemade molasses cookies to my concoction... mmmmm! I highly recommend this combo. I sat outside on the front patio with friends and enjoyed every last bite... while we were there, we noticed big people and little people of all ages with one common interest: ice cream! Churn is a wonderful family friendly addition to the CenPho neighborhood; I'm sure it will do well and I look forward to future visits!

Cute little old school candy shop and amazing ice cream! I had cherry pie and Vietnamese coffee (amazing!) skip the pretzel cone - it was hard as a rock. But ice cream and ambiance is great. It's attached to The Windsor which is also amazing for brunch, lunch or dinner
My wife and I always go to Amelie's for date night. Raspberry tarts and Petit's are great. But you can't beat the salted caramel brownie.

Great large coffee shop and bakery. Ample parking and nooks to work. Amazingly this place is always packed with long lines, but they have line control down to a science. It would be nice to have a self service black coffee line, but I would assume people would take liberties. If you need to kill an hour, head here. Would be five stars, but the coffee is pricey and not very strong. All the baked goods are 3-5 stars depending on your taste.

This place is definetly a diamind in the rough! They have the best macaron ice cream sandwiches in charlotte hands down!! My boyfriend and I came for ice cream and noticed these huge amazing macarons and we were definitely not disappointed. We got the pistachio and the strawberry cheesecake macaron ice cream sandwiches and they were delicious!! I will definitely come again and I'll be bringing in more people with me!

What a bright addition to Southend! I've been wanting to get to Jeni's since it's opening this summer. We decided to stop by to warm up date night and I'm really glad we did! The store was super inviting, with friendly staff ready to help. There was someone making waffle cones that I knew I had to try and another person describing the many samples to us. We decided to share the trio sampler ($6). My favorite hands down was the Brown Butter Almond Brittle. My goodness! It was delicious. We went with the Goat Cheese and Red Cherries was a close second for me and then the Brambleberry, also yummy. The trio came with the piece of the waffle cone I wanted so badly. The salt in the cone wasn't quite what I was looking for, but it was good.

The best ice cream!!! If you're not here on Tuesdays what are you waiting for?! $2 buck Tuesday is great, they're so generous with their scoops! It's actually like 3 scoops lol. A few of my favorites are anything with cheesecake because they come with little cheesecake chunks, the blueberry cobbler, and the blue monster which comes with lots of cookie pieces! They have seasonal flavors that I like to try out too! Please try this place out, you won't be disappointed!
Always a good place to stop by and grab some ice cream. I recommend the orange sherbert parfait.
Great variety of flavors, very friendly staff, used to get busy when school lets out but not a problem now, I always buy some to take home, highly recommend it

I feel like we all know Jeni's is delicious. They have extremely unique flavors and high quality ingredients. That said, it is expensive. If you go here you probably know that going in. Two single scoops (half of each flavor) in two waffle cones ran us 13 bucks. That.is.a.lot. However, this place is a special occasion ice cream shop... probably not a 'lets take all 5 kids" ice cream shop. They probably won't dig most of the flavors anyway. I will come back for a treat every now and then! Let me tell you though ..Two Scoops Southend is on the same road...and it's located and delicious and a bit less $$$$. Jeni's has plenty of competition for sure.

They must put crack in the birthday cake milkshake lol. That thing is seriously the most delicious dessert I've ever had. God knows how much sugar is in it but wow. I get the regular size ($10), and there is a smaller version as well. I don't get alcohol in it I feel that would take away from the taste. I've also had the birthday cake truffles (they come in a pack of 3). They are like little balls of heaven. The line is never too long and moves pretty quickly. The staff is very friendly. Must check out.

Sugar bomb a Rama. I actually think they have gone to larger donuts and more frosting than their San Diego original, but hey, Vegas baby. My favorite remains the Oreo birthday cake, but most anything is good -- except the fritters. Those are the only thing on the menu that goes the other way, under glazed relative to their dough mass. Definitely worth the walk when you're near downtown.
Wow. Some of the richest most decadent donuts I've ever had. My favorite was the maple glazed. The place is small but the taste is big.

Campfire Smores sundae is to DIE for if you like all that this lovely delight has to offer. If you are more of a toffee person then the Toffee Bonifi is for you!! I have been coming here now for over 3 years regularly. I love their ice cream flavors and the menu selections are great. The staff needs to be more customer focused. It always seems like the staff is either tired or just not into providing excellent customer service to those coming into the business. The owners are hardly ever to be seen in their own business operation which I think may improve customer service if they saw how there staff reacted to their customers.

If you love pastries, you MUST try this place! It's located in Chinatown near spring mountain and Wynn road. All day long pastries are baked and coming out hot straight from the oven! I tried few pastries and our favorite are the little flan or egg tarts, the garlic and cheese bread, the brioche and the mushroom bread! They offer to bag each pastry individually or in a box. The missing star to make it a 5 is for the below. If you are in the rush, it won't be the place to go. Pastries comes and goes right away lol (they sell it quick) The line to pay is long long long... so be patient. The sitting area is alright, something is missing to make it cozy. The staff at the cashier always look stressed and overwhelmed by the constant crowd waiting to pay. If they close at 10pm, they stop baking at 8pm so most of the pastries won't be hot. Great concept! And love the pastries

I visited the day after their grand opening and it was still super packed, but worth it for their soft serve with their cinnamon toast mixed in and cheesecake bites on top. I just wish there was more cheesecake bites on top. I also got their rose milk and was slightly disappointed because there just wasn't enough rose for me. However, I will definitely be back to try other drinks and to get more soft serve. The space could be considered small, but has a super photogenic leafy wall for photos. It was also super nice of them to continue their BOGO deal for the week a total steal!

My girl was hyped up to come and try their Crack Pie. On our way there I was thinking this pie must be amazing to have a name like that. It was the only thing she ordered and when I saw it I couldn't believe how small it was, in my head I thought it would be a huge slice of pie. My girl loved the pie but when I tried it I just thought it was okay, nothing spectacular and definitely no fireworks from the experience. This is a review on the pie but in the future I would like to try their other products.

HIT -AND- MISS My Wife & I are former NY'ers of Italian descent, so we were excited to try Villani's. The Bakery concept is nice; the server was really nice, and they have several items - though the availability of items rotates. Part of what I had deserved 5 stars, and the other part of what I had earned a single star. The rainbow cookies were five star perfection, as was the pastry part of what comprises their St Joseph's pastry (which I think the clerk referred to as Sfingi). How do you describe the perfect rainbow cookie? Villani's. Likewise, the Sfingi pastry was fluffy without being too light; a perfect balance, and tasty - a five star pastry that could go head to head with anything in NY. Literally. May I also add that everything was fresh, which is also uncommon. The filling of the St Joseph/Sfingi, and the filling of the cannoli, was a disaster. In my life I have tasted different types of cannoli filling made from ricotta, with different bakeries flavoring the filling with nuts, chocolate chips, etc. I have had cannoli filling that is sometimes too sweet, and cannoli filling that leaned towards ricotta tasting. The cannoli shell at Villani's tasted like a fried noodle from a Chinese restaurant, formed in the shape of a cannoli shell. Both the Sfingi filling, and cannoli filling, tasted like unsweetened heavy cream with a touch of cinnamon. The consistency was good, but the taste was very unexpected. In my 40 something years of eating Italian desserts, I have never had anything like this, and I didn't find it tasty. So...IMHO, Villani's was a hit and miss; what Villani's got right, they got right in a way that's worth bragging over. Unfortunately, what they got wrong was likewise extreme. 2.5 stars, rounded up to 3 stars, as I believe that Villani's makes a deliberate effort in serving up fresh, quality, items. The cannoli shell and filling were a HUGE miss, unfortunately.

This place is so cute and love that they use chinese take containers for bowls. Cute idea and the fortune cookie just sells the cutie concept. Order the plain jane vanilla. The staff explained that all the ingredients are local and made in house. I could not wait to try it. It was good, but way too sweet for my taste buds. I heart local businesses so I need to come back to try another flavor.
They have some flavors only found in Phoenix there. Nice people that make fresh ice cream.

This is my fave location. You can see ice cream being being made from the windows. You can also sample before having to make that important commitment to a flavor. The upstairs helps alleviate congestion issues and the train around the downstairs seating area adds charm. It's very family friendly and worth a visit. Parking as of my post is kind of a mess, while construction occurs behind Mitchell's.

Hard to find, tough to beat. Same great flavors and service as the 16th Street location, but without the crowds. There are 2 customer parking spaces on the street level, then a big parking structure. Don't know if the structure parking is free or not.
Mint chocolate ice cream. That's all I need in life. And Churn has the best ice cream in the valley. Prove me wrong!

I'm sorry but I'm pretty sure they aren't the yummiest cupcakes or brownies I ever had not even in my top 5 but the experience of using the CUPCAKE ATM with children was worth it. It was so much fun to let them order with the touch screen and then wait for the door to open with their treat. I only return to have the joy of seeing the kids get so excited for the door to open up.
This place is a hidden gem. We got pecan buns for breakfast and they were the best we have ever had.

We had a few pastries, yummy pistachio macaroons and delicious sandwiches. If you're staying at the Venetian this little stand is so conveniently placed! My only peeve is that I think the hours should be longer. A few times we went down to try and get something but it was closed! I could see myself needing a trip to this stand every time I come to Vegas.

If you want to get the best varieties possible go there by 10AM. And I mean by entering the store by 10AM. Because we left the store by 11 and some of the popular items are starting to sold out. since it's grand opening time and they are still new so I'd expect that trend will happen for a while. Their box of egg tarts are pretty good.

Was walking Around the market And has no clue there was a little crepe place tucked in here! Right next to a coffee place! I wasn't in the mood for anything sweet so I ordered the Naples delicious crepe filled with pepperoni, mozzarella and sun dried tomatoes! Super friendly service and the crepe was cooked to perfection! Would love to come back and try something sweet! So many choices here! Check them out ASAP!

Best donuts ever! My only complaint was the workers and that they don't have the flavors of the donuts listed.I felt very rushed and was afraid to ask what flavors were available because she seemed so annoyed whenever I asked a question so I ended up just getting random ones. They were still good, but I'd like to be able to choose the flavors I want. I will definitely be back though next time im in the area.

Amazing like always . The donuts are delicious ,light and not overly sweet which you can actually enjoy the donut. Wish they had a donut shop like this in town I would go often and bring more customers because a lot of people have never heard of the donut bar . My first time having it was in San Diego . Come into Henderson please
Yes! You won't be disappointed. PS. The toasted marshmallow can be put on anything!

Really great place to spend time and get ice cream. They have a lot of flavors that cater to almost anyone. The best part about this place is the fact that you can get ice cream sandwhiched between a ice glazed donut. I mean who can pass that up? They have many different toppings to pick from. Most of it is cereal type toppings and a few syrups. The Fat Elvis is pretty good when it comes to being sandwhiched between a donut or waffle. The sorbets that they have are really good, they constantly change. The owner is always really friendly and willing to help and offer samples. Its really small inside which makes it hard to move around if you bring a few people or people are already in there. The ice cream is like any other ice cream ive had nothing to special besides the flavors. Its a great place to relax, cool off and hangout while eating a sweet treat.

I love fun and unique experiences... And that is exactly what this was. The outdoor sign caught our attention "ice cream stuffed donuts". My life is now complete. The owner takes pride in the quality of the ice cream flavors as well as the goodness of the donuts. A great break from the hum drum of "usual".

Every time I drive through Charlotte, I stop at the NoDa location. The food and atmosphere are awesome. I just sit back for a couple hours and read my book. Eat a sandwich and pastries. Love the salted caramel coffee.

Came to place because we've obviously seen the pictures all over social media and it did not disappoint! There wasn't a line, the menu options were plentiful, and the staff was friendly. My husband ordered the strawberry shortcake milkshake and I got the chocolate mint macaroon sandwich. The ice cream in both items were delicious! I loved the crunch of the cocoa pebbles on the ice cream sandwich and the milkshake was super creamy. We will absolutely be going back!

The lobby looks like the entry way into heaven! I'm not big on Sweets, but the atmosphere is amazing. I loose all sense of time in this place. I'm addicted to the soups and the salted caramel brownie is one thing that satisfies my overly picky sweet tooth.

The operating hours are not accurate, they should be updated to reflect that they close when they sell out which is no specific time. I went to take my 8 year old son who loves donuts more than anything, he opened the door to walk in and was confronted by a very much less than friendly lady who dang near closed the door on his foot while saying very unpleasantly "were closed" I tried to ask her what would be the best time to come and she answered "we are open until we sell out!" Still trying to close the door on my son, this doesn't give me a good vibe or a feeling that I want to return when they do open, if your closed that's fine, if your having a bad day fine but learn some customer service skills especially when dealing with children. I will NOT be returning to patronize this business
Love this place. Coffee is to die. Food is amazing and the atmosphere is perfect. So many cool things to look at. Lines are long however the staff is awesome and get you taken care of fast.
Delicious! Great ending to a family trip to West Side Market. The interior is fresh and inviting. So glad it replaced Moda. I think and hope it will do well here.

Made a quick stop on a Saturday, mid-afternoon. There were a few spaces for street parking during the summer in front of the bakery, and although the line was long, if was pretty fast. We tried cannolis, an apple tart-like pastry, and something akin to a cinnamon roll. All delicious! We will be back! Note: There is a Catholic church across the street. This seems like a great place to stop by after church!

I love you guys! Wow all I can say is wow! I have been to your San Diego location and I come to Vegas every other week. My girlfriend and I are HUGE fans of the Big Poppa Tart & the creme brÃ»lÃ©e :-) The place looks really cool and has a great vibe to it. It's in a old historic building that has been remodeled. The backyard patio is perfect for coffee & donuts in downtown Vegas! We also saw Chef Santiago & he took the time to say hello and welcome us to his new shop! We can't wait for Ice Cream Cones from Donut Bar!!

OMD - Oh My Donut! When in Sin City, one must succumb to all of their vices. So when I discovered this sweet, sweet little gem of a donut shop in old downtown Las Vegas, I knew this was one vice I could not resist. But be warned, if you do not come to the Donut Bar before noon, chances are they will be sold out for the day. And trust me, they sell out fast. This place was so good, I had to come twice in two days to try more flavors of their donuts. On my first visit, I ordered the strawberry cream cheese donut and a blueberry donut with Meyer lemon frosting. The donuts were dense but not overwhelmingly so. The strawberry cream cheese was a little too sweet for my liking but had good strawberry flavor throughout the frosting and the donut. The blueberry donut with Meyer lemon frosting was delicious. The flavors were simple but spot on. On my second visit, I opted for the salted caramel donut and the Apple crumb donut. The salted caramel was by far my favorite (that I've tried so far). The Apple crumb was tasty with good apple flavor throughout but a little too heavy for my liking. They have so many flavors to choose from and their flavors appear to rotate almost daily. But like the saying goes, "the early bird gets the worm". Don't be the bird that misses out on these amazing donuts.

Las Vegas Yelpers came to my rescue again with this amazing gem. I ordered the 4-scoop sampler with chocolate chip cookie dough, coconut milk ice cream, peanut butter parfait, and vanilla with oreo. The best part: it only cost $4.25! Not only were the scoops of ice cream decently-sized and filled with mouth-watering, sugar-craving deliciousness but the price was insanely cheap for the amount I received. If I am ever in Las Vegas again I will definitely return for round 2!

Wow, the treats here were amazing. It took my family and I a good 10 minutes to figure out what we wanted to eat. I ended up with a waffle cone of Moosetracks ice cream and a scoop of brownie batter on top. So delicious! My dad got a tub of brownie batter and a chocolate dipped pretzel. I really wanted to try one of the probably dozen flavors of cupcakes, but it was hot out and ice cream won. The staff was super friendly and the shop was clean.
The desserts are decent but a bit overpriced at times and the coffee is kind of bitter. It's a good place to hang out with free wi-fi but it is always busy and a bit noisy.
So delicious! Get the cookie cup or you're not doing it right. The owner is awesome a,d flavors change at least once a week. All employees friendly and knowledgable.

Best Donuts Ever,,,, Great taste .. And always Fresh! But get there early! Once they run out. they close for the day. Their coffee and hot chocolate are not to be missed. One last thing. I enjoy sitting in the courtyard in the back of the store.

Oh Jeni's ice cream I love you so, founded in Columbus, Ohio and several locations across the country. The Charlotte location is in the hip South end neighborhood which is filled with variety of restaurants, shops, Apt's & condos. This is one of the smallest Jeni's I've visited & they have Jeni's standards plus a few limited edition flavors. My Dad enjoyed the summer favorite Strawberry Buttermilk, my Mom milkiest chocolate & me went for a double of Texas Sheet Cake and Darkest Chocolate. Jeni's Ice Cream is always a wonderful treat during my travels don't miss it!

This is one of my favorite bakery anywhere I go! When I found out they have one here in Las Vegas, I was excited to go! It didn't disappoint me! I had the brioche (this is the best) especially when it come right out from their kitchen, the matcha chocolate bun, choco bun and white macadamia cookies! They were all really good! If I had a bigger stomach, I would get more! You need to go early otherwise the bakery items are gone!

Absolutely delicious ice cream sandwich! Mint chocolate cookies with mint cookie ice cream. The cookies were very moist with a little bit of crunch from the mint. The ice cream was perfect. It was a combination made in ice cream heaven. The staff was great - very friendly and serving a line of people at 10:30pm with speed and grace. You can sample the ice cream flavors if you aren't sure. Very clean very cute place. Nice patio outside back. Will be back next time we are in Phoenix.
This place is amazing. The line was way too long the last time we went and we were on a time crunch. Everything we've tried has been a home run at Churn.

I came to milk bar with my family after eating at block 16 food court . My little sister ( 7 years old ) ordered the cereal milk ice cream with sprinkles . We also ordered a few cookies ( corn, cornflake chocolate chip marshmallow , compost) . The cookies were soft and good size . The corn cookie was just ok . The compost cookie was good but it had a coffee flavor so I wouldn't recommend it to anyone who doesn't like coffee. The cornflake chocolate chip marshmallow cookie was my favorite . It was sweet and salty. I've tried other cereal milk ice cream flavors that I like better but this one was ok . It wasn't that sweet . My little sister did not like the ice cream at all . I would give this place another shot and try something else but I don't think I would recommend it for kids because the flavors are pretty unique and different for certain young palates .
Amazing! Super friendly staff! Delicious ice cream, assortment of flavors and fun floats and sundaes! So cute and colorful inside!

They have great selections. The cupcakes are always fresh. My favorite is the Red Velvet. If you are going to give it as a gift, they package the cupcakes in a very nice presentation. I definitely have it as a desert after a ride on the High Roller.

Went for the first time with friend! We loved it! Sebastian helped us and was such a plus to the experience! Great attitudes but the whole team. Definitely a great date spot or place to bring the kids. Going back for sure.
Stop by and get your candy! This is off the strip by the Linq and High Roller. Chocolate sales itself. There is always a line and people Re always excited to be there.
Absolutely perfect dessert spot! Fun location! Amazing choices! Best soft serve I have ever had! I will be coming back every single time I come to Pittsburgh!

All of the desserts they sell look and taste amazing, but my ultimate favorite is just getting a soft serve ice cream cone. They make their cones fresh (you can tell as soon as you walk in) and they make really authentic flavors like matcha, hojicha, ube, and more. Love that you can swirl the flavors together too!

Came here just for the Dough Melt (donut ice cream sandwich). Got it with Bourbon salted carmel toffee ice cream and free topping of jimmies. Lived up to expectations. This place reminds me of Afters ice cream in Cali but with a hipster vibe attached to a cyclist bar. Definently coming back next time I'm in Phoenix. Might want to try the waffle sandwich ice cream.
Gross!! Got a cookie, pie, and milkshake and all of them had a weird taste. Like cardboard or something.

First of all OMG, they have the best ice cream in town, or even in the US. I'm normally frozen yogurt girl, but this ice cream is amazing. So, I have been here a couple times now. The first time I had the coffee ice cream. It tasted just like coffee, but better. Then the second time I had the peanut butter, coconut and butter pecan. Now these 3 flavors were amazing together. All I can say is that I know that I will definitely be coming back here for ice cream in the near future. :)

The place was extremely crowded when we got there and the line was to the street by the time we paid for our ice cream. Anyway, this place was okay. I was set on trying the espresso oreo, but they didn't have it so I went with rocky road. It wasn't thee best ice cream, but it was bad either, so overall I would say it's okay. I guess if I'm ever back I would like to try out the espresso oreo, but who knows.

Pretty disappointed in these donuts. I'm a huge donut person. I went here thinking that it was going to be the same as the location in San Diego, but not even close. These didn't taste fresh or nearly as good. Huge let down would not recommend

I'm picky about cake. Most American cake is just fluff; it doesn't have the body, the dense crumb that you see in, say, British cakes. Butterwood is legit! I went there with a friend who was deciding on a vendor for her wedding cake. Between us we tasted pretty much every cake they had on offer that day, and took the leftovers home in boxes. My friend has decided to go with Butterwood for her wedding cake - it was the best and most unique of all the places she tried. All the cakes were excellent: good texture, good flavor, unique combinations of cake and buttercream. Note that in their nut buttercreams, the nut flavor is there but it's pretty delicate. So for example, in a salted caramel cashew buttercream, the salt, butter and caramel were the forward flavors, with a hint of cashew. Still delicious! We also tried one of the pudding cups, which was amazing. I have also sat in here on a weekday and studied, with a piece of cake and a cup of tea to sustain me. It's pretty quiet in the middle of the day so I don't feel too bad about occupying a table, and it gives me time to finish one of those enormous slices of cake. :)

This place is just ok, not really worth the hype or the wait in line. My friend and I stumbled upon this place by accident while walking into the Grand Canal Shoppes in The Venetian. I was excited to see a black and white cookie here (I'm still longing for the William Greenburg ones I ate at the Plaza Hotel in New York) and this was an extreme disappointment. The cookie itself was dry and lacked flavor. The sugar cookie I also bought was the same, hard and dry. IIt was such a shame considering how much they charge for cookies! I wouldn't recommend going out of your way for desserts here.

I love this place this is the 2nd time I have been here. The first I had chicken and waffles which were outstanding! I had poached eggs bacon and potatoes this last time and it was great. I also got donuts which were so good! The had cinnamon. And sugar with chocolate dipping sauce! This will be a place I go every time!

The flavors are great, the vibe is very chill, and best of all, the donut ice cream sandwich was not messy or unwieldy at all! We expected the process of actually eating the delicious creation to be a lot more hazardous than it was- instead, you are able to enjoy it all the way through! Great customer service too, even with long lines.
The chocolate malt cake balls are incredible and very reasonably priced. We got the cornflake cookie as well and loved it.

Really good salted cream coffee. Easy to use kiosks to order cake or drinks. The line was too long to try the baked good, but after they are open for a while I'd like to try the hotdog buns. The prices on the bakery items was very reasonable.

Not too impressed with the prices or quality of this semi new ice cream place. The lone asian women behind the counter was nice, but this shop immediately reminded me of one of those asian donut shops you see in every city. The donuts in those places are not usually good and the ice cream here was less than memorable as well. First off, make the size of the sundae bigger or lower the $6.50 price of that sundae. It's not even a sundae technically because it has no syrup. You get two small scoops of bad ice cream (i needed to try 5 flavors to find decent one), two stale macaroons and that "famous" toasted marshmallow. One person with me had a bad aftertaste for at least an hour after the nutella. My flavor was cinnamon toast crunch, which like many flavors, are just vanilla with cereal tossed inside. If your gonna overpay for ice cream, go to creamistry. BTW , If you go non sundae, prices are normal.

Delicious bakery in little Italy! You come in and take a number like the deli counter in a grocery store. Then you get served when your number is called. They have a variety of food including sandwiches, gelato, many pasties, cookies, and more! The cannoli and cookies we got were great!

I have been here a few times and the service is always great! The staff is usually really helpful in helping you figure out what ice cream you want and the service is always prompt. The ice cream itself is super rich and seems to have more toppings than most other Oberweis' which I really enjoy! The only thing slightly off about this particular visit was that the Manager was reprimanding one of the employees very visibly behind the counter. I totally understand holding workers accountable, but there's a time and place for that and it shouldn't be in front of the customer. Other than that, the visit was great and I will definitely be back!

I'm from New York, so when I was in Cleveland on a business trip, I had to see the city's "Little Italy" section for myself. While it wasn't too big, it made up for it with places like Presti's. I had gotten dinner elsewhere, but stopped in here at the recommendation of my hotel staff for dessert. I took home some pistachio gelato, and was not disappointed. Arguably some of the best I've ever had, and that's from a New Yorker!

Deliciously awesome. We had the espresso ice cream in the waffle cone. When we first opened the door the smell of fresh waffle cones filled the air. They were making them then. Super delicious and cute place. I am subtracting one start bc the older woman helping us could use a happy pill. She seemed to be in a bad mood and not so happy to serve people. For petes sake lady, you work at an ice cream shop. Have fun with it!

I have tried a variety of breads here as well as in California and wasn't really a huge fan and would say it's a hit or miss depending on what you get. The price point is amazing, and the bread is fresh. I feel the variety is limited compared to the Cali locations and they tend to have a repeat of the same breads on the other side of the bakery. The cakes or a no-go for me. The cream cheese filled breads I like, but I'm also a huge cream cheese fan. Lines go by quickly.

The ice cream is good! I would recommend getting a scoop or two of something. When I came I had the fruity pebbles ice cream and it hit the spot although they can stand to add more fruity pebbles to the mix. My husband got the cookie marshmallow cup thing and he said it was delicious, but it's a bit pricey at $10 Finally, I ordered a taro milk tea. The milk tea had run out, so I turned the milk tea down. However, the girl proceeded to make it. With water. I was a little confused and a little mortified but I decided to try it. Why the heck not? Anyway, it was really gross. Now at a grand total of a little over $20, I felt a little disappointed by it all, so overall 3 stars.

I finally found something good to est today in Little Italy, a chocolate canoli with a double expresso. The shell was crispy and dipped in chocolate. The filling was creamy and not overly sweet. The expresso cut the sweetness nicely. I sat outside and enjoyed the summer night with my dolce.

Read about Churn on Yelp while visiting Phoenix and decided to take my kids to try it. I had a scoop of the peanut butter and it was delicious. I am not a huge peanut butter fan either, but never had peanut butter Ice cream. It was so creamy, like no other I've cream I've tried. Probably the best I've cream I've had. Would definitely go back to try some more flavors.

Don't come here unless you want to make it a regular stop. The staff is friendly and attentive. They also explained the menu as well as how the ice cream is made. I tasted a few flavors and ended up getting Horchata as well as the "Fat Elvis" flavor , which was peanut butter, banana, and bacon which I loved. They are dog friendly and even have ice cream for them!

So since we were in Las Vegas I told my husband that we had to try Carlo's Bakery. I was disappointed... My girls had the brownie and cookie and my husband had the carrot cake cupcake and I had red velvet. We both agreed our local cupcakery at home was way better than this location. I think if Buddy came to visit he would feel the same.

Not only does Mitchell's have the best ice cream around, this location is just the best. I love the open concept where you can see the factory setting behind the counter & two level seating for guests. There is a nice outdoor area to sit when the weather is nice that is a go-to in the summer time to hangout & enjoy your delicious ice cream. Favorite flavor: double chocolate chunk!!

Novel is our favorite ice cream place. The prices and ice cream are great, and the staff is friendly and polite. The toffee caramel bourbon crunch is amazing; we love it so much I buy a couple pints of it every so often just to make ice cream cake.

Superb. The Vanilla Cold Brewed iced coffee is recommended. The Cheese Danish is my favorite of what I've tried -- crispy and flaky on the outside, softer and chewier towards the center. There is a bakery on both the first and second level, though the one above may be a bit smaller, and certainly has smaller display cases. That said, I've seen much shorter lines and received quicker service on the second floor, and would suggest going to that one.

I don't normally have a sweet tooth...but I could come here every day! Yum! So happy to have been introduced to this place that is a mere 5 minutes from my house! First, they let you try each flavor in typical Baskin Robbins fashion. So for those that want to TRY avacado/jalepeno but do not want a full scoop then you can go for it. I recommend the strawberry buttermilk and anything with caramel in it. Can't wait to go back!

I'm definitely biased because I'm from the area and have been a long time regular, but AmÃ©lie's is always the first place I take friends that are visiting. I can't speak to the macarons, as those aren't my thing and I know very popular from here, but I've never had any complaints about any of the baked goods. The breakfast sandwich always slaps, and definitely my favorite place to grab a quick and tasty iced coffee!

So went to The Windsor and had to try this out afterwards. Ashley got a scoop of the butter pecan and I have to say that it was fantastic. I got the oatmeal cranberry apricot cookie and the spiced molasses cookie. The cookies were lightly crisp around the outside with a soft airy quality on the inside. They were delicious and melted in my mouth. Yummy.
Got the 'Compost cookie' here and it really tastes like the name. The cookie was stale and over-salted. Also very crumbly.

First off, they changed the name from crack pie, Anoyying they had to do that but I love this place. The soft serve was sooo good. It was just like I imagined when I heard about Milk Bar in the first palce. I took home a crack pi eand cookies to my man. He loved them and they stayed fresh for a couple days.

I have a slight obsession with macarons. So I seek out authentic macarons. This is my ultimate favorite place to get authentic macarons. They are absolutely divine, and by far the best I've had state side. Doesn't even matter what flavor, they are so perfectly made. To bite into the perfectly baked crunchy yet chewy cookie then taste the incredible filling...it's heavenly. My old favorite was Earl Grey, but I recently tried the Peanut butter and jelly which is....Amaziiing!!! They now make large macarons, as well as my favorite little ones. The vanilla bean, pistachio, strawberry, and chocolate are all fantastic. Always grab at least on sea salt caramel, they are superbly delicious. If you are in Las Vegas or Beverley Hills go to Bouchon's Bakery!!

Phoenix should be food porn capital of the west, sheesh. Not only can you find pretzel cones here (yes you read that right. Salty to compliment your sweet treat.), but you can also find adult ice cream. No, that is not just chocolate in that ice cream.... mmm mmm. Churn is owned by the same people who run Federal Pizza, Joyride, and one other similar creative venture all within the same block. Whoever these folks are, they're doing it right. I've got it so bad I'm already planning my next Phoenix Foodcation. Not only is the ice cream slow churned and to die for, but the whole atmosphere is really unique. I found a wall with cassette tape wallpaper...of actual cassette tapes. Not paper. Picnic benches outside are in the shade with misters going at all times, because Arizona. Very laid back vibe, perfect for chilling with friends, or for the kids and the dog.

You Scream! I Scream! Well I now scream for NOVEL Ice Cream! Well I do for now and I know you will too. An amazing Ice Cream shop opened in downtown Phoenix. In the heart of the urban district filled with locally owned shops this yet tiny store can curb a sweet tooth craving. Today was my first time in as the store that is only 10 days old. Lucky me who lives a dairy free life style got the opportunity to taste the Tangerine Sorbet. Freshly made by a local maker this fruity sorbet has Vitamin A, Vitamin C, Vitamin E and some carrots. I have to say I am highly impressed with the overall taste. What is different to me about the flavoring is you can tell not only that it is fresh but the flavor is powerful. It is not an artificial taste. It actually tastes homemade. The sorbet is creamier than most sorbets which I am not use to. I have to say I actually prefer the creamier taste. I can't wait to come back and try other flavors. My coworker the daring one was sold on the Bourbon Caramel Toffee Crunch. Even though the super friendly owner Brandon had offered to allow my party to sample other flavors she ended up choosing the most popular one. One she had topped with "sprinkles." Not on a cone or a cup in a doughnut. Yep! a warm doughnut that did not even melt the ice cream. It melted in her mouth not in her hand. Let's say we did not talk for a while as her new favor treat consumed our time. (Laugh out Loud) I am excited to come back to explore another flavor. Brandon mentioned they are working to add more nondairy flavors. However, the items not free from dairy are creative and look so good. The toppings they offer are unique. They offer cereal. That's right the delicious cereal choices you chose as a kid can be topped on your ice cream like Fruit Pepples or Coco Puffs. This shop is not a dine in location but the perfect place to drop in to get a scoop to go while walking the local shops in downtown Phoenix.

Love love love this place! We used to come here when it was drips and really enjoyed their matcha tea! The staff is always friendly and the location is easy to get to.I love trendy places and the backdrop for photos is so cute. We went on Saturday to try their ice cream and I had the Reese's Puffs! I was so delicious and they topped it off very nicely with Marshmallow Charms. I will be back!

I drove by a couple of times but didn't go in; looks like a great place for when we're able to gather more and walk up and down around here. Then a couple of friends picked some up and shared, and, I want to go even more. I had a sticky bun: pecans on top, doughy sweet bun, big, tasty, sticky, yum. Not the best one I've ever had, but pretty darn good. There were other options in the box that looked just as tasty, but I had been jonesing for a pecan roll and this worked nicely.
