Disappointed at this location!!! Sunday afternoon and most of the flavors were gone. Tried strawberry and chocolate peanut but both were disappointing ( left like artificial flavors ! )
Amazing crepes! We got 2 and didn't even make it back to the room which was literally a few steps away so had to go back for more to ensure everyone was happy! Definitely try it if you're around...

Okay, hands down the best place in Charlotte. This place is so awesome, usually pretty busy but the wait isn't too long, and if it is, it's worth it. Get your food and hope to find a table, don't worry one will turn up. The decor is borderline cute and over the top but nonetheless fun to look at. They have pastries galore!! Everything from croissants, to macaroons to cream puffs, all delicious. They also have soups and sandwiches, everything you need to spend hours working, studying or just hanging out with friends. I wish I lived closer, I would be there errday! If you have not visited it yet you are missing it, so hurry and check it out.
Long lines... it's not even a pleasant experience... get in and get out...! For a donut...??? No thanks..!

Their ice cream is nice and creamy. Perfect to cool off fm the hot weather of Las Vegas. The staff is quick and gives you your order right away. I tried the sample of 4 different ice cream. I like the praline pecan not too sweet and just enough pecan from every scoop. Definitely worth coming back even during the cold weather
Best pizza evaaaaa!!! The only place that can make delicious cold pizza. Presti's is one of the great things about Cleveland!

The Iced Matcha Latte was what caught my attention. Unfortunately, there is only one size for that particular drink 16 oz. Hint, hint make 24 oz available for coffee/matcha lovers like me! They also have ice cream with a variety of cereal and toppings you can blending into your ice cream. I haven't had a change to try it yet. Looks interesting, but I am more of a sweet drink person. Cute decor in the shop an friendly staff.
Good place, easy to find. Ice cream was thicker than most ice creams I've had but still not bad

Phenomenal as always! Also a long line always! Ha! You must get in line early although they do move along pretty quickly. I opted for the chocolate croissant and it was thick and flaky! They definitely don't skimp on the chocolate. Their coffee is delicious so much rich flavor in one single cup!

Possibly the best ice cream I've ever had anywhere--and I've tried a LOT of ice cream. You cannot go wrong with ANY flavor at Mitchell's! The caramelized chocolate was INCREDIBLE and the key lime pie was the best I've had outside of Key West. Friendly, fast service and great portion sizes.

I rarely ever get donuts so I'm completely willing to splurge when I do. I chose solely on the way they looked but the woman in front of me had the girl explaining what every single donut was. While this was a pain to be behind someone such as this, holding up the line, the girl at the counter didn't seem annoyed at all, just providing the customer a service. All of the donuts were tasty, especially a chocolate raspberry one!! I didn't care for the plain glazed, it had a weird taste to it but that could just be me.

Can't review the food because they wouldn't let me in. Got there exactly 15 minutes before they closed, had walked 1 mile so I could get a brownie, and the girl at the door stopped me and said "we're closed." then shut the door. Beware, they reserve the right to refuse service for any reason.
Cool staff. Cool looking donuts, but tastes so meh for the price. The small donut places around town with little to no advertisement are still way too superior. 2 stars for presentation!

It was a little hard to find the place, but any dessert lover should definitely check out this place. We ordered the raspberry macaron, an apple croissant, and a plain croissant. The plain croissant wasn't very flaky, and didn't taste very good. The apple croissant, on the other hand, was delicious. Crunchy butter sugar topping on a sweet layer of thinly sliced apples and a yummy croissant. It was delicious! The macarons were huge! They were about two or three inches in diameter which is huge for a normal macaron. The ratio of filling to shell was perfect, not too much, not too little. I thought the raspberry macaron had a very pleasant flavor. It wasn't extremely strong, but it was definitely present. Overall it was a pretty good snack, but I would skip the plain croissant.

Very busy spot and parking was quite full because all the other restaurants around. The selection of ice cream is limited but, there were many creative combinations to choose from. One we tried was a s'mores which looked like a fun treat as they melt the marshmallows right in front of you like you would when making creme brÃ»lÃ©e. I sampled a few ice cream flavors and decided to go with butter pecan and asked to have a bit of their flavor of the day which was grapefruit it was delicious and the server didn't charge me more. With a fun Willy Wonka feel to the shop I definitely would go back.
I should have known not to get bubble tea at a coffee shop. The taro milk tea didn't have any flavor and the boba was hard. Do not recommend going here for boba.

Pretty amazing for a vegan donut and the prices are what are expected for quality of donut. I really enjoyed my donut and will return again. They have plenty of options to more traditional to contemporary. Their is a little park next door with benches if you would like to enjoy the donut right away. I brought mine home to enjoy. The staff was kind and sometimes I see a huge line but today around 10 am I was able to walk right in with plenty to select from.

Went for the toffee banofi but ended up making my own mix......Triple play coconut sorbet, peaberry espresso sorbet, coconut cashew curry ice cream with homemade brittle and caramel sauce. WOW WEEEEEEEE WOW!!!!! is all I can say. For once I can say there is something that rivals gelato. I will definitely be back!

Cute shop in the center of the Venetian that is pink and colorful and just draws you in if you have a toddler like I did. I had the Brownie Hot Fudge. This did not disappoint!! The Cookie Monster ice cream has Oreos and chocolate chip cookies. The brownie was melt in your mouth fresh. I added Oreos and asked for no whipped cream instead of the heath bar that comes with it. Aaliyah was so helpful and even put it in a container to go so I can eat it through the shops.

2.5 stars, but I'll round up to 3 for Buddy's sake. The line that snakes down the main hallway should be a sign that you're either going to love Carlo's for the delicious pastries, or hate Carlo's because of the ridiculous line/service. I'm assuming that they knew Carlo's was going to be mobbed by fans of the show... so why the F did they make the inside of this place SO SMALL? My husband and I walked around the Venetian shops and this was the only place that was absolutely booming with people... in the most claustrophobic environment ever! But, I digress... After waiting about 30-45 minutes in Line #1 to actually get in to Carlo's Bakery, they "grant" you entrance into the shop to wait in Line #2 to order. They give you about less than 10 seconds to actually see what is in the display case to choose from. I really could not make up my mind and felt pressured to order, so I settled on a Cannoli and Cream Puff. After you order, they send you to yet another line (Line #3) to wait for your order and pay. By this point, I felt like I was in a cattle herd. As I was waiting in Line #3, I noticed that there were so many other pastries in another case that I was not given the chance to see. I totally would have ordered other items if I had seen them, but whatever. Overall, the cannoli and cream puff were good-- but definitely not worth standing in 3 lines for. I think they need to figure out a better system or expand and make the bakery larger.

Consistently good value and service. Ice cream flavors are unique and tasty. Interesting story of how the biz got started after the owner evaluated the meaning of her life and what she was doing after the Twin Towers were destroyed 9/11. Featured on the Food Network. Highly recommended!
Great desserts not too heavy on so can taste more flavors l. Good place for a quick snack or a variety of baked items.

Been to this place many times, while you're in downtown LV in the morning, check this place out! Nice staff, good prices for donuts and coffee, and there's vegan options. The menu rotates everyday so you can have different options. I hope to try their other donuts on their menu, my favorite is the birthday cake oreo, blueberry meyer, and raspberry.

Well we just ate at Carlo's and it was good. Not as pricy as one may expect. I did get to leave with both my arms intact. The Lobster tail was inhaled by my wife and the cannoli was eaten like a boss by my best bud. If you want to be in a sugar comma I suggest you come here. The doughnut did taste like a sweet 16 you would buy at your local supermarket but hey it did the job! So I would like to say to everyone.. " to the box truck baby!"
Finally got to try their infamous Lobster Tails !! Perfectly crispy on the Outside & delicious cream on the Inside ! Kinda pricey for $6 but it was pretty good :)

Great little place, cute decor. Definitely worth trying for a date or desert. I would like it more if they offered decaf latte, but they only have decaf drip coffee. Otherwise the food is great,and the place is really cute. I will add the line is always long, be forewarned...
Whoa!! I found this gem in Chinatown in Las Vegas! I was craving something sweet, and 85°C was just 3 miles from my hotel. It was packed but so worth it. Must try if you are visiting Vegas

Yelp, you've failed me. At 10:05 pm after a horrible meal at Flying Fig (review forthcoming) I was excited to see that there was still hope for the night to be saved by sweet, sweet ice cream. Because, you know what they say... When life gives you lemons...eat ice cream! Let some other sucker make lemonade. Anyway, sweet comfort in site, I reached for the door handle anticipating the sugary perfumed air about to greet me, but - THE DOOR WAS LOCKED!!! So Yelp, thanks for the tease, please update this location's hours ;) Oh, as for the ice cream, it's top notch, when you can get it. In my book, right up there with Portland's Ruby Jewel and Salt n' Straw.

Crack pie was very good, but so rich--plan to share the slice with someone. Compost cookie was not a hit with us--very strong coffee taste, which we did not care for. Overall decent, but not likely to go out of my way to visit.

This brings all the feels. First off after having a cocktail and wanting to eat a scrumptious snack the cupcakes are perfect! Plus it's a ATM! That's right quick easy and perfect for on the go celebrations and neatly placed in the box.

Always a favorite! The macarons are probably the best I've had (and i've tried a lot of them in the US - from NYC, to LA, to DC, to Baltimore). It was the right amount of chewiness, and crunch in the shell. The flavors are amazing, but not too overly saccharine. The pistachio and the salted caramel are my favorites. I also got a chocolate croissant...OMG, it was AMAZING! The croissant was super buttery and flaky. It also had dark chocolate as the filling so it wasn't overly sweet. It was basically perfection!
Best desserts ever tasted recommend going to buy their desserts.Very creative and awesome
Since my last review I've eliminated dairy from my diet..boo hoo. But no worries, they have at least 4 vegan options all the time! Coconut sorbet and chocolate sorbet are amazing!

heard so much about it. decided to check it out. went late around 10pm. saw so many tips about salted caramel brownie..definitely worth it! coffee is fresh and not bitter. definitely wanna come back and try their food menu :)

Need to consider opening earlier than 7 am. I was very discouraged yelp did not have the hours posted & I drove across town and was told they were not open. I saw the donuts and employees, but didn't get to try them yet.

My boyfriend and I came in the middle of the day and we weren't surprised to see a line. It was our first time here so we were grateful for the chance to take our time. The service was terrible. The lady behind the counter was very sour and seemed very unhappy to be working there. I also have an issue with the sanitation... where are the gloves? I noticed papers being used to grab everything, but I couldn't help but notice the paper didn't seem to prevent the woman behind the counter from touching my cone. No papers were even used when providing samples either. After the off service, I ordered two scoops of ice cream in a waffle cone. The rum raisin and the bananas foster. It was absolutely delicious! The waffle cone was amazing too, it tastes really fresh. The food was great, the service and sanitation needs work.

Easy breezy walk from Fremont--I know there's been talk about where you should and shouldn't walk in Vegas but I had zero issues. Or you could uber lyft it, but I enjoyed the stroll. The place had an amazing selection, super night staff. The donuts were visually dazzling and did not disappoint in the taste department. Walked a box back to the Nugget, had a great breakfast, ziplocked the left overs. Turns out they were still pretty flipping yummy the next night (two days later? Can anyone be sure of date or time in this magical city?) after a 4am hot streak on the tables when Hubby has a contagious sweet tooth. Thanks for the treats!!!

Stumbled upon this place after searching for dessert near by. It was awesome! I got the dough melt with strawberry shortcake ice cream and loved every last bite. The staff was so friendly and explained all the options and provided suggestions and background info. The line seemed long when we got there but it actually went really quickly.

This is so annoying !!!!!!!!!!!!! I waited in line for 25 mins for chocolate covered strawberries for their not to be any! Not to mention I was stared at by staff for over 10 mins while they fulfill everyone else's order and cut some fucking tape and completely ignore me. This is beyond rude and completely stupid. The manger even came out to see her so hard working staff be complete idiots. There is no sense of customer service what so ever. Thanks for nothing carlos bakery. I'm headed to Godiva.

SUMMARY: Awesome local ice cream spot! FULL STORY: Stopped by with some friends right before close one night. The owners were out chatting and greeting folks even though it was late -- they seemed to know all the neighbors coming in and were in no hurry to shoo anyone out. Tried a few flavors -- they have some classics and some funky ones rotating through along with a couple vegan options. Some were pretty mild (taro), and some were on the more sweet / strong side (almond) - definitely recommend tasting before you choose to find what you're into. I personally loooved the black sesame flavor! Look forward to coming back soon and trying more of their creations. I wish you could see what's available each day on the site or something to know if your faves are in stock! There are some outdoor picnic tables and lights strung up outside. Shop is smaller on the inside. Cute setup, especially since it's in more of a residential area and open late (till 10) in the summer. Note: They make their own cones! Closed on Mondays.

We go to Churn so often, I had assumed I had written a review- but I realized I hadn't! Churn serves up some of the best Ice Cream in the greater Phoenix area. So good, that we stop in even during the winter. Flavors that keep us coming back: Mint Oreo Ice cream, and any number of Chocolate sorbets: dark chocolate, white raspberry chocolate, etc. with Salted Caramel on top. Also a huge fan of the s'mores bars! Kim is our favorite ice cream scooper. Everyone is super friendly. Stop in, bring the kids, your friends, or a date! Fun for everyone!

We popped in on a busy Friday night. There was a bit of a line but I totally expected that. It moved fairly quickly. The area was a bit chaotic and dirty, and the employees were definitely unorganized and seemed anxious. They were out of several things, and actually locked the doors approx 15 mins before closing. Our shakes were delicious! It seems they had been victims of a busy day with a staffing shortage.

Great little spot for a quick sweet treat or your caffeine fix while on the busy Vegas Strip! Very pleasant & helpful staff. Nice quaint little patio seating on the outside the perfect area to read a book or people watch all day long!

They do not offer carry out orders. I did not want any of the soft serve products and they still would not take order over the phone even willing to pay with credit card. I was literally in the parking lot but had sleeping kids in car and did not want to leave them in car you themselves. Also it takes a few minutes to make the food and it would still be hot to eat so ordering inside was not idea.
Amazing amazing amazing donuts!! BOMB.com I can't say anything else.. they were theeeeee BOMB SUPER GOOD!

A short walk around 12 minutes from downtown Las Vegas to the donut bar. We went around 7:45am on a Tuesday and wasn't busy at all. Walked and I was in awe of all the donuts they had and the size. These are huge and they all look delicious with interesting flavors. The staff was so helpful making recommendations and highlighting their unique and seasonal flavors. We got the classic homer donut a big pink sprinkle donut, their popular strawberry big poppa which had an entire strawberry pop tart inside, a maple Apple fritter, and the creme filled creme brÃ»lÃ©e. All were delicious and not too sweet my top favorite was the Apple fritter with the maple glaze on top. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was also delicious and I'd recommend for its unique texture and delicious taste. We also ordered some coffee and enjoyed them in the socially distanced back patio, we actually were the only ones back there the whole time. Can't wait to comeback 10/10 I highly recommend.

(Lyrics - Neil Diamond - Sweet Caroline) Where to begin, I can begin with milkshakes But then I know my appetite is growing strong Start with a scoop And the scoop became a double Who'd have believed it came along Hot.....fudge sundaes..... Reaching out, trying it, tasting it...... Sweet Republic (bop bop bop) Good times never seemed so good I'd be inclined (bop bop bop) To believe it never would Now Bo Bites..... How shall I start! I love Ice Cream!? Well let's just say I'm one to have a sweet spot for some good ice cream! Sweet Republic has that covered ladies and gents. With funky flavors such as Kulfi, Jalapeno Avocado Bacon Brittle, Basil Lime Sorbet, etc. Sweet Republic has 2 locations I hope this little ice cream boutique grows, even though the Shea location is close enough for me to visit more often than not. However, my gut and love handles say NO MORE! My mouth and eyes say just a small bite of Waffle cones and 2 more flavors! They also serve up some interesting milkshakes and sundaes, which I can't wait to try! Your ice cream could be served up in a waffle cone, cup, and even between 2 cookies of your choice! I came here on a hot summer day and ordered the waffle cone with Salted Caramel Butter and Belgium Chocolate. I'm not too crazy for the exotic flavors; like to keep things simple. Sweet and buttery ice cream slow oozing down my cone as I embrace every bite and lick.....gee I think I just had a foodgasm! Overall, the place is very welcoming like most ice cream shops. It can get real crammed up in this shop since seating is limited, but lets just hope you beat out the crowd. In the end, Sweet Republic's reputation is definitely well deserved and a must visit! - Enjoy

If you're at the Cosmopolitan hotel and youre looking for a sweet treat, you need to stop by Milk. Their soft serve is incredibly delicious- not too sweet. They are a little pricey for such a small portion, but that's to be expected. I didn't get a chance to try out their other items on the menu... at one point, I was tempted to buy their cookies to bring home since I was only in Vegas for vacation. But if I do return to Vegas in the near future, I'll definitely be back.

Did I die? Is this what heaven is like? Batch is the bakehouse of my dreams. It's perfection from top to bottom. Batch's interior is incredibly inviting with its ample natural lighting and the soothing robin's egg blue on the walls. The display case is expertly arranged, and the staff was very understanding of my need to just take it all in before narrowing it down to a reasonable order of one item instead of one of everything. Eventually my eyes zeroed in on the dark chocolate honey almond tart and I knew that this item and I were meant to be together. The dark chocolate honey almond tart is literally one of the best baked goods I've ever tasted, and I make a point to taste many. The tart shell was firm and didn't crumble when cut into with a fork. The chocolate flavor was present without being overwhelming or bitter. The filling comprised crunchy sliced almonds bathed in golden honey that added just the right amount of sweetness without being a sticky mess. The tart was topped off with a lattice of chocolate sauce to get it an extra chocolatey note. This tart is something to take your time with and enjoy every bite. I can't wait to go back and try another of their amazing creations.
Cookie was rough but ice cream was really good, recommend the chocolate fudge. I had the peanut butter cookie and coconut macroon cookie as my two cookies for the sandwich. A little hard to dig into.

Sweet treat that's good to eat. That's how the saying goes, right? Regardless, churns out if you want sweets, it's right across the street from Postino's! (see what I did there?) I came here after Postino's and had their Vietnamese Coffee ice cream. It tastes like Haagen Dazs' coffee ice cream, but more sweet. My friend got the banana ice cream and it tastes like a fresh banana that you've just bitten into. I could have sworn I felt so healthy eating ice cream! It is on the pricey side for ice cream and a little too sweet for me, but I liked it nonetheless!

in case it's not obv in my review, i'm a HUGE fan of buddy/carlo's bakery so his restaurant and carlo's were MUST DO's during the vegas trip as i'll likely never go to NJ for his bakery... anyway, so during the days b4 we arrived at carlo's, there's been controversy over this surprise that my husband had for me which turned out to be a personalized cake. so i was nervous and unsure how this would go. my husband was pretty pissed a few times w/ them. anyway, there's a big window wall where u can see the whole baking/decorating process being done which i thought was cool and did watch for a few mins.. and i always thought that if i got to go to carlo's that i would wanna order everything in the display cases lol cuz his show 'cake boss' sure always has this effect on me! but for some reason, this seems like a smaller version of his other carlo's bakeries and there wasn't tons to choose from.. i didn't even see cannolis in the display case when i was there! and we know how major cannolis are! BUT regardless, i knew i was getting the lobster tails lol which they thankfully had a huge supply of (i was worried it would be sold out or we'd have to wait for em to be made lol), so the lobster tails were absolutely a must for me.. and let me tell ya, very satisfying!!! my taste buds were thanking me all day after i ate em! plus, when i was looking at the diff items, the prices weren't as bad as i thought they'd be. i honestly expected the small items to be at least $10 each or something, so i was thrilled to see the avg price was around $5 each.. but it's diff on the website when u order delivery lol, very expensive and u gotta prepare them urself! but if u got the $$, order it from his site or make ur way to his bakery somewhere, find a way to get these lobster tails in ur tummy! btw, they have the same set up as the original carlo's w/ a 'please take a number' dispenser, etc. idk how it is in the original w/ seating, but in the vegas one, there's only a few stools and for me (i'm 5'3) it was really difficult to be comfy in those stools! i had to hoist myself onto the stool and then my legs kept losing circulation cuz i was too short and whatnot for my feet to reach the foot part of the stool :/// so i didn't stay sitting for long, and eventually had to go to the buddy v's version of an 'outdoor patio' to sit while i waited for our whole order (2 lobster tails and the personalized cake) to be finished... so after more controversy inside the bakery, turns out they lost the order form at some point, and also made duplicate cakes, etc. idk, it was all confusing to me but at least the cake did get done by the time we went there and it was very yummy... they did blue writing w/ black writing right on top of it! i've never seen anyone do that b4 so i thought that was awesome!
Delicious ice cream! Came by on a Wednesday night and the line was 15 deep. The mint and banana ice cream is awesome! Haven't had a chance to try anything else yet, but can't wait to return.

Donuts are yummy ! My fav is the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut :) they always have a long line and run out of donuts ! I heard they usually run out of donuts around noon time . So if you are planning on trying them out make sure to come well ahead of this to ensure yourself a wide selection. One bad thing however is that they make their donuts a night ahead of time when then are all sold out.

This place had an assortment of different kinds of cool donuts. The interesting thing is that their hours say an opening time, but instead of a closing time it says they close whenever they sell out of product for the day. That ensures they are fresh everyday and don't sell day old donuts. It's a small shop, and can get pretty hectic when it's breakfast or lunch time, so prepare to wait in line. Donuts were very moist and full of flavor.

I am not an ice cream fan as I am not really fond of sweet things. My husband usually gets something and I taste it and then I am done with ice cream. That's what I was expecting when he asked if I wanted to try this place. He ordered a donut with a scoop of honey lavender ice cream. He took it, had a bite and offered it to me for my taste. Imagine my shock when I didn't want to give it back to him. I asked for my own and ate the whole thing! Best ice cream I have ever had! We go back every time we are in Phoenix. I rave about it and drag all of my out of town visitors to try it.

When I went to Vegas, I knew I had to find a place that had macarons. Because that's what you do in Vegas?? Just kidding. I had a short list of places I wanted to check out and someone suggested Bouchon Bakery. Apparently this seemed like an impossible journey as my friends literally trekked all over The Venetian trying to find this place. Finally, after probably an hour of walking, we found Bouchon Bakery. Casino level, tucked behind the escalators. When we finally found BB, I was disappointed to find how small the bakery was (like a stand in the mall food court), but boy did the macarons not disappoint! I bought the sample pack + 1 pistachio because I'm obsessed with this flavor. My oh my! This was so delicious! It was just like a macaron should be - delicate and crisp on the outside, soft and gooey on the inside. I was in heaven and I spent the next 2 days eating the rest of the macarons (shared with my travel mates of course, I'm not that much of a fatty!). They are rather large, so they are definitely good for sharing if you get a few. This is definitely a must if you love macarons!

Apparently they had to change their name to Rewind from Dripp, but this place was made to be Instagrammed with fitting backdrops and bright, colorful drinks for pictures. I'm sure there will be a Black Mirror episode next season about the culture of going to a restaurant or cafe for the 'gram, but I digress. All that aside...the ice cream and drinks are as beautiful on the inside as on the outside. I mean that quite literally with how they infuse the cereal into the ice cream. I was expecting something similar to Cold Stone where chunks of mix-ins are spread out in the ice cream, but they have a cool machine setup that drills your cereal choice down to distribute it homogeneously throughout the ice cream. I got vanilla ice cream with Cinnamon Toast Crunch mixed in and Reeses cups on the top. We all agreed the CTC was the perfect mix-in because when ground to a powder form you get a perfect flavor of cinnamon and sugar mixed in with the creamy ice cream. It also paired well with the Reeses on top. It definitely surpassed my expectations and it is a neat concept overall! My girlfriend got boba because when boba is presented as an option, she can not or will not choose anything else. She had an iced matcha latte with boba and I thought it was pretty good. The matcha flavor was very strong without being overpowering. My friend got a butterfly rose lemonade and it was tasty, the rose flavor was subtle. I personally would not order it because it was essentially more expensive lemonade with some subtle flavors, but if you are one to Instagram your drinks, the butterfly rose is a great model for photos.

Every time I visited Las Vegas, the line for Carlos Bakery was always way too long, but in my most recent trip, I had a chance to finally try some desserts. Located in Venetian, the bakery itself is quite small. I ordered some sugar cookies, a slice of cake, and a cannoli set ($21). The cookies and cake was nothing special, but the cannolis were absolutely delicious! They recommended that I try the chocolate dipped cannoli, which just added more sweetness to my experience.

This place is located on the second floor of the mall that connects the palazzo and the venetian. OK seriously this is the most overrated and overpriced dessert house i have ever been to. OK its the strip I should have been more aware,but when you order 6 pastries and it comes to 68 dollars it better be the best fing pastry you have ever tasted. taste was average at best. But the boxes and string were first rate,i suspect thats what i was paying for. just another example of an all hyped out fancy schmancy underwhelming and thoroughly disappointing experience on the strip. Why is it that all these places on the strip put so much into the visual experience and short people on the tatse experience,these are places to eat not places to look at views...smh

First time here!! When we arrived the line was really long and it was a bit hot outside even at 11pm. I think its really awesome that they are open late which allows for perfect date night desert run! When we finally got to order, it was heavenly sweet surprise! I will definitely be back!

If you havent tried every flavor, I would suggest you do. Not that it will help you decide because, trust me, it may only make the decision harder being that ALL the flavors are amazing. Lucky enough, they thought of people like me and offer The Indecision.

Note: this review is based on the ridiculous wait time. The product is actually good but you have to be kidding me With how long your wait time in line is. This is the second time I've waited in line and left without purchasing anything. And covid is not an excuse. How long does it take to purchase pre-made pastries etc from a case??? A very long time apparently. Sadly as much as I want to keep supporting local, this place lost it for me today.
Terrible, I know 5th graders who make better grilled cheese sandwiches than these guys. Thomas Keller needs to get down here and go Hell's Kitchen on these people.

Always yummy and fun!! Just so pricey for ice cream. I hate that places like this mark everything up (my $2.00 brownie mix is $5.00 here). That's the only reason for 4 stars. Service was Awesome!! Rayna (sorry if I spelled it wrong) was at the cash register and was so fun and full of energy! We all had sundaes and the folks making them did an excellent job. I don't gamble so this is a great place to "lose" my money after a night walking the strip

Such a cute ice cream shop!! If you're craving some "hipster ice cream", this is definitely the place to go. Double scoop of their Chai Tea and Vietnamese Coffee with the signature fortune cookie on top is the way to go. Don't know how I will be able to get ice cream any place else

Good little spot for ice cream. Came across it after hiking Camelback mtn. Good flavors. Small scoops was the only drawback. Especially for the price. $7 for 2 scoops. It would of been 4 or 5 stars with bigger scoops.

Okay this place is a tad obvious to get to if you park in the garage nearby. However we found it and there was a line. They let a few people in at a time and then the guy stopped us and said it would be half an hour. Not sure why as there was only like 6 people infront of us. Anyway finally got up there and I ordered the treasure island. I sadly had to throw more than half of it away. The brownie was the best part, after that it was solid fudge stuck to the cup. the spoon they gave wasn't even strong enough to get it off. The ice cream had no flavor and was too hard to even take bites of. My friend got the ocean beach and she seemed to like it but I didn't try it so my review is based off what I had. I would like to UPDATE- the manager reached out to me and took the review very seriously, which I appreciate so much. I never write reviews to receive anything but I love an honorable business that stands behind its product. They did not ask that I update but I wanted to for how prompt and kind they were. I believe that when I return, I will have a much different experience and I look forward to that!

I don't care if it seems trendy to like Jeni's. I've been following her for nearly a decade, eating ice creams made from her cookbook until they were available in stores. I've tried nearly every flavor. You truly can taste the difference in the quality ingredients she uses, which means other "fake ice creams" at the grocery store have lost their appeal. I'll take the real stuff, the best stuff. And that's Jeni's.
Just my favorite place in the world. I always get the ube and the bubble waffle- best way to start off summer.
The crepes here are FABULOUS!!! we got here just before the line got too crazy but I still would've waited.
Best...ice cream...EVER... The menu was a little overwhelming, only because there is so many good flavors! I strongly recommend this place!

Amelies...Amelies...how I love thee! There are so many good reviews on here. There isn't much left to say! Awesome decor, delicious desserts, eclectic environment. Their macaroons are TOO LIVE FOR! Everything I tasted were authentic French pastries. Nothing tasted American made! The staff is really friendly. They even have their own delicious smelling coffee! Nowhere in Charlotte will you find a place like this! Oh, but wait there's more! They are open 24 hrs! Awesome! Awesome! Awesome! Says the pregnant woman! Lovely place for you to do school work or to meet people. As a Charlotte native, I never thought the day would come where places like this would exist here. Love it! If you haven't been, go now! They're open! Lol

Best value in Madison. Best ice cream taste in Madison. For 2.75 you can get a huge portion of ice cream and huge is the only way to go when getting ice cream. The mocha flavor is personally my favorite. The peanut butter chocolate is also delish. It's always fun to pester the students working there. By pester I mean ask for ice cream nicely. Come on bro just scoop the ice cream, we all know you just have this job for beer money.

Found this little gem today after doing a quick yelp search. So glad we decided to stop in. Brandon was such an amazing help with helping us decide what to get. You can tell he has a passion for what he does. The ice cream flavors are amazing and very unique with a few of the classics!

I have served this country for 30 years retired USN I came up to the cashier and showed my military ID if they are giving out a military discount and the cashier said that I should be in uniform to get 10 percent discount. Wow!

I just came back from Vegas after spending my St. Patrick's Day birthday there. I was given a free cupcake at Sprinkles. It was a good thing it was free or I would have said something. The cake tasted like it had been baked a week ago. Dry as could be. The icing!!!! 3/4 hard as a rock icing and 1/4 cake. Then the price. $5.00 for a little bitty cupcake? I could make over a dozen for less then that and the cake would be moist and the icing would be creamy. From the reviews it looks like I'm the only one that feels this way. My son bought a cupcake and said his was terrible as well. No more Sprinkles for me.

I sampled some of their coconut macaroons at The Taste of Charlotte. They were FANTASTIC. I haven't actually made it to the shop yet, but will put it on my "list of things to do on a Saturday" list. Yay sugar! :D
Fun atmosphere and great ice cream. The worker gave me the wrong ice cream by accident but it's okay because everything is so good. Would recommend.
This place is adorable and has excelled customer service and their ice cream is fantastic. I will definitely be back to try more flavors, but the chocolate was excellent!!

I just wanna say thank you Milk Bar and Christina Tosi for opening this location lol. It's still an airplane ride away but at least its on the west coast! Every Vegas trip literally results in a daily trip for Cereal Milk froyo (don't forget the cornflakes!). And thank you for Vegas business hours so we can make it for late after dinner treats!

I'm only giving this place one star because I didn't get to eat here. Why? Because they do a piss poor job in guiding you to this bitch. On the casino floor they advertise it everywhere. Then you start looking for it and there are no signs anywhere!! I had to ask 4 people that just told me to keep going. It's in BFE. Next to Rockhouse where you can't go any further. Now my family has lost interest. Put up signs to guide people here!!!! I'm sweating from the long walk here!!!! Damn!!!!

Went there on a very hot afternoon. The staff was super friendly and helpful with their menu! The parking area is very small so be aware of that. It is fixed up in this small, little building next to other small containment ship stores. I got the dough melt to share with my bf and it is a warm doughnut and you choose your choice of ice cream and topping in it! The Cookie Monster was suppppper delicious. So delicious that I couldn't stop thinking about it the next day and unfortunately I am from out of town so that sucked. But it was worth trying and I would love to try their other flavors!!! Very unique and fun ice cream ideas. The only con is that it was so freaking hot outside I wish they had misters around the area at least

Looking for what is the BEST ICE CREAM in TOWN? Look no further because Handel's is it!!! I first took notice of them back home in San Diego and my friend brought me to their Calrsbad location and when we first walked up it was a little building with a long line outside...that alone assured me that their ice cream was no joke and definitely going to be the talk of the town. Since then, I moved to Vegas and didnt think id ever find Handel's out here until I went to my trusty little app Yelp lol Was super excited that they had a location out here so I made a mission immediately to drive across town to relive that joy I experienced when I took my first bite of cookies n' cream (HIGHLY RECOMMED). Drove up and they had their same store front image with a walk up window and their menu display of all their flavorful ice cream including their eye catching "cookie monster." My gf ordered their banana split, her son got a cookie dough ice cream on a waffle cone and I ordered their pecan praline in a cup. We waited impatiently outside their store because thier indoor seating was closed off but it was fine, since their were benches very close to the pickup window. When we finally got our ice creams, my gf banana split looked amazing and definitely had some weight to it and I was beginning to have a change of heart and steal hers lol but I was being a good boy and stuck with mine...we all started eating our ice cream and we all couldnt help but smile and compliment how smooth their ice cream texture was and just how refreshing it was to finally taste what good ice cream tastes like. Of course the saying goes, whenever its quiet when people are eating that means its a good sign...lol well that stands true 100% When we got done with our ice cream her son looked at me and told me with a huge smile that he gives this place five stars and that it really was the best ice cream in the world...that really made me felt happy to hear him say that and much happier that now we all have a favorite ice cream place to go to now. If you can, make the drive you will not be dissapointed I promise, the only dissapointment would be not ever knowing what good ice cream tastes like and you're just left wondering until you try Handel's!

Not really a chocolate fan. So I think you can understand the review. However, it was clean, the service was good (to my friends that were chocolate fans) and the location is right there in that area where you walk towards the High Roller near LINQ. For me though? The below pretty much sums it up. Walked in. Chocolates. Walked out.

Awesome idea ran by great people. Had the "Leslie Knope" (ice cream sandwich in between two waffles). We also went with the doughnut stuffed with ice cream as well, and it was ridiculously good. Love that they make everything by hand as well, you can definitely taste the difference. We're visiting from Chicago, and the kids have already made us promise we'll stop there again before we leave!

I am obsessed with Amelies!!!!!! Let me tell you what, thank you to all of the workers there that put up with us when we roll into the joint after a long night on the town. They are always patient and helpful. The Croque Monsieur is the BOMB!

Quite possibly my most favoritest place in Vegas. I found it on my last trip in March of 2009 and tasted the best cheese danish I have ever had in my life. Flaky pastry...delicious (not too sweet sweet) cheese...in perfect ratio. This weekend, I revisited only to be completely impressed with the chocolate tart. Super chocolately without being overwhelming and the tart was the perfect texture, not too thick or chewy with just the right amount of crispness. It was so good, I brought one back home for my hubby and he loved it. I will say though, that I did try the huge red velvet cupcake once and that was not perfect. It was a little dry on the inside. While I wouldn't call the prices affordable, they are low by Vegas standards and in line with prices for such things in San Francisco. I won't be going back to Vegas anytime soon, but in the meantime, I'll just dream about this place until Thomas Keller one day realizes that the residents of SF would probably swarm this place.
Very slow customer service. The lady wasn't the most pleasant person. With the line , you can tell such a high demand however very slow in getting crepe. You ll need 45-50 min to get your crepe

It is hard to appropriately describe what it's like to walk into Amelie's...it's like Alice in Wonderland meets Paris meets Grandma's house meets a garden party. The food is amazing. We had coffee and dessert (we tried several), then we took some pastries back to our hotel for breakfast. It is a wonderful place to check out while in Charlotte!

This is a lot of hype...but does not hit its mark in my view...there are many talented pastry chefs...and clearly she is one but her ideas are not that creative in this place. She has them but choose not to execute them, to bad for all of us. But, kinda cool place, average food , but a very great chef without question.

My 26 year old daughter told me to go here and get a treat for my 50th birthday..I went on aug 13th 2016,I did have to wait in line.got there around 9:30 pm at night. I got me a vanilla cupcake and 1 choc.I though it taste very good.My daughter could not have a treat she can only eat gluten free. I wish they had gluten free. I know Bouchon does but did not know they were only open til 7pm.I would not try canoli.I do not like cream cheese in mind.My aunt is from italy and she does not put cream cheese.She puts pudding in hers. and it taste so much better that way.

Get the cookie cup! Very good. You get to pick a flavor of ice cream and macaroon and then a marshmallow is toasted on top. I picked the chocolate hazelnut ice cream and then picked a strawberry macaroon. My niece got the coffee favored with red velvet macaroon and said it was excellent.

Great spot to get some really good ice cream. We like to get the sweet sundae where you can choose 4 different kinds of ice cream, comes with a cookie, brownie and a toasted marshmallow. This is a great item to share. I have also got the sorbet, strawberry and coconut which is very refreshing as well. Typically on the weekends they have enough employees to handle the line. When I recently went this past weekend, they do not have any seating inside only about two tables outside. Love to come here when we are in the area!

I thoroughly enjoyed myself at Novel Ice Cream. Brandon was extremely friendly and knowledgeable about their flavors. I did not have the chance to get the name of the cashier but she was extremely welcoming as well. She gave me a few recommendations of places to visit while I was in Phoenix. I tried the half honey lavender/half strawberry ice cream and it was absolutely delicious. I would highly recommend anyone visit this establishment to try this place at least once!
The salted caramel cashew was the favorite amongst our family. Friendly staff, seemed clean, great creamy ice cream!

Definitely some of the best ice cream I've had. The selection is massive and the prices for the amount served are more than generous. I highly recommend even if you have to go out of your way. The lines are long so bring your patience, it will be worth the wait :)

Excellent chocolate shop. Clean, friendly staff. They have menus that you can view as soon as you walk in. The menus are on paper so you can take one with you. It smells like chocolate when you walk in. Everything is made there in the shop including the ice cream from what I understand. The portions are very large. The cost is a little higher than the average ice cream shop but you are getting a very quality brand of chocolate. Its a great experience

Wow! All I can say is the ice cream here is awesome! I had the infamous cookie cup tonight with Cap'n Crunch Ice cream and it was delicious! The cookie was a delicious red velvet macaroon from a local bakery and it was so good! To top it all off they toasted a Marshmallow on top. Do yourself a favor and check this place out!

I called to place a phone order and was hung up on when I asked if the lines where long?! No, slam!! Thanks B$@ch it's called customer service if you don't like what your doing for a living than find another job! Maybe one that involves you in a closet by yourself
They have a variety of pastries available and the staff are so friendly. The location is perfect if you would like some outdoor time. Definitely recommend
Beautiful place, amazing decorations, and I LOVE the macaroons! They have a variety of things to choose from. Great place to go with friends, relax, and chill.

This hole in the wall ice cream shop is fresh and gorgeous. The store is lined with gorgeous art prints for sale. Try Purple Rain, formerly known as Blueberry Muffin. It is far away from me, but definitely worth the drive.

Hamburger Cookies, as I call them. Amelie's French Bakery has some good ones. My flavors (ranked in order): birthday cake, pistachio, s'mores, Cinnamon Toast Crunch. You cannot go wrong with birthday cake flavoring in any form. It was the densest hamburger cookie out of them all and I loved it. I'm glad I got two of them as they were my favorite. Pistachio tasted nothing like a pistachio. It was the perfect subtle sweet cookie that is just so pretty to look at. This is one of the most popular sells at Amelie's. S'mores was more chocolatey and it was missing the marshmallow in the middle. I was hoping for the campfire style s'mores with your chocolate, marshmallow, and most importantly, the graham cracker. If they decided to go with a marshmallow cream filling and somehow mimic a graham cracker taste, this would become an instant all-star. Cinnamon Toast Crunch - the classic childhood favorite, morning cereal before school. This hamburger cookie contained chocolate in the middle, which threw me off because I don't recall my bowl of Cinnamon Toast Crunch with 2% milk have any chocolate flavoring. They would of done better playing it safe going with a vanilla based creme instead (with cinnamon?). Nonetheless, the crunchy cinnamon on the outside and softness on the inside made this a decent hamburger cookie. Becca was very funny and friendly in helping us pick out our hamburger cookies. Good energy in this very cool, unique cafe that's open 24 hours a day. Prices are just too steep.
Most amazing ice cream on the planet! Soo happy our hometown ice cream finally came to vegas!!! Yum!
Great customer service. Fantastic ice cream and very friendly atmosphere. Very kind employees. Extremely clean! - totally a five

So good and so much ice cream that I felt like death afterwards. And not to mention the massive amounts of Lactaid poor little lactose-intolerant Asian me had to take. Totally worth it. Well, I really wished that they had different sizes because a single SMALL scoop would have sufficed. However, I had to have both the Green Tea and the Coconut Almond Bliss, which meant I had to order the one with two flavors and it was enormous. The waffle cone is amazing, and the dipped ones are even better. I was very sad that I couldn't finish my ice cream and it was all melted by the time I got home. Crying.

Stopped by this new Ice cream place inside the Venetian hotels on the strip. It's by the canal near San mare plaza The store itself is very colorful and inviting. They just don't sell ice cream but all sort of toys and candies and more. It's adorable but maybe too many thing beside the ice cream!

Ghiradelli shops are very consistent from store to store which is what I love the most about them. Only wanted the free sample chocolate they were giving, but you cant walk into this store and not order anything. Everything is just too damn delicious. Who can resist? This location is a bit tiny but does the job. They have a pretty good reputation so it was packed but we didn't have to wait long at all. They took our orders quickly and we got our desserts even quicker.

Sprinkles is at The Linq (between the Flamingo and the Quad). Cupcakes are $3.75 each and an additional 50 cents if you want it in a box instead of a wax bag. They have more than one door. The left is cupcakes only while the right side is both cupcakes and ice cream. They have prices and flavors posted and only offer certain flavors on different days of the week. You can check their website or download the Sprinkles app to find out what flavors they have that day. I just went to the cupcake side on this visit, but plan on trying the ice cream in the future. I ordered a "Doggie Cupcake" priced at $2.50 that is sugar-free and has a yogurt frosting. It had a cute little orange bone on top. My dog, Brownie loved it! She licked the top off first and then ate the rest. I had a "Lemon Meringue" that was very good. The lemon cake had graham cracker lining and delicious tasting lemon curd in the middle. The top had toasted marshmallow that was good, but had a chewy outer layer that was tough to eat, so that was all that was left of the cupcake I didn't finish. They have tables and chairs outside of the store. As I was sitting there eating my cupcake, Candace Nelson the founder of Sprinkles came outside to greet customers. She was very sweet and signed autographs and took pictures with people, including myself! They have a decent amount of tables and chairs outside, but they were pretty filled up and the inside of the store was busy yet the line moved along smoothly. There is a cupcake ATM outside (near the ice cream side) on the patio and it's open 24 hours. The cupcakes are still $3.75 each, but come boxed so you have to pay the extra 50 cents. Hubby had a strawberry cupcake that I tried a bite of and liked, so I got one of those from the cupcake ATM to see how it worked. The ATM is user friendly and the screen allows you to see your cupcake coming to you from inside the store to when the door lifts open on the ATM revealing a pink box. I thought it was cool and even though the store is open late, it is neat knowing you can get a Sprinkles cupcake at any hour. Hours: Sunday - Wednesday 10 am to 12 am Thursday - Saturday 10 am to 1 am

Really unique menu selection. We were told the crack pie was a must try but sadly they didn't have any available. I did try their signature 'cereal milk' in a latte and it was incredibly different. A little sweet, a little salty - somehow they've been able to replicate the taste of milk leftover from cereal perfectly. Definitely worth trying
Chocolate Croissant is to die for! This place is such an amazing spot to grab coffee or a delicious dessert. Everyone is so nice!

Part of the charm of shopping at WSM is the interaction with colorful personalities of the appreciative vendors. It's certainly not a requirement, but does add to the pleasant overall experience. Oddly enough, happy customers buy more and return often. As with many other reviews, the staff at Crepes De Luxe is simply not worth dealing with and appears to be best suited for work not involved with or anywhere near people which is baffling considering it's an open stand with direct customer contact. If you're into subjecting yourself to confrontation, arrogance and rudeness you won't be disappointed. Not me, once is enough

A friendly clean and welcoming ice cream shop. The staff is happy to offer suggestions and describe the flavors. The ice cream is creamy and delicious. It has a very cute area to enjoy the shoppe and eat your choice or take home a pint or quart. Right on the Encanto light rail stop. Fun stop.

Batch has the most consistent quality and best variety of pastries and desserts in the area. Lots of good, tasty stuff and always great service. I like the cakes, cupcakes but especially the tarts and other pastries near the front of the store. Slightly less impressed with the breads which are decent but not great.

Was a little disappointed in the pastries I got. I visited this place several years back when it was in a much smaller location and thought it was better then. Maybe it feels too commercialized now. The almond croissant was fine. Nothing special. It wasn't warmed, either, and had way too much almond paste in the middle. The macron was cold and hard, not soft and delectable. I couldn't even finish it, and that's not a good sign. The coffee was fine. Also nothing special, dashing my expectation for a delicious cup of French coffee. Went back the next day to try a few more things. The elephant ears had no taste. The tea cake was good. Honestly, Had hoped for more when I walked in given my past experience. It went from quaint good French bakery to giant just OK French bakery.
A nice place to hangout and get something sweet on a warm day. A big selection and the custard is creamy and delicious.

Even if you just go to try out some crazy blue ice cream, go. Awesome owners answer any and all questions you have, you get to try out every flavor beforehand, you just can't go wrong. Cute building with lots of character, super awesome and delicious creamy goodness of ice cream, great people. You just can't lose.

I was definitely expecting more from this place based off of the photos. The reviews were accurate, everything was subpar at best. Which is unfortunate, I tried the Red Velvet Milkshake, B-Day Cake slice, B-Day Cake Truffles, and Milk Pie. The only thing that was above average was the Milk Pie. The Cake slice was hard and not moist at all, and everything else was just...regular. I definitely will not be visiting this place again.

If you are in the market for a bit of over priced desserts, then you are in the right place. Sprinkles is in a prime location of the LINQ. Always active on the streets out front since they are right next to the Brooklyn Bowl, so its really convenient for people to see a show or get dinner and come here after. I have no problem with the workers there or anything. They all seem like great people and the times I have been there they have always been helpful. Even the store is great and had the cupcake dispenser on the side. Great time during summer to check this place out. The one big set back for me is the price of these desserts. It's definitely strip prices so I am paying for location. I just say if you have another place to get desserts, I say go there instead. If you are trying to save money.

Disclaimer: this review is only for the ice cream. That being said, I gave it an extra * because I'm only reviewing a portion of their offerings. The milk bar is a walk up dessert shop in the Cosmopolitan. If you stop by at any type of popular time, there's going to be a wait. But to try such unique confections by one of TVs most beloved celebrity chefs (Christina Tosi), it would be worth it, right?? For the ice cream, not so much. Milk has three different flavors--cereal milk, chocolate pretzel, and a fruity cereal milk. I got cereal milk and chocolate pretzel with chocolate topping. A small was ~$6, it wasn't a huge amount for the price, but it would be enough for one or two people to share. Or even 20, because once I had a few bites, I went from being intrigued to really put off. The pros: The consistency is perfect. You can tell its a high quality soft serve. The staff is nice. The cons: The descriptions are 100% what you're getting. The cereal milk ice cream tastes like cereal milk. And not cookie crisp cereal milk, but some kind of cardboard healthy cereal. And the chocolate pretzel was the same--it was extra pretzelly, not enough chocolatey. Overall my biggest problem was there wasn't enough sweetness to it--it really just tasted like creamy versions of the flavors. The chocolate topping, for $1 extra, wasn't hot fudge-y and it wasn't sauce-y, it was weird and almost taffy-like. I wanted to try one of their cake or pie offerings, but they were just way too expensive for me to justify spending on dessert. Next time I'm in Vegas and have a hankering for ice cream, idk where I'll go, but I won't be visiting Milk again.

This was my go to place for breakfast everyday when I was visiting Vegas for few days. I really love their coffee and pastries! On the last day of my stay, I went there to pick up some macarons to bring home and as usual there was a long line. I really didn't mind to wait. When I got back to the hotel room which was upstairs, I quickly realized one of the macarons was not what I ordered. And i was also being charged for extra macaron on the receipt. I went downstairs again and told the lady at the shop about that. She raised her voice and said that's what I ordered. I further explained maybe because I was wearing a mask and it was loud in the surrounding (inside a hotel and casino and there were many people), she may not heard it right. But I would like to exchange to the one I wanted. She gave me such a dirty look and was continuing accused me that's what I ordered. I politely told her I would like to make it right to what I have ordered. I further explained I was being charged extra and she looked at me like I took my macaron out and came back demanding for the refund for ONE macaron?! Making it in a scene and everyone in line was looking at me! Really? This is the most ridiculous thing I ever experienced in a cafe like that!

I wanted to love this place because it is so cute!! I'm still on the fence. The food was pretty good, but sightly overpriced and the line was ridiculous. The line makes you anticipate that you are going to be eating something amazing and while they're good-I wouldn't say amazing. Not much they can do about it, but the line was like 30 people deep. Will probably go again, but NEVER on a weekend.

LOVE this place! Every time I go, I always discover something new and unique. The courtyard area is eclectic and the atmosphere is always lovely and fun. I recommend trying this bakery if you haven't already.

Multiple people have raved about this place, so I was very disappointed with the experience. This is what we ordered: Napoleon: Is there ice cream in this? How about some flavor? Blech. Key lime pie tart: Eh, pretty bland. Caramel apple cake: Cooked a few weeks ago, I think. Soooo dry and bland. Bread pudding: Is this pudding or cake? Again, outrageously dry. Also, a 20-minute line? Ha! And a font for menu items that I can't read. I'll never come here again. Way overrated! They did offer free refills on coffee which was nice.

Delicious, friendly and accommodating. They went above and beyond to help me to buy a cake for my son's birthday. I don't live in Cleveland (any more) and they really went out of their way to help me to make my son's day special. Oh, yeah - it also tasted just delicious (I hear).

These are real gourmet donuts with a nice price their coffee is also good and the staff is so friendly you can tell they put a lot of time and effort into not only their donuts but to their coffee also I like the maple bacon donut and I got a latte which was awesome!

I was really disappointed with trying this place! Everyone raves about it and arriving there, it was packed! Maybe my hopes were set to high? The ice cream wasn't BAD it just wasn't great. It had a grainy texture and mine didn't have a whole lot of flavor. I was really bummed! Great service, fun atmosphere, just not the creamy and flavorful ice cream I was hoping for.

If I could give them more stars, I would. My family loves this locally owned place for ice cream. They have such great flavors and they are very unique too. I love the salted butter caramel with a toasted marshmallow! My kids love the brownie swirl with a toasted marshmallow on top. They have some seasonal flavors that are always worth trying. Sweet potato was pretty good. The bananas foster was so yummy! Definitely try this place if you haven't!

Mitchell's is amazingly fantastic. It's hands-down the best ice-cream I've ever had, and I freaking love ice cream. Grocery store brands are nothing in comparison. ALL of the flavors are great, even the ones I didn't think I would ever like. Strangely enough, for me, personally, the mint chocolate chip is eh and sort of disappointing, but everything else is ridiculously good. My favorites are the rocky road, coffee chocolate chunk, key lime pie, wild berry crumble, raspberry chocolate chunk, butter pecan, and the raspberry sorbet. (:
Got there at 8 on a saturday, 2minute wait, friendly staff and great donuts. Strawberry Big Poppa was like a toaster strudel on steroids. Good stuff!

The coffee is very good and an alternative to my usual Starbucks morning coffee run, but the pastries and cakes were disapointing to say the least. For first thing in the morning you would expect fresh and crisp, but they were soft and stale. The atmosphere of the new downtown location was very nice though, and it would be a great place for a meeting over coffee. Hope they get the bakery side running properly soon or they will find it difficult to stick around. Willing to give their breakfast and lunch food a try. So stay tuned.

Best soft serve in the burgh! Their peanut butter ice cream is to die for. I also think their chocolate is the best I've ever tasted. The lines are always long but it goes very fast - excellent, fast service and really great prices. So glad I live so close!
Ice cream was soooo delicious! I got the watermelon taffy very sweet like I like it!!
I Love this place, the desserts are AMAZING! It is so hard to pick just one.

We were looking for something sweet after a meal of heavy carbs and decided to try melt. The portion sizes were good, not stingy for the price, and the ice cream flavors were unique, which I appreciated. I tend to prefer ice cream that has more of the crystal formation, which this did not have (complete personal preference), but it was creamy and delicious. I tried the Trix ice cream, which was an 8/10. The ice cream tasted like cereal milk, which I'm always down for, but the pieces of cereal were this weird amount of encapsulated soggy, which I wasn't a fan of. I'd have omitted the cereal and let the flavor of the ice cream stand for itself. I got a second flavor, but I can't remember what it was; so I'm guessing it wasn't that memorable?

Not sure what's wrong with this location, but something always goes wrong. My first visit they did not have boba. On my second visit, the boba were hard. Third visit, the internet is out. Notified the staff, but they didn't seem concerned about it. Their location down by the college is better. I think I'm done with this one.

A pretty good ice cream spot! My husband and I have passed by Jeni's plenty of times just to see a line out the door and down the road. We've always wondered what the hype was about. Tonight we stopped in after dinner to give it a shot. For $5, we each got 2 half-scoops of ice cream in a bowl. The staff was friendly and let us try a few samples before deciding on a flavor. I went for the dairy-free chocolate and chocolate-chip mint. My husband went with regular dark chocolate and orange chiffon. My mom got the gooey butter cake and the bramble-berry. In my honest opinion, everything I tasted was good but I still don't understand the hype. I definitely would have been disappointed if I'd've waited in a long line for it. I also thought it was a little overpriced. But, like I said, the flavors were good! And the dairy-free chocolate tasted just like your typical chocolate ice cream. No complaints here (besides the price) but I just don't understand the hype.

My family and I were visiting from out of town and had a little sweet tooth after dinner. We browsed through Yelp and found this hidden gem, nestled among a few other brightly colored, tiny houses. We went up the little ramp and walked in to find a fairly modest interior- rainbow squares along with fun doodles plastered all over the walls and one case of ice cream with a row of toppings showcased in cute little labeled containers. The owners greeted us with a warm smile and graciously gave us the run down- we could try every flavor of ice cream before choosing one, pairing it with a free topping and choosing how we wanted it. We could do the traditional scoop or try one of their signature styles- a donut ice cream sandwich or a waffle ice cream sandwich! He explained that both their ice cream and donut chefs were widely acclaimed for their desserts. While they have only been open for about 6 months, they have worked for two years to accrue the best ingredients, best flavors and best chefs to create the BEST product. I ordered a single scoop of the Fat Elvis (peanut butter ice cream with banana and bacon bits) with waffle cone pieces on top and my boyfriend ordered the donut ice cream sandwich with the Nutella ice cream. After the first bite, we agreed- this is hands down the BEST ice cream we've ever had. The ice cream itself is very creamy and packed with flavor. And the donut combination was to die for!!!
Huge donuts but not the most flavorful. They had lots of options and we went for the apple fritter, pumpkin cream cheese and Nutella. Donuts were a bit dry. The staff was very friendly.

RUN, don't walk, to this INCREDIBLE bakery on Charlotte's west side. It is a quaint shop in an area that is being developed into a spot you could spend all day at. Every interaction I've had with the wonderful ladies that work there has been so sweet. But the real star, are the baked goods! I love that they have a rotation of items so you always have something new to try. I have LOVED multiple variations of their coffee cakes and brownies and my husband loves the cookie sandwiches. It is impossible to walk out with just one treat since they ALL look so amazing!

Bouchon Bakery is one of those "pilgrimage" bakeries that you must visit at least once a year (or once a month if you're an LV native for all I'm concerned). Their macarons are crazy delicious and are really large like the rest of the pastries there. I would personally recommend getting (in addition to a box of macarons) the chocolate croissant, the chocolate bouchons, and the TKO (Thomas Keller Oreo).

Cristina was great to work with. She was very responsive when it came to a cake order we placed and the dulce de leche passed my Brasilian wife's standards with flying colors. I will absolutely be using Cristina for any future orders I have and will look forward to visiting the coffee shop more often on a regular basis.

Wowowow. Churn makes excellent ice cream. This may be in the top three ice creams I've had in the entire country. I got half a scoop of the peanut butter, half a scoop of butter pecan. Each one was to die for. The peanut butter was absolutely perfect. The butter pecan was so delicious. I tried my friend's vanilla, and it was so smooth and not your typical boring vanilla. The prices are unbelievable for the quality. Would've paid double the price. It's a small shop with seats outside. And they do samples!

It was ok. I was disappointed that they only had two non dairy options that were both sorbet. Other places also have a dairy free frozen yogurt or a tart. The prices are much higher than I would expect, parking was tough. They did have a bunch of cool candy treats which was cool. It wasn't bad. It I likely won't go back.

This place would have received 2 stars if not for the ice cream. Grandma's cookie flavor was great! What I didn't like were the macarons and the marshmallow. The cookies were too dense and chewy to be considered macarons. The issue with the marshmallow was that it was extremely gummy and made it hard to bite off, it tasted stale. The portion was decent but still expensive. I was excited to try this place and was disappointed. I probably won't be back when there are many other ice cream shops that offer better products at a more reasonable price.

This place is so delicious. It has great traditional ice cream flavors along with Asian Filipino treats. My kids loved the Cookie Monster ice cream. Everything was so rich and creamy. Don't miss the boba tea!

I had to. I had to get a cupcake. I had to. And I ate the whole thing. Like I said, I HAD to. Got a coconut something or other. I don't remember the name. I just remember it being so delicious. I didn't share. It was all mine. Will go back again. This could turn in to a problem. They have a loyalty app too. Oh goodness there is no hope.

One of the best pastry places I have visited. Absolutely love their tiramisu, creme brulee and cheesecakes. Their cappuccino and biscotti are a must have. Good options for vegetarians. Their basil pesto and sun dried tortellini are mind blowing. Also love the vegetarian stromboli. Would really recommend this place for a weekend brunch.
Yummy bakery items. I especially enjoyed the cannoli. The espresso coffees are perfect, not overcooked like some places. Looks like this place gets a LOT of regulars.
Only place close in fun and deliciously creative donuts is Hurts Donuts in Springfield, MO. Great espresso here!

Their cereal milk soft serve is JUST AS GOOD as people say! The first bite was AMAZING. I freaking love the salty after taste. Though it does get a bit too much towards the end, that's why it's a 4 instead of 5. I recommend sharing with another person to get the best experience.
Oh wow... BEST waffle cone sundae I've ever had! Can't wait to try the next delicious adventure

The first two times we came here it was great the second time we were disappointed nothing tasted the same and I don't know how to describe it just disappointed might give them one more try on next trip back to Vegas if changes will change review

Hands-down the best bakery in Charlotte. Came here on Saint Joseph's day to get a Zeppoli and it was so fresh and soft and delicious. I had to come back for more and have made many visits to the bakery. Everything I've tried I would recommend but especially the red velvet cake and the lobster tail.

This review is for their ramen that they sell during the winter. They were doing an occasional ramen pop-up, but their ramen was so popular that they started selling it every weekend during the winter! I stopped in to give it a try. It was $12 for the tonkotsu and you can either sit at the counter or they have a covered patio with tables you can sit at if you've got a little group. So I grew up on packets of ramen. Square of hard noodles and a seasoning packet that you dump water onto and heat on the stove/microwave. The legit unprocessed version at Mason's is pretty tasty upgrade and definitely a comfort on a cold day. Also, they give you a whole egg, not half like some other ramen places. Mmm I could probably eat two bowls in a sitting. Friendly service. Just make sure you get there early to score a parking spot (and before they run out of ramen!).

Omg sooo amazing!!! I know this is something really simple but my husband asked him for cup of water and he gave 2 cups of water for both of us!! I call that a perfect customer service. I'm so happy with Pjo John's service. Totally made my day!!!
By far the best cupcakes I've ever had. I always have to get a box of these while in Vegas. Strawberry and vanilla are my two faves. For sure a must-try place if you enjoy your sweets.
So charming and sweet! From the decor to authentic French treats and pastries, it always makes my day to pop in here when I am visiting Charlotte.
This place has so many flavors, it puts DQ to shame. So cheap, great vintage feel, outdoor seating. Short drive off campus.

This is my new favorite ice cream place in Phoenix! An ice cream sandwich made with a donut - FANTASTIC!!! I have had the Cookie Monster ice cream with the glazed donut twice now... And there are soo many different flavors... I can't to come back again!!

I learnt about Bouchon bakery through yelp and when we planned for Vegas this place was made to fit in the itinerary on the places we wanted to visit. This is my first experience with the Thomas Keller creation. Bouchon bakery is located at the Venetian. We went around 7pm and the actual bakery was closed but there was a pop up bakery and that was enough to get me going ga ga. I went with chocolate and pistachio macaroons, Oreo biscuit (Thomas Keller special), croissant and a hot cappuccino. The macaroons sizes were bigger than average, the biscuit was a little crunch but soft and chewy, the cream inside was delicious, soft and rich. I felt the pistachio was a little sweeter but my favorite was the chocolate. My most favorite of the lot I took was the croissant and the Oreo biscuit. The croissant was so buttery it was literally melting in my mouth. The Oreo biscuit was dark, perfectly sweetened and the cream was so rich. It was one of the best I have had. My taste buds were having a ball. The cappuccino was delicious too, We loved everything. The price is not very expensive. It costed me $20 and that's about average. I would highly recommend this place and will visit next time I'm in Vegas.
To the tall guy with long hair and glasses, wearing a red shirt; how could you take something sweet and make it so sour?

Came here per friends' recommendation since I was on a business trip in Decatur, which is 30 min away from Champaign. I had my doubts at first because who would have thought any food could would be this good in a small college town. Boy was I in for a treat. Strawberry shortcake snowstorm was my choice based on my friend's yelp review and it was AMAZING. The portion for was quite large for a small cup too. DEFINITELY going to come back again in my future trips.

I believe this showed up as a Yelp recommendation for me because I was in Vegas for a conference. I had never heard of it before but the concept of a cereal milk-flavored ice cream was very appealing and I couldn't resist trying it. It was exactly how you would imagine it would taste and the corn flakes took it to the next level. I even bought a box of the different flavored cookies for my kids. The compost cookie was everyone's fave but as the kid who helped me said, the corn cookie is super slept on! Not cheap but a nice treat.

Located inside The Cosmopolitan; Milk Bar is located close to all the food places like Egg Slut and next to Marukfuku Ramen. Admittedly, I did not know about this place until a friend asked me to get them something from here when I was in town. So I figured since I'm here, might as well get myself something as well. So I got myself a variety of the cookies and a slice of that bday cake. The cookies, are just okay in my opinion. But the bday cake is fireeeeee!!!! I went back another time and tried their chocolate bday cake and I feel like that was even better than the regular one. The chocolate is super decadent and just kinds of amazing. Their stuff is pricey, but I don't know if it's because it's a Vegas thing or if all the other ones in other locations are the same, but I figured "when in Vegas, right?" Super side note: if you're planning to buy a cake here and take it back to your home destination to share with friends and family, the cake which normally needs to be refrigerated, can be out and about for four hours before it goes bad. I asked the staff and they told me that.
These were definitely worth the wait! Drove all the way across town to try them. Service and donuts were great!

I'm a pretty experienced ice cream eater, and after my many years of eating ice cream, this is my new favorite place. Great ice cream, delicious cone that complements the ice cream, and great service! I tried the thai tea, french toast, pumpkin pie, sweet potato pie, and salted caramel. And these are the most accurate flavors I have ever had. The french toast actually tastes like french toast! I felt like I was at brunch, except I was actually eating ice cream. And they even added maple syrup on top of the scoop! I thought it was a nice touch. With the thai tea flavor, they also added condensed milk on top. Each ice cream flavor here is truly perfection. Creamy and flavorful. And the flavors actually taste like what they say they are! Also, the array of flavors here are vast and original. I have never seen a sweet potato pie flavor! And it is exactly what sweet potato pie would taste like too. The cone here was also beautifully crafted. They are made in house and go well with the ice cream. Outside, there is seating with cute lights. And there's a mural of an ice cream cone too! (Very IG-able) Also, the staff here are very friendly, and didn't get irritated by my sampling. They even offered me more samples after I had ordered my ice cream! They never seemed annoyed or anything.

Are you ficking kidding me?! This place was on fire! Yeah yeah ice cream on fire ha ha! No kidding! Every cream is that consistency more towards gelato and that is a colossal victory.
