Stop on down, took me 30 minutes to get there from Gilbert, and enjoy a cone or cup. Do yourself a favor and don't delay for 3 years like I did!

What a great place! I have to visit a local donut joint in every city I visit; so glad I picked this one! The young lady that helped me was super cute (I love a girl who can rock blue hair) & friendly. I was bummed they were out of the salted caramel until I saw the size of their fritters! I got the one with bacon- check out the pic. And I finally got a creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut! So happy I did. Both were excellent. A bonus: the "artwork" in the bathroom!

Totally disappointing given the hype. Cereal milk soft serve ($6) had a creamy smooth texture but faint flavor. A small slice of Crack pie ($6.50) was cold, mushy and just plain sweet. Everything is pre-packaged (other than coffee and soft serve) which sets the perception that it is not all that fresh.
Best ice cream / donut sÃ¡ndwich ever! Everyone from out of town I take here and always a favorite for everyone. A must try in Phoenix!

Pro-tip: Expect a line. There's no place to eat inside. They offer samples. You can split one scoop into two mini scoops for more flavors. For the floats, they give you the rest of the soda in the bottle/can. Highlights: The pricing is really affordable for someone who wants a double or triple scoop since one scoop is $5 and it's only $1 more for 2x the ice cream or $2 more for 3x the ice cream. The ice cream is good quality and the flavors are distinct as well. Lowlights: It would be nice if they had indoor seating or even a larger space so people in line don't have to wait outside in the heat. They only have 12 flavors and a lot of them are the basic chocolate/vanilla/butter pecan type of flavors.

Fast and friendly service in a nostalgic little joint. Definitely a family friendly spot and highly trafficked (lots of customers enjoying the fall weather on the outside seating)! Passing thru town and was recommended by our host. Delicious little treat in this gem of a city!
Love this place. We always goto the Donut Bar when we're in San Diego. I so glad there is one in my hometown now. I will be making many many visits to this place.

very lack luster, whats the big deal ?? The "buttercream frosting" and I use that term LOOSELY ! is more like crisco cream frosting, and lets forget about the salted carmel brownies, they are NOT what they use to be :( sorry Amelies, I wont go back ,, I will stick with Novas Bakeries in Charlotte
Decent-to-good (not spectacular) desserts. Very limited seating area. Quite noisy.

This place is ok. Customer service is not the best and the ice cream quality is neutral to me. The dinning was interesting , the wood chairs are way too tall to sit and talk with the person next to you!

This ice cream is a must in Pheonix. They have about 8 - 10 flavors and all of them were so good that I had a hard time to pick which one for my donut melt. I finally came with honey lavender ice cream. The donut by it self was so soft and yummy. With the ice cream inside, it tasted like heaven!
I may need an intervention on my cream puff addition! These are just the right size, excellent pastry and chocolate but the filling is sublime! Their blueberry lemon scone are moist and flavorful .

Fantastic Spot for Premium Donuts When I heard San Diego's Donut Bar set up a location in Vegas, I just had to have it again. In SD, I had the Strawberry Split (an unforgettable fruity donut stuffed with whipped cream, $4) and I was pleased to see it again here in Vegas. But on this trip I had to try something new. On this Saturday morning we got there pretty late, around 10:30am, and it seemed like a lot had already been sold. Of what remained, I had two donuts: Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e ($2) & the Twix donut ($2). I gotta say, both Donuts were unlike anything I've ever had before. The brÃ»lÃ©e had a sweet sticky crunch layer of molten sugar and filled on the inside with sweet cream. I knew going into the Twix I would be smacked with an explosion of chocolate and it did not disappoint - Twix bar crumbs covered the top layer of thick chocolate dressing on chocolate dough. Amazing! For your coffee craving, there're several options to choose: espresso, mocha, chai latte, drip, etc. I had the Americano - a super smooth black coffee. Plans for my next visit, try two new donuts, try the drip coffee, and ARRIVE EARLY!!!

So happy to have an authentic Filipino dessert shop near us. The halo halo special was amazing! The owners are so sweet and customer service is phenomenal. It's hidden in the back so a little hard to find but will definitely be back! Maybe next time we'll try the other desserts but they do have ice cream too. The owner said they were rolling out ice cream flavored coffee too.

There was a very long line when we were there on a Saturday morning but the 2 gentlemen who were working worked quickly and efficiently to get everyone through. When we ordered, they were out of the brisket which is what my husband ordered, which wasn't a big deal at all so we both got the Complete and let me tell you - it was AMAZING and DELICIOUS. Well worth the wait and I have already told all of our local Cleveland friends to stop by and try your amazing crepes!

Was introduced to this institution when I first moved here five years ago, and then three years ago bought a place a mile away! How lucky was that!! Can't go wrong with anything you pick. Ice cream is nice and creamy and the texture is perfect. The portions are huge. A small is surely enough to satisfy, but if you wanna indulge get a medium with two flavors.

Oh wow! After seeing multiple Instagram posts of the macaroon ice cream sandwiches I had to try Ninety's out! I came around 9pm on a Friday and the plaza Ninety's is located in was packed! Inside the shop was busy, but surprising most people were ordering the homemade ice cream. They had about 12 different flavors, but my heart was set on the macaroon sandwich. I looked in the freezer and there had to be 15 different flavors. The ones that popped out the most were pistachio, peanut butter, play dough (cookie dough), birthday cake and strawberry shortcake. My husband and I decided the split the birthday cake macaroon ($5.95). Note they will cut it in half for you and it was easily big enough to split. Ok the sandwich. Wow! The ice cream was cake batter mixed with cake pieces, sprinkles and frosting. And the macaroon was super soft! I thought it would be hard from the freezer, but I was wrong. It was such a perfect mix. Eating the ice cream and macaroon together was so delicious! This was probably one of my favorite ice cream treats Ive ever had. There's also a lake near Ninety's where you can sit or walk around, plus they have paddle boats available. It would be a great little date night to enjoy the paddle boats and go for some Ninety's. I will definitely be back this summer!

You want the best? Here it is! I lived across town for a while and still detoured to pages to satisfy the ol sweet tooth. The brownie Sunday and malt milkshakes are my go to treats You go there on a hot summer night and the line can be across the lot into the lot for the car dealership. Amazingly the people there keep things rocking and rolling. Around back is little history of the Baldwin necks run area.

Terrible. Got a Thai tea smoothie for close to six bucks and it was the worst thai tea flavored thing I've ever tasted, just straight up tasted like milk. Friend got a milk tea latte and it was half powder not mixed properly. They don't even try, it seems. Another friend got gelato which tasted like frozen sugar water and nothing like pomegranate. also ridiculous expensive for small portion. I have yet to hear anything good on their menu, but especially stay away from thai tea, milk tea, red velvet, any gelato.

I'm from CA on a business trip therefore I wanted something to do in NC and Yelp was a lot of help in finding Amelie's! However I can not say the same for the staff at Amelie's! I order my tart and coffee and was told they would take it to my table. Well I never got my coffee bc no one told me that I had to pick it up at the coffee bar and no one was nice enough to take it to my table! On other bad note! I wanted to buy some of there tarts and take them back to CA to give to my friends and staff! However this same staff told me that they do not have any boxes to put them that would help with the air flight. She did not ever try to help me! To bad for her bc I wanted to buy enough for 50 members of my staff! Wow someone does not like making money! That's ok bc I could always take my business where it is welcome!

The Frenchie sandwiches here are legit Yo! I mean the fresh warm rustic bread, toss in some gourmet stuffings like brie, gruyere, seasonal compotes, pate, spicy mayo then each are matched with an awesome meat or veggie to create a divine lunch. Of course I can't forget the almond and chocolate croissants which are seriously a guilty pleasure of mine. I scooped some on a mid-day hoping I could hang onto them for breakfast. Yeaaa that didn't quite pan out those awesome pastry delights didn't make it to sunset and I wasn't complaining. Thanks AFB
They have the best donuts in town. I love coming here. They're always so friendly. Every time I drive to this side of town it's a must to stop by.

The best treats in town! My favorite are the various caramels and single serve cakes. I have gifted the bourbon vanilla extract which Kaya makes/ages herself and the recipient could not have been happier! Some of her marshmallows have been used in drink specials at flying machine coffee and really made the (already awesome) drinks supreme. I can't say enough good things about Kaya and this lovely budding business!

I had the chocolate walnut meringue cookie, hazelnut lobster tail, and French cream lobster tail. I was disappointed with the cookie, it didn't have that fall apart on the outside, chewy on the inside type of texture. The fillings for the lobster tails were delicious but the crusts were meh. The pastries didn't seem to be freshly made. Oh pretty expensive. $5.50 per lobster tail.
Great ice cream with VERY interesting flavors (horchata, strawberry jalapeno, churro, guiness). Awesome customer service too. I will definitely go back! The strawberry jalapeno was SO GOOD!

I love cake boss!!! Met him a few years ago at a book signing vromins in Pasadena. He was very nice. This bakery though was very unorganized and very long waits! The cannoli was delicious but I would not go back for those lines. Sigh... It could have been better. But it could be cus it was new and the weekend. I dk lol

I'm originally from Cleveland OH. Everyone loves Handel's from back home. Moved to Vegas awhile ago and I started getting cravings. Happy to find a Handel's right down the street. Best ice cream in the country.

This is probably one of the best bakeries and Cleveland. . I would recommend the meat Stromboli and pepperoni and sausage supreme pizza, for desert the Amarado lobster tail.. they have great coffee, breakfast sandwiches on Friday Saturday and Sunday. He's in many ways to enjoy this place

Super disappointed with a recent experience to Bouchon Bakery. Having had Bouchon macarons before, I thought it would be worth it to drive to the Venetian hotel, park and walk through the casino for this tasty little treat. I had a friend in town on a short layover and had told her how these were the best tasting macarons I had ever had, including our many trips to Paris. Unfortunately, we must have hit the bakery on leftover day because everything we ordered was STALE. At $3.50 per cookie, I expected them to be super fresh and melting in my mouth. They were not moist, but completely dry and old tasting. Two stars because the chai latte was decent.
Best donuts on the earth! Fresh daily, amazing combinations and award winning! LOVE, LOVE!!!!

Honestly, nothing special about their ice cream. It was just a little less sweet and a little more creamy than other ice cream places that I've had. Nothing else was that good or bad. It's just ice cream but if you really like sweet things then maybe don't get the cookies and crÃ¨me and strawberry.
If you don't mind standing in line for an hour because of lack of organization and then eating subpar bake goods, this place is for you.

Stopped in after waiting so long (dietary restrictions) to finally try. I did some menu research ahead of time and was excited. On the evening of my first visit I encountered a short line. But hey, it's a small cozy shop and it is good so expect a little line on your visit. The ice cream selection rotates but they keep their most popular around. They let you try all the flavors you want. On this visit I had lavender honey ice cream with fruity pebbles in the donut as well as a float with their pistachio ice cream combined with a cream soda from thier house curated soda selection. Treats in hand I sat out on the shared patio at 3rd Space and enjoyed the evening.

I've been coming to Jarling's for a long time and it never fails. Delicious custard prepared in a huge variety of ways. The line at the front can be confusing but I would stand near the back when you first walk in and then you'll notice several counters where you can place your order and lines form leading up to them. The snowstorm is Jarling's version of a Dairy Queen Blizzard but my favorite thing to get are the sundaes. Be sure to bring cash! There's a $10 minimum for cards and it's hard to reach it since everything is so cheap.

This place is not ideal for large groups. I took a group of about 18 girls to Churn for a celebration and we experienced the utmost rudest customer service ever. We called the day before to give the workers a heads up that we would be coming in with a larger group. However, when we arrived our group was rushed, spoken to like children, and even had some of our orders tossed at us instead of handed to us like a good paying customer. When we were leaving we could overhear the workers talking about some of our girls in an inappropriate manner. I believe that this type of treatment was uncalled for as we did our best to insure that our group treated the workers with respect and grace even though that was not the treatment that we were given. I am so disappointed because our girls were so excited for this celebration and it was tainted by the workers contempt. Like I said, this is not a good place to take large groups if you are wanting friendly service.
Really enjoyed an iced rose cardamom latte w/ oat milk. There was more seating than I expected as it is attached/open to a bike shop, Seems to get super busy with students studying, Enjoyed our stop,

food: i love bouchon and i love their bakery. i come here whenever i'm in vegas for the TKO, macarons (all flavors!), carrot cake sandwich and of course, the bouchons. i also love that you can buy thomas keller's amazing jams at the bakery. service: nice and patient final thoughts: hard to find but worth it. it's great :)

Where do I start? Masons is one of those places that every neighborhood needs. Something that is unique and gives character to the area around. The location used to be home to The Ohio City Ice Cream shop and that place was great. When it closed, I like many others was heartbroken. But after hearing Mason's would be moving into the same spot, my dismay turned to hope. Before the brick and mortar location, Masons was usually at different events and festivals around the city. I'd always had trouble finding them to give them a try and now I know where they are anytime I wanna stop by. I still haven't figured out how they do it but each time I've been there, they have some new creation to try out that is incredible. So far the nutella has been my favorite but what makes them great is that they take inspiration from fans as well. Recently I thought of the idea of passion fruit sorbet and ran it by them on a visit. Wouldn't you know a few days later, that flavor was in the store! AND it tasted great on top of that. They use all natural ingredients sourced locally and it shows in the freshness in the taste of their ice cream. If you haven't been by the shop, go RIGHT AWAY. You won't be let down!

There were so many options on the menu, I felt so vanilla for just getting a milkshake! To be fair, it was the best peanut butter milkshake I have ever had. My daughter had the peanut butter fudge sundae and loved it, we also tried the coffee ice cream and I've honestly never had coffee ice cream so rich and flavorful. We love Mitchell's!

This place is the worse. Only 6 small tables and benches to sit at. I took my daughters here, 4 of us, and there was no place to sit! Wasn't even busy! If you don't mind standing and eating ice cream that's overflowing out of your cup, then this place is ok. If you like Ghirardelli in San Diego and Monterey, don't go here!

Super cute spot. More of like an old fashioned ice cream parlor with all the random decor and candies. 5 stars for the place. I got the strawberry shortcake and was highly disappointed. My pound cake was rock hard. Boo!!! We got the coke float, it was good, nothing stand out though.
Fine the food good not great. Service is always marginal. The original Hoboken NJ location is better in so many ways. Wish this place had same standard.

Good ole fashion ice cream. They were busy for a Friday and the staff went out of their way to be kind and prompt although they had a large group outside with a big order. The parking isn't great and I wish there were more seats outside, but the ice cream was perfect.

Thomas Keller does not disappoint! I love their macarons here! It's $3.50 a pop but it's the bigger one so you can really enjoy and savor each and every bite without having to worry that it'll all be gone after just two meager bites. I had the chocolate and pistachio. Both were fantastic! Not too sweet, texture is just perfect, filling is not overwhelming but still rich in flavor. You can tell there's so much love put into that pastry. I will come back to try more flavors and their other pastries the next time I'm in Vegas. Prepare to look for this place. We got lost a couple of times before finally getting here. It is located near the casino under/behind the escalators.

The Milk Bar has delicious and unique treats. The cookies are delicious but the Crack Pie is the star of the show. They changed the name of the Crack Pie,but I will always call it Crack Pie. It's so good that it's like crack. This time I had the Fancy Birthday Shake. It's very rich and so yummy for your tummy. If you like sweet treats you must come to the Cosmopolitan and get some goodies from The Milk Bar.

I'm pretty sure this is the most amazing ice cream in the whole world. I had it before in Nashville and was thrilled when I heard we would be getting one in Charlotte! This location did not disappoint. It's located in a busy area off Camden Road in South End and always seems to be busy. That being said, the line moves quickly as the people behind the counter are efficient and eager to help. They are actually some of the kindest people I've ever met in customer service.. it must be all the ice cream they get to try! The flavors at Jeni's are out of this world! The peanut butter with chocolate flakes is killer as is the goat cheese and cherry. You also can't go wrong with the brown butter brittle or the bramble berry crisp. Honestly, you can't go wrong at all other than not getting anything. I also recommend getting it in a waffle cone which are made fresh right in front of you. There's nothing quite like it!

My hubby and I went today and like a lot of other helpers here stated.... Yep it was a line. Mind you it's Tuesday around 8:18pm. But please get a number as soon as you see the line because that's who they go about receiving your order. I got the California cheesecake which was okay and was nothing to rave about, I also got the vanilla buttercream icing cupcake which was a little dry, and the salted caramel cupcake which was HORRIBLE!!!!! The line isn't worthy it whatsoever. Please save your money and find another bakery. I'm still in search of a really good one.

I had never heard of Sweet Republic until a week ago. I knew they were celebrating their birthday by giving away free single scoops of ice cream. I read several reviews and not one of them had anything bad to say about it. I am now one of those reviews. This place is awesome. I had the brownie swirl. Love it. Check this place out. They also have sorbet.
Line was not too bad when me and my family went. Pastries were good and moist. Don't forget to download their APP to earn rewards.

I always get sad and anxious when Jarling's closes in November. My usual order is the Grasshopper snowstorm. The smallest portion is still too big. I wish they had an even smaller size! When I don't feel like eating too much ice cream, I just get a Teddy Cup. It comes with one scoop of custard (you pick the flavor) with 3-4 Teddy Grahams and a cherry. Perfect for kids...or a college student.
Absolutely awful experience!! It was hair in my ice cream and the manager was super rude about it and said they don't give refunds!

The macaroons at Bouchon are the best ever . My wife and I make it a must every time in Vegas . Being right at the RTC bus stop at the Venetian is a great commodity to this resort . TI is across the st and on this side are the Venetian and the Palazzo. Carlos bakery is upstairs, but this little place has a soft spot for my wife . They are not limited to just macaroons , there are sandwiches , bagels , brownies, muffins , coffees , juices . Well rounded spot for fancy snacking , that you can later walk off . The macaroons have a slight crunch , but then seem to turn into a soft cookie that melts in your mouth . The chocolate ones are the favorite, for they are decadent without being too evil . Awesomeness comes in small forms at times. There is Yoda , then there are Bouchon Bakery macaroons!
Unbelievable ice cream! OMG...Habenero Bacon ice cream!! Amazing flavors and concoctions. I got the Pecan turtle sundae. ..its the best Sundae I ever had.

Cute place. Limited flavors, but the Vietnamese Coffee ice creme was very flavorful. Outdoor seating- in spring, it's perfect. Not sure I would the say the same during the summer. Parking patience must be high. Parking is limited and feel like a game of Frogger (yes, I'm dating myself)

It's really just a very beautiful shop with overpriced so so icecream. We enjoy walking in the store. But after we ordered 3 different flavors. They are all overrated. The store looks a lot better than the actual icecream. Too bad, we really wanted to like this store. The store rating is 5 stars, but the icecream is only a 2.

I visit every time I'm in Charlotte! The menu items are DELICIOUS, but the customer service is very questionable. I have had anywhere from awesome customer service to really poor customer service, however, the good outweighs the bad with this place. My only suggestion is to ensure the quality of customer service is consistent.

The hype is not real unfortunately. To each their own I guess, but I was only impressed with a few of their donuts. The pop tart ones are good. Strawberry being the best by far. The blueberry was ok and the smores one was WAY too sweet, like eat one bite and get diabetes sweet. Creme Brule is a good idea but that sugar coat on top makes for difficult chewing. Their apple fritter was actually pretty bad. I took a bite and threw it away, had a burnt quality to it. Personally, I enjoy donuts with a glaze AND something on top or filled. Most of these are plain donuts with something on top. I wanted to love this place. I was there at their grand opening and even met the owner. But I couldn't love it, only like certain things. That being said, their french toast donut is amazing as well as their churro donut ice cream cone. Both of those things along with their strawberry pop tart are worth it.

Would recommend getting the Hoboken Special as it contains most of the small pastries really signature to the Cake Boss show (cannoli, lobster tails, and the rainbow cake as slices). The lobster tail pastry is very similar to the Italian sfogliatella pastry, but is unique to New York and filled with French cream instead of ricotta cheese. Though I also REALLY loved the mini cheesecakes and was really happy about the variety of lobster tail flavors. Also, if you get a bigger order, double-check you got anything before leaving. Would recommend eating the lobster tails fresh. They're still good overnight in the fridge, but it's NOTHING compared to when you first get them. XD For those not as familiar, Carlo's Bakery is the Italian bakery featured on the Cake Boss show. They're based in Hoboken where the original bakery is, but now have locations all over the US and some in Canada. For those from California, they have a location in Santa Monica. This Las Vegas bakery location in The Venetian (so free parking) also faces their sister restaurant (Buddy V's Ristorante, different from Pizza Cake By Buddy Valastro that's down the Strip) and supplies the various Cake Boss "ATMs" (vending machines) where you can get fresh slices of the rainbow cake. XD If you're there when it's busy, you'll probably see employees with ordering pads taking orders as far down the line as they can. We kind of jumped the gun and ordered early on, but I would advise against doing so as there are more items up front near the register that you might want. Specifically, I wanted to get an additional lobster tail. They'll let you add it to your order but with how busy things get, things sometimes slip. In our case, since our whole order was in one taped-up box, we didn't realize we were charged for (but missing) the additional lobster tail. They were great about that though. We called ahead, they checked their records, and recognized us when we went back to get that pastry. And it was SO worth it. We ended up going back a couple of times while we were in Vegas, just kept coming back. Overall, would definitely recommend, they're so much fun!
Great peanut butter cookie and I am not even a peanut butter fan! Also loved the strawberry and butter pecan ice creams.
Stopped in with my family. We came in for the 2018 Lawrenceville Cookie Crawl. On a saturday, easy parking, and such a great time. We orderded so much food and 5 drinks and the barista was so great!

I anticipated with excitement and expectations of a sublime doughnut experience. However, my eagerness dampened as i discovered that the quality, taste, and flavor of the doughnuts and coffee was less than impressive, more average and mediocre at best. The key feature is novelty of the variety and the size of the doughnuts that gives it it's attraction. In comparison, Blue Star doughnuts in Portland is much better in every respect. The consolation is that the doughnuts are better than your average, ok, or supermarket type doughnut retailer. Sorry, I really wanted to like this cute little shop. The stars are for the service. People are friendly and helpful and the donut variety is creative.

Disappointing. I was incredibly excited to get some sweet treats from this place, I love the show and love specialty goodies like these. There were so many things to choose from - everything looked so good. My friend had a chocolate fudge cupcake and I ordered the original cannoli and seasonal cupcake. The cannoli The pastry was dry and clearly old. When I took a bite the outside crumbed off (not in a yummy flaky way) and the inside of the cannoli was chewy and gross. The filling inside was alright, it was creamy but nothing spectacular. I didn't even finish the cannoli because it was so lackluster. Since I only tried one, I can't tell if I got one of the old ones from a week before or if they are all like that. Truly disappointing. I would have expected a store bought (like walmart) cannoli to taste this terrible. The seasonal cupcake Looked delicious. Beautiful cupcake decorated in fall/autumn colors with a chocolate leaf on top. It was a vanilla cupcake with vanilla buttercream (colored) frosting. The cake was pretty tasty, not incredibly fresh but it wasn't old and crumbly like the cannoli. The frosting was clearly homemade. Good, right? Um, no. It tasted like straight up butter. I bake occasionally and I have had this happen to me when I used too much butter and not enough sugar. The frosting didn't even have a hint of vanilla taste to it. I'm glad it was homemade I just wish they would've put some "Cream" in the buttercream frosting. Yuck. My friends tried it and all felt the same way. We took the frosting off and ate the cake part. The chocolate fudge cupcake was alright. I didn't try the frosting but the cake part was the same as the seasonal cupcake (meaning it was edible). Not worth the money or time spent waiting in line. Seriously, spend $3 on a Betty Crocker cake - it's cheaper and tastes better (sadly). I'd love to go back and try other items but with three out of three misses I doubt it's worth the effort at this point. Sad face.

Everyone jumped on the hype train when this place first opened and took over the old O Face Doughnuts location. My first run-in with Donut Bar was when I lived in San Diego in 2013. They were one of the first West Coast shops to try to emulate the cronut, which at the time, had just been invented by Dominique Ansel and was an overnight sensation. Donut Bar's Gaslamp location was very much like this one. There were huge lines that stretched out the door in the morning and they were often sold out by midday. In fact, I never did get to try one of their cronuts or "cro-bars," rather. Flash forward three years and once again Donut Bar is the darling of the donut world and selling out on a daily basis by 1 pm. I've visited this location twice now (but really once because one time it was sold out), and I'm still unconvinced that the majority of these doughnuts are that spectacular. For the most part, the novelty is the large size, especially the Big Poppa Tart, but I felt sick trying to finish an entire one myself. This fact holds true for most of the other large, yeast doughnuts as well, all priced $3-4. However, the one doughnut that I felt was unique enough to return here for was the crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e. The caramelized sugar topping has that deeply satisfying crack when broken in half and the filling flavor is completely on par with that of a vanilla crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e. It's advertised as vegan and also only $2. Overall, I wasn't impressed by the size or price. The yeast donuts turned dense if you didn't get them fresh. But highlights include the can't miss crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e donuts and Stumptown coffee (which just so happens to be my favorite coffee).

A french bakery open 24/7, what a niche filler in Charlotte. We are lacking sooooo much in super late night eats and love that you can always count on these guys to be there. Get the caramel brownie. There I said it. You'll thank me later, but lets just get that out of the way. What else you may want is up to you. Plenty of soup, tartines, and sandwich options. The soups change daily, so I can't really recommend any one in particular. As far as the sandwiches go though, I'm a turkey and brie on baguette fan. The roast beef and manchego is worth a try as well, and a great dipper in a french onion soup. After you've ordered, take a look around. If you go around to your left, there is a large open area with multiple seating options. You can normally count on someone studying back there. The atrium out back also has plenty of seating options and is quite a change of pace for Charlotte dining. Wherever you sit, don't forget to bring your diner number with ya. It can take a while to get your food otherwise. Disclaimer: Its normally after 2am when I eat here, so the food could easily be close to 3.5-4.5 stars and my munchies are just taking over. Regardless, its still a great option for the late night.

I went this morning for a coffee and an almond croissant. It wasn't busy, but the girl working the cash forgot to give me the croissant, so I had to stand there being ignored until one of her coworkers clued in to the fact that I was waiting for something. The pastry was good. The coffee was pretty bland...I don't think it was an execution thing---more of a beans thing. I'm only providing feedback because I expect more from a Keller joint.
Great bakery! Love the variety of the macaroons! What I love about this place most is they are open late! When your craving a much better than grocery homemade pastry or slice of cheesecake.

I followed their instructions and called in my order, which was waiting for me when I got there. Fast, easy, and delicious as usual. Thanks so much for reopening, you didn't have to but I am so happy you did. This ice cream is absolutely the best in town and their employees are always so nice and friendly.

I have never been here before, and I have to say it was one of the worst customer service experiences I've had. First off, none of the donuts are labeled, and when I asked an employee to walk me through the flavors, she responded "just point and I'll tell you." Quite rudely. Second, while I was at the counter deciding on what donuts I wanted, a customer shoved by me to get to the register, saying "Excuse you." Also very rude. Third, I picked two donuts with vanilla icing and vanilla frosting. The employee gave me two donuts with maple frosting. I asked if the icing was vanilla, and she assured me it was vanilla. What if you are allergic to maple? You would get sick because of the employees lazy attitude. All in all, the employees are rude and not helpful, there is no flavor menu, and half of the donuts are not even fresh at 9am. I will not be coming back here again. I'm going to Krispy Kreme, or Spudnuts, from now on. They have better prices and better donuts. I suggest you do the same.
This place is insane. Ordered delivery and they packed our ice cream with ice so it wouldn't melt. Brownie batter swirl is AMAZING
Delicious ice cream, cute decor, nice patio, everything's great! I don't love the parking situation (or lack thereof) but otherwise, this place is great!

Yum! Homemade marshmallow, macaroon and gourmet ice cream, what a wonderful combination. The owner is super friendly and let you try pretty much whatever you asked for. I give 4 stars because the macaroon was a bit chewy and lack of the usual almond flavor that I love.

I'm guessing that Mike is one of the owners and he served me today. Such a cool looking place! The ice cream was incredible! Creamy and rich! I sampled a few different flavors that I loved all of, but chose campfire smores and strawberry rhubarb. I wish I lived closer so I could come here more often.

Overall: overwhelming flavors, slightly overpriced, nothing special I had heard a lot about Milk Bar, as everyone has, especially since watching MasterChef Junior with the chef Christina Tosi. I've seen many Instagram posts from the Milk Bar in NYC too, and there is overall a lot of hype, so I was excited to try it in Las Vegas. It's an adorable shop, just a window, but the neon sign grabs your attention. The menu is pretty confusing; it seems to be mostly cookies, slices of cake, soft serve, and milkshakes. I've seen people mostly get soft serve, so that's what I went for. They did offer samples which was nice. I was pretty underwhelmed with the flavor options. They had three flavors: cereal milk (corn flakes), crack pie (toffee), and chocolate pretzel (salty chocolate). All of the flavors were unique, but the crack pie was so overwhelmingly sweet and salty at the same time we did not like it at all. The cereal milk was okay but a little subtle, like corn flakes aren't a strong flavor to begin with. The chocolate pretzel was good, but the salt was a bit much, and I couldn't eat a whole cup of it. Another thing to note is that the corn flake topping on the cereal milk soft serve was $1.25 which seemed a little high for just a few corn flake crumbles around the side. All of the flavors were very creamy, but I have had so many ice cream places that I prefer that I have no desire to return here. I think it's overly hyped and there are plenty of better places to go for ice cream.

HOME OF THE (almost famous) COOKIE CUP. Instagram pictures don't do it justice. The cookie cup is a giant chewy macaron with two scoops of ice cream, toppings, and additional locally made toasted marshmellow. The ice cream is soft, creamy, and amazing. We were recommended to get their cereal ice creams (fruit loops, captain crunch, cinnamon toast crunch) I loved it, only thing I didn't like was the actual cereal bits because they got soggy, but the flavor was spot on! We ordered cinnamon toast crunch and green tea in a red velvet macaron with a toasted marshmellow for ~$6. Sharing is advisable because of size, but I'd completely understand if you don't want to. Oh my goodness is this guilty sugar overload, but I would be more than happy to come back over and over and over. The store is small and kind of hidden away in the shopping plaza behind Church's chicken. The owner was so sweet and helpful. The grand opening will be hosted, so keep you eyes out for the ads! I highly recommend this place to everyone in the area & I only hope for the best for this shop :)

The best ice cream I've ever had! Maybe consider moving the list of flavors that sits between the windows. I find that when people cluster in line and at the counter, they often stand in front of it making it hard to read.

Hanging out with my big bro in Arizona. Oh my gosh! The Leslie Knope is AMAZING! You also get a full size candy bar with the Candy Bar ice cream flavor! Travis and Val are SO kind and helpful! 10/10 for everything!
I don't think I can thank Mrs. MY enough for this WONDERFUL after-treat. She picked up a half dozen of their chocolate cupcakes with marshmallow frosting.... they are definitely TO DIE FOR!!!

This place is so clean, spacious, and a fantastic place for hanging out or studying. The food looks pretty on their tv screens but when we tried waffles and honey toast, I was unimpressed. Doesn't taste bad but the presentation and ingredients/flavor profile leave much to be desired.

My best friend mailed me a Batchmaker cake for my birthday a few years ago and it was so good! Fast forward to last month: I was visiting my friend in CLT,so you know we had to come to the Batch House! The space is so cute and welcoming. I felt comfortable as soon as I walked in. We ordered a little bit of everything to try. I honestly can't pick a favorite, but my top faves were the puddle cookie, the oatmeal cream pie, and the edible cookie dough. I also snagged a "people first, cake second" hat that I have been wearing around Pittsburgh. As someone who likes to bake as a hobby, Cris's creations really inspire me! I can't wait to come back to Charlotte and trying some more goodies from the Batchmaker!

Foodie bucket list item accomplished! I've always wanted to try this, to say I have a sweet tooth is an understatement! When I got to the milk bar I wanted to try everything, I went with the sampler that came with a slice of its Crack pie, a cereal milk soft serve that was to die for, a compost cookie, and some birthday truffles. I also got a cornflakes chocolate chip cookie as well. The girl at the counter was amazingly nice, she was the bomb . com ! That cereal milk though wow!

Need an idea for a fun girls' day out? Stop by Jack Frost then head to the Cleveland Zoo to watch wild animals reenact what you just did with your donuts. (That's actually exactly how I found this place lol). Like others have mentioned, you need to bring cash, be prepared to wait in a VERY long line (which seems to go pretty quickly), and bust out those sunglasses when you reach the glass counters so as not to be blinded by these sugary beauties. I enjoyed the apple fritter, maple bacon, and crullers. The salted caramel was also a memorable choice. You honestly can't go wrong with any of them and be prepared to surprise your digestive system with at least 3 donuts in rapid succession. Unlike other donut places, these delights are light, flavorful, and not sickening. The proportions are always correct, so that you never feel like you're being shortchanged on filling, topping, or dough. They really are special and that becomes clear when you meet people waiting in line that have traveled hours (that's right) to sample some of these treats. Count yourself lucky if you live nearby!

Horrible! 4:00 PM NO donuts with no more expected out for the day. One employee took a donut back from a lady that brought it back to the store, and then put it back on the shelf, and then another employee gave it to me. Not expected to close until 8 pm. Tremendous increase in price since moving into their new building apparently.

Sooooo many delicious items! I spent $35 myself and I don't regret it. Excellent almond chocolate croissant, very chocolate-forward, which is difficult to achieve at other bakeries. Give me one of the gruyere croissants and the chocolate pecan pie, and I'm in heaven. Subtracting a star for the utterly sullen demeanor of the employees. And the coffee was meh.
What an amazing Thai iced tea!! The owner was so nice and sweet! I recommend the Thai tea ice cream. Everything thing was so great!
The bakery was amazing! Loved the Strawberry Shortcake I got for my birthday and the Cheesecake I got for my mom were beyond delicious!!
Eat pls e in town for ice cream and their cones are the best I've ever had also. If your ever on that side of town stop in you'll be happy you did

Yes, this place is great. A little overrated but best around town. Nice bakery and great macaroon. They can get a little packed so depending when you go, sometime you'll end up waiting 10-15 minutes before it's your turn. That was the longest I've waited but it was only once out of couple of times I've went there. Their stuff are a little over priced and the location does not have enough parking, especially if there's an event. Parking also isn't that great if you have to park on the gravel.

I have been going to Prestis for many years. Love the breakfast food, lunch is spectacular and the bakery is out of this world. I try to get there at least once a week. The staff is always friendly and working very hard to get you served quickly.

I am not even all that much of a donut person, but this place is AMAZING!!!!! The donuts are light and fluffy, not greasy and the flavors are absolutely delicious!! Drip coffee is $1 which is a very welcome surprise! I would stop by even just for the coffee because it is delic. The staff is so welcoming and friendly. I cannot say enough good things about this place. I tell everyone I meet to go try it!
Delicious as the last few times! I can't get enough of Honey Hut. Whenever I am in the area, I MUST stop by! Believe all the 5 star reviews. This place is so worth it!
Hands down best ice cream /dessert place ever !the staff was great and really knew their story

My favorite spot for ice cream! Love that most of the ingredients are organically sourced - love that they offer vegan options as well! Vegan Salted Caramel Pecan is my go-to staff is always super friendly as well!

Bouchon creates the best macarons I've tried to date, and by FAR the best on the strip. And I've tried macarons from Sweet Factory and Payard and they simply do not compare. They're huge -- like the size of 3 regular macarons (and priced to match!) but the flavor and texture are on point. I generally am not a fan of fruit flavored macarons but I love the raspberry flavors here; those, along with pistachio and vanilla are my go-to's. Their vanilla eclairs are yummy too. I recommend snagging tickets to Phantom and then munching on a couple of these afterwards!

Great selection of yum yums but came here specifically for the French macarons... Which are HUGE, by the way, but pricey at $3 something per macaron. As a self proclaimed macaron connoisseur, I have to say that Bouchon macarons are nice because they don't use jelly fillings. I kind of hate jelly filled or jelly based fillings for macarons because they taste too sweet. Bouchon macarons are of a buttercream persuasion, but not too buttery like others I have tasted in the Bay Area. Perfect crunch, perfect chewiness, perfect light tasting filling.

BEST RED VELVET CUPCAKE! I went to all the cupcake bake shop in Las Vegas and this bake shop has the best red velvet. My mom will be ordering her wedding cake here soon. The only thing I didn't like was one of the employee is really rude. This was my first time coming here, so ordering I didn't how they do it. I was only going to ask her a question but held up her hand to my face. She didn't even let me finish. If I come back to this shop I hope she will not be there to do this to me again.
This French bakery is located in charlotte, rock hill, and Atlanta. I think it's cute that small towns like rock hill have the option of a French Bakery!

The family had peach crumble, vanilla bean, banana, and bubble gum. The toasted a made from scratch marshmallow and it was devine. We passed our bowls around trying to decide which one we liked the best. Service was very good and they let my daughters try out pretty much every flavor in the place. We are actively trying to find excuses to come back to the area to eat here again.

Went to Cleveland for a day trip and this was on the top of our location list. Thoroughly impressed with the flavor options that were offered. We got Key Lime Pie & Peanut Butter Frozen Yogurt. The flavors were very robust and love that these ice creams were made with fresh and local ingredients. Will absolutely visit if in the area again.
Hot diggity! Macaroon ice cream sandwiches. ..need I say more? You are in for a perfect treat.

Wooooooooow. The peanut butter and butter pecan were TO DIE FOR! I know there are so many reviews but I had to write another one! The ice cream is amazing because it's homemade. Amazing. Stop reading, go have CHURN!

A well-loved local hangout with a caring staff and great peoplewatching. Lots of pastry choices, as well as soups, salads, and sandwiches. (My only complaint was the mushroom soup was in an excruciatingly salty onion base. I was thirsty for the next 2 days.) Go see this place if only to see how a three-bay concrete space can be turned into a charming cafe with creative painting, silly but friendly wall decorations, and funky painted furniture. Open 24 hours!

This is my first review on yelp ever. It was worth it. The ice cream was the best thing I've ever had. And the service is just as good as the ice cream. It was an amazing experience. Can't wait to bring my friends and family here. They truly treat you like they value your business.
Try the Carrot Cake. Rich, moist, and delicious. Everything is made in-house from scratch and its shows. Highly recommended for cakes cookies and Italian breads.
Freaking delicious! Little Freezie Rocky Road is out of control good.

This is a small, yet very cute place. The ice cream is good and there are plenty of novelties. It would be great if they expanded their flavor selection. Moreover, a caddy to hold your cone while shuffling through your purse for your wallet or signing your receipt would be nice.

Do not go to this place unless you are ready to be disappointed. Me and my husband came to this place in hopes that I would find a sfogliatella. Normally they are a very very nice size as being a brooklynite I was expecting the nice size. What I got wasn't even the size of my hand. It was small extremely stale. They didn't even bother to put powdered sugar on the pastry. I was sooo upset that I spent that money on it. Next the lines aren't bad but the disorganization is a joke, we had been waiting for our order for about 15 minutes and our order was two sfogliatella and two canolli. Which by the way was also horrible.... not what I had expected from a place like this because he's world famous. Fix your business buddie it's really horrible. I will never step a foot back in this place, sad but true.

Ok so it's really cool that they have vegan soft serve ice cream... but I had the weirdest most uncomfortable experience w the staff while there with my sister. Idk if the staff were new or not but it was odd for a first time going in there having to order with 3 different people before actually being helped even though there weren't other customers. When the third person asked me what I wanted I almost didn't answer bc it was like... alright... one more time... but then they made my ice cream.

I've been eyeing this place for a while. I finally made my way inside and the atmosphere was quaint and relaxed. The staff was also very friendly. I got the famous lemon lavender and a strawberry shortcake. I am not a fan of lemon desserts but both of these donuts were possibly the best donuts i've ever had. I am questioning if they are vegan because they are that good! Will definitely be coming back.
This place is legit...pastries are baller and eapresso drinks are solid. Will be back...easy access right on the strip

I was at Mitchell's ice cream on West 25th when I saw too young teenagers or that taking 6 ice cream cones outside sitting them on the table photographing them and then right in front of a homeless man how asked about them through all six in the garbage without even tasted one of them they were also employees of Mitchell's ice cream

Okay, what the heck happened? This place used to be my go to place for a quick snack when I stayed at the Venetian. Now everything is mediocre at best. The macarons were stale and the croissant was meh. Very, very disappointing. Probably won't be coming here for a quick snack again.

The famous 'Cake Boss' bakery is located in the Venetian hotel and it was a bit stressful to find. My girlfriend is a huge fan of the show so it was a must. The array of cakes and cookies and cannolis is extremely impressive considering the space is quite small. We ordered a lobster tail and a cannoli, both of which were quite generously filled with sweet cream. Both cakes were delicious and quite large. No seating, as has been said before, but we found a table nearby. Enjoyed my experience overall.
Great place! Loved the different selection of ice cream. Awesome variety. Great service and great ice cream!
So So So So Good! The long line at any given time of day is annoying but shows how good this place is. Yum!!!!!!!

This is the best ice cream. We used to get it mail ordered to us from Ohio. The flavors are so unique, and we just love the texture of their ice cream. When you walk in, one employee is hand making waffle cones. There isn't much to say about this place, except about how amazing it is!
Yummy donuts at a decent price and it is all a feast for the eyes. Chai tea latte was pretty great too. Lots of choices and friendly service. Off the beaten path but worth the side trip.
This place has one of the best donuts in town! They are always our go to when we want something on the sweeter side for breakfast! They have so many flavors and always have amazing deals!
I always stop here when in Cleveland! This was a staple treat in a lovely neighborhood when I was a student nearby.

Delicious and unique ice cream/drinks. I don't think the ice cream is worth the seven bucks though UNLESS the person making it puts in the effort into make it aesthetically pleasing. Because come one, that's what most people go in there for. One visit my ice cream cone looked squashed and lopsided, the next it was tall and proud with strawberry syrup that I didn't receive on my first strawberry shortcake cone. I'd take an out of town person here to show that AZ does have some cool spots, but I wouldn't come here on the regular. *side note- no substitutions on the signature combos. This includes simply omitting a topping due to allergies.

Who cannot love Amelie's? Walk in to one of the most relaxing spaces in Charlotte and you will find yourself among a sea of folks just like me. Any time of day, or night, Amelie's has a showcase of mouth watering pastries, savory soups and sandwiches, salads, pastries, artisan breads, pastries and an array of teas and coffees. Did I mention the pastries? Grab your laptop, bring a friend, grab a snack and walk back into any one of the eclectically decorated rooms. Stay as long as you like; Amelie's is open 24/7.

Amelie's definitely has an authentic French bakery feel to it. The vintage French dÃ©cor gives this place a very unique flair. Aside from them having an excellent variation of pastries, cakes, dessert and other menu items to choose from, this place is also a great place to hang out or study. The staff is consistently friendly and accommodating regardless if the place is incredibly busy (it always is). Amelie is definitely a must-visit if you are in Charlotte. They have something wonderful for every palate - from their full service coffee bar, the huge selection of freshly baked pastries, to the savory soups, sandwiches and salad. I assure you, you will never go wrong with whatever you order. Charlotte definitely needs more places like this!! Highly recommended!

Cleveland at it's best is when it's NOT TRYING to be Portland or NYC. In context of what's around, it is actually one of the best places out here. Best because: most unpretentious, or least pretentious, whichever you prefer. Food is cheap, great for a student budget. Since recently (?) you better watch out in particular ordering things like deserts using fresh cream, ice-cream, fruit salad, fish/chicken dishes or mayonnaise in salads. Because very obviously some dishes are several days old. Salmonella danger alert, level orange. You can notice it if you get a fresh cheese cake with cherry on top and it has a crust, when it should be fluffy like a cloud and the fruit on top of it is chewy like a gummi bear, that means this item was born many days ago and is not safe consumed as food item. If you see the tuna salad having brown dried edges on the tuna flakes, no matter where you see such a tuna salad actually, at Prestis or in your own fridge, do no longer eat it and also do not feed it to any of your pest you could get very sick. Same counts for fruit salad that starts to decay, eating that one will counter act your best intentions to eat "something healthy". Be your own judge, but don't blame me for yet again saying something unfavourable to a situation where Cleveland thinks (and promotes) it is "rust belt chicque" again. . According to numerous staff that have worked here, many of them cute art students from nearby CIA and also other unis in town, unfortunately they still keep up old Little Italy tradition and refuse employing African-Americans, although allegedly they will with a big smile take your application (and throw it straight in the bin, as I was told.) The minute that changes I am more than happy to add one more star. Further: to those good people who do not realize what they're looking at: if you happen to sit in PRESTI'S (but the very same applies to other restaurants in Little Italy) and you are being approached by some very young children (at the time of writing maybe around 6, 7 years old? Who knows), asking you to buy a candy bar (the going rate at time of writing is $5) as a charity event for their school, do not buy from them. You can read up on this problem if you i.e. put in google search "Candy Sales Another Form of Human Trafficking" is one article, there are plenty describing the issue; if you are not sure ask the kids which school they are from, they might say "Tremont" (which is the other side of town) without naming a special school, ask for their permission; late at night you may see them at the bus stop to Mayfield (opposite of Tremont) with what seems to be their moms, possibly hear them discussing the hotel where they are intending to spend the night. Don't waste your time calling police, who will tell you there is nothing wrong with selling candy bars, or they might say, an officer was just out there and talked to the kids and there wasn't a problem, or they will ask you if you intended to create a problem for a seemingly single mom trying to earn a buck on the side for her family having her kids sell candy bars, or they will tell you, you are being presumptuous (all of these were told to me by police trying to report this, as it is suggested to do on sites that address this perhaps out here new problem that were maybe not written in Cleveland). In any case police can't be bothered, so maybe best do not nurture the issue by buying into it, that is IF you can be bothered.

Bouchon was my savior! My parents don't drink coffee, well, they don't drink my coffee because it's too strong...LOL! Whenever I come to Vegas, I like to take long early morning walks on the strip to work off my night before buffet. But hunger also hit so, I stopped here for a large capuccino and a croissant, and then an almond croissant on my second visit. The staff was friendly at this early time. I can imagine they get tired of the Vegas riff raff and Eurotrash...LOLLLL! I sat near the canal and I felt like I was somewhere else.
PB&J Ice Cream is really good. Also got blueberry cheesecake, which was not as good but still good. Good place with good flavors.

Was in the neighborhood for a vet appointment, so we stopped in to try the cake. I had seen the really beautifully adorned cakes on instagram, and with flavors like 'blueberry rose with pistachio buttercream' how could one not be, at the very least, super curious!? This place is super cute and cozy, and would be great if you're looking to snuggle up to a book either inside or in the adorable garden area out back. Also, the cake did not disappoint! It was very dense, but also quite moist, and not overly sweet or gluttonous. My partner said they reminded her of a cake donut, but I suppose I enjoy cake donuts more than she does ;). I also had the hibiscus passion fruit iced tea, which was perfect. I hardly ever eat sweets, but this place makes for a perfect departure from the regular. Most of the time I will decline sweets because I feel that they aren't "worth the calories" (I'm more of a savory girl), but this place is definitely worth any and all calories. And while I didn't try them today, they had plenty of really good looking vegan options! Definitely worth a stop :)

Great selection of italian cookies, pastries, and cakes. I got a small box filled with random cookies that I picked out. I am not usually a fan of italian cookies but I definitely enjoyed eating most of them. The cannoli was creamy, heavy and delicious wrapped up in a crispy shell. I also had an italian iced tea dessert. It wasn't what I expected, but I liked it. It's essentially italian ice with iced tea drink poured over it. They ran out of lemon ice that day so I got mango which was yum. Presti's Bakery has a good reputation and the reality lives up to expectations.

When I discover a city has a Little Italy neighborhood, my number one priority is to get my hands on a cannoli. Whether it's Boston, Baltimore, or Cleveland, it's an absolute must (this is serious business people). Cleveland's Little Italy is a lively place on Saturday night, so we had to fight for a parking spot and a place in line at Presti's. Luckily there were plenty of employees to help us out and make it a fun experience. Even though it was a bit of a hassle, that crunch of the pastry and sweet creamy ricotta was totally worth it!!!

Customer service was on point! 2 stars because of the fact I spent $35 on mediocre bakery treats. It's an unwritten rule in my book, if it's seen on TV, 9/10 times it is not nearly as good. The treats were not bad, don't get me wrong. But for $35, I'd rather support an awesome local bakery !

I'd heard legends about Jack Frost Donuts but thought, 'they're donuts how special could they be?'. For anyone else thinking that same thing, erase that idea immediately! They say that we eat with our eyes then our mouths. Jack Frost makes beautiful looking donuts, pretty enough to adorn any party or buffet table. The big payoff to the donut is the taste, icing that melts in your mouth and a cake that is light, fluffy and delicious. Don't get me wrong, I'm not saying that these donuts can change your life, but these donuts WILL change your ideas about donuts. I've never seen donut flavor combinations like they have before, they are more like flavors you'd see in a full-size cake. Cassata donut (Cleveland style), Chocolate Decadence and my absolute favorite German Chocolate (just like mom use to make using the recipe from the Baker's Chocolate wrapper). I'm an east-sider and the trek to Jack's on a Sunday morning is about 20 minutes one way. For me on those mornings I make the trip it's the best 40 minute round trip of my weekend.
Donuts are the size of my 2 yo daughters head!! Staff is super nice and helpful! Nutella stuffed donut is delish!!

I had high hopes since many people would hype this place up but when I went I wasn't impressed. Personally what you get for the price point is not worth it in my opinion. We paid a little over $14 for the s'more sundae and strawberry shortcake sundae. First they didn't have the chocolate for the s'mores sundae so I had to substitute that. It came with one scoop of ice cream and a heaping of marshmallow fluff with one graham cracker broken in half. I did like that they toasted the fluff. Nothing wowed me from it. I've had better. Now for my husband's strawberry shortcake sundae. It was a flop. The "cake" was dry, hard, and almost old. It was as if they left it sitting out all day. You needed that ice cream to help get the cake down. The strawberries were hard and frozen and neither of us were a fan of that. We wish they would put fresh strawberries instead. They didn't put enough of the strawberry drizzle. What you see in the picture is all that was put on it. Again it was only one scoop of ice cream used. Honestly it's was an okay experience. The employees were friendly but were rushing us and the people before us. I will say if you want more for your money and better flavors, I recommend going elsewhere, like down the street to Nami!

My husband and I recently visited Cleveland and after walking around for a little bit stumbled upon Mitchell's - a local chain of ice cream stores - while strolling in Ohio City. Less than 12 hours later and we were eating Mitchell's again at another location in Shaker Heights - it's that good. This location seems to be the original - it's set in an old theater, which is cool, and has a lot of cool features. It's clean, decorated in a bright and airy way with tons of natural light and ample seating (with small chairs/low counters for the kids to have their own seating), a cute model train that circles the shop, and in addition to that you can see the staff actually making the ice cream and sweet treats in the large open kitchen behind the display cases. There's also a second floor with tons of seating and another area to view the ice cream-making process in the kitchen, from a birds' eye view! The ice creams we tried were all super creamy, with a mix of standard, creative, and seasonal flavors. My husband got a super fudgy vegan chocolate mint truffle flavor and the porter chocolate chunk (exclusive to this location, with beer from a local brewery with giant dark chocolate chunks), which I was super impressed with. I'm not a beer drinker, but this porter chocolate chunk tasted like the best porter you could imagine. I had a junior scoop of the pralines and cream, which was delicious and classic! The price point is super reasonable and I could see myself coming here often if we lived in the area. The scoops are generous and filling. Definitely make your way here if you're craving ice cream and in the area - highly recommend!
First time trying Novel today and HOLY MOLY. We're obsessed. We will be back! Excellent service, excellent area, excellent price for the quality.

I like Amelie's.....good coffee and drinks- BUT the pastries (and anything else) are a tad on the pricey side. I can't say I've ever been to a (sit down) bakery where the items were so much- maybe you're paying for the 24 hour part?

For a person that doe not like sweets of ice cream whatsoever, this place always have me coming back. Personal experience - Melts staff members lets you sample any flavor that you like, which is pretty nice if you have no clue what it is. For my first time, I did not do that but all my friends did. Instead, I chose a name that really threw me off or sounds interesting to me. Chop Suey, for a flavor that sounds bizarre (which is a Chinese cuisine dish) this flavor was quite interesting. Has a fusion of three flavors, yet so hard to describe. So I got three scoops. The creativity that is put into an idea of serving ice cream in a Chinese to-go box with a fortune cookie is fascinating. Overall, friendly service so I have to tip over 20%. Melt is pretty small place, but they have there own apparel store next door, which I need to see for myself sometime. They also have like a patio/picnic table where you can sit and if you go at night, you can catch they sometimes having a live performance. Pretty sweet if you ask me. The only frustrating part is arriving there, a little confusing yet not, but I found it. Thus, this place I recommend it to anyone who is looking for ice cream and sweets.

This place has delicious ice cream!! Have been here twice, once around lunch/early dinner time and the second late in the evening after dinner about 9pm'ish? Not very busy early in the evening, long lines at night on the weekend, but worth it! LOVE LOVE LOVE the mint & the Vietnamese coffee!! Also the first time i went there they had a Stout flavor.. but sadly was not there the second time I went! Price is fair and their selection of cones is good as well! Will be back again to try other flavors and milkshakes, etc!

The best ice cream in the world!!! My Go To is the strawberry. The sweetness is just right and the strawberry flavor is perfect. A lot of other places the flavor is dull and they just focus on the sweetness. Handels has that perfect balance between the two. If you want to Treat Yo Self, I recommend the strawberry cheesecake. Which is basically half ice cream and half cheesecake. It's almost too sweet for me but like I said. Treat Yo Self. They have specials on Tuesdays but the line is too dreadful for me. I don't mind paying full price so I go on the days is not busy. Maybe they should implement some kind of system where you pick a number and wait to be called? Other than that, this place is a must!

During our vacation in Vegas, my sis was adamant on checking out this Taiwanese bakery chain, and now I can see why. There were 20+ people in front of us when we arrived. We got the bacon & cheese roll (I'm a sucker for savory rolls like that) and signature egg tarts. OMG, both were hands down the best AJ and I've ever had! We also tried a the macchiato cheesecake, mango panna cotta, chocolate bread, which were all very delicious. They were just extra flavorful (perfect balance of sweetness) and the textures were all on point! I wish they would come to Hawaii, but for now I'll be on the look out for it whenever I'm traveling.

So many yummy flavors to choose from!!! We both got the sundae which included 3 flavors, a wet topping (hot fudge, caramel or marshmallow sauce) and one dry topping (candy or nuts) plus whipped cream and a cherry for $9.95 each. I really liked my flavors and would go back to try different flavors.

Ummmm what else is there to say other than EVERYTHING they make is amazing! We had birthday cake, egg and cheddar bombs, and the bagel bombs. The bombs make the absolute most perfect breakfast after a late night out too. So glad it is so close to where we live so we can grab them anytime.
Super delicious icecream! Pretty grumpy service, no matter how hard I tried to be friendly. * Don't make any jokes. Just order. Pay. Leave. Enjoy.

I finally visited this world-famous Taiwanese pastry & coffee shop! Now I can't resist on shopping here on a bi-weekly basis, albeit it's a 20-minute drive from my house. Thus far, I am enamored with the vanilla cake roll; Black Forest cake; red velvet cake; blueberry cheesecake, and pineapple milk cream bread. The hubby, and me loved everything we've tried - not overly sweet, FRESH, with creamy & rich frosting! I look forward to sampling coffee & smoothies on my next visit. I also LOVE how clean, modern, and SPACIOUS the bakery is. Added bonus is that all the staffs from my three visits were friendly & efficient!
All I can say is they have very good ice cream I would for sure recommend their cookies and creme ice cream it is very good

Crack Pie Milkquake!!!! Oh my goodness this is the best ice cream treat ever! I keep getting cravings, we have been here a few times and everything is superb, but the crack pie options win for me! For locals they do have a punch card, which we appreciate.

We got lost finding this place in our hotel. I almost gave up and turned around but we finally found it and let me say this..... sooooooo glad we did. We ordered a cheese danish and almond croissant. It was amazing! The pastries were so soft they melted in our mouths! Flavor was also on point. The location is somewhat hidden under the escalator so that's not convenient . However it was a fun adventure to find these yummy treats. It also opened earlier than most places in the hotel so that was a plus!

Waited over an hour on a Sunday night around 8PM. They need to consult with the business school on campus, and get their operations logistics ironed out. The reason for the long wait is that they are super inefficient. Now on to the ice cream. It's good, but definitely nothing out of this world. If it were anywhere else, it wouldn't be so popular. It's just that this is the only custard place in town. They place music on speakers while you wait, so it makes the wait a bit more bearable. But it takes the people who work here so long to get your order together. They have benches for seating outside. Also a drive through line. This place is only open during the summer.

Been a huge fan of 85c bakery and being from California I was so happy to finally have a location in Las Vegas! The location is overall great! Its very clean and easy to find! Parking was not difficult to find at all! There was a long line, however it was the grand opening so that is bound to happen! Once you are in you are able to order drinks and cake from the kiosk and pay there! Once you pay you get your order number and are able to pick up your drinks! I highly recommend ordering from here ! FYI they do not take credit cards such as American express and discover! They take visa! I highly recommend getting the sea salt caramel with iced! So good! I will definitely come to this location more and hope they causes more 85 degrees in the Las Vegas Area!

We've been eyeing this spot for some time and after dinner last night we decided to give it a shot. I was impressed we actually showed up with at the perfect time with a very small line..as we always drive by and see the long lines. The ice cream was good, not great. I had the butter pecan cookie sandwich with chocolate chocolate chip cookies. The cookie was just ok. Didnt taste fresh, it wasnt soft. Disappointed. Maybe I will try it again and only get the ice cream. Side Note: It melts very fast compared to other spots we visit.

Don't forget to try their Bacon Brittle, which I completely spaced out on! I had Sweet Republic on the top of my "must eat" list while in Arizona since I saw them on Bon Appetit's 10 best ice cream shops list. Although they are located in Scottsdale, they are 10-15 minutes north of Scottsdale Stadium (where the SF Giants play). We drove up for ice cream after a Saturday afternoon game, and the shop was fairly empty around 4pm. That was great since we had time to look at all the different flavors for their sorbets and ice creams, and also sample a couple before having to make a decision (the Maple Pecan flavor I tried was pretty good). We finally settled on a scoop of Salted Butter Caramel (Soft Buttery Caramel Ribbons in Creamy Vanilla w/a Sprinkle of Salt) & Almond Buttercrunch (yelp.com/biz_photos/swee¦). I thought I liked the salted butter caramel more, but the almond buttercrunch really grew on me the more I ate it, especially when I got a bite with the buttercrunch. The salted caramel at Bi-Rite Creamery in San Francisco still wins the salted caramel battle in my book, but I still enjoyed the ice cream at Sweet Republic a lot. I didn't have a chance to compare their ice cream to Churn, but hope to have a chance to do so in the future! Parking is ample, and the staff is really nice. They also have board games to play while you eat your ice cream!

This is definitely a different approach on classic ice cream shop. Instead of the classic "baked bear" ice cream sandwich or cold stone waffle cone, Fatty Daddy's delivers a melange if textures and tastes. Each component of my treat, had a different layer of creaminess! First, a cloud of roasted Smokey marshmallow that falls. Then comes a delicate silky macaroon. Lastly, a frosted hill of smooth ice cream. I asked the guy his favorite mix - Irish cream ice cream with a Carmel macaroon. We both got some and enjoyed everything!
Amazing!!! Just amazing!!! Must have, a must try! The the shop is small and packed. You are given the option of trying any ice cream before purchasing. Very happy and super content.

Best ice cream in town! Went here on a Tuesday and got a single soup just for a $2.75! Always love seeing families come out to enjoy some ice cream. I especially love this place because of all their different flavors and their huge proportions! The pistachio flavor is my personal favorite (on the sugar shell cone). Today I also got the sampler with four different flavors- strawberry cheesecake, Reese's pieces, matcha, and butter pecan. One day I will try all their flavors! Can't wait to go again

Small little ice cream shop in Phoenix that is definitely worth a visit! The line is out the door but once you taste the ice cream, you'll know why! Great flavors, some I had never even heard of before and tons of options for add-ons. There's a great seating area outside in the back of the shop that is great to hang out in AND the ice cream shop is connected to a bar! Definitely worth a visit.
Pretty good, good hours....I like this place for when im craving that midnight snack or need my morning coffee... The coffee taste like a desert depending on kind u get....love this place!!

Ok so the Super Bowl was boring but my ice cream sundaes made halftime! I discovered Handels not too long ago and they make the Best homemade ice cream---there-on premises. Two things I noticed immediately: 1. It's pristine clean. You can see thru the windows where they make the ice cream! 2. The teens that work there---positive, upbeat, clean cut and happy to give out samples. Reminds me of the In n out burger philosophy! And most importantly the ice cream is sooo good! I called ahead yesterday and ordered 5 quarts: buckeye, strawberry cheesecake, blue monster, malt and good ol choc chip cookie dough. My guests at halftime were impressed! Ok I'm from Ohio, never heard of them there and am sooo happy they are in vegas. On tuesdays they have 2 for Tuesday but I never seem to be there on that day. Oh well!!!

This place is amazing. I had both the apple cinnamon and pumpkin spice ice cream in a waffle cone. The ice cream was the best I've ever had. I believe what makes it so good is the texture their ice cream has. It is something I haven't noticed from other ice cream shops. The cone to me was great but other people I was with thought it was a little sweet. The price was average which was great considering the high quality of the ice cream. The staff seemed friendly. I have no complaints.
Average place ,not my first choice tried the cookies, croissant, cup cakes and it wasn't great , good location and good place for coffee

My wife wanted to try this place. The place is small but really how big does it need to be. The menu has a few great selections and it is great to see the likes of red bean as an option. The smells are wonderful, the art on the wall matches. This is a great treat for the whole family. Recommend.

Very cute cafe. It gives me all the cozy hangout feels. The soft serve flavors tastes like what they are described as. The Ube and hojicha flavors were amazing. It was a tough decision as to what to get my first time coming here. Everything sounded so tasty. The Ube latte mixture was homemade. I asked and they boil down the Ube root. It was very creamy and rich tasting. The matcha latte was good as well. They do have a loyalty program as well.
Super yummy and delicious ice cream and treats! Following all Covid procedures (limiting customers inside, spaced out line, masks, gloves, etc)!
Best bakery in Little Italy. Been coming here over 20 years, cookies are awesome, half off specials, pasta salads, gelatos

I've been getting pastries from here for years and yes it's a bit pricey but the convenience of getting a coffee & a quick breakfast while being so upscale is worth it. The macaroons are to DIE FOR! I have to thank all the people who said where the location actually is so I will post the same. There are two Grand Lux locations but this kiosk/stand alone bakery is inside the Venetian behind an escalator. I'm always able to find it because to the left of the escalator is this great chocolate/candy/carmel apple glass stand.

I stopped here randomly because I saw that it was busy and I was not disappointed! I got strawberry ice cream and it was so good! The ingredients tasted fresh. There was a good selection of flavors to choose from and I liked that this place was more local to Cleveland. I hadn't heard of this place before but I would come back! One thing I didn't like, though, is that they got my e-mail when I checked out and they kept sending me a stupid amount of e-mails. How many ice cream updates can one shop give? Other than that, no complaints!
Always delicious pastries and cookies. Never a disappointment. The best coconut bars around! Very clean. Friendly staff. We love going to Presti's Bakery!
Unbelievable dessert and their salted caramel brownie is to die for! Expect a line, that is how good they are!

Visited this place for the first time and it was such a nice experience. Not only are the Dough Melt's amazing, but the owners are so kind and personable! They recognized my friend who had been in once before. Great people, great treats. I'll be back!

This is hands down my FAVORITE bakery in Madison! You will not be disappointed any anything they make here...my most favorite is their key lime pie , it's so rich and smooth and just a great dessert! I never pass up grabbing a few of their 1" decorated cookies near the register. It's amazing how something so small can have such a BIG taste! Make SURE to grab a croissant (any kind or flavor they have!!) because they will leave you craving for more - so crisp, soft and delicious at the same time. Also love the fresh soft pretzels and their sourdough. Just a tip if you don't preorder anything - get there earlier than later because things sell out and you will be sad!

Wow! Mango gelato, coconut macaroon and a toasted marshmallow! Wow! Going to go again! Betty's combo was chocolate gelato, strawberry macaroon and toasted marshmallow. We were very happy to see the reviews and it's closer than (now boring) Dairy Queen. AND supporting a local small biz!
