There's also $2 Tuesday where you'll get a GIGANTIC scoop of ice cream (when they say single scoop, it's pretty much the size of a double or triple) for $2. Lastly, we once ran into Dan Reynolds (lead singer of Imagine Dragons) here and I really really wanted my kids to say hi (ID is their favorite band and they know every song off of both CDs) but were too shy. So, next time you're in the mood for ice cream - come here, get a Hot Fudge Sundae with Graham Central & nuts. You're welcome!

Churn is a whimsical, retro-styled creamery offering a grand selection of sundaes, milkshakes, and floats debuting flavors like Oh My! Affogato, Caramel Apple Pie, Kickin' Cherry Cola, and How Now Brown Cow. Churn is a reminiscent 1960s relic: a soda shop, candy store, and ice cream parlor all at once, yet with a modern adaptation.

The food and quality here is amazing. The salted caramel brownie is incredible. I also love the cream cheese puffs too. Heck, everything here is good. Just be careful when you go because a long line is not uncommon.
Very sweet. Too sweet. Expensive. However cashier was nice and even gave sample. Loves the tables outside to sit by fountain. Make sure to brush teeth after sugary treat!

I LIVE LAUGH LOVE MITCHELLS! For AGES I have gotten my ice cream here, and it is the real deal! The staff is adequately trained and kind. The kids love watching the train go round and round, and it is just a very enjoyable family favourite! Please go here!
The Bagel was stale the cheese danish was too lemony but the raspberry beignet was fantastic and the coffee is strong like I like it

So the long wait is finally over--85c Bakery Cafe has opened up shop in Las Vegas and we were thrilled to see that they had a soft opening today until 5 pm (Grand Opening on Dec. 6th). Me and my wife immediately grabbed a tray and selected a few of our favorite freshly made breads and pastries. Of course, the 85c experience isn't complete without their famous sea salt iced coffee (which you can order unsweetened). The soft launch staff is adequately prepared and the bakery is abundantly stocked and continuously churning out fresh bread just like the well-oiled 85c machine we've grown accustomed to in California. So far there's no long lines, probably because people aren't aware that the cafe-bakeshop is open. It's a glorious day for Vegas foodies indeed and we'll definitely be visiting regularly.
BEST ICE CREAM OF ALL TIME!! the salted peanut butter is the best flavor and the waffle cones are fantastic!

Perfect treat if you are checking out the Linq! My son and I went on the High Roller and passed by Sprinkles on the way out. I'm so glad we stopped! Great service and awesome choices. I had a cookie ice cream sandwich. Nom, nom, nom. Double chocolate cookie with banana ice cream. I should have waited a bit for everything to get melty bc the cookies were a bit tough at first. Still delicious! My son had a vanilla malt milkshake and a black/white cupcake. He wanted me to get the captain crunch ice cream so he could have had more! We sat near the fountain and enjoyed our frozen treats while people watching. I totally recommend a stop to this small sweet spot while in vegas!!

They were extremely crowded on a 3 PM Friday afternoon how to draw a number to get service ended up getting quite a selection as there are a lot of items to choose from. Staff is very friendly. got the chocolate walnut hazelnut cake the pistachio chocolate cake, cannoli cake, Napoleon, German chocolate cake,cappuccino brownie and the lemon coconut cake. to be totally honest none of them were good they werent offensively bad per se but lacked flavor. my main issue was with the Napoleon, as this is my favorite dessert. this was literally not a Napoleon. it had the traditional Napoleon topping but then the body of it was chocolate mousse and with a very very thin layer of cream and phyllo. so that was a huge disappointment. the other cakes also didn't taste like what they were advertised to especially the pistachio cake and just in general weren't very good they all had the mousse and maybe it's a personal issue I have with mousse. The German chocolate cake also just wasn't very sweet and the cappuccino brownie we a-likened to a Costco brownie it just honestly to me tasted like Betty Crocker- it did not taste special and it did not have a coffee flavor at all. I feel bad being so critical because it was a really beautiful store and the desserts are all very aesthetic but I just don't think it was worth it especially for the price which ended up being about $36. The quality was like a grocery store.

Down right Delicious Walked in and ordered the chocolate croissant it was light, airy and the outside was very flakey. I also got the salted Carmel macaroon for my husband. He loved it The workers were friendly and seemed to be in a great mood. I mean who wouldn't with all the deliciousness surrounding them. Great spot for a quick pastry or sandwich. Highly recommend

Amelie's is a French bakery with great reviews that is open 24/7. The one place that is open at all hours. I love the pastries and the coffee that they serve. I actually got chocolate croissants to go and sat in to eat a chocolate mousse cup and a slice of their cakes. It was sweet and goes well with the latte that I was having. It was a crowded place, very limited in seats because they are all occupied. Its quite a small place and sometimes the line went to near the bathroom area, and it was only 10pm. Next time I would try a later time hopefully there would be more seating.

My rating from this place is between a 3 and 5, but a solid 4 at all times once the experience is over. The painful line at night during the time everyone wants dessert is my reason for a 3, although a 5 when I'm hammered and get sobered up with some coffee and pastries! Good place to study as well, or get hit on by strange men with purple beards.

Absolutely the worst service I've ever received. The main manager there was freaking out that we had even entered the building.. which we didn't know wasn't allowed... the doors were wide open. Then we didnt have a mask.. which I understand there's pandemic.. but when we are about 30 feet away there's no reason to freak out and immediately call a building manager to get us out. Just the rudeness from the staff makes me never want to visit the ice cream shop again.

Worth the hype worth the drive worth the wait... strawberry pop tart donut was as big as my hand definitely shareable. It's filled with strawberry and has the topping of a pop tart on top if your a fan of strawberry and donut plus pop tarts this was a great marriage. If you want a less massive donut and love apple or apple pie the apple crumb is the way to go the cake donut apple flavor again was great and my son even saved half for next day (still good) I also had a iced chai latte with almond milk and dash of cinnamon (didn't make the picture) perfect amount of chai to milk sometimes the spice from the chai can be over powering but this was great ( only regret was not getting a larger size) Customer service y'all know I love a good customer service.. they were friendly (the man plus women) sorry might even be the owner. But friendly, patient and did not rush me as I slowly looked. I was sad because the (FRENCH TOAST DONUT) served isn't during the week but if you go Saturday you can get it. Transportation I came from the strip and rode the deuce bus all the way to Fremont experience and just walked no more then 2 blocks they have a little back seating area then we walked back to Fremont st and saw the sights. When I'm back in Vegas this will be my stop!

This is so like my great & uncle's house (when they were alive, RIP). Full of charm & antique-ish wares! Busy, busy, busy...no matter when you go. This is a favorite hang out spot for co-working, meetings, those "hey, I just left the club & I am drunk", "hey, I need to pick up some treats for a party"...& just plain, "I WANT DESSERTS!" 24/7 hours & you are in a win-win situation! Also, if you're in the mood for soups & fancy sandwiches, you're in for a "treat", too. My favorite are the little berry tarts. MMMM! I'm also a fan of their salted caramel brownies. The coffee is STRONG, so beware! Oh such a great people watching place! :D Go ahead & take your laptop / iPad / tablet device in with you & enjoy the free wi-fi!

such sweet owners and staff! the tea is amazing and freshly brewed! please support local business. it's their first year and they made it through a tough year, all in the midst of the pandemic. supporting local is important right now and this place has such a great energy. their ice cream is very good too! 10/10!

I've been waiting for Milk Bar to open for a few weeks now after stumbling upon it's storefront advertisement a few weeks ago. I stopped by today after lunch to check it out. I've had Momofuku Milk Bar a few times before in NYC so the opening in Vegas is really exciting for me! Their most popular dessert is the milk and cereal - I wouldn't say it's the most spectacular dessert, it literally tastes like milk and cereal, but it's worth a try. What I keep coming back for is their cookies - compost, corn, blueberries and cream are among my favorites. So far the line is pretty empty, I don't think a lot of people know it has opened in Vegas, but I anticipate it will get busy soon.
I don't eat donuts very often, but Jack Frost are the best! A huge assortment, and always fresh. The staff is friendly and helpful. Go early!

Love, love, love! These donuts taste great and are decorated super cute. If you love cream filled donuts, this place is for you. There's a mountain of cream on top of the donuts. Don't forget to get some donut holes too, those were gone as soon as I put them out on the kitchen table.
I have been during little Italy festival. Their cannoli and tiramisu are to die for. Parking was a problem. If not for that this restaurant is perfect.

We've been eyeballing this place out for quite sometime now since we live just around in Town Center. My husband and I were looking for a new close by desert spot and decided to finally try this place out. We came a little pass 9pm last night (Sunday) and there was a short line but nothing crazy. We were excited by the huge selection they had to offer specially when the advertisement said that their ice cream were hand made daily. I decided to get the 4 sampler and my husband wanted a hurricane. The guy who helped us from the left windrow told us they can't make a hurricane anymore. It didn't need to take him to roll his eyes to show that he was being so salty to his customers. Though it looked like he really wanted to. The other guy on the right window was alright by the way. I wasn't sure if this guy was in a bad mood or something. But my husband felt so uncomfortable to the point he finally got so irritated and decided not to get anything for himself anymore. At first there was a lady in front of us that ordered and before she even completely finished ordering, the guy just shut the window on her. I felt bad for the lady because she was so sweet and she felt a little embarrassed about what he did too. Too bad we came in the wrong time as our first time. Maybe well go back again because we like supporting this kind of food joint. Maybe when were not feeling Yogurtland on Flamingo/215, but not anytime soon.

I have to agree with all of the hype I've heard about this place - for a small shack, this place does serve up some of the best ice cream in town. My husband and I went on a Saturday afternoon during COVID. It was not busy, so there was no problem with social distancing. We ordered at the window outside and ate the ice cream on the way back to the car. My husband ordered a cup with honey lavender and bourbon toffee. I ordered a dough melt with cookie monster and the bourbon toffee ice creams. Yum! The donut was warm and did not disappoint! The only thing I will say about this place is that it is out of the way and not in the most convenient location. I don't know how comfortable I'd feel going there at night.

I HATE giving a 1 star but enough is enough. Lik everyone, was excited that we have 85 in Vegas. So we be been patronizing as well as my work and clients. At one time my work almost bought out the whole store, but I'm sure I'm not the only one. I come here to send clients little snacks and intro them to other pastries. So today I ask for a small box so I can give as gift. I'm told no, then I said I can pay for a box, told no. I said I'll buy more stuff for the box and was told no the box are only for a certain item like a cake. WTF? That's new! Ok let me buy the stupid cake so I can get the box and then never come here. Honestly I fucked up! I should've just left, hahahhaha facckk Never never never again will I come here

While I was in Paris, my boyfriend was in Las Vegas...oddly enough in the fake Paris hotel...you can guess who won the battle of emailing Eiffel Tower pictures. I decided he too needed to smuggle baked goods in his luggage. I think he did a better job than me. I only asked for bouchons, but I was also given a chocolate tart. I think my heart stopped for a couple seconds while eating it, and I'm not sure if it's because I shouldn't have eaten the whole thing by myself or because it tasted of chocolate heaven. Even though it had been in the freezer for a couple days, it was still pretty damn amazing. The bouchons were just not that amazing in retrospect after the tart. They were good, but I can make a glorified brownie too if necessary. I am far too lazy for a tart. I would eat everything again though, and then some more, don't get me wrong.

When you live in Arizona ice cream is a must to combat the scorching temperature. Novel is in the right place at the right time, and does not disappoint. We have been wanting to try Novel for some time now but didn't get around to it. But let me tell you it was worth the wait. At first we could not find it, it sits on the corner of Grand and 11th but is tucked away with other small businesses. Thank God for the signs because it helped us navigate to ice cream euphoria (i.e Novel). We where greeting right away and given a run down of the flavors and additional choices. My daughter got pink (strawberry) with sprinkles of course and I got the bourbon in a donut. Both flavors knocked it out of the park and I loved how the donut was a little warm. I also picked up a glass bottle of squirt to take home to the Hubbs. We will come back to try the new flavors they surprise us with.
Fun place. Open 24 hours. Good pastries and coffee. Quirky decorations.

It was pretty good! I had a mangoneada and it was a nice combo of sweet and spicy. My big negative is the prices. I think they are just too high for an ice cream place. $5 for two scoops? Sheesh. I honestly don't think I'll return and that's unfortunate because their cookie cup looks good.

Wonderful ice cream shop. I love supporting small local businesses just like this because they are usually locally owned and family run and I like supporting the community. But most of all the ice cream is fantastic. There is nothing in this shop that you can't love. The service is amazing and the people are extremely friendly so what more can you ask for?

Amazing ice cream. Anyone visiting the Scottsdale area should try this ice cream joint. It has interesting flavors and the service is great. Upon arrival the employee told us that we can sample. So, I sampled. It'll be hard to explain considering their flavors are unique and infused with many different ingredients in different combinations. I opted for the pint. 7.50 and you can mix two (or more but it was suggested that two was the maximum mix) flavors. Mango lassi and Peppermint were my choices. The Mango Lassi tasted almost exactly like a mango lassi beverage you can buy at an Indian restaurant. Peppermint was mixed with real peppermint canes.

I realize this is an outlier of a review, but I did reach out to Donut Bar via their website with no response. Overall, these are some good donuts. I had the maple bacon cinnamon roll before we headed off to Death Valley and Northern California. The first few bites were pretty amazing, but things turned when I got closer to the center, which by this time we were in Indian Springs. The girlfriend thought it was a molten center, but it just turned out that the center was COMPLETELY RAW! I'm not saying this was the contributing factor to some stomach problems I had for the following few days, but exactly rule it out either. The other thing is the kids donuts they have on Saturday. And while they are cool, they are really no different than those over-iced heavily food colored donuts you can get at a supermarket.

Amazing and utterly decadent concoctions! We loved the Vietnamese coffee, sour cream cinnamon and whisky toffee. My son devoured his peanut butter kids scoop ($3) the pretzel cone was a novelty and interesting, but I wouldn't recommend as it didn't complement the flavors and had an odd consistency in my opinion. However, still thoroughly enjoyed the ice cream and heartily recommend!

The music is WAY TO LOUD! You have to scream what you want! The donuts are tasteless. How can that be? My grandson would not eat them and hes 7!!!t they are the worst tasting donuts I have ever eaten, they have no flavor. And the cost is ridiculous for a tasteless donut!

Lots of good flavors and also has seasonal flavors that they change up frequently. There are a few dairy free options that are good as well. The atmosphere and customer service were good. My only complaint would be on some week nights there may be slow moving lines due to too few workers on that night.
This place is amazing! We loved every bite! Nice to have awesome service as well - this is now our go to ice cream shop!

There seems to be a curse on whichever establishment opens up in this old house, but Melt is a parlor that needs to stay. I have my booze, coffee, and food options already taken care of on this road, so an ice cream shoppe is refreshing! Tried the watermelon and cucumber sorbets. None of that fake crap like high fructose corn syrup or artificial flavor...it was all so fresh, you'd think they farmed the fruit that day. The price is reasonable, the quality outstanding, and you get to snack on a fortune cookie at the end. I have no regrets.
No military discount here. Minimal seating at this ice cream store. 2 stars, because the employees were unfriendly.

I love ice cream places that serve unique flavors. This was it. And they serve them in Chinese take-out cartons with a fortune cookie! They had flavors like Trix, banana pudding, lucky charms, etc. but their flavors are rotating so you might not see the same that I did! Go here. There are tables and chairs outside.
Perfect little ice cream portion. And love the extra waffle on top. It's cute and delicious.

Omg, this was the worst cupcake I've ever had, it was dry and crumby like powder. It must have been DAYS old. Shame on Carlos for his lack of attention of this bakery. Gordon Ramsey would not have put up with serving crap.

When I found out there was a Carlo's Bakery in Vegas, boy was excited. I've haven't had the time to check out the one in LA, so when I found out there was one in Vegas I had to make a stop. I think the reviews are a little bit lower than they should be. Sure people expectations our high and so are the prices here. This place similar to Milk Bar in the Cosmopolitan is one of the most expensive places to pay for dessert. I only tried to item a chocolate Cannoli & hazelnut lobster claw. Just for those two things it was like 12 bucks, we could have really spent even more money, but I just wanted a taste. Originally I was going to go with the Oreo Lobster claw, but one of the employees said the hazel nut ones one of the best flavors. The lobster claw is like a croissant, but it is a little harder, the hazel nut cream was delicious. I thought my wife's cannoli was alright. I would come back though I feel like there could be more choices in unique baked goods.
This ice cream is absolutely delicious!! I highly recommend the banana cream pie flavor! Seating is outside only and very minimally available at best.

It was a Friday evening that we were there, having just come from Anthrocon. There was a line at this place, but all we wanted was a scoop of ice cream. The flavors of ice cream were interesting: cannoli, birthday bash, a piece of cake, peanut butter cup, salted caramel, etc. lots of melted chocolate lay around for sale, as well as empty candy jars with no goods in them, despite their labels. The a/c unit dripped on us a whole bunch when we walked in. When I checked in on Yelp, it gives you the offer to have a free chocolate covered pretzel. So when the time came, we waited in line (there was only one very stressed young man working, he said his coworkers hadnt shown up, he hadn't had a break, and he'd been working all day. What gives?! We got a single scoop of peanut butter cup ice cream, in a plain small cone, price came out to be around 2.77 or something like that, couldn't remember the number and there was no where the prices for ice cream were listed. He didn't recognize the Yelp check in deal, but still honored it. The pretzel was super stale. Pretty not appetizing.

Kind of more expensive than the chain ice cream places BUT the ice cream was delicious. Tried roasted almond and the cookie monster flavors. Not too heavy and definitely the cool treat that we needed during the still hot Arizona days. Met the owner. Such a friendly guy. Moreover, the location is such a great place. We were planning to just grab ice cream and go but we felt the vibe and chilled for a bit. Even went back to grab a nice sugar cane Coca Cola from Mexico to complete the afternoon 'snack'. Sad that we were just passing through but definitely glad to help out a local owner and hope to return again.

Modern but feels old fashion. I ordered the rocky road sundae. How rocky was this road? Well if I were driving Grandma around, her dentures would be rattling and once we get to the destination, she may have lost them somewhere between here and there. So if you can't picture it, the rocky road is loaded with almonds. I loved the almonds and was the best part of the sundae. The chocolate ice cream was creamy but too sweet for me. The flambÃ© marshmallow fluff was beautiful and enticing, but too sweet for me. I ordered a pretzel cone on the side to try as I read good reviews... it was kind of ehh. I would absolutely come back to try more of their imaginative menu. I was surprised at the sticker price on the menu, so be prepared. I came late at night so parking wasn't an issue, but it may be an issue during prime time. Oh those nuts... Grandma, can we go on another ride?

Visited this place with my teenage girls. Absolutely incredible ice cream. A variety of different flavors. It is a walk up window and seating in on adjacent park benches in the walkway area of the strip Mall. The price is decent for what you get.

A little annoyed that I drove 30mins to try this place out and all they had was 5 flavors to choose from!? For the people that have to make a drive maybe you should call ahead, and see if they're serving more than 5 flavors or have waffles in stock. It was a waste of my time...

Mason's is a great place to go if you're looking for unique flavor combinations and homemade ice cream. The menu is constantly changing and they have vegan and dairy-free options. My all-time favorite is the cardamom ice cream but today I opted for the pistachio over the French toast, which I also sampled. Prices are fair - 2 scoops for $4.50 in a cup. I would rate 5 stars except parking is super limited - Ohio City is a very popular neighborhood with small lots. Try to get street parking nearby if you can.

This place is such a Pittsburgh gem!! The best ice cream I've ever had. Their menu is HUGE and everything is so so good. This is a must if you are visiting Pittsburgh or live here and haven't ever been.

I know the shop is new and I'm sure it's busy all day, but the two girls who helped me made my experience bad. In general, the staff is not organized at all. My friend requested rocky road and when we were waiting for our ice cream (after paying already) the girl who was helping us told the customer after us that there was only one scoop of rocky road left and she had to choose a second scoop of another flavor. My friend went up to the employee and asked "how did you skip me when I ordered rocky road, but now you served it to a customer who ordered after me?" I also ordered roasted almonds on my ice cream and when I got my cone, it was peanuts. I asked that same employee if they were peanuts, and she rudely replied, "NO, they are almonds.".. I let my friends taste my cone, and it was peanuts!!!! I know what peanuts taste like! Just the overall experience was disappointing.

Dear god in heaven, the ice cream here! So damn good! I had two scoops: one of Vietnamese coffee, the other a half and half of German chocolate and butter pecan. Each flavor was rich and wonderful, and the butter pecan had candied pecans in it! Absolutely delicious. Will be back.

Omg this place is absolutely amazing with their fresh mad ice cream and delicious cookie cup! They have an original and unique selection of ice cream flavors that are all so delicious! I have been a few times since I moved to Arizona and will keep going back! So glad I found this place! The cookie cup has your choice of ice dream, your choice in flavor of macaroon cookie on top, then topped with a crisped marshmallow! Absolutely amazing creation!

Love that carb life! What I love getting: - Kouign-amann: So buttery, so flaky, so delicious - Ham and cheese croissant: Perfect morning snack on your drive home - Bouchon: Basically the best chocolate brownie bite ever - Macarons: I found that it's a cheaper deal overall to get 6 of the big ones then getting one of their premade boxes - Epi bread: As one of my all time favorite restaurant breads, I love taking this home with me. You can spritz it with some water and toast it up to warm perfection in your toaster oven at home - Chocolate chip cookie: I can't explain it, but this is the PERFECT chocolate chip cookie. It's crispy, but has this chewy center. It has plenty of good quality chocolate, but also balanced with hints of salt. Pros: - Basically, the entire bakery section. Like ALL of it. From their baked goods, to their sweets, to any of the sandwiches (I prefer the ones they can heat up for you). Carb life!!! - The line can be long sometimes, but they do a good job of moving things along and starting your order before you get to the cashier Cons: - Location is right by the guest elevators, so unless you're a guest at the Venetian, it can be a bit of a walk to get to this shop - Coffee was not great. At all. We got a latte and it just tasted so weak! We had the guy make it again, and it was the same thing. I'd rather get my coffee elsewhere from now on - Good quality baked goods are not cheap. But I don't care. Carb life! Would I come again? YES every time I stay at the Venetian/Palazzo. That carb life!
The best dark chocolate cupcake ever. Bad it for desert with an espresso last night. It was a great way to cap a night.

First time at this ice cream place. The ice cream is absolutely amazing. The mango actually tastes like mango. This time I got two scoops on waffle cone and they offer sugar cone as well as bowl. They have many flavors to choose from. Definitely coming back for some more.

We went here to end our anniversary date and had some great deserts. The desert specials were very large, but had smaller sizes available (which we overheard). Love the ice cream here and the atmosphere. My concern was the young employees having some very loud conversations in front of the customers about their dating lives. The employees need a space where they can talk about these things, but also need to know this is not something to be done in front of the customers. Some folks are trying to celebrate.
Best ice cream in vegas!! My fave flavors so far are: Banana cream pie Chocolate pecan Oreo Salted caramel Customer service is amazing too!! Can't wait to try all the flavors!!
Aside from their crack pje, you should try their Chocolate Malt Shake. Super rich with chocolate milkshake. The bottom has a chocolate fudge that makes every sip tastes like heaven!
This place is just the bomb!!! Love all different flavors and Tuesday specials!!! Everyone is friendly

Disclaimer: I am a huge macaron fan. Now that that is out of the air, I LOVE their macarons! These are probably the best macarons I've tasted so far. The only other places I've had them are Vanilla Bakeshop in Santa Monica and Europane in Pasadena. I'm going off on a quest to search for macarons better than these in LA. Bring it! I bought the set of flavors here, and it was totally worth it to try all the flavors! Now I know which ones are my favorite...and they have to be Raspberry, Vanilla Bean, and Coffee. I think these flavors are more fragrant and they coffee has a deep earthy coffee taste to it, just how a coffee flavor should be. The lemon and orange were a little too sweet for me, and I just somehow don't like the citrus flavored macarons as much. And I never had a thing for chocolate flavored anything, so take my opinions with my preferences in mind. The shells are very delicate, as they crack quite easily, but the crunch had just enough soft chew too, and on top of the cream or ganache inside, it was heavenly! I also tried the carrot cake cookie and it was okay. I think the carrot cake could have been more moist. The cream cheese filling was good though. =) There was also a really cute sweets stand next to this stand. Oh, and Bouchon Bakery is not a store. It's literally like a little stand! Downstairs by the casinos and the Phantom of the Opera Theater is where you'll find it. =) And make sure you get there before they close if you want to buy anything. My mom was saying we should go there right before our POTO show started for some dessert after dinner, but I thought that was a huge mistake and made us go in the afternoon before we went outlet shopping and dinner. THANK GOD. It was closed when we came back to watch our show. [Phantom of the Opera was amazing too! But that's beside the point... :)] If you're a macaron fan, definitely try theirs. Overpriced, but you'll forget about that once you try it. =D

Disappointed. I have been eating sprinkles cupcakes since the beginning. This red velvet had to be the most dry cupcake I've ever had. I can guarantee it wasn't made today. I don't know what's going on but sprinkles has gone down hill as it has spread the country. Cupcakes have gotten dry, smaller & the quality just isn't what it used to be. The icing was even slightly hard! So sad!

I had the mint ice cream (it's real mint!) and Meyer lemon olive oil in a waffle cone...delicious! Super impressed by their individual service and their delicious flavor offerings. Impressed by the owners entrepreneurial spirit and amazing heart they've clearly put into their place.

Unfortunately after having Jean Phillipe Patisserie , Carlo's didn't seem as good. Tried the lobster tail and cream puff from their place. Lobster tail was stuffed with cream which was really good but i found the puff pasty to be harder than normal and chewy. Puff pastry was really disappointment as I have had better one in regular cheap bakery shops.. Maybe other stuff are good which I didn't get to try.

First time walking in with my lil family Found it on yelp like i find any other place. I was very pleased with the service & the time they took to explain what comes in Halo Halo. Oh my was this Halo amazing ! 10/10 Must stop by & try this place.

Excellent customer service. They let you try all the flavors. Then pineapple was fabulous, but we went with strawberry and some fruity tooty thing, both of which were great. The neighborhood was full of "character" at night, but it was a cute place. I'd go back.

I had the strawberry shortcake cone and it was so good! It was also huge and I couldn't finish it. Their teas are also really good, and the staff is friendly. Very clean and cozy inside. Will definitely be coming back.

Great pastries, but the service has went downhill. We come here every time we're in Vegas and the service we received this weekend (3 times mind you) it got worse every time we came. The last day we were there I called in my order which is required to be prepaid and still waited in line for 20 minutes and were treated like we didn't even exist. Very disappointed in the service.

Updating my review from 1 to 4 stars. Tonight I tried the chocolate chip cookie, the caraway shortbread, and a honey miso latte. I didn't like the chocolate chip cookie but my partner did; it was chewy which he's a fan of. The caraway shortbread was GREAT. The shortbread was so good-- a little salty, subtly sweet, and had a great texture. The honey miso latte was good! I appreciated that the shortbread was labeled as "caraway shortbread" so I knew I was getting something herbaceous and unique. The service could be better by which I mean the people could be more talkative and a little less "moody but cute Tumblr chick". There was no effort to build rapport but I'll assume they were just incredibly focused on cutting marshmallows. I will be back!

I was very excited to try this place as a coworker and I had a very long stressful day at work and needed a quick pick me up. Upon arrival we were greeted and found it surprising that when we asked to see the menu the cashier left for about ten minutes. After taking our order I asked of we could add an additional item to which have rolled her eyes and headed back to the kitchen. As we were paying she provided me with the receipt and was annoyed when I asked for a pen to sign the receipt. We sipped on our drinks and surprisingly they were bland and gave us all a headache. Unfortunately we will not be returning back.

Presti's offers a great assortment of cookies and pastries. We tried their chocolate covered cannolis, various cookies, and cassata cake. All were very fresh and tasted great. The cassata cake was so moist that it blended nicely with the layers of custard inside. Our only disappointment was the selection and quality of the gelato. We've had better in the Bay Area.

The interior styling and decor of this cafe is incredible with usage of antiques and vintage items to create a cozy, artsy aesthetic. The Butterwood offers a variety of succulent gourmet pastries and cakes with surprising flavors to delight every taste bud. In addition, many coffees and teas are available to accompany your sweet treat. Service is always excellent and the baristas are extremely helpful answering any and all questions. If you want to stop somewhere for a great (and unique) baked good and hot beverage in an interesting setting, you must stop here!
The bakery needs set hours. Says it closed at 9 but they decided to close whenever they felt like it tonight. Not cool!
Macarons are fan-freaking-tastic! Wish I'd gotten the pain au chocolat fresh, but it was delish nonetheless. I don't know if it was because I ate it the next day, but the PB&J brioche was a tad dry.
I love donut bar. The donuts are huge. We walked 4 blocks each day to eat there. Our favorite is the cake batter donut

I'm not late to try this place out. I'm just late to review them. First of all, I'm not a huge fan of sweets unless it's peanut butter covered with chocolate in a dark brown paper cup and packaged in an orange wrapper. Yes, I have a weakness for Reese's. Where was I? Oh Yeah, Milk Bar. My first experience with Milk Bar was a melted soft serve, Compost cookie, Corn cookie, and the Crack Pie. I didn't think that the soft serve was bad, just expensive and melts way too quick. Their cereal milk soft serve is worth if you're a fan of cereal and milk. I also wasn't too impressed with their cookies and the Crack Pie. Crack is supposed to be addicting. I wasn't addicted and only needed one bite. I was ready to give Milk Bar 3-stars because I thought that everything I tried was just A-Ok. Then it happened. I got a chance to try their Birthday Cake and was blown away. It's hard for me to explain what makes their Birthday Cake so good. Everything from the icing to the buttery taste of the cake is simply just awesome. The cake is small and the price is massive. Take my advice and limit your feeding to just a few bites a day. You can make a whole cake last a whole week doing this. Just don't forget to keep the cake in the fridge. That's what we do when we have Milk Bar's Birthday Cake at home. Best Week Ever!!

I really wasn't impressed. I shared three different mini cupcakes with my friend. Red velvet, black & white and vanilla. The after taste was the worst part! I won't go out of my way to return. The cupcake ATM was a hoot and I will post photo.

Well, the desserts are as good as they look on social media. Whatever you imagined something you viewed looked like, that's what it tastes like! After cyber-stalking this trending bakery on social media for few days , I decided to make a pilgrimage for something...anything she ( the baker) had left. Luckily, after standing in line, I was able to try a couple of items pictures with this review. It was worth the wait. If you have time to kill, the line isn't that major. Just bring a friend to catch up or whatever. There is seating indoors , and hot beverages available on the menu as well. This foodie call is worth it, trust me .
Place is cute. Super busy, but that's fine. Sweets are great, but way to over priced. Still a great place to go and hang out at any hours of the day and night.

No wonder this place made one of the top 10 ice cream places in the country! It's a little taste of Heaven!!! I got the Campfire S'more sundae with the Madagascar vanilla and chocolate scoops. I'll admit that I got it just to see the marshmellow on top get slightly toasted with the dessert torch. It felt and tasted like eating a creme brulee marshmellow on top of a giant ice cream s'more. My husband got the Peanut Butter Brittle sundae, which was also nothing less than perfect! It was hilarious because there were two visitors from Atlanta in front of us in line, who has just come straight from the airport to Sweet Republic because they had to try this ice cream!! I guess that show "The Best Thing I Ever Ate" truly does help recognize this unique ice cream shop and the ice cream speaks for itself. I really wanted my husband to try the jalepeno avocado bacon brittle ice cream, but unfortunately this flavor was unavailable on Friday, so I'll try to check and see if it's there the next time we return. On the up side, we were able to purchase a bag of bacon brittle to take home with us. Of course, we didn't wait until we got home to try it. We broke off pieces of the bacon brittle and stuck them in our sundaes. Un-freaking-believable!!! Man! I love this place!

AYYY after hearing about this place selling MACARON ICECREAM, I HAD to have one!! They had so many flavors to choose from, pistachio, cotton candy, coconut, strawberry, etc. I had the strawberry shortcake & my mom had the coconut! The strawberry shortcut was so cute! It also tasted veryyy good not too sweet just how I like it! (Coconut was good too, I like how they put nuts in it!) I just wish it wasn't so big, beware guys! I could just finished half of mine, next time I'll probably just end up splitting it with someone! Cool place to check out if your ever in the boardwalk area(:

Great bakery in Little Italy! Stopped by for a coffee and a little treat. They have so many pastries and other desserts to choose from, and there's seating outside so you can enjoy the sun on a nice day.
It's alright. Nothing special and a little over priced for what you get.
Very nice upgrade to the store. So much more on their menu and my kids love it. Every time we go we get to enjoy the outside air and walk around the pond.

I've been here twice, both times around 10pm. Where else can you get cake at an adorable quirky location late at night in Pittsburgh!? I think the pictures here on Yelp can help to show off their decorations and the kind of feel this place has. After ordering and paying for the cakes at the counter, they'll bring it over to your seat with your drink or some water. All the cakes (total of 4) that I've tried here are more on the dense and sweet side. Although I'm usually more for the fluffy/light type (I grew up on Japanese-style cakes), I still really enjoy the cakes here. Rather than being like the cakes at a Japanese or French patisserie, the cakes here remind me of the cakes that the mother of my childhood friend made. Cakes that are like what I would imagine the best home-baker in town would make. Rich and flavorful, with delicious cream (NOT hardened frosting!). Except unlike a home-baker's offerings, at Butterwood you get to choose what you want out of an entire display case of drool-worthy, uniquely flavored goodies! For the price, size, and heaviness of a slice, I would say that you could probably share a slice between two people if you're not super hungry. I'll be back the next time I'm out and craving sweet things late at night. On my next visit, I'd love to try their hot chocolate!

I was excited to go to Milk Bar as I have been to the one in NY, and loved it. here... I was pretty disappointed. The soft serve was... salty. The texture was spot on to how I remember, but the flavors were very flat. I remember there being a harmonious play between savory and sweet, and instead there was a strange, flat salty flavor with almost no sweet. Plus, the pricing was extremely expensive with miniscule portions. The crack pie had great flavor but the serving size was literally the size of a restaurant match book. :(

We got the closing special so we tried a lot of donuts. Honestly I think they're okay. I've had specialty donuts and these were cool but I wouldn't come back. I didn't particularly care for any of them, I didn't like the donut batter itself. The crÃ¨me brulee wasn't sweet enough and I don't normally like super sweet things but something was just off. These aren't bad but aren't the best specialty donuts I've had. The search continues!

Here's all you need to know: they have an ice cream sandwich made with a glazed donut. I've been here a couple times, and there's always a line out the door. This is a local, individual-owned ice cream shop serving more than just ice cream -- they've become a staple in an area where a lot of small shops are being pushed out due to a rapidly gentrifying area. Come out to support them, and at the very least you'll leave with a belly full of happiness.

This is a small, possibly difficult place to find, ice cream shop especially if you don't know the neighborhood. It is located in the back of a small commercial building. They are known for their marshmallow and macaroon toppings but we just got a small cup with 3 flavors. The peanut butter was very peanutty and delicious and the Irish Cream definitely meets expectations. The chocolate chip, although good, could certainly use more chips. Our only disappointment was with having such a the wide variety of flavors they didn't have chocolate. We asked but the girl behind the counter wasn't very talkative and really didn't respond she just smiled. But it is a great place to go for a homemade ice cream fix.

It was a bit hard to find at first. Melt is not it's own shop. The ice cream shop is in another restaurant and just a small portion with not a whole lot of flavors to choose from. Definitely nothing too special. Good for pics. Ice cream was creamy, but wish they had more options to choose from.

So happy my brother and sister-in-law sent over a little surprise from Rewind. Now I have this place on my list. Drinks were super yummy. The Thai tea was delicious and is always a good drink to default on when you're having a hard time choosing from all the other milk teas. I'll have to stop in to see the rest of the menu but I'm confident that they'll be just as good as the three that were delivered. Also, their quality does not lack as you can see from the photos. The drinks traveled well.
So Yummy! Love the takeout containers the stickers are so cute and worth going out in the heat to grab some Ice Cream!

Yummmm! Got the redvelvet ice cream with the red cone. Perfect for the summer days. Ice cream was nice and creamy and it wasn't too soft. I thought it would've been on the softer side since it's so hot in Vegas. but they kept it nice and firm :) The redvelvet has some pieces of redvelvet cake mixed in. There was a line when we went in, but it gave us time to look at the menu. I over heard other customers and it sounds like they have a points system going on. They have the left side for cupcakes and merch. And on the right side is their ice cream. They have ice cream sandwiches, you can have that cookie or cupcake style. They have Sprinkle T-shirt's you can purchase in different colors and ribbons and candles. They also have their cupcake mix you can buy as a gift or take home and bake yourself.

Tried Handel's for their $2 Scoop Tuesday's and 1. Their "scoop" is really 3 scoops (no complaining here) 2. They have so many flavors to choose from its amazing 3. The staff is friendly and cheerful (always a huge bonus in my book) I had the chocolate peanut butter brownie and it was deelish, my hubby had the Chocolate marshmallow also good, my son had the cookie dough and really enjoyed the huge chunks of dough and my youngest had the blue moon which was raspberry and although it was a little too tart for me, she loved it. We will be heading back and taking advantage of their $2 scoop Tuesday

I had a split scoop: Fat Elvis (peanut butter with sweet banana and bacon), Arnold Palmer Sorbet. I enjoyed the Sorbet the best. Wife and Daughter got the Dough Melt with berries and cream and had it cut in half.

The yum ee bun ice cream sandwich might have been the best thing I have ever eaten! Combining a warm donut, ice cream, and rolled in cereal is a genius idea! Can't wait to come back and try and different combination. The customer service was great as well. The team was very knowledgeable and you can create your own custom combinations. Very cute decor and atmosphere as well.

I was looking for an ice cream place late last night and found this place next to Jobots. The flavor choices are unique and everything I sampled was very good. I got a scoop of the Greek yogurt and the carrot cake I wish I got a scoop of the cucumber sorbet, but I knew I couldn't finish 3 scoops. I love how the ice cream is served in a takeout container with a fortune cookie. Definitely a special little place!

Truly amazing ice cream! We were just in town from Yuma for a day and found this shop on Yelp. Boy was it a great find. Whenever we find ourselves in Phoenix this will be a guaranteed stop!! The young man running the place was great and very informative. Novel has very tasty and unique flavors so look them up and enjoy, you will not be sorry!!
The sundaes are good but nothing out of the ordinary. If you want good ice cream in Vegas, there are tons of places better than this

We love this place. So many hand made ice cream flavor to choose from. Ever Tuesday is $2 Tuesday. It's a great way for me to show my son appreciation for all of his hard work at school. If you don't like this place then you probably won't like anything :-)

Great atmosphere and pool side dining at The Venetian. But, portions are way too large for breakfast. We felt like we were wasting food. Great service and delicious plates. Would recommend, but for sharing!

This place is soooo cute!!! I was actually walking to lunch when I saw this place and I had to go in and try their ice cream. Since it was a hot day, I decided to try their vanilla ice cream root beer float. The root beer hit just the spot - it was light, crisp, and refreshing. The ice cream was amazing too, as it held its form in the root beer and didn't melt too fast. The composition of the ice cream was interesting, as it had a stretch, which I thought was so cool. They have a lot of options to choose from, ranging from coffee to homemade sundaes.

I split the Triple Cinnamon and Cuban Coffee with my boyfriend. The Cuban Coffee was too strong for my tastes but he really liked it. Even the cinnamon was a little overpowering after a while. Texture was slightly moist, but more of a sturdy cake. Icing did not have that bad artificial taste that icings tend to have. The ATM was super cute! I would go back but try a different flavor.
a Korean cafe whose only tea is "Mighty Leaf" tea bags? the only green tea is a sweet fake flavor "tropical green tea." Not even kidding. what in the world? there must be some mistake.
Love this bakery and their French macarons are the best! Every time we go to Vegas we load up on their pastries - sadly we eat the entire box before we even get home.
Place is always packed so naturally had to try it , had peanut butter shake was great
Meh. Had better. Small scoops and lackluster flavor. Not sure why this place is rated so higj

Rainbow buttermilk frozen yogurt: super tart, strong sour flavors, pretty overbearing had to fight it with my tastebuds to eat it all, wouldn't recommend if you like sweeter flavors Rocket pop: less sour still was wondering how theyd get the sorbet creamy but I don't think it played out well. wouldn't really recommend it Wild berry lavender: finally something calming and relaxing to the younger much needed was the best in the trio we got and we saved it for last so we could end the night in a happy note instead of sour haha Gooey butter cake: always gonna be my favorite can't go wrong w a sweet cakes ice cream especially with the salty cones Almond brittle: little too sweet for me but a nice second if gooey butter cake isn't available but you want the same vibe The staff is nice and the ice cream is smooth

This is the best Donuts I've ever had.. seriously. I heard about this place when it opened.. it closes kinda early so I didn't make it, kept putting it off.. eventually I made it in. I went three days in a row. I got two donuts each time.. I spent 4$, $5 and 9$. The prices are very reasonable .. the last time I was there.. the $9 visit. I purchased the French Toast Donut.. it involved a grill, came out hot and awesome.. with silverware; butter, syrup and jam on a plate.. my goodness!!! The first and third time I went I was that around opening and it was awesome.. the second time I went I arrived around 11:00AM. (They close at 1Pm) .. at 11 they were almost sold out. That's a positive thing. This place has fresh donuts and they are delicious. So get there earyish

Jack Frost Donuts is your old neighborhood donut shop in Cleveland. I literally came in early one day and a police officer was having a mentoring conversation with one of the young employees. If you just sit in the parking for a while in the morning, you'll see all types of people coming in and out: the lazy grungy dude in his PJs, the businessman in a hurry, the mom with 4 kids, and multiple cops. Anyway, you'll never be disappointed eating fried cake and coffee and I wouldn't miss out on Jack's if you're looking for a Cleveland staple. My recommendations are the German Chocolate, Salted Caramel, and Maple Bacon. The coffee is self-serve and is pretty good.

Kill me! I want everything when I walk in. The food, the desserts, the cookies , the gelato.... I honestly don't know how to control myself. It's always super busy. You pick a number. It's like being in NYC. LOVE!
Amazing! Pastries are incredible, coffee is great as well! Truly a unique spot on Charlotte!

I wish I could have tried Sweet Republic as it looked phenomenal when I stopped in. Unfortunately after two groups came in after me but were helped before me, I decided to leave. I had already been there for 15 minutes and did not want to wait any longer when the staff clearly wasn't paying close enough attention to their customers.

Went there on a saturday night. Super loud, crazy music, and people all hovering in front of the flavors. Too chaotic. Yogurt not particularly good (and it does NOT take a particularly good version to please me. Dissapointing - just ok.
The cream cheese frosting here is the best part. Try the red velvet cupcakes! Didn't care much for the decrotive sugar pieces on top, they're hard to eat.

Wow! This is some good ice cream!!! I had the special where you pick 1 flavor of ice cream, 1 flavor macaroon and a huge toasted marshmallow! I chose chocolate sorbet with the fruity pebble macaroon! Omg was it good!!! I would totally drive again to go here! I gave 4 stars because the service wasn't very good! Usually when your a first time customer they make suggestions. The girl wasn't friendly and didn't smile, almost seemed irritated we were there so we ate outside.
Delicious cannoli and lobster tail! Long lines, but worth the wait. No where to sit and eat at the bakery, so brought our treats back to the hotel room.

If you love ice cream this place is for you. I was visiting from out of town when I came across this place on one of the travel blogs. They have some great flavors and toppings to choose from. I went with the double trouble sundae and it blew my mind with every bite. I only wish they had a location in Los Angeles.

The best ice cream! As they say "no phony stuff" as in no artificial ingredients in their ice cream. And in addition to ice cream they have amazing cookies and rice krispie treats. My favorite is the salted chocolate chip cookie. And my favorite ice cream is the pumpkin when they have it. Otherwise, it's the toasted coconut.

This is the best ice cream place in Pittsburgh!!! They have many flavors, many mix ins, sprinkles, dips, multiple sundae options and snow cones. The variety is endless! The line is usually long, but goes quickly and is well worth the wait... Every time. This place is consistently great!

Stopped in and ordered a smattering of donuts with my beau whilst on a mission to find the best donuts in the city. These were tasty, but way to sweet for my palate. I'd go back for dessert, but not as an early morning pastry. Defiant worth a try though.
Great place, great food, great prices...too many hipsters. Not a place I'd sit and eat, I get my stuff to-go
the workers were so kind! the milk tea + strawberry soft serve was AMAZING. they were so delicious, i highly recommend this place, it's SO GOOD!!
Good bakery with a vast selection of food, desserts, and gelato. Good cannoli and great tiramisu! Slightly proxy but still good.

What friendly service! Walked in looking for a caffeine kick and was immediately greeted with a smile and info about what they served. Fun, little place with a hip atmosphere. Drink was hand delivered to me and oh my goodness....so delicious.
Everything is amazing. They get the subtle sweet balance right! I hate overly sweet pastries, and these are perfect. Macarons are the best in the area!

Campbell's Sweets Factory is known for their unique flavors of popcorn, but in our household we not only like the popcorn, but we LOVE the cupcakes! During this unfortunate time in which we are all quarantined, Campbell's is coming to your rescue to satisfy your sweet tooth. Place an online or phone order Monday through Wednesday then you can pick it up on Friday starting at 1pm. When you arrive, just call and they will bring out your order. No need to worry, the workers will be wearing masks and gloves to ensure proper precautions are taken. Not only will you get your delicious treats you ordered, but they come in a cute reusable tote! Thank you Campbell's for providing some joy during this difficult time. Now, if I can just pace myself and not end up in a sugar coma

Working with Milk Bar to pre-order a birthday cake was a smooth, seamless process and for that I am thankful. I'd ordered a 6" strawberry lemon cake - vanilla cake layered with lemon cheesecake, milk crumbs and strawberry jam, topped with strawberry frosting. Total came out to $60, was ready on the day and time I needed, and was worth the price. My friends and I agreed that the lemon cheesecake was a bit too tart, but that just comes down to personal preference. I would definitely use Milk Bar again for my cake needs in Vegas based on their quality and customer service.
Ice cream is good but service is slow-we are in line but barely moving and it is extremely hot.
The donuts were pretty good. Flavors were tasty but they were a bit dry. The coffee was good. We got there at 10:30 and the selection was already very limited which was disappointing.

A trip to Las Vegas without a stop at Milk Bar at the Cosmopolitan is incomplete. I've always want to try award-winning pastry chef Christina Tosi's dessert place. Her creations are so fun, creative and delicious!! She is the creator of the highly addictive cereal milk ice cream, compost cookies and crack pie. The place is super popular and crazy busy day and night. I tried her signature Crack pie and the soft serve ice cream with crunch, which was on top and the bottom of the ice cream. I enjoyed the soft serve, but it was a little sweet for me (not that it stopped me from eating it all). The Crack pie, which has an pat crush with a gooey butter filling, appealed more to my palette as it was less sweet, but equally delicious. I would highly recommend checking out any or all of the sweet treats at Milk Bar. I'm already looking forward to going back in November.

Hands down one of my go to when I want something sweet! Not only is the ice cream DELISH, but the experience was so FUN! I love watching the staff make the cones and the taiyaki! I haven't had a bad experience here yet! The staff is typically friendly and fast! I got the upside down ah bong with strawberry and guava swirl and the hubby got ube. It's so good and affordable!
I went there this morning, I ordered three donuts and an Iced coffee. I paid for my meal, and come to my surprise, I only received two donuts and still paid for three. Not very happy with this place.

This place was delicious. My brother and I went and got raspberry lemon donut, with fruity pebbles. Sooo good. And we got a scoop of cafe con leche. Honestly it tasted so good. My first impression was holy this is really good. A small place but we got there on time because then it go super busy. If you are ever downtown you NEED to go. We will be back soon!!
So cute and the donuts were delish. Love watching downtown Vegas come alive! This place is a must stop for belly filling breakfasts or dessert

This place is awesome! The atmosphere. The music. The people. Yes, yes, yes! The Maiko Special is so good. Normally these layered desserts are super (too) sweet but this one is amazing. You can taste the flavors of each item in the cup and nothing is too sweet. The mochi is on point.

Line out the door....must be amazing, right???? That is right!!! It's amazingly deliciius!! Toasted marshmallow on ice cream is pure genious!! Lucky charms and ice cream....omg good! Great people and great ice cream!! Prefect ending to the night!!

Do you need something sweet and delicious? Chocolates? Candy? Cupcakes? Popcorn in a ton of crazy flavors? They have it. I especially love the fun popcorn flavors and the cupcakes. This place just recently opened and is run by the same people who have the stands at the West Side Market. Don't park in the lot across the street; I think it's easiest to park on a side street & walk around the block. Just a heads up: I found their dark chocolate treats to taste more like milk chocolate and the milk tasted like white chocolate to me.

Sad. I wanted to like this place. This review is for the macarons, I had two, mint choc chip and passion fruit. First of all, I think they are too large. In my opinion, macarons should be a bit smaller unless you're absolutely sure you can get them right. The ratio of cookie to filling was too high, which made them a bit dry. The mint choc chip was decently flavored, but it reminded me a bit of toothpaste. The cookie was a bit too mushy. The passion fruit was a disaster. The filling tasted like buttery egg, and it was only very very slightly passionfruity. All in all, these are low on the list of macarons for me, and they were also the most expensive by volume. Save your money and try something else, if you fancy yourself a true macaron lover.

Dang. When people, newspapers say this place is good, they're so lying! ITS AMAZING. I was willing to take a 25 mile drive over to this place after realizing that this place has the 5th best ice cream in the US! I just got the peanut butter somethingy and it was super tasty and 100% original. The ice cream is a little pricey, being as one scoop of ice cream is about $3, though it's worth it!!!! Turns out the Food Network came to this place, so this place is a 100% MUST COME. NOW!

I have tried to go to this bakery for years and everytime I visited the line was crazy. This week however there was no line so I decided to have a taste. I had the hazelnut croissant and a brownie with pecans and caramel. For a bakery with such hype, I was sadly disappointed in the quality. The croissant was over stuffed with hazelnut cream so it ended up oozing everywhere. The brownie also had only a couple of nuts on top with a little drizzle of caramel. The actual brownie was more like cake than a brownie.
Omg amazing!!!! Need I say anymore ... Nutella , key lime pie , butter pecan , deep dish apple pie are all ridiculously good ! Be sure to try it out

We were Virgins tonite as this was our first trip to Handels and Trip it was as it was 20 miles one way to get there. I say it was worth the trip. The Flavors were not only good but plentiful and fun. Lin had the chocolate marshmallows which she said lacked marshmallows throughout the scoop. She also had coconut cream pie was the better of the two. I had the Praline Pecan & Vanilla Oreo which were both good with the Praline the better of these two. Our young man that served us lacked a smile and just kind of blew me off when I tried to say something to him. Overall it was worth the 2 hours that we spent going to & fro and we met a cute lil lady that was in 3 grade but talked like she was in High School and made the wait in line a delight. ( I bought her cone cause she was a cutie too). Thanks to the internet I found Handels and we will make a return trip.

I was enthusiastic about visiting the bakery. My wife, my daughter and I went to get some cake for my birthday. I love Caramel Cake. We tried the Salted Caramel and was politely let down. The cake was fresh and moist but the Caramel flavor was lacking. I have had some absolutely amazing Caramel Cakes so I was looking to be wowed by the cake at Carlo's. It is a good cake but nothing spectacular. On a final note they do not offer a discount for locals. I think they should offer a discount to locals that decide to patronize the businesses on the Strip like many other businesses.

Usually a fan of ice cream, I was very much disappointed in the tastelessness of this soft-serve. I was expecting some type of flavor dimension but it simply came flat. The ice cream tasted like plain 2% milk not even a hint of vanilla or anything--so if you enjoy some type of flavor/sugar in your ice cream this is not for you. Next, the cost of the cornflake topping was just outlandishly expensive!! Literally, the cost of the cereal topping on two ice creams would make up the cost of the whole box at local grocery store. Definitely one of the most overpriced spots for super bland ice cream. I do not recommend but if you're curious about the hype just like me, then try it for yourself but don't have too high expectations.

I wish I would have taken a picture of our delicious donuts! They were exquisite! They don't put "#bestdonutsever" on the box for nothing. Our family had a coffee, cream filled donut, old fashioned, and a maple bar donut. Everything was great!! I highly recommend this adorable donut shop.

The weather is perfect today and we actually had a day with nothing going on, which for this family is an anomaly. So what do you do? If you like creamy, homemade ice cream with unique, out of the box flavors, then get to Mason's. The employees were friendly and asked us if we wanted to try any of their original flavors. I went for the Honey Cornbread...wow. The friendly guy behind the counter was happy to oblige and sprinkled the sample with a dab of honey and boy was it good. Even though it was good, I opted for the Brown Sugar-Bourbon and Almond. Wow, my taste buds were blown away. Creamy, smooth, and sweet- even the waffle cones are home made. Be prepared because these aren't those dry, sterile ones with no taste that you get in a box at the grocery store. Mason's is some of the best ice cream I have ever had and their local, so go out and support this great little business!

Carlos's Bakery has a beautiful display of bakery items. The line was long and the service was tepid. It appears as though the location provides enough of a tourist base for steady customers and they do not have to put a lot of effort into building on return visitors. I ordered a cannoli and three cookies. My purchases were pretty but basic and flat tasting. They did not offer a "wow factor."

Wishing this was a fivestar-er, but man we're bummed. It was hard to find this place at night, no illuminated signage. Once we found it, we were pumped and the girl who welcomed us in was nice. Unfortunately, although we were the only people there... And the only people in the parking lot.. Repeating myself here this joint was not busy, pretty much everything we came for was sold out. The marshmallow you see in every picture on Yelp? Sold Out. What bothers me about that? How do you run out of your signature item, especially when it's (I'm assuming here) not homemade. Go to the grocery store, buy mallows. Problem solved. Same with the red velvet macaroons. I happened to order the last one, leaving my boyfriend to pick from the remaining flavors (Carmel was also sold out). Ice cream flavors were good and the macaroon was tasty, but for $11+ dollars?! No. Especially with the inconvenience of ordering from a limited menu and the atmosphere being kinda meh. Just... No.

This place is a nice little gem in Champaign. It is a great place to stop on a hot day for a nice cup of custard. There are so many options on the menu, so it is easy to find something that you will like. I suggest the vanilla custard with cold fudge. It is absolutely delicious. Who knew that cold fudge would be better than the classic hot fudge? There are plenty of seats outside, and there is a large parking lot. I have never been there when it is busy, but I have heard that the lines can sometimes be up to an hour long. The only reason that I am not giving this place 5 stars is because the service is kind of slow. There have been times where the person helping me will take a long time getting my custard made, but I realize that when it's busy, sometimes it can be overwhelming. Anyways, I would definitely recommend this place, and I can't wait to go this summer!

Amelie's is really going downhill ... We used to adore this place ... Food quality, service, understaffed - has all gone down ... Maybe ego is the issue- maybe time for them to get a competitor so they care again. Only reason for two stars is some pastries are still yummy ... My chai latte was water downed yuck!

So happy we made our friend pick us up some pastries for our little hiking day trip to Red Rocks! We got the egg, ham, croissant, a cheese Danish, blueberry muffin and a raspberry macaroon. The egg, ham croissant was $10, but huge. The croissant was so crispy and fluffy. It was a good breakfast before our hike. After our hike, the macaroon and the cheese danish were great desserts! It was so good. I especially thought the cheese danish was amazing! The cheese and the crunchiness... perfection. The macaroon was about $5 but it was huge! Definitely coming back for some baked goods every time I'm in Vegas!!

What can I tell you that others haven't already? Higher fat content makes for a superior-tasting product. Multiple flavors of everything, fresh, hot, made-to-order food, classic neon lights and a drippy railroad bridge. It's a beautiful piece of mid-20th century American nostalgia. What's not to love?

Most of the donuts are huge! Plan to share... that way you can try all of them! Cake donuts are in there back on the cooling rack. I think the donuts are good and the price is within reason, especially for the amount. I'd go back.

Totally worth the hype! We are from Texas and don't have a sprinkles in our city. I'm a sucker for anything with a buttercream. I ordered the sprinkles cupcake with buttercream and yum First of all the cake and icing proportions were perfect. The cake was moist and the buttercream was made from real butter and not nasty lard like some places use. I can't wait to visit again and order from the "cupcake atm"!

The decor for this bakery sure is nifty. Part of me hates is because it's borderline hoarder mentality with the overwhelming amount of random stuff and mismatched tables and chairs. But a part of me also adore it because it is so unique. Maybe I'm just a closest hoarder. Came on the day of my flight back to NY, figuring that as a bakery that is opened 24/7, and I'm part of the church belt, it'd be sort of slow. Nope. I was wrong, thankfully the service was quick and I go the front of the line within 10 minutes or so. I ordered a two macaroons, a mini berry tart, two bags of coffee, terragon & mint tea, and a roast beef sandwich. The tea itself was a bit on the disappointing side(should've just gotten iced black coffee). The tart, macaroons, and roast beef sandwich however, were very tasty. And still kind of left me wanting more. I dug it. You bet I'll be back if I'm ever back in Charlotte again.
Just moved back to Vegas and found out that 85c made it here!! I remember my trips to Cali and craving the Iced, Sea Salt Caramel Coffee.... So happy!!!

High prices, lame flavors, skip. I was expecting some more unique flavors from the reviews but was sooo disappointed in the small selection of plain Jane flavors that I ended up not even ordering. My husband had a peanut butter chocolate sundae which I tasted, it was very rich but nothing I couldn't have gotten in a tub of grocery store ice cream. My sister got a small brownie (looked old) with scoop of vanilla and hot fudge. Our order for those two small-standard regular joe desserts totaled $17!! Not worth it.
A little pricey, but the quality is there as well. Make sure to try the mint and some flavor a that are new to you.

After our dinner at Cabo, bf and I decided to get something sweet. This was our first time trying Amelie's and were not disappointed. We shared a peach tart and a Yelp favorite- salted caramel brownie. It is very sad ( in a good way) that we were wanting more of these very tasty and addictive treats. Lol. We had some restraint, but will definitely be making more trips to Amelie's.

Oh how I wanted to LOVE Hopscotch. The interior is darling and some of the artistry done with frosting is magnificent. For my birthday, I heavily hinted to my husband that I would really, really love to have one of their works of art as my cake, and he delivered. The cake he brought home was pretty, although not exactly what he has asked for (roses instead of peonies but really not a big deal), but the flavor was what we were excited about; vanilla blackberry. We eagerly cut into the cake (after letting it sit out for two hours as instructed) to find that on sight, it resembled very stale soda bread. It was incredibly dense and heavy - and really tough to cut (sawing was required). Still, we remained hopeful, but on first bite we struggled to chew the cake that was tough, dry, and not even a little sweet (and I prefer my desserts on the unsweetened side). There was no taste of vanilla or blackberry, and there was a definite smell and taste of frostbite or perhaps just something very artificial. Neither of us could finish our pieces, and the rest of the cake was tragically trashed. The worst part of this was not that my birthday cake was a total dud, but rather watching my husband's face fall as he realized what a disappointment this cake was. I am quite pregnant and not able to partake in some more typical celebratory indulgences, so he had hoped to get me an epic cake to make up for it. I hope others don't have this experience, but also hope that the bakers at Hopscotch can work to prevent any future disasters. All the pretty icing in the world won't help a cake that's too tough to chew.

The couple of experiences I've had here have all been positive. The lines are long of course but what do you expect? They're highly sought after. (The line is formed against the side and there's windows so you can see inside the bakery which is pretty cool while waiting). It's also alllll the way towards the end of the strip so it can be a walk if you stayed in the middle. If you really want to give the place a taste than the wait shouldn't be a problem considering everyone else is there trying to do the same, it's just about being courteous. Anywho I LOVED everything I tried so far (I will be back ahah) but my favorite treat are the cannolis omg they are so great, good crunch, yummy filling and I love the little chocolate chips and chocolate dip on my ends. Buddy was there on one of the days I went and I felt the passion in his work and I'm not just being a fan he's a hard worker, you can sense integrity.

The only thing I didn't like was waiting in line. I seriously have no clue why people do not give this 5 stars. I had the Cannoli and the cream inside was amazing! Not too sweet or heavy. I loved the look of the bakery, it also has a viewing window so you can watch them making things as you wait in line. I will go back next time I visit Vegas.

Best ice cream in town.......check. Amazing house made glazed donuts.....check. Wonderful owners....check. Lots of tasty toppings....check Put this all together and this hidden gem is going to be a favorite of mine and for ANY who gives it a try. After enjoying Father's Day with my great dad and entire family, I recommended we all try out Novel Ice Cream as my dad loves a cold treat. Who doesn't? With that said, we all (9) showed up at Novel and I must admit I was concerned. As us yelpers know, when you recommend a spot blindly you just hope your thoughts of the establishment are right on and thank the Lord, Novel Ice Cream was a huge hit. Upon entering, the owners (Brandon and Jennifer) were so darn friendly. Brandon gave us all the rundown and offered everyone as many tasting as needed in making our selections. It took me no time at all as I knew the Fat Elvis (PB, banana, and bacon) was the one for me. Okay, I can't lie, I had a scoop of the lavender and honey as well. Both amazing. After everyone received their ice cream, we headed outside to the patio (no seating inside) to enjoy our dessert. As I have already said, best dang ice cream not only have I ever had but my family too. Like my entire family!!!!! Mind you my father who is 70+ and considers himself a connoisseur of amazing ice cream kept telling me that it was the best ice cream he has ever eaten. He also continued to tell me what a great job I did at finding the place. Almost made me feel like a played a part in making the amazing stuff. Upon finishing my sweet treat and having to do my yelper job, I tried others treats as well. The glazed donut (nice and warm) with ice cream (Cookie Monster) slammed in the middle was awesome. The pistachio ice cream was the best I have had and I have tried a lot. Everything here was just great. Overall, this gem is a winner and you better hit the place up before everyone else knows about it. There is not a better joint in town for ice cream and better people serving it.

I like cake boss. There I f***ing said it. We went there to buy cakes. Line was crazy and it was hot in there. Got the mini cakes and they were pretty good. I guess i expected more but it was just another bakery.

What a waste of time and drive! Came here to buy donuts to take back to LA to our kids for Valentine's day. If your website says you close at 1pm you should make enough donuts to be open till that time....especially on Valentine's Day when you know ppl probably give them as gifts! Paid for parking too only to walk over and find that they wrote on the window that they were sold out and it's only 11:30am! It was dark inside so I'm sure they just didn't run out! Bad customer service and bad planning on owners part! I don't care if you have 4.5 stars on Yelp if your customer service sucks! Won't return! Don't care how good the donuts are!
Been here twice now and I would say their cannolis are a must try! The filling is really good and the shell is nice & crispy.

After hearing good things about this place, we wanted to check it out since we were finally in the area. It was pretty dead around 1:30pm on a Saturday, but there was plenty of parking as it's kind of a hole in the wall place. I noticed they had boba so I got a black milk tea, and we also got a cookie cup.. which consisted of an ice cream flavor of your choice, a macaron, and a marshmallow on top. We chose strawberry sorbet and a vanilla macaron, of course topped with the marshmallow which they "toast" for you with a mini blowtorch. The boba tea was pretty average. I've had much better and wouldn't recommend getting it here, but it was still drinkable and fine. The cookie cup was okay.. the marshmallow was really good but the rest was just average. Nothing special taste wise. I will say, I love the name of this place, and the novelty of the cookie cup is pretty cool (especially for those who like to instagram their food) but I just don't see myself coming back, unless someone else wants to.

Excellent, fresh ice cream with many eclectic toppings (and a drill to make room for them in the ice cream!) make Dripps a great place to go for dessert or a tasty treat. The iced Matcha green tea latte is absolutely delicious and a great way to get some antioxidants. Took one star off for the smaller space and time to wait for order. Otherwise, the food, drinks & service is top notch!

Your Green Tea ice cream is amazing. It's one of the best in the US. I can really taste the matcha flavor. Please do not discontinue this flavor. You have no idea how difficult it is to find a good green tea ice cream.
Really cool ice cream shop! The ice cream was amazing and so were the toppings! Everyone enjoyed it with me which made it even more special and perfect!!Had a really great birthday yesterday!

On our way to Niagara we stopped overnight in Cleveland. This ice cream shop was near the bed and breakfast we stayed in, so we decided to stop in. I'm glad we did because it is by far the best ice cream I have ever had. I chose a coconut based ice cream and my husband chose the seasonal peach ice cream. Even though mine was dairy free, it was just as creamy as his peach ice cream. I would love to know their secret to creaminess! It's hard to find a non-dairy ice cream that is rich and velvety on the tongue. I wish they shipped their ice cream across the nation, because I would definitely buy it! Next week we are hoping to stop back in on our way to Niagara.
