Even thought it was past 12 midnight, they were helping us take pictures with no complaints. I just want to thank them for making me and my wife's night at Sprinkles. Thank you ladies =]!! Highly recommended to go there when they are working the closing shifts! love them.

We just moved into the neighborhood and have mixed feelings about living close to this gem... Obviously, we're stoked because their drinks and food are so delicious... but we've been treating ourselves a little too much with the help of their convenient online app - we're gonna be broke and chubby in no time. I guess it's fine as long as we're happy, right? My favorite drink is the London fog, and really, you can't go wrong with any of their pastries. Our favorite, though, are their macarons! Our realtor bought us a box of them after we closed on our house and thus were pleasantly introduced to Hopscotch. Now we're hooked!

It's good pastry but at high prices even for Vegas. I thought this was going to be a cheap breakfast for us but turns out 2 pastry 2 macaroons and 2 coffees and we're @ $30 so we could've had a sit down breakfast anyway. Also they don't offer iced coffee though it's going to be nearing 100 degrees. The patio and Venetian scenery outside is nice but it's also overrun by birds. There must've been 50+ of them all over the patio.
Just amazing food. Had lemon pistachio donut, and it's great. Flavors are just right, not exaggerated. Hazelnut coffee wasn't super though.

oooooooooh man am I SO GLAD this place isn't near my house, I would gain 20 pounds in no time! My sister took me here for the first time a couple weeks ago and my mind was blown by all the unique flavors they served! The shop itself is very cute and modern. I like that they have a section in the back with a bunch of board games, very cool. As for the ice cream I got the dutch chocolate and the horchata. The horchata was so so good, I cant stop thinking about it! The following week I took the husband there. Again the ice cream was very good but the service was terrible. It was an older lady behind the counter and she really couldn't care less that we were standing there. She let me sample an ice cream and then I just stood there for a good 5 minutes while she did other things behind the counter. We did finally get served but my husband wasn't impressed with the serves one bit. This time I got my ice cream in a waffle cone, the cone was so light and airy, I loved it!
Love the deserts and the soup and sandwiches, this place is definitely serving some delicious food but the long waits to purchase and hard time finding a place to seat inside is a turn off for me.

I love their dessert. I came here every time I go to Cosmo. I have gotten their Milk Bar pie (crack pie) and their cereal milk soft serve. The first time I got their cereal milk soft serve we didn't know it comes with the actual cereal on it. Just got one with my boyfriend and friend, we all got cereal milk soft serve and this time they all came with cereal topping. DELICIOUS! Their crack pie was good too. I usually get a slice and share. For some people it can be little bit too rich, but if you handle sweet like me. I think it's actually good. Crack pie reminded me of ginger snap chewy cookie. There are so many other goodies that I want to try. Will definitely try other things next time. Stay tunes.

How could anyone not like this place? They have 25+ flavors of ice-cream and the prices are reasonable. They even have dairy-free options. I'm not an ice cream connoisseur, so perhaps the texture isn't perfect, but it's ice cream and it's good.

Batch is our neighborhood bake shop. They offer delicious breads and baked goods. Their sweet treats are some of the best in town. My favorite, the dark chocolate korova cookie has a sprinkle of sea salt on top. I recently ordered a trio of cupcakes to try and was delighted by the korova cupcake, which had all the delicious flavor profiles of the cookie! I suggest you stop by and get a sampling box of treats to find your favorite!
Best ice cream in Vegas! A variety of flavors and different presentations. The kids that work there are great!

Stopped by on a late Friday night with a friend as we were craving a yummy dessert. We were happy that they stay open pretty late on the weekends, but we were worried they weren't going to have any vegan options. When we got there it was pretty busy which is a good sign lol. There was a man and a woman working there at the moment I would say owners? They were both really friendly, super helpful, and happy! They had 2 vegan friendly sorbets, unfortunately the vegan sprinkle cookie is only available on weekends. However, the young lady offered us a coco whip topping to spruce up our sorbet and omg it was super delicious!!! She also suggested sprinkles which I could not resist lol. I am so glad she offered us the suggestion, since we were looking for a little bit of indulgence that night haha. We ended up going with the raspberry sorbet with a coco (coconut based) whip topping and a dash of sprinkles. It was a great way to sit down, indulge and have girl talk on a summer night. I will most definitely come back here next time on a weekend I'm curious about the sprinkle cookie I've heard so much rave about. This ice cream shop is a must stop and if you're vegan don't let that stop you, they will welcome you with open arms and ice cream scoopers ready to satisfy your tastebuds!

Really good ice cream and chocolate. I had the make your own quake shake that was really good. You pick 3 individual square of chocolate from their selection of chocolate; give it the cashier and they will mix it into a thick milk shake . Yum yum. Little pricey but worth it.
Best ramen I have ever had in my life. Deep flavor, always piping hot. I get the spick chicken ramen extra hot. I promise, you cant go wrong. #noramenolife
The hype is real!!! Go get yourself some damn Ice cream and experience pure joy of the senses!!!
Poor service, cardboard cookies, flavorless cakes. A huge disappointment, everything we bought ended up in the trash uneaten. Bouchon just down the corridor is much, much better.
great local ice cream shop. Try any of the snowstorms and you will love it. My favorite is cheesecake snowstorm or the Heat bar snowstorm. Yummy

Best ice cream spot in town by far. Minus 2 stars for their ridiculous policy of not giving change back for cash. I understand the whole national coin shortage, but this has absolutely nothing to do with bills. This is just pure laziness by management. My bill was $11.35. I gave the worker 13 bucks and told him to keep the change as a tip. So they got cash they just too lazy to insure they have enough for customers. Sad!

Recently my parents were visiting, and after going to Amelie's my mom said to me, "I think this needs to be our new tradition when we come to see you." That pretty much says it all. Atmosphere is fun and food is beyond delicious.

Oh wow - I do not even care what the dessert tastes like. We were at the Venetian in Vegas and expected a wait - they took our order in about 20 minutes.... I tried paying but the cashier said - you have to wait and be called?! And not with a nice tone- no name tag so no name... hmmm ... so we waited in another line ... and my kids and the family of kids in front of us were not being called... Others way after us had their orders... ' a five pack of cannolis' a complicated order- especially since it is predefined... get a new cashier with a new attitude...

I'm a HUGE fan of macarons, so I really needed to check this place out during my stay in Vegas. I saw pictures of the size of their macarons, and as they say, pictures don't lie. The macarons were definitely way bigger than usual. However, with that said, I thought the taste itself were just okay. I didn't think they were anything special, and a bit too sweet for me. I've had a cinnamon one, which I don't think any other place had this flavor before, so that was kind of cool. But still, not worth my $3.50 and deliberately coming here for a pastry!

Amazing coffee and pastries. Best chocolate croissant I've ever had in my life. Had to break keto to enjoy one! I did get an almond milk latte with an extra shot of espresso here that was out of this world, so good they beat out Starbucks. I'm glad we don't have one back home, or I would testing my willpower. Definitely a must if you're staying at the Venetian. They're only open mornings, which is a small disappointment.

I have to add that in my subsequent visits to Amelie's I have learned that their employees are very, very unhappy with their management, which is quite unfortunate to hear. For me, even an employee's happiness is important when it comes to where I spend my money. To Management: Have a staff meeting. Ask why your employees are unhappy. Fix it. Your customers will be happier if your employees respect and trust you, and your employees will do a better job.

This place was incredible! The pastries, atmosphere, the kind staff. Parking is good also, it's on the end of a strip mall. Everything I had was fresh. You can taste the quality, like the butter in the puff pastries that doesn't make you feel like a glutton. The place is spacious, great scene for laptops, dreamers, and lovers. I like how you can see what's going on in the kitchen, it adds to the intimacy. They have outside seating with huge umbrellas, they know the sun can get pretty brutal. It's a very thoughtful place, inside and out, cake and more.

Ordered through the outdoor window and ate outside. The donut sandwich was incredible and the staff was nice, helpful, and quick! Would recommend for a quick stop, the place has parking and a fun outdoor seating area, but no misters or cover so during summer you can't stay long.
Hot fudge Sunday 12 bucks. It's to be expected. It was good. My wife had a vanilla shake she thought Baskin Robbins was better. They are in a good location. Very busy.
They have good shakes and good Boba tea's and really friendly service. I like this place And so did my kids.

Love the rotating recipes. I've not tried anything other than the cupcakes. And they're very light and so is the frosting. Use the fork! And for on the go, pick yours up using their cupcake ATM on the side of the building! I'm here for the June specials-Marilyn Monroe red velvet and pineapple upside down cupcakes.

Best cherry ice cream I've ever had! The waffle cone or bowl is so sweet and not at all cardboard tasting like others I've had in the past. The inside of the shop is just as you'd picture a classic ice cream parlor from the movies, it's just so cute! The service was friendly and even though the place was a bit packed, my party of 6 got our orders pretty quickly. My mom also loved the place when I brought her for an after dinner dessert for Mother's Day. Definitely coming back soon!

Who doesn't love Jack Frost donuts!!!! They are over the top, delicious, dessert breakfasts!! My coworkers go crazy when I pick them up on a Friday morning. I tried to get Jack Frost ordered for a special occasion and I called about 4 times with no success. The first time I was told that it was too busy and the last three he phone never connected. They tell you to order ahead for large orders, but how?

I read the reviews before I purchased the cake but still purchased it because it was cute. Had it delivered through Uber Eats. It was worth it to not deal with the Strip and Venetian during a pandemic. Anyway, the cake wasn't dry at all, but it wasn't good. It very much so tasted like a store-bought cake. The buttercream frosting was gritty ... like in the way that your mouth feels a little gritty after your teeth are polished but you haven't fully rinsed, yet. Without delivery, the cake is only like $36. It's not terrible, but honestly, I'd prefer my own h go one made cake or a boxed cake compared to this. It just wasn't very flavorful. That said, the cake was gorgeous and the colors were vibrant, so.... I guess that was the trade-off?

Macarons to die for here! I had to return more than once for them:) The beignets were equally as good but they didn't have any wow to them for me. I think the prices are quite reasonable here for what they serve.
AMAZEBALLZZZZZ!!!! Great customer service, fun staff and they know their products! I can't wait to go back very soon! And let's not forget they got great music!

We frequent the original donut bar in San Diego so decided to stop by the one by Fremont street (downtown Las Vegas) while in town for the 4th of July. The place is pretty inconspicuous so easy to drive past, with paid parking all around, although we risked it and just parked and ran in to grab our doughnuts to go. First thing different we noticed was that there was hardly anyone there. We arrived about 35 minutes after they opened and walked right in. Normally at the one in SD you can expect a line of 20+ people waiting before they open. Maybe we caught them at just the right time since we noticed more people start to show up as we were leaving. The place is a bit smaller, and it seems like the selection may be smaller too. I also noticed that they don't give kids free doughnuts like they do at the one in SD. The staff were just as friendly and welcoming though, and we were not disappointed with the doughnuts we picked, just as delicious! If you're staying in downtown or have a car if you're on the strip, definitely worth the trip!

Adorable Matcha tea and ice cream shop. Great selections and feels like you stepped right into a modern Tokyo tea shop right here in the Arboretum. The team is super patient friendly and put a great amount of effort into making the perfect drinks. I can't wait to return. I ordered the number 8, tastes liked a toasted green tea latte but not overly sweet. The shop is tucked over in the corner near Versona and Penney's Spices
Great selection of pastries. I would recommend everyone to try it out at-least once. It is pretty pricy & depending what team member you have helping you, they can be pretty rude.
Excellent! I got the coconut and peanut butter - creamy and tasty. Service was outstanding.

Pretzel cone, OMG! Server was so friendly, she gave us several samples and chatted with us after (it was very quiet). Everything we tried was amazing, can't wait to go again. Get a single, which is plenty big in the pretzel cone, and they let you get two flavors!

Absolutely love this place it's literally one of the best in town. I've been eating here since I was a kid. I love the pro-nuts and gluten friendly options!! The only reason I'm giving a 4/5 is, I Took my kids in to experience the "Jack Frost" taste and my god are the prices outrageous compared to local donut shops.

The one, the only, the original...Honey Hut on State Road screams summer memories. I remember going here as a kid with my grandparents, who lived right down the street. The bee sign, ice cream sweetened with a dash of honey, and benches remind me of my childhood- you know that glorious phase in life before getting a real job, paying bills, and learning the world around you isn't as perfect as you thought it was as a kid. Ice cream is a slice of nostalgia and shared memories with loved ones, both here and gone that make me both smile and yearn for times past.
Omg this place is so amazing! I had the donut with ice cream...will be back for every cheat day

I really like sweet republic. I am obsessed with the s'more campfire sundae and all of the ice cream always has such unique flavors and what a fun atmosphere. I have never seen an ice cream parlor with a stack of board games for its patrons to play while they enjoy their treats! It's so fun. The problem is this is not where I got on a regular basis for ice cream. It's very pricey($7-$9 for a speciality sundae) and that's what I go there for. This is not somewhere I go just to get a scoop of ice cream, this is for special occasions. I think they are awesome and everything being made In house, down to the marshmallows, is so cool, one day I'll try the sundae featured on the food network, but until then the s'more will have to do!
Fresh cones and raspberry ice cream was excellent! I also like the macadamia nut cookie ice cream and the hot fudge sundae with nuts. Very good.

Okay I did not get lost between Venetian and Palazzo for twenty minutes to find such a random small stand under the escalator! Yes, the macarons are delicious, but dayum it is expensive! Back home, i can get it for $1.65 for the same size and im already flipping tables! After purchasing one for $3.50 ..I'm ready to go to the gym, build some muscles, and come back and flip the entire stand. But I have to admit, it was pretty good. The butter cream was nice and moist and the outer layer was a mixture of crunchy but yet soft. I got the pistachio macarons and boy oh boy ..melted inside my mouth and I was literally in heaven! Can't visit this place all the time.. Or else I'll become bankrupt.... And overweight

Strolled by Ice Cream Social last week to try out their ice cream flight. The venue is small but is very clean and cozy. The ambiance was very nice -- I liked their decor and neutral light colors which made the shop feel bright. My two favorite ice cream scoops were the "Holy Chip!" and a solid chocolate one. The Holy Chip was mint flavored ice cream with chocolate brownie type chunks in it. The flavor of the mint was spot on and very tasty. The chocolate ice cream had Pinot noir reduction in it which made for a very silky and unique aftertaste. Overall, would recommend this store to anyone around the Madison area looking to try new abs yummy ice cream flavors!

Ridiculously good ice cream. Quaint little shop in the heart of Ohio City. Unique flavor combinations, made on site, vegan options. Super friendly, down to earth staff - let's you try any flavor and they are dog friendly. Got the chance to chat with one of the owners on our visit - local guy totally invested in the city. I had caramelized pear which was absolutely amazing. You will get flavor combinations here that you won't get anywhere else. This may just be my new favorite ice cream shop. Can't wait to go back and see what new flavors they have come up with

Yaaayyy!!!!! It's finally here! I never thought it's going to happen. I've eaten so much ice cream in my life but Handel's is hard to beat! For anyone who has no background of this wonderful treat, this hails originally from Youngstown, OH! They make everything fresh daily one batch at a time in every location! Now that's something to boast about being in existence for almost 70 years! I was 1st introduced to this deliciousness by my husband about 7 years ago & that has left such an imprint in my head that whenever we get to go back to his hometown IT has to be the 1st pit stop before doing anything else . I think they're most popular for their Chocolate Pecan Ice Cream so it's just fitting that my 1st order for their opening day would be such & it did not disappoint! Thank you Mr. Patrick for taking a chance to make this a reality for all the Handel's patrons in Las Vegas! Good luck & I hope it'll be here for years to come! Now what are you waiting for? Get off your bottom, head out west & get your 1st lick & I'm sure it won't be the last!

My girlfriend surprised me with a cake from here from my birthday and it was so delicious! I've been here before and picked up some little things but I've been dying to try their cakes. I love that they have vegan options especially vegan cakes are so hard to come by. The blueberry lavender cake was delicious and even my non vegan friends loved it and said they wanted it for their birthdays! If you need a vegan birthday cake (or any cake really) this is the place to come!
Macaroons were bomb. I got vanilla. I'm pretty sure they used vanilla beans because it was so flavorful.

My husband and I came here after going out for dinner cuz we were craving something sweet. I have to start by saying that the staff were all kind and very polite. They asked us if there were any flavors we wanted to try and didn't seem to mind when we tried more than one. My husband got the taster's trio of pralines and cream, cookies dough, and caramel sea salt (about the same as two heaping scoops in size). I found all three of his flavors very delicious. The caramel sea salt was delicious but very sweet so after a few bites you needed something to switch to or it got to be too much. I got a taster's duo (about a scoop and a half in size) of black raspberry chocolate chunk and fresh mint chocolate chunk. Both flavors were very fresh and didn't leave that "too sweet" flavor in my mouth. The chocolate chunks were nothing to write home about but complemented the flavors nicely. I also brought a brownie to eat with my ice-cream which was ok but I think next time I would just eat the ice-cream. They actually have two locations to this restaurant and this one has their factory in it. You can actually watch through the glass as they make different batches of icecream. I think watching them make the different icecreams is what set this icecream shop apart from others. I would definitely come back again to try more flavors.

I hate to say it because I'm a big fan of the Cake Boss show but I was pretty disappointed. I had a cannoli and it just tasted burnt and way to heavy and sweet. Also, there was a very long line that moved super slow. Perhaps some other desserts are better but I would not waste time trying this place again.

Heard the rave about their shakes so had to give it a try. I've only tried the Crack Pie Milk, a slice of crack pie blended into cereal milk, soft serve. It wasn't anything spectacular. It was a bit too sweet for my liking, but to be fair I don't have a super love for overly sweet things. For the price and flavor I most likely wouldn't order again. Maybe next time I'd order something else to give this place a fair shot.

Amazing option for vegans! This place kills it with their crazy flavors and non-dairy alternatives to nearly every menu item. Great spot for those who appreciate local business and local food. Such friendly workers as well! If you are visiting Cleveland and looking for ice cream, Mason's would be the first place I would recommend.

This place is REALLY hard to find! It's under the escalators in the Venetian, near the casino, and could have more signage to make the location apparent. That said, the pilgrimage was worth it for the chocolate croissants! Perfectly flaky with dark rich chocolate in the center. These people know how to bake em! Coffee was meh, but not bad. The employees work hard to get the line moving quickly. The only problem with service is they kept calling me the wrong name, even after I corrected them, which led to a chain reaction of people grabbing the wrong drinks. People get my name wrong frequently, so it didn't bother me, but definitely made things more complicated. Overall, a quality place.

Two stars for failing to ask me if I wanted milk or dark chocolate on my hot fudge sundae and giving me milk when I always get dark. I asked for additional nuts and whip and didn't get it either. I'll stick to the location in lathrop or SF.

Mitchell's is one of the things about Cleveland which will make it hard to leave when the time comes. I am not an ice cream person, but when I am, I am a snob. If it isn't great, it isn't worth it. First, I love that they are very open and honest and meticulous about where they source their ingredients. Everything that can be purchased locally, is purchased locally. Second, I love that they have interesting and unique flavors. The Edmund Fitzgerald Porter ice cream is my favorite that I have ever had. It is not uncommon to find a pint of it in my freezer. I've also been stunned by the decadence of the caramelized chocolate. I don't love chocolate ice cream, but this is just amazing. Not too sweet. I've also tried most of their seasonal flavors--berry crumble, peach, apple cider concoctions, pumpkin spice, juniper/olive oil/orange--all amazing. They taste exactly the way that they should taste except better and creamier. Third, having cut dairy almost completely out of my everyday diet, their vegan ice cream is fantastic. Their vegan ice cream is better than most regular ice creams. It is wonderful, rich, creamy, good flavors, absolute excellence. The cookie dough ice cream has massive chunks of cookie dough in it. The peanut butter chocolate concoctions have loads of peanut butter and chocolate. It's a beautiful thing. The portions are generous (I usually get a junior size or a pint to go). If you're in the area, indulge. Mitchell's is fantastic.

I didn't think i would be a huge fan of the cereal milk soft serve but woaw did it surprise me brought me back to my childhood with that flavor and best part is you get a cornflake topping and they dont get soggy like when you would put them in ur milk soo they stayed crunchy all throughout which was awesome. Loved it!

MILK BAR is next door to Momofuku at the Cosmo hotel. Come here for unique treats such as their famous "crack pie!" It's a buttery shortbread crust with a dense chewy butter cake that is out of this world! If you get one thing there, get that! But of course they sell individual cookies from chocolate chip cornflake cookies, confetti cookies to their "compost cookie" which I bought as souvenirs!

I love Sweet Republic's gourmet flavors.. it's a little pricier than average but worth every penny! I usually get my ice cream to go but I sat down to eat it this time around and I couldn't help but notice how cohesive and energetic the workers were! The girl who scooped my ice cream never lost the smile on her face and was super knowledgeable about the product. The ice cream was good but the overall atmosphere made my experience that much more worth while! I'll definitely be sitting in more often.

The place is nice & clean. I tried their cold chai latte & it was really good!! The cost is a little pricey throughout the whole menu. Their pastries look so delicious but unfortunately I didn't try, sad I wasn't hungry

OMG! Soooo good! Hot and tired from walking the strip? Swing through the Cosmopolitan Hotel and stop by Milk Bar. You have to get a cereal milk soft serve. I got cereal milk with corn flakes. It was awesome! My wife had the compost cookie with hot fudge. It did not disappoint. The best part was just as we thought we were full we found additional toppings at the bottom of our cups...we just couldn't help but to eat it all. Refreshing, not just because we were hot and the ice cream was cool, but because the flavors were amazing. Next visit need to try the cookies and amazing looking cake slices.

My friends and I visited there today 2 of us had m&m cookies and 1 had the sprinkle cookie. They were all really tasty, they were just the right consistency they weren't hard but the weren't really soft.

I went to the donut bar based on the yelp reviews Sorry 18.00 gets you stale creme brulee donuts Stale coconut chocolate donut, stale maple bar. The two stars go to the bourbon caramel donut. The only fresh one in the bunch. Oh and the creme brulee is NOT creme brulee, its a cheap vanilla pudding and not even tasty vanilla pudding. Not returning to spend that kind of money on garbage I decided to drive out of the Las Vegas strip after reading the reviews. God was i wrong to trust. Either people were drunk when they came here or i arrived on an off day.

This place has so many options to choose from! I was amazed at the wide variety of treats. I had the magonada which was absolutely delicious. I would definitely get it next time. The location of the shop is kind of annoying. It gets extremely crowded in the parking lot and sometimes you have to walk a long way from your car. The service was just ok. The staff seemed a little out of it, even though they weren't that busy. They were confused about some of the questions I asked and almost seemed like they did not want to be there.
This place smells so bad for a bakery. You'd think as soon as you walk in you'll smell fresh pastry but no, it smells like gutter! Unacceptable

Mwahahahaha. I found this sweet dessert place on yelp and since I was staying at the Linq I HAD to try it out... Too bad when I went there, it was already 11ish pm, so the shelves were pretty much EMPTY. They didn't have a wide selection to choose from so I couldn't get what I originally wanted (next time, chocolate marshmallow!!) so I settled for the Peanut Butter Chip cupcake instead (and I'm not a huge fan or pb or frosting) but holy crap. I had no regerts. The frosting..was yummy. Not your generic store bought frosting. And it was such a delite to find chunks of choco chips in the cupcake. Ahhhh.... I wanna eat another one just writing this! The next time I go to LV, I have to come again (and at an earlier time)!

First and not the only time! Great prices and amazing taste. The parking is crazy but that just means it's good. Had a boba and loads of different types of breads. None of them let me down. Staff was nice and it looked clean.

Thank the Lord for Fatty Daddy's. My family's dinner plans did not turn out as great as I was hoping for and figured lets try one last spot to save the night. Fatty Daddy's was the hero. This hidden gem offers great homemade ice cream selections, macaroons (yep, that's what I said), along with burnt marshmallow yumminess. For my treat, I ordered the cookie sundae (there may have been a name for it I can not remember). With it came two scoops, a macaroon, and marshmallow. For my ice cream scoops I rolled with Nutella and fruity pebbles. The Nutella tasted like a Wendy's chocolate frosty and the fruity pebbles tasted, well, like fruity pebbles. Both were so good. I went with the fruity pebbles macaroon that was so chewy and flavorful. As for the marshmallow, not sure if it is homemade but it sure tastes like it. The whole treat was a winner for sure. The establishment was very comfortable with inside and outside seating and the young lady who prepared our treats was very friendly. She offered free samples for all who asked. Overall, a great dessert stop and glad we made the visit.

I've waited so long for Milk Bar to open in Las Vegas in order for me to try the desserts! I've made cookies, pies, and cakes from the cookbook without ever tasting the originals, so I have been so excited to see how comparable they were and what I could possibly change in order to make the baked goods just like the ones they make at Milk Bar. I ordered a slice of the highly addictive crack pie and three types of cookies: cornflake marshmallow, compost, and corn. All were underwhelming. The crack pie tasted more fattening than sweet, much like eating a sweet stick of butter compared to the caramel toffee tones to balance the salty oatmeal crust I had expected from it. The corn cookie also lacked the "corn" flavor. Out of all the desserts, I enjoyed the compost cookie the best. The coffee and chocolate hints are great, otherwise the cookie just tasted like a power/protein bar. Given the disappointment and the quality for the price, I won't be going back. I'll just stick to the cookbook versions.
Always so good! The rainbow sprinkles is my favorite. Saturday night after they close, use the cupcake ATM for a late night treat!

Milk Bar is definitely one of the most unique ice cream/dessert shops I've been to. Their class cereal milk ice cream with cornflakes threw me off. I was expecting a sweet, creamy flavor but was struck with slight sweetness overpowered by salt from the cornflakes. The ice cream takes a more salty approach than sweet. I also tried their compose cookie - one of a kind taste made with unconventional ingredients. Definitely worth a try. 3 stars because my taste buds say no but obviously Milk Bar has a huge fan base from all the 5 star reviews.
Service was excellent! Donuts, aesthetically pretty made for a great photo opp, however NOT AT ALL WORTH $46 for 12!!! The taste not worth all the hype.

Love love this place. First time there but I'm already hooked. They have different options every day so you can never get tired of it! Hidden gem! Great art to make the environment super chill and artsy! Lots of flavor for you to choose as well as different flavor macaroons

I would leave 5 stars if I could, but since my friend pre-ordered two dozen and picked up for me I cannot comment on the physical location or the staff. I can say that my friend had no issues placing his the order or picking it up in the morning. Forgive me for not knowing exact amounts but there were a lot of the matcha green tea cake donuts, several blueberry lemon cake donuts, and some raspberry pistachio yeast donuts. I was most excited for the matcha donuts because I'm obsessed with matcha. This donut was an absolute success, it made the perfect cake donut. It was sweet but not overly so and the matcha flavor was prominent without being overbearing. I loved the texture of it as a cake donut, definitely could have eaten twenty more of these. I then tried the raspberry pistachio yeast donut which was as big as my face. Seriously, the thing was HUGE! I'm generally not a fan of yeast donuts because they lack flavor, this yeast donut however had the perfect fluffy texture and was buttery. the raspberry pistachio icing was incredible as well, slightly tart but mostly sweet with subtle hints of pistachio. It melted in my mouth with each bite, I was sad but very full when it was all over. I really want to go back to try their creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut, as well as any others they're offering. I'm reading reviews about their donuts being dry but I didn't have that experience at all. I think Donut Bar's donuts are way better than the donuts O-Face used to sell. I'm hoping when I can check out the physical location I can update my review to 5 stars.

Breakfast was off the chain.... i had the the eggs Benedict and mt wife had the Lobster hash with spinach and eggs... Kelly brought out the creme brulee.... a must have.......This place is on our Vegas list.....

Terrible service with coffee that taste like crap. No flavor syrup and suggested I should go to Starbucks downstairs. Seriously?! Took 15 min for a latte to be made when I was the only customer at the time and they have 3 people working.

I love Batch! Almost everything is wonderful (and it's fun to try to figure out your favorites). The croissant and other sweet pastries are great. I'm especially enamoured with the vanilla swirl roll, which is flaky like a croissant, but sweet (but not too sweet) like a morning bun. I recommend avoiding the fougasse, as it's too salty (even for a pretzel type bread!) and stick with the other yeast breads and pastries. The scali bread (a semolina? loaf with sesame seeds) is great. It seems like their prices have risen lately, though I'm sure this is due to the increasing price of food. So bring more cash then you think you'll need (since they are cash only).
Great service! Unique flavors but wasn't too crazy about it. Ordered the baby bday shake about $8. They are okay.

In Phoenix visiting and the kids wanted ice cream. Did some yelp searching and found this place . I had the chocolate ice cream with donut. Absolutely delicious. The location is super cute as well. Worth checking out. You won't be disappointed.
The cake didn't have much flavor. Looked pretty though. It was pricey, but most things are in Vegas.
Their pastries and coffees are an absolute delight. Price point is a little high but great location for a casual meeting or quick bite . Love the abstract arts also. Would come back again.

I have driven by this ice cream shop tons of times all year. I finally decided to go check it out on a chill sunday evening. I parked and saw a long lone so I figured that was a good sign it must be good. There is a ton of unique dun flavors of ice cream but I decided on just getting a single scoop cake cone ($4) & my guest got a hot fudge sundae w whipped cream n a cherry on top (bday cake & coolie dough ice cream). The single scoop was pretty big-I am not really a desert person and it was a lot for me. I want to try the "4 scoop sampler" next time (@&4.55). Friendly staff, and they all wore masks for covid safety measures. I will be back next time I have a sweet craving! Great flavored ice cream and big portions for the prices.

Was in Vegas for the weekend and stopped here for breakfast on Saturday. They have a sourdough waffle on the menu that caught my attention instantly. I was not disappointed in the slightest. My mother got the brioche French toast that came with orange marmalade. She liked it but wished the French toast was cooked a little more because it was still a little "custardy." But then again, she's a picky eater. We also got bacon, the lyonnaise potatoes, and the chocolate croissant. Everything was great, including the service. I highly recommend making this apart of your stops in Vegas.
I'm not a big fan of ice cream but we both had a cone here last weekend and the ice cream was as good as anything I have had. The science fiction wall mural is awesome.

Fabulous! Loved the mini lemon and key lime pies. Cute dining area. Very crowded on a Sunday afternoon. About 1/4 of the customers not masked. They ran out of bacon and most of the sandwiches have bacon as an ingredient, so not many options for lunch the day I went. But I got a turkey sandwich with brie on the flakiest, most delicious croissant I have ever eaten. If I lived in Charlotte, I would go there every week!

I recently tried novel for the first time at a different location and was blown away by their ice cream donut. This location is great and as expected did not disappoint. I tried the fat Elvis and the coconut cold brew both of which were delicious. When it comes to novel ice cream they just do it right.

Finally a late night ice cream place that caters to vegans as well!!! menu is small right now and will expand with other desserts' This place just opened - and stays open til midnight!!!!! Please support this amazing place!

I have been stalking this place on Instagram waiting for them to open the brick and mortar store. It finally happened and it took me forever to get here but it was worth the wait! The decor is light and airy. Plants decorate the space and natural light give it a welcoming ambiance. The young lady who helped us (I'm assuming that it was one of the sisters) was so friendly so was the man who greeted us. I chose the strawberry shortcake donut and the lemon lavender donut. My sisters both chose chocolate glazed and cookies and cream. They loved them!! My 3 year old niece ate her donut and most of her aunts donut then asked for another! The donuts are very moist but not greasy. Truly flavorful not just sweet! Having lactose intolerance and other food I may have to make the drive from Shaker whenever I get a taste for a donut! Back for another vegan donut hit! Today I tried the apple cider cake donut and it was delicious! I also learned that they substitute water in place of milk and applesauce in place of egg! You wouldn't know it because the texture and flavor of their donuts is amazing! Keep up the great work!

I'm ashamed to say I've never heard of this bakery until a friend dropped off some cheesecake for us recently. It was so good, that I had to make a trip to Villani's to see what else they had, and buy some desserts to gift to someone else. Arrived on a Saturday afternoon and there were only a couple of customers ahead of me, but that was fine, because there were so many pastries and desserts in the cases, and cheesecakes in the refrigerator that I needed time to figure out what I wanted. I ended up getting an assortment of Macarons, cheesecake, cookies and other sweets. I thought the prices were pretty reasonable, the employees were very friendly, the dessert was GOOD - and I will most definitely return.

Ok..... by now if you follow me I always try and find places that have gluten free/ nut free places ... and if especially it's Asian!!! So now it's desserts and Ube!!! I'm so excited when I found this place and me and my cutie went and indulged in delicious items!!! I hope to try all the yummy flavors they have to offer!!!! I'm still glad I can eat diary! But yay for the rest. Woot!

Ok....Ok....I know this review will not be favored amongst other yelpers. I'm not a huge fan of Amelie's. One night, my boyfriend and I decided to hop in here on a dreary Saturday night after being in the Plaza Midwood area. I was in search of a latte and he had a sweet tooth. While the line was about 8 people deep, it moved rather quick. I've since learned that this number of patrons was an anomaly as the line is usually wrapped around the room. Anyways, we tried the Salted Caramel Brownie that EVERYONE loves, a few Tortes and a strawberry croissant. First off, they did not want to make a latte....not at all. I don't blame them, it was not that good. I don't think I was able to finish all of it. We were not impressed with the brownie either, it was just a thick chunk of caramel plopped on top of a dry brownie. Maybe we got a bad batch or something but it was not the "raved" about dessert that I was hoping for. I had the same problem with their layered tortes....dry and not flavorful. The croissant was....not the warm, buttery pastry that you would envision. I would love to love Amelie's but I just don't. I DO like the fact that it's open 24hrs. and I find it a good place to sit and people watch. I plan on returning for a third time to try it once more, have a plain coffee and sit to work on some writing.

As a donut lover, I researched the best donut places in Las Vegas before flying in for my first trip. According to reviews and social media this seemed to be the place to go. My friends and I woke up early on a Sunday morning and took an Uber to the bakery. When we got there it wasn't crowded at all and we spent time looking over the menu trying to decide what we wanted. Thanks to the pictures I saw on Instagram, the French Toast donut and Strawberry Split donut seemed to be must haves. Along with those I got a vanilla bean glazed, a Nutella filled and a cheesecake filled donut. Go hard or go home right? The strawberry split was my favorite hands down and I'd go back for that alone. The French toast was made to order and served hot with syrup, jam and butter. Easily a second favorite. The other 3 were okay and kinda let me down. The nutella and cheesecake filled were both good but did NOT have enough filling...I felt like I bit through 3/4 of the doughnut before I tasted filling. The vanilla bean glaze was also okay. However, there are so many delicious looking donuts available that I'd definitely go back to try something new along with my favorites. Props to Donut Bar for having a back patio where you can sit and enjoy all your donuts. The morning we went there was plenty of seating available. If you love donuts like me, definitely make this a stop on your next trip to Vegas.

I would have rated this place higher, but the woman at the door left a bad taste in my mouth. It is a huge bummer because I was really looking forward to trying this place. First off, the cupcakes and ice cream are really good. My son got the ice cream sandwich which was huge! Thry have only certain flavors of ice cream on certain days as well. The downfall is the set up of this place. There are two sides to this place, one side for ice cream, the other side is for cupcakes so make sure you are in the right line. Next, there is only one party allowed inside while you place your order. They have someone standing at the door to make sure you follow the rules. When we got to the front of the line, we went inside because the door Nazi had stepped away. She confronted me with "I didnt see you in line" so pretty much accusing me of jumping the line. I took offence to this so we went back and forth as I asked her how I got the little card in my hand that she gave me to decide on my flavor. Good luck in the summer when it is 110 degrees and people are forced to wait outside in the blazing sun. There is no seating inside, but some dirty tables outside that people would just leave their containers on. These did not get cleaned up quickly enough, IMO. I don't know if an employee cleaned them or people looking to sit down cleaned the tables so I can't comment on that. If it wasn't for the rude employee at the door, I would have given this place a solid four stars. These types of establishments need to train their employees that its not the message, but how you deliver the message that matters.
Wow, wow, wow! The best pastries I've ever eaten! They were kind enough to pack up a few in a box for the trip back to California (they were still great)! Light, flakey, crispy, yum!

Not sure what the big deal was on these! Even though we stopped by at noon, the donuts should of tasted fresh if bake today. The 4 different ones we got all tasted dry, like day or 2 days old. Paid $11 for 4 donuts! Felt was too much!

I was surprised to this is a walk up place with no seating. We went on a weekend evening and the line was 10 minutes long easy. They had two windows open taking orders and moved through the line efficiently, there was just a lot of people. The ice cream was amazing! Highly recommend and the line is worth it.

Awwww yeeeeeeah. Just went to this place for the first time and it was awesome. I had driven past it many times and my curiosity was piqued by the many signs all over the building with delicious-looking ice cream on them. So naturally I was super pumped to go to celebrate a friend's birthday. We pulled up and found parking right by the building, and then only had to wait in line a few minutes before placing our order. They have about 15 different flavors of soft serve, a whole bunch of different dips, different cones to choose from (pretzel, waffle, cake). They also have a whole bunch of delicious looking sundaes and Arctic blasts, and tons of other options. I went with a cone of the birthday cake soft serve dipped in chocolate. It was fantastic - the soft serve has a great smooth texture and the dip was on point. They also put a plastic sleeve on the cone to catch drips, which totally saved my clothes. My husband got the Yinzer Sundae, which had a blondie, vanilla ice cream, milk chocolate, white chocolate, caramel sauce and whipped cream. YUM. The employees were polite and very efficient keeping the line moving. The place has a fun laid back, retro atmosphere. Can't wait to come back!

You can never go wrong with a sprinkles cupcake. I used the outdoor ATM machine on the side of the building. You select your cupcake order from a touchscreen and then pay by credit card. Within seconds the door opens and your cupcake is in a box. There is a 50 cent extra charge for buying from ATM. It is convenient. They have outdoor tables to sit at. I had the vanilla with chocolate frosting. They load on the frosting. The cupcake was moist.

It's hard to resist this candy shop with homemade ice cream, baked goods (think cookies and brownies), stuffed animals, gag gifts and toys. It's right outside St. Marks Square so right after eating your Italian food you can come here. I was eyeing their coconut ice cream, but ended up ordering a small cup of banana chocolate chunk, a peanut butter cookie and bottled water on my first visit. Both the ice cream and cookie were delicious! Turns out their ice cream is so good, I had to come back a 2nd time before leaving town and try more flavors. I ended up settling on a cup of dark chocolate brownie this time which was really good to say the least. I was happy to see that prices are affordable compared to some other places in the canal shops.

Simply the best ice cream I have ever tasted. The fruit flavors are unbelievable. I may find a place to own next door just so I can walk over any time - perhaps I should say all the time - on 2nd thought maybe I should move to the other side of the world. This addiction could get worse than crack!

OMG - this place is amazing. I am not sure if I have words, but I will try. I can't believe places like this exist. A place with fresh made everything from scratch?? YUM. I am a traditional girl, so I opted for a hot fudge sundae with pecans and madagascar vanilla. UH-Mazing. I also tried the mint chocolate chip (my 2nd fave), complete heaven. Made with real, fresh mint, you can totally taste the difference. I also tried the Desert Honey Sorbet since I love our local honey. Again, UH-mazing. I am seriously impressed since I am grossed out by Dairy Queen and not happy with the Sugar Bowl. I drove farther and spent more and totally worth it.

Very very good. Had the strawberry cream puff looking donut. The strawberry pop tart. They will push the grilled cheese donut on you but I just ignore upsells and get to what I want. Good coffee, service and donuts.

The customer service sucks. They overcharged my food when I only bought 4 items and not 6. When I went to get a refund, they charged me again instead of refunding the money they owe me back. I once again, have to go back in the store to ask for a refund and finally this time I ask them to refund it with dollar bills instead of doing it through a card which they did. If you do indeed go here and buy their food, make sure to check your receipt so you don't get overcharged.

stopped at churn while a family member was visiting and they were craving some ice cream...we couldn't have been more pleased with the taste of the ice cream, great local flavor! Plenty of options and they offer samples of each. A must-try in my opinion!!

Decent ice cream spot in Cleveland. Apparently this place is popular that a long line is outside the door! I was just another out-of-towner seeing what else seems cool on the trendy/hipsterish West 25th street. I went in there before it got busy, when there was no line. Mitchell's has dozens of flavors. I really wish they would've displayed all of their flavors ON THE WALL instead of some dinky laminated menu which would have caused me to get to the back of the line. All the other ice cream places do that, I'm just saying. Hint hint! I did settle for the Banana Cream Pie, which was delish. Would have loved to try their over flavors, which can be found at a lot of other ice cream spots anywhere. I asked the cashier (who wasn't that friendly) what Mitchell's signature flavor was but she didn't know. Still, it's a nice place in a historic building.

I had their pink sprinkles and creme brulee. There was nothing special about them. The filling for the creme brulee was one sided and minimal. The pink sprinkles one was not even moist on the inside. It was very dry. And even with a mustache, the lady called me ma'am lol.
Walk up ice cream window. Best ice cream I've had since moving to Las Vegas. They have SOOOOO many flavors. There is usually a line but it is worth it. Make sure you try chocolate cake batter!
The wife and I are long time patrons, however it seems like the size of the scoops are smaller than they were last year? At least when we're talking about the ice cream cone portions.

Stopped by the Cosmo location after the Vegas half marathon to refuel and our ensuing feast was worth every mile!! Love the compost cookies and birthday cake shake plus the cereal milk soft serve! Friendly service, great location, totally lives up to the insta hype!
Delicious pastries and lunch. Love the atmosphere, too!

3.5 Love all the flavor choices and cool decorations. My favorite had to be the lemon pistachio, was a little disappointed with the creme brÃ»lÃ©e and that was the one I was so looking forward to try. Staff was very nice and helpful. Clean bakery with the racks of fresh donuts. Used Yelp deal for a free large coffee with purchase of a dozen.
Loved the Thai Rolled Ice Cream! I highly recommend the Bumble Bee. Fun and casual place to meet for a treat.

OH MY GLOB! I went here for my first time on a Saturday night and there was a long line to get in and order! Hm, must mean this place is good. At least I hope so! I ordered a s'mores sundae (chocolate ice cream, hot fudge, butter graham's, and toasted marshmallow fluff) but I switched out the chocolate ice cream for Madagascar vanilla. It was AMAZING! And huge! They give you so much! I'm glad I traded out for vanilla ice cream because the chocolate would make it even more sweet and rich. My dad ordered a strawberry shortcake sundae but I didn't try it. I love Churn and would definitely love to return!

I can honestly say that I can taste the quality of the ingredients in all their baked goods and all the care that goes into what they do. They have a seating area and great coffee and even a large selection of breads. I did however try an olive anchovy bread that was way too salty for my taste even though I love salty. This has been my only disappointment at Batch but it would take a lot more than salty bread to make me stop going here. I highly recommend a visit to Batch, there are so many choices and you can't go wrong!

Yummy yummy. Super nice staff. Ordered the birthday cake donut. After trying my family members choices, mine was by far the best. Fluffy donut with an Oreo inside. Had the cold brew which woke me up right away. Happy we found this place on yelp. #memories :)

I have been wanting to try Milk Bar for so long because I heard great things about it. Finally got the chance to try it and I am sadly not in love with it as I want to be. First the service was not the best and the person ringing us up seemed annoyed. I got the birthday cake soft serve and I thought it was okay. Flavor of birthday cake was there but it was overly sweet for me. Also without toppings it was already $6.50. I get that we are on the strip so prices tend be higher. My husband got the chocolate cake milkshake that had cake chunks in it. He enjoyed it. I plan to give this place another chance for a better experience and try something different. It's definitely worth a try if you're in the area.

Seriously good ice cream. If you're looking for new and interesting flavors, definitely check this place out! Compared to Mitchell's and Tremont Scoops, Mason's is more expensive and doles out smaller portions. However, this place doesn't serve the typical flavors everyone expects. It has milk chocolate, but also dark chocolate, black sesame, taro, Thai tea, pistachio, almond baklava, popcorn, rose water sorbet, cardamom and so much more! They're always changing up and trying new flavors here and I'm excited to come back and see what else they've discovered. Because apparently, all of their flavors are good. I haven't had a single one yet in which I felt disgusted by. So it's $4.50 for a small which is two scoops and they have a large size and a cone for $1 extra (which is nice and buttery). They also make root beer floats and ice cream sandwiches with different "cookie" options. It's small but still formidable. And the outdoor seating is cute too! The whole atmosphere reminds me of going to an ice cream place on the beach. It's on a street corner in a not too crowded location, no crowd at all since it's a stand alone store. I would definitely recommend coming here if you want quality ice cream and new flavors. It's nice not to get cookie dough for once, you know?
Insider Tip: go for the small batch or seasonal! Awesome Small Batch Peaberry Coffee Ice Cream! As other reviewer's echo that's a bit pricey but definitely a nice treat. Super creamy!
Love this place. Very eclectic. Always good food. The drinks are small, but that's only a problem because they are delicious.everything I have ever had there is great!

What a cool way to bring back some of my favorite cartoons from the 90s plus milkshakes, A taste worth remembering.. Can't go wrong at all. Some extra deets... parking was pretty packed on the weekend but close. The cost wasn't bad at all and worth it. Paid around $20 for 3. Even though it's the 90s it was more of the cartoons and design but the place could use some upgrades. Didn't want to sit inside. Besides that I Highly recommend.

While living in So Cal, I used to love to eat Sprinkles cupcakes. I was so excited to see a Sprinkles at the Linq in Vegas that of course I had to get one. I try red velvet cupcakes anywhere I go and Sprinkles red velvet did not disappoint. The cream cheese frosting was delicious and not overpowering. The cake had a great flavor and was very moist. Next time I will try the ice cream that everyone is raving about. :) Cupcake was $4.06 with tax and the mini cupcakes were $2 each plus tax. Not sure how much the ice cream cost because that was in a seperate part of the store which was super busy with the line outside the door.
First of all, the donuts are out of this world!!! Secondly, the staff are so happy to be there. Walking in their store is like a breath of fresh air. Lovely experience overall.

We stopped here for dessert after dinner. There was a long line outside. Very popular stop! They are only allowing 2 parties inside to order at a time and masks are required. They have many ice cream flavors and baked goods. Smells delicious. They have some seating outside. We tried the coconut sorbet, dulce de leche and Vietnamese coffee. We also had the coconut macaroon cookie. All delicious! Would go back if we are in the area to try other flavors.
I have ordered a Brownie Swirl and tasted great. This ice-cream doesn't disappoint you.

I was introduced to this great place by a local. I travel from San Francisco & Amelie's is ALWAYS my first stop. Being open 24 hours helps me achieve my goal no matter what time I fly in. Whenever they have their crab/tomato bisque on the menu, EAT IT. I haven't had one bad meal here. Croissant sandwiches, salads & other morsels are a delight. Now I have to mention all the tender, luscious sweets they have on hand. What do you want? Cake, macarons, or perhaps a freshly made tart. YOU WILL DIE OF A SWEET ATTACK! Whoever is back there in that pastry kitchen is trying to murder us with sugar, I'm sure of it! The creative flavors of the macarons will tantalize the palate. Their chocolate cake is nice and moist & you will not leave a piece on that plate.
Over 300 reviews and still 5 out of 5 had me curious and this place did not disappoint! Super good! Love it!

What food network fan hasn't fantasized about a Sprinkles cupcake? We were waiting by and I made a beeline in. I wasn't sure that the husband was following me, but oh well. I think they had an ice cream bar, but that wasn't what I was checking out. The cupcakes stared back and me and I couldn't decide what to do. I decided cupcakes for me and for me to take home to the kids. I got the peanut butter chocolate, black and white, and the red velvet. We all agreed tasty. Best cupcake in the world? Probably not. But a good, solid, yummy cupcake. Good stuff.

I love this place! Every time I go in the workers are extremely welcoming and have great personalities. Shoutout to Anaya! I love that they always have different donuts to try out and they're all big! I can never finish one by myself. The coffees are good too, I usually get the iced chai latte with vanilla when I go. I tried the grilled cheese donut this most recent time I went and it comes with a side of siracha mayo and hot sauce, it was really good! I had a chance to meet Chef Jeff while I was there this weekend and he was really cool. I can't wait to go back.

Ok, I will start by saying that I'm going to be a little biased. This is, without a doubt, my favorite ice cream place in AZ and maybe the whole country! So why 4 stars and not 5? Because my favorite thing in the world is coconut, and this place has the best coconut ice cream on the planet. They switched to coconut sorbet. We drive all the way from Gilbert a few times a year, and they haven't had the coconut for at least a year. Please bring it back! I beg you!!!!! 5 star review once the coconut returns! 5th star hostage until then!

On my trip to Cleveland, I had the opportunity to stay at the Hilton Downtown on Lakeside. After dinner, I stopped in their snack mart for a treat. How the stars aligned this night. I picked up a glorious cup of Mitchell's Homemade creamy heaven from said mart, and it was love at first bite. I consider myself an I.C. expert, and this is one of the best I've ever had. The chocolate peanut butter blew my mind - the ice cream is velvety, the chunks were plentiful... and you can absolutely taste the quality behind the ingredients. I visit Cleveland pretty frequently for work, and I will be SURE to bring my coworkers to the physical shop next time I'm in town. What a sweet, sweet find. --- UPDATE: I went to the factory in Tremont (I believe) when I was there last and was BLOWN AWAY. The amount of flavors they have is insane. You literally cannot go wrong with anything you order.

The highlight of the morning was the Tartine with Brie, Fig and Bacon. Go for the full if you're hungry because the half is a bit small on the stomach. We also ate a Brownie Macaron and it was really good! There's outdoor seating which was really cool and comfortable

If you're trying to decide what to get here, opt for the CRACK PIE!!! yes, I'm addicted, I want more!!!! You can't have just one bite. The cookies are amazing as well but my favorite is the Cornflake Chocolate Chip Marshmallow. Can't wait to go back and get more!

The pastries were fabulous! Especially the lobster tails. However, trying to buy gift cards for a wedding present was a nightmare. It took three trips to get them. I finally did. I emailed Carlo's Bakery letting them know. Took forever to get a response. When I did, they said someone from the location contact me. No one did. I emailed again. Someone emailed offering to sent me the gift card sleeves, even after I advised that I had given the gift. The last email advised that they were sending me the sleeves and two coupons for a free cannoli! To be used at any location! Yeah! Wait...I live in CA & there is no location here. Got the coupons today's. Not only are they for a location we don't have, they expire in three months. So much for the attention to detail they rave about on the show
The best macaroons ever made! The pistachio macaroons are so wonderful. Actually all of the pastries that I've eaten there, has been terrific!

Great ice cream and chocolate retail shop. Love coming here when I get the craving for a hot fudge sundae. Everything is a little pricey $10-12 for a sundae or up to $.80 for a single piece of chocolate but with quality ingredients and great taste it's totally worth it. And not to mention it's in the Linq on the Strip. Beware it can get pretty busy on nights and weekends so I suggest you have a little patience when going.

I came into sprinkles today at the Las Vegas location and got some ice cream. The man Markell who helped me was so kind and helpful because it was my first time trying the ice cream. He offered me many samples to help me make a decision and pointed out to me what the best selling item was. I ended up getting a sprinkles sundae with the cookie cupcake and cookie dough ice cream and it was delicious. Thank you so much for the great suggestions sir.

Drive to Lawrenceville for a piece of cake? Yes Please! Visited this lovely boutique bakery tonight for dessert and we where over the moon. My husband had the rosemary cinnamon almond cake and I had the lavender infused cake. Several of the cakes were vegan and looked wonderful. Your piece of heaven is served on a China plate. The seating is either in its unique cafÃ© or outside on it's a wonderful patio. The prices are definitely worth it and did I say the cake was good? It is really really good. We are really looking forward to our next trip where we can try more delightful baked goods.

Was totally stoked to try this place as I haven't had the chance to go to the NJ original location. I got 2 different pastries - the regular cannoli and the regular "lobster tail". Very creamy and delicious.

I love a mile away from this lovely little cafe. The best times to go are during the day to get work done. Later in the evenings the creepers seem to come out but all the same it makes for good entertainment.

Jeni's is always delish! It's a little more upscale than your traditional ice cream spot, making it a great way to end date night or dinner with friends. The atmosphere is great and I like the decor. I love the unique flavors and I always try something new when I go. It's not the spot for someone who is picky or likes their ice cream plain, but it's great if you don't mind being a little bit adventurous.

Seriously best ice cream, "dough melt," and experience. The Dream Team KILLED it on their costumer service and I can tell you that you won't be disappointed if you go here. If there is a line, I promise it is worth the wait. I had the "dough melt" with the Honey Lavender ice cream in it, and it was THE BEST EVER! Go and try it now... like right now.

WOW!!! We found this place by driving through NoDa and just stumbled in to check out the pastries. As soon as I walked in , the line wrapped around to the back of the room! I wish we have one in Richmond, Va! It's a bit pricey, but doesn't hurt to indulge.
Love it, sometimes the lines are long but the wait is worth it plus the outside scenery is definitely a vibe.

Super nice lady at the counter. Lots of great and different flavors but pretty forgettable taste. I had the hazelnut with marshmallow topping and an almond macaroon. It was just ok....nothing special. The boy got coconut ice cream and a coconut macaroon and loved it. We also took a red velvet macaroon home and enjoyed it later. It was all pretty decent.

The best Ice cream spot in Arizona, their donut ice cream will make you regret ever considering going on a diet. It is soooooooo gooooooood. I find myself visiting this place whenever my travels lands me here.

During the Feast my family and I stood in a long line to get Gelato only afterwards to see the the tubs were Blue Bunny ice cream. I spent $30 for 6 small single scoops of ice cream. As I attempted to take photos I was threatened. Although a few years have passed I'm still furious.

Refreshing matcha drinks! If you want a tasty treat for tea lovers try the incredible Matcha Cafe Maiko! I learned about the flavors to try and the staff was wonderful about teaching me. I had the float drink Kokuto Matcha Kuromitsu Kunako, it was delicious. The flavors of tea and honey are yummy. I liked the black honey taste was like a sweet molasses texture. There's lots of combinations and you can have hot or cold. I want to try more flavors. The awesome drink was delicious!! They're located near Michael's in the Arboretum shopping center.

Delicious small batch ice cream. Adorable and hip location. Super friendly owner and staff. Husband got the tres leches and I got the Cookie Monster in a warm doughnut. I was warned it would turn my mouth blue, and all I can say is it was worth every bite!!!! The warmth of the soft donut and the cool of the ice cream make for a dreamy melt in your mouth combo. Prices are reasonable considering its artisan ice cream which is usually priced at $5/scoop and upward. Loved it! Will definitely come for the dough melt!!!

In the past I've always been hesitant to ask for even one sample when I go out for ice cream (I'm not referring to Novel). Sometimes you can just tell that you're annoying the staff for asking for one or multiple samples, but when you walk into Novel Ice Cream that's the first thing you're asked, it's "what would you like to sample today?". Although I have my go-to flavor, from talking to the owners and staff I know that a lot of thought goes into the creation of all their crazy delicious and one of a kind flavors and I like having the opportunity to try bits of it. This business not only has great ice cream, they have great service, passion, and the genuine desire to make the experience unique and enjoyable for all.
Literally one of the best places on earth! The staff is incredible and so friendly. The selection is something special you won't find at any other spot! Must try.

My husband is from OH and grew up eating Handel's so we were very excited to see one opening in Vegas and 2 miles from our house made it even better. Since they've been open I have probably tried 90% of the flavors on the board and they are ALL delicious! My favorite is the Graham central station. The staff is always super friendly too.

So, I'm sitting here like usual at Amelie's waiting forever on a sandwich that I ordered 15+min ago and there was no line (ironically) when I got here. Anything I've ever gotten here is golden! Pastries, sandwiches, soups, coffees whatever...it's all been delicious! But, I just can't bring myself to give more than three stars because I have to believe that their process for preparing food orders is just too inefficient and can be faster than it is. The phrase good things come to those who wait is an understatement. If your in a rush or really hungry, bring a book or friends or consider somewhere else. If you have the time, get prepared for good food and pastries.

The French Toast ice cream was EXTREMELY salty to the point where a few bites in could give you hypertension. We also tried the Birthday Cake Milkshake that was also bad. It seemed like the milk or cream had gone bad. On top of that it's odd that an ice cream place in a casino wouldn't offer tap or iced water.

Ice cream was delicious, excellent choice of flavors, was hard to pick one. Good amount for what you pay for. Service was top notch too, friendly and high spirited people behind the counter. Inside was pretty cool as well and love that they are open later.
Delicious for lunch and excellent for dessert. Atmosphere is unique. Lots of interesting maps, painting, chotchkies. Would suggest the salted carmel brownie to anyone.

So last weekend my wife and I came to Vegas to celebrate her birthday. On our way out we stopped by Bouchon for breakfast. We have been to the location in Beverly Hills but this was my first time here at the Vegas location. My wife and I both ordered the Petite breakfast which comes with a pastry, coffee and juice, eggs, and bacon and sausage and a side of fries. The food was good and obviously this place is know for its pastries. We did have an issue with the service. Halfway through our meal we noticed that we were not served our juice. When we asked one of the wait staff, we were told that it did not come with our meal, which we were a little confused because the waiter took down our order. It wasn't until we got our check that we asked another person and he clarified that it was indeed included so they brought us a glass after we have already finished our meal. Also our fries never came and by the time someone came by to see if everything was ok, it was already too late so we told them to cancel it. Needless to say we felt like the waiter just totally ignored us when it wasn't even that busy since we were seated at like 8am on a sunday morning.

Loved the Red Velvet Vegan cupcake! Of course it's not quite the same as "buttercream" but I believe he frosting was coconut butter based. The cupcake was moist and not overly sweet. Definitely a must stop for a vegan treat!

$12 for a Mint Bliss. Maybe I'm cheap. Probably. Maybe I shouldn't expect to walk into Ghirardelli thinking it would be wallet-friendly. Yea, probably. But let's take a sugar-ridden step back. $12 for a scoop of mint, a chocolate bar, some chocolate syrup, and a fudge(?) base. 5 bites later and I'm done. Sorry, my cute-cat-wallet-I-bought-from-Target. The desserts are great to take pictures of but the price... Man, I told myself to visit every Ghirardelli store that I come across but darn, it's getting too expensive. But great news, 5th location is checked off. Anyway, free chocolate when you enter. Don't share that but do share anything else you order.

Best Damn Donuts in #CLE! I love everything about this place: the scruffy exterior, cheap prices, long history (since 1937!) and of course the made from scratch crazy good donuts! They have the perfect mix of classic and cool flavors - truly something for everyone. My must have - the pumpkin. I also have been known to scarf down classic glazed, salted caramel, and maple bacon to name a few of the yum that awaits you. You can even grab a cup of coffee for the road. Call ahead to make sure they have your favorite flavors and most importantly - BRING CASH! No credit/debit accepted.
Very good doughnuts. A bit more expensive than I would have imagined but worth the trip and our family enjoyed them. I really appreciate having a vegan option in Cleveland. Thanks for being here!

This place is worth all the hype! Brandon was so sweet and let my husband and I try as many flavors as we needed before making our choice, which is hard because all the flavors are delicious! We both ended up going with a donut sandwich and were not disappointed! We will definitely be back!

If you love matcha then this is the spot for you! They have matcha EVERYTHING. Matcha drinks, pastries. And ice cream! I had the matcha ice cream with half roasted matcha and it was so good they also have a vanilla flavor for the non matcha lover friend or significant other that tags along. Prices range from $3-$9

Amazing ice cream every single time. Last visit, I had a scoop of Carrot Cake (with fresh carrots) and a scoop of Caramel Corn (with popcorn pieces/ caramel topping) and both were out of this world. BAE had the Peppermint Bark (which included HOMEMADE bark). All were amazing.. They let you try endless flavors and will even offer ice cream from the back. Even strange flavors like Chicken and Waffles (with waffle and chicken/chicken skin pieces that I subbed for dinner) were unreal. Worth the trip from the suburbs, or anywhere for that matter. If you have an Instagram (and the willpower), definitely follow them because they post pictures of current flavors (no spam).

This is my favorite place in Las Vegas to get premium Asian bread. My favorites are the Mangotale (sweet bread with mango custard filling), Berrytale (sweet bread with blueberry filling), and their Tokyo Cheesecake. There is usually a line outside on weekends and nights, but it is generally clear in the early mornings and lunches on weekdays. Their selections, however, are not consistent as there are some days where they have many selections and other days where they have limited items. My favorite drink is the Mango Coconut slush as it has mini tapioca balls and does not have dairy. Every time I come here, my tray is always full of breads. From experience, the breads have a shelf life of max 3 days, so make sure you can finish all the breads before they start to go bad.
Jarling's is my favorite place to go for ice cream. I always get a strawberry cheesecake snowstorm and it's delicious!

Went there at 750am before they opened. There was a line. Not impressed with it at all. Decided to try it for a second time the next day. Got there at 815am, didn't walk out till 9am. Same disappointment in the goods, not good. Not recommending unless you have lots of time to kill for average baked goods. Way over rated. It must be their marketing tactic to create a line outside because they work slow compared to norm. No sense of urgency or efficiency. They ate slow!!! They write down your order instead of pulling it out from the case as you tell them, then they have you wait while they grab your order n box it. Then you go up to this really sweet cashier lady who is at the same or slower pace. N when you are ready to eat your 40 min wait goods, there's nothing wowing to it. Super average!

I wouldn't say I'm an ice cream connoisseur... but I also wouldn't say I'm not one. With that in mind, believe me when I say Churn is always a great choice for dessert. Their ice cream is delectable. The strawberry shortcake sundae is unbelievable. The cookies tho, that's where the money's at. The salted chocolate chip cookie is legitimately one of the best cookies I have ever consumed. Minus 1 star bc I wish the flavors were a little more fun and flirty, but you can't beat the classics so I get it.

I absolutely loved Carlo's Bakery!!! It took me over an hour to find it, but it was so worth it! The line was super long but their goods were to die for Next time I'm in Vegas, this will be my first & last stop!! (I got so much more than this)
Best ice cream! Every flavor is delicious! I always highly recommend the chocolate peanut butter cup or the chocolate raspberry truffle!!

A social media moment - Novel Ice Cream popped up on my yelp notifications. It is close to my house so I decided to head on down. That turned out to be a great idea! Brandon and Jenny are great and so is their ice cream. We opted for a Dough Melt - a doughnut stuffed with ice cream. For filling we went with Fat Elvis and Bourbon Caramel. Loved it! Highly recommend that you check this place out. Cool location, great owners, and darn tasty ice cream. N*joy....

I wanted to try out this place as it looks great. Yup it LOOKS great but it is not that great. Nice variety of items. You take a plateau and pick out what you would like to buy. Then wait in line. Seven people working (of what I see) yet the wait is pretty long and the line moves slow. I got 2 pastries that I heated up in the oven. They were very bland: mushroom one and the hot dog one. There's better spots I'd say...
Absolutely fabulous! I have never had a more flaky croissant in my life. The danish was out of this world. I will gladly drive an hour and a half for these pastries!
Cookie dough sold by the scoop! It's very very sweet but if you love that, this is your place. I had a Brooke--a brownie surrounding by choc chip cookie, baked together. The cookie part was tough.
Good place to score crack. Excellent fix. Still buzzing, expecting withdrawal symptoms soon...

Looks like a mom & pops shop... Fairly small & not a huge selection but very well stocked. Lots of vintage old school candy. Staff was friendly & helpful I got the FAT ELVIS SUNDAE & man was it delicious! I recommended 110%

I live in AZ but will be stopping here every time I'm in Vegas which I'd A LOT. Got 3 donuts and couldn't believe how cheap these huge delicious things are. Can not wait to go back and take everyone I know.

Review is for taste of bakery items only. We are fans of the show so me and kids had to roll in and see the Cake Boss bakery. They didn't have any fabulous cakes displayed which was a disappointment. It was a Sunday in late July so no line to complain about. The quality of pastries wasn't all that. I actually let the kids have the cookies and we opted for Bouchon bakery instead. We tried the eclair, stuffed croissant, Canoli's and cookies. If I had to wait in a line for mediocre pastures I would've been pissed.

Amazing customer service! We were early for our brunch reservation next door so we popped in, we asked if they could hold our boxes till we were finished or till t hey closed. They sold out before their official closing time so they called to notify us and we were able to pick up our boxes! We will be back to try some of the ones that they had already sold out on.

Suggested to us by a security guard, a couple blocks of The Fremont Street Experience. You see the picture, delectable. A little pricey, but it is Vegas.... Well worth every penny. Don't often crave a donut, bit glad I did today. Walking distance, close to hotel, perfect. Well worth your text and Penny's, priceless!!!!
