This sundae was so big I nearly didn't finish all, but was worth every bite. My favorite part is how they give a free promotional flavor chocolate square at the door. Definitely recommend anyone in the area try this place for ice cream, cookies or brownies. And of course, chocolate!

I'm Filipino and this place made me feel right at home. Their Sago Gulaman and Taho is the most authentic I've had in Arizona! Decently priced and their ice cream servings are very generous with so many flavor options! Definitely recommend and coming back!!
Ordered $30 in pastries and cookies and would have been better off buying from a gas station convenience store. They were stale, flavorless and artificial.

After seeing some positive reviews about Rewind, I wanted to stop by and check it out for myself. A store that sells boba and ice cream at the same time? Say less and hook me up because I'm coming over at the speed of light. Now onto the review: Dessert/Drink (3/5): For the drink, I got a Blueberry Matcha Latte and I got the Matcha Madness (in a cone) for dessert. Let's start with the drink. As someone who absolutely loves matcha, I knew I had to order this. It is different from most matcha drinks I typically see in which this one comes with blueberry puree. The drink was a good size for what the price was; however, the drink isn't that spectacular. The matcha flavor was nice but the blueberry didn't really add any wow factor to the drink. If anything, I felt as if I couldn't ever taste the blueberry so that was rather disappointing. The Matcha Madness ice cream included the following toppings: two pocky sticks and chocolate shavings. I find that the ice cream itself was pretty smooth and had a really good matcha flavor to it. Only downside was that it was really melty within a minute and the ice cream wasn't as pretty/have a nice swirling effect. Atmosphere (5/5): The establishment was really pretty and I absolutely love the vibe. Decor was pretty minimal but any place that has a neon sign and a grass wall is amazing in my eyes haha. The store was also very clean and neat. Seating was pretty limited as there was only 4 - 5 tables. Service (4/5): Service was alright. I didn't find it to special or felt that workers went out of their way. Did notice that a worker was talking to their buddies when people were waiting to order. Overall, just lack of attention to customers; however, the drink and ice cream came out at a good pace. Overall, Rewind offers customers a good mixture of drinks and ice cream selection to satisfy any sweet cravings. The attention to customer could be improved but timing between order and handout was good. Would I come back? If I was in the area then maybe, but I certainly wouldn't go out of my way to go. Might only get ice cream if I go though as the drink was average.

Omgggg! The best donut, ice cream and service! We came on a Saturday night around 9:30 and just missed the line because there was no line! The owner was so nice and welcoming. He described every flavor to us and how it's made and allowed us to try any and all flavors we wanted. The flavors were sooooo good but I opted for Madagascar vanilla with the doughnut sandwich and no topping. The donut was amazing!! Soooo good and light in your mouth. You get to choose one topping with your ice cream. My boyfriend got the butter pecan in a cup with Cinnamon Toast Crunch as his topping. The butter pecan ice cream was amazingggg! The manager/owner was so nice and we will definitely be back!!

Finally opened in Vegas! I've been going to the 85 bakeries in California and I have always wanted one here in Vegas. Now that they're opened (Grand opening Dec 6.) I always look forward to getting my fix. The quality of bread is amazing and the variety they have is immense. If you look for something savory, sweet, or decadent this bakery has it all. I always get the Hawaiian chicken and garlic bread. The service is excellent, cashiers are fully attentive and are always accommodating. If you need a quick fix of delicious baked goods definitely try this place out!

Two stars for the pastry, five for people watching. Had an eclair, it was very average compared to the bakeries that I eat at in Paris. The decoration is very Dorothy Draper, which I loved. Good French sodas though.

Mitchell's ice cream is the best ice cream I have tried in Ohio! I love the array of flavors and the variety. My favorites are the key lime pie, banana cream pie, and amaretto cookie (when it was still available). Going to miss this ice cream now that I've moved away from Cleveland. Also loved that pints of this were sold in a giant Eagle close to where I lived.
Have had the cannoli on numerous occasions and it is amazing. The wait in line was a little long but that is to be expected.

This is a nice treat after being so good all week! The menu options are very well rounded and they take simple American favorites and turn it up a notch! One of my faves is the PB&J. It's a jelly filled donut with a peanut butter frosting on top. So good. They give free donuts to the kiddos on the weekends which helps when you're waiting in line for sure! The cold brewed coffee is also really good! The kids love picking out their own huge donuts which they never quite finish in one sitting. Disclaimer: if you go there really hungry like I did there is a chance you'll leave with more and have extras for the next day! :)
The most mediocre place ever... smelled like chemicals when we walked in. A SMALL ass scoop for $5? And $1 for every topping? Gee thanks for my 4 sprinkles.... Never coming back here again.

Was not a fan of Sprinkles in Beverly Hills. Was hoping for a better experience at this location. Well, here is what I I liked. It is located right on the Strip at the Linq Promenade. The Cupcake ATM looks like an amazing feature. Should have tried it, but I did not. Maybe someday. What I did not like. I was not crazy about any of their cupcake flavors that day. Not saying that they tasted bad. Just was not "Wowed". Overall, I find Sprinkles cupcakes good. Not great, sorry. I recommend Sprinkles as a fine 3 star cupcake shop. Nothing more at this time.
best dessert in AZ! Love the cantelope and coconut sorbet

I. Love. Jeni's. I went to school at Ohio State, so I was incredibly excited when I heard Jeni's was coming to Charlotte. I love a lot of their flavors. Goat cheese and cherries and brambleberry crisp are both great. I love that they let you sample as many flavors as you want (although this does add to the long line). I love that they use metal sample spoons. I tried the frosÃ© this time and it was amazing. I think it's my favorite flavor I've had there. The fruit flavors really come through. Their waffle cones are homemade right in the shop and they are to die for. If you haven't tried Jeni's yet, I suggest that you fix that immediately. It's definitely worth the long line!

When Yelp tells you the best ice cream spot is in your town, you have to check it out. We made our way over after dinner on a Saturday night. Parking is tough but manageable on side streets. I wanted to try everything. Every flavor of ice cream was so good!!! I ended up with vanilla and chocolate bc let me tell you this was the best vanilla I've ever tasted in my life. Who knew vanilla could have so much depth of flavor?! My husband had a donut sandwich and it was amazing. The staff is so friendly and make the experience that much better. I can't wait to come back with friends to try more flavors!

Had to visit the Carlos bakery and went on a sat. Night. The line was as long as a show line in Vegas. Didn't wait but went back at 745am before they opened at 8. Already 10 people in front of me. Wow but worth the wait. Very organized pleasant staff, prices reasonable, best lobster tails I ever had. The cannolis are to die for. Yum I will be back waiting in line before I leave Vegas. Kudos to the manager and to buddy.

I loved this place but they've moved to being a pop up shop out front of Jobot Coffee right down the street Friday-Sunday only... the sign out front of their original location right now is a little misleading. I watched three other groups of customers walk into Jobot and ask where melt went tonight, hopefully the actual store comes back soon -- not sure if it's closed or just under construction?

Not only did they yell at everyone as they walked in to the store to wear a mask (when the sign on the door didn't read "mandatory") but also as I get up to the counter with my mask on and the lady asks if I ever have been crop dusted wearing my mask. Extremely rude and uncalled for. Very rude and inconsiderate staff. Pastries and desserts were okay at best. Nothing explains to you what these parties are and staff barely knows. Safe to say you lost a customer.

This place has tasty items but they are extremely expensive. I totally believe you get what you paid for but this is extreme. $17 for a slice of cake with taxes. The lease at the Cosmopolitan can't be that high.

Soooo this place I saw on IG by a friend and had to try it. Ice cream in a donut? Sold! We get there and it was small but absolutely adorable. Really loved the feel where it was located. I got the Cookie Monster ice cream with Cookie Crisp inside a donut. They warned me it would turn my mouth blue and teeth, tongue, etc. I didn't care, because it was amazing! The donut was warm and delicious. It was so perfect together and a perfect combo! The owner even served my friend and I our ice cream! I love when owners are so involved with their business and assisting the customers. He was such a cool dude! On a side note, it also turns your poop blue- so don't panic! LOL honestly, it was the best and I would definitely be going back!

A Sunday afternoon stroll brought me to Jeni's to see what "All the hype" was about. There is always a line and I had heard good things. The place itself is adorable and it wasn't quite raining yet so that was a plus because if you are waiting in line, and it happens to be along line, you will be hit by the elements. That aside, we walk up to the counter, but even before you get inside you can smell the cones sugary sweet smell. The list of flavors is long and very creative. An unfortunate truth, I can't really have ice cream, lactose and I are not friends but I love it. Fortunately, they three very interesting options. I chose the infused coffee and coconut milk - A*M*A*Z*I*N*G! I did taste the chocolate and the goat cheese with cherries which were equally as good but the Coffee and Cream spoke to my heart. I opted to have it in a cup and the very sweet, very attentive attendant that work there made the smart suggestion of putting pieces of cone into the cup (thank you). So this goes without saying, the staff is great. I was SO pleased I made this stop. I highly recommend the full experience. You can apparently buy pints in certain stores around town but you truly have to go in person.
I love this place. It's a staple from college and worth a trip here everytime. It's such great custard...it makes me want to make the sucky drive down 57 right now.

Cool little hole in the wall ice-cream donut shop. Great selection of ice cream to choose from, don't be afraid to ask to try them because I know I wasn't. The employee that was assisting us with our order turned out to be part owner of this shop, really amazing individual, you don't often see a co-owner working in the front. Will be back to try more!

I'm so disappointed. I got a Sprinkles cupcake last night & it was horrible. Dry, bland, & kinda stiff. Not even lying. :/ It made me so sad that I couldn't finish it. Paying for an almost $4 cupcake, it killed me to throw it in the trash. I've never had any of their cupcakes that were like that. I usually visit the one close to me in La Jolla in San Diego & the cucpakes were always yummy.

This place by far is my most favorite place to go to when I am downtown! They alway have the best selections especially for the sweet tooth cravings I alway have! There location isn't too far from downtown Fremont and the Container Park, So this is alway a good option to come to first thing in the morning. That's probably the best time to come in is early, they alway sell out fast and all the good options are gone if you decided to come in later in the day. I have been lucky so far to alway grab my favorites before they sale out. My go-to's are alway the birthday Cake, the Homer, and a Nutella one. I even love the Churro Cone with Ice Cream. My favorite time to come here is on the weekend. It should I say my little ones favorite time to come here is on Saturday or Sunday, they alway give out free donuts to kids. They make them a featured character and have it all decorated out. Last time we came here and got our free donut they were handing out Ninjago Donuts, my son was super excited and absolutely went crazy with pure happiness. He has now made it a point to request we go there everyday, but unfortunately my metabolism won't be able to keep up with that request, so we opt for the weekends only lol. If your lucky enough to come on happy hour you can grab a box full for $10, the only sad part is you don't know when they will have it or if they will. It's usually before they close and depending on how much they have left. So it's alway a win win when you come in, you can grab a speciality donut, or a free kids character donut, or a happy hour box. Either way you will definitely not be displeased with the quality of the donuts, and you can always walk off the calories at Fremont or Container Park.

I am a fan...and because of that, I stop pretty frequently...I'd say more than 50% of the time that I motor north into the Great Shining Beacon on the side of McDowell Mt. and Pinnacle Peak called "North Scottsdale", I stop off for cup or a cone! The ice cream is made with love and craftsmanship that surpasses that of most of the restaurants in the Greater Phoenix area...I really do love their Madagascar Vanilla Bean ice cream! Wonderful, delightful sweet treats...just about the best ice cream that I've ever had (and that includes the homemade frozen custard that I used to make...and I will tell you that nobody appreciates my own cooking more than I do!). So, Donald, why only 4 stars for the Republic? Is it just me? Am I xenophobic?...have something against ice cream based governmental systems?...maybe a lactose intolerance based grudge against the Republic and those for which it stands? No...no...I just want a smile out of somebody when I buy a cup or a cone and then maybe spend another $20-30 to take a little frozen delight home to the Beautiful Carin...I've been in this place 20 times or more and I never get more than a "next" out of the people dishing out the scoops! Or a hurried "will that be all?" when they are ready for me to be done and pay and get going... I try to chat...even stuff like "how's your day?" and "boy, that looks great!" is met with silence. Maybe it's just me... Last week, I dropped by on my way home from a visit with one of my attorneys (and you can believe me when I say I really needed a treat). It wasn't a busy afternoon...but again...I was greeted with...indifference. There was a sign in the window advertising for help...wanting people "passionate" about being there...OK, I see the passion in the ice cream...and the customer service isn't bad...not really...they always get to me eventually and I get what I want...but I couldn't say that anyone behind the counter has ever smiled at me...chatted with me...even when taking my money...sometimes quite a bit of money...it's a little bit disconcerting... Oh well, the ice cream here is the star of the show and I do like the ice cream! Oh, and a smile and chat would be nice, too!

The shape of ice cream was pretty and the Thai flavor was good. Selected blueberry as topping, and it was fresh and tastes great with the ice cream. However, I waited for 20 minutes to get this which was far longer than I expected.

This place was on my to try list for a bit and I'm glad we stopped by. The lady who took care of us was super friendly and polite. You can do half and half scoops which I really liked. I got the double chocolate and the butter pecan and both were solid. My date got the tiramisu which I thought was pretty good too. I thought one scoop was a lot to maybe next time I'll go with the kids scoop. There is outdoor siting at the front of the shop and at the back. I think the seating at the back of the shop is cozier. I would definitely come back again and try some of their sundaes which all sounded delicious! Cookies also looked good. Bonus points for still offering samples, I thought maybe due to COVID they wouldn't but they do.

I have been dying to try their ice cream for a while now, ever since my co-workers told me about it. So my family and I went here today and we were not disappointed! The staff was super nice! They were very patient with my two little girls, who kept asking questions at the same time and wanted to try ALL the flavors, lol. My kids ordered a scoop each of two different flavors, my hubby ordered two scoops of the caramel toffee (I can't remember the exact name) and I ordered two scoops of the honey lavender, which was delicious!! We really enjoy our ice cream. Hubs even loved his. They use real lavender flowers in the honey lavender and you can definitely taste the honey as well. The prices were a tad higher than what I'm used to paying when we go out for ice cream, but I'm okay with that since this is fresh, handmade ice cream. I'd definitely recommend this place and would also go here again! I do hope they move to a bigger location in the future because my one critique would be that it is a small place with no seating and I'd love to be able to sit down at a table with my family and eat ice cream.

Was going for an evening walk and saw the lights of the little outpost beckoning like an oasis at the end of Bridge Ave. Great staff -- didn't bat an eye lash when I tried two flavors and then settled on a third. Went for the double cookie, with chocolate chip and homemade cookie dough. The cookie dough was stand-out. So so so good.

A great bakery, but the baristas are never very pleasant. When I ask for coffee with soy milk, they always tell me that you "can't" make that drink with soy milk. I enjoy pastries here, but I'm not a coffee snob. Complaining about making drinks with soy milk only pushes me to Starbucks.
Bomb.com Try the fruity pebbles milk shake. It is absolutely amazing. The soft serve is good too. We tried the coco puffs mix and it did not disappoint. The location is clean and instagram worthy.

Chocolate Shoppe Ice Cream is so worth it, I once spent $40 to ship two pints to my sister in Michigan! Every flavor is fantastic, but some of my recommendations are: Fat Elvis (banana ice cream with peanut butter and chocolate), Coconut Almond Bliss (the ice cream version of an Almond Joy bar...it tastes JUST like it!), and my most recent favorite, Triple Zen (green tea ice cream with lemon and raspberry ribbon). And while they no longer make it, I LOVED Oatmeal Cookie! It had huge chunks of oatmeal cookies in it. A single scoop in a waffle cone is a few bucks, so Chocolate Shoppe Ice Cream falls into the "more expensive" category. But if you're going to indulge, I say go for it!

Listen if you see a huge line don't wait, if the line is ok wait and try the pastries. I just promise one thing you won't be impressed, at least I wasn't These are the prices for what I ordered : Large Cannoli $3.95 , French NapoleÃ³n $7.50 , and the total was $12.39 & btw they only accepted cash ! So disappointing because my expectations were a bit too high I guess.

We were referred here by friends who rave about this place. Maybe our expectations were too high because I think you can do better in the ice cream aisle of the grocery store for less than our $14 bill was here. The ice cream was fine. The chocolate wasn't rich or very flavorful. The peanut butter ice cream was nutty and not too sweet. That was good. I was told to get the hot fudge which I ordered but didn't end up on my sundae. My wife ordered a chocolate chip cookie. The cookie was baked well and had good texture but had more salt on top than I'd prefer. There's a good amount of parking and a nice outdoor seating area out back. Only one party of customers is allowed in the store at a time and all of the employees were wearing masks. Sanitizer was provided. All in you can feel okay passing on this one.
These donuts are HUGE and delicious! The staff is friendly and welcoming. They have a cool aquarium of donuts!!! I will be coming back in the future

I LOVE THIS PLACE. It's pretty close to happiness on earth. Their snowstorms are the best. Be warned, it melts really fast. But the texture is super light and doesn't give you that heavy feeling after you eat ice cream. My go to is their blueberry cobbler. It has blueberries and oatmeal crumbles in their vanilla custard which is absolutely AMAZING It's a great place which outdoor seating to chill with friends and to enjoy the summer weather. Whether you're a local or just here for the weekend, this place is worth prioritizing on your list of places to enjoy a delicious treat.

Amazing! Wow delicious homemade ice cream and cookies. Had an ice cream cookie sandwich- one 'bun' coconut macaroon and the other snicker doodle w toasted coconut ice cream in the middle and toasted marshmallow on top! Mind blowing. Too bad I don't live in Phoenix; then again, perhaps it is a good thing- Id eat my weight in ice cream here. So much to try!
This place is very hipster, I had the strawberry basil sorbet it was very refreshing and delicious. My friend had Oh My !! Affogato, has her wired, this place has a laid back atmosphere.
Sooo good! Love the fruity pebble ice cream and macaron. The marshmallow was gooey and perfect. And the lady was so nice!

This is a must stop place for ice cream if you are within an hour drive of the place, It has the best home made ice cream in the country. Their seasonal flavors are awesome and their pumpkin pecan ice cream is to die for! Buy a cone and purchase a quart to take home for later or trust me if you don't, you will be kicking yourself that night for not getting some for later.

The ice cream is good but I give the three stars because the staff just seems to really lallygag and just hang around back there while everyone waits outside. They make the milk shakes with a lot of milk and a little ice cream. Maybe the whole experience will be better on another day. I'll give it another chance some other time.
This place is pretty neat. Little cool spot for a date, or even just a hangout. The pie is rad, especially a la mode. Do it up big homies, and try this spot out.
Love this place! We come from Glendale Almost 3x a week just to get cookies. Best in town.
Churn is definitely my go-to dessert stop in Uptown. I love their peanut butter ice cream! They have amazing sundaes and shakes too!

Day and Night is definitely a spot Charlotte needs. It's trendy, Instagrammable, and the cereal options are super creative and tasty. I went to the grand opening and had "Unicorn Breathe" which was fruity pebbles, lucky charms, whipped cream, cookies, and strawberry drizzle. I had it with whole milk but there are other milk options. There are two bars on the inside where you can dine in and a table for outside dining. I think it fits right in with the neighborhood and the surrounding businesses. I would definitely go here on a date, with friends, or when I just want a unique bowl of cereal or cool milkshake. This is also a black owned business so I will definitely be spreading the word as much as possible. There is street parking near and also a parking deck. It's right across the street from a park as well so you can enjoy your cereal or milkshake there!

Went there for a quick ice cream run after a pho dinner. Was pleasantly surprised. We had the whiskey almond ice-cream and was a bomb. Really great flavor. They can add a little more whiskey to the ice cream. Overall great!

The Bacon-Cinnamon Roll here is epic (10/10). The Nutella donut & the Cream BrulÃ© were both above average but not life-changing like that bacon cinnamon roll. We showed up at 9:15am on a Froday and were lucky enough to get the last bacon cinnamon roll- so get here early if possible.

The good: Their cheesecake is phenomenal. Everything else looks wonderful as well, but I love their cheesecake. The bad: The service could be better. Not bad but not great either. Whenever I get there and there is a line, I dread it as I know I will be in it for quite some time. Odds are someone is going to order a cake right in front of you and it's a time consumer and the process needs to be improved. Also, odds are against you if you want to grab a slice of something and get a spot inside to eat. Hopscotch has quickly grown a fan base and it stays pretty packed inside.
Amelie's is a staple! Try the pumpkin latte in the fall with some macaroons or a salted Carmel brownie. 10/10

I have been to the Donut Bar a few times and like to bring friends/family when they visit. They have a fun collection of donuts and good coffee. The staff is friendly when ordering donuts. We also enjoy the back area for sitting and talking. My last visit ended with an unpleasant encounter and now I am not sure how I feel about visiting again. Everything was good until we were about to leave. My sister and I had our kids with us and we decided to go out in the back to eat donuts. When we went out we noticed they had gotten some corn hole boards and some other customers were enjoying them. My sister's kids played with them for a little at one point but for the most part stayed by us. As we were leaving our group was approached by an employee who asked our kids in an accusing manner what happened to the corn hole board. When we explained that others were playing with them and the kids said they didn't do it he continued to accuse them of damaging them and then proceeded to lay a guilt trip on the kids. First, if you think someone's kids did something you should approach the parents and speak with them so we can handle it. Second, if you don't have proof or a witness accusing someone is wrong. He never said he had proof or a witness...if he had we would have handled it appropriately and the kids would have been held responsible. Like I said at the start normal our visits are great and we love introducing people to the donut bar and love their treats...now I am a little put off by this last visit due to this employee.

We happened upon this epic little spot during a mini-vacation to visit Phoenix and what a lucky find! I felt like I was stepping back into the 50's - or at least what I think it would be like. From the employees rolling fresh waffle cones (for real!) to the adorable young women who took our order, the place was just incredible. Their ice cream was amazing and the most incredible part - as we were waiting for our order, the owner stopped by to ask how long we'd be waiting. It had maybe been a total of 2 minutes (they were very busy on a Saturday night). He just wanted to make sure it hadn't been too long. I cannot remember the last time I have experienced excellent product, great ambiance, and phenomenal customer service all in one visit. Wish we lived there so I could visit more often!

They had a few different vegan options- creme brulee, apple fritter, and strawberries and cream! Yum! I got the strawberries and cream to go for the road. It was HUGE and amazing. I will be back for more

Tiny hole in the wall ice cream shop that serves interesting flavors in cute Chinese takeaway boxes. The ice cream is just okay but it's better than all of the other ice cream joints in Phoenix, so Melt it is. What makes the ice cream just okay is that it's not very creamy. It's more flaky with ice chunks in it. Still refreshing, but not to die for.

"Life is not measured by the number of breaths we take, but by the moments that take our breath away." Take a stroll with me! Remember when you were little, holding mama's hand in line patiently for ice cream. Perhaps it was daddy's special day, looking around from the top of the world. Up on daddy's strong shoulders, safe and ready for ice cream treats. How happy you were. Now your the mama or daddy! It's time to take your children to get ice cream. Remember the special moments that were created for your. This ice cream parlor is a throwback to the days when ice cream parlors were in style. It's those whimsical dreams that we can share and re-enjoy again and again with generation after generation. Remember this ice cream parlor is located inside the Venetian shops. It's a wonderful place, but it's touristy heavy. It was created to make you stop in and feel good. The ice cream is always delicious, always the staff has those smiling faces. It's the cost that will set you back. You decide the price of your happy. Sure for what you get sometimes the price will shock. As a local in Vegas, I would highly recommend this spot just for the memories that will come from it. If your familiar with Eddie World in Yermo, California: same kind of similarity. It's worth the happiness that ice cream joy makes for the family. Is that sundae worth it? This is sort of a build it your own ice cream happy. For around $10 it's a few scoops of ice cream, whip cream, sprinkles, caramel or chocolate sauce; and that cherry on top! If your a fudge brownie kind of sweetness type, they have that loaded with all those sweet options on top. If your looking so ice cream, just "ice cream," it's here too. Many different flavors exist, with a few twists and turns. Come discover what ice cream concoction makes your heart flutter. It's the post COVID world now, masks are a mandatory in Las Vegas. While ordering keep your mask on. The employees here return to the customer, a clean environment for us all to exist in. Between customers we observed an employee whose dedicated position was to cleanliness. The atmosphere of the store even feels clean. So many delicious treats stare back from the glass, and the main consumer is children. The glass was hand print free and all sparkles. It's got a streak free shine on those windows. How we appreciate all the cleaning and sanitizing that the staff performs! Thank you for all your hard efforts and works at keeping us all safe. Because they care, our cashier was happy and upbeat. As we waited in line, the rules of COVID have switched up how we interact these days. We must remember six feet apart. You have to wait in line just a little longer. As we stand here, check your IG account! Check in on Yelp!! We did! The worth for their glamorous ice cream is worth it. All forms of payment are accepted here. The touch less forms are becoming more prevalent than cash!! It's Vegas, so cash is still "king" here. After ordering they usher you down the line where the crew will directly hand off your sundae to you. If you order consists of a donut or cookie; it is called separately. Either way the orders go in order as placed; and handed off. Every wonder what Homer Simpson feels like when he holds that pink sprinkles donut. "Homer like, mmmmm donuts!" Come and be epic! The large Homer Pink Sprinkles donut is available here. This epic donut is offered in power blue with rainbow sprinkles. No matter what color or flavor of Homer Donut you choose; it's a delicious choice. The Homer Donut is delicious. As you enjoy that first bite it takes me back to when Homer had a chance to live in raining donut land. The time machine jumped, too late. Now you can have that moment anytime you want while enjoying your small piece of the Simpson's. Take you little ones hand and take them out. Due to COVID our family members get togetherness has diminished. Take back family time and be happy. Make new memories. Rebuild old paths with new steps. Let your heart flutter and beat fast as you laugh and smile. Ice cream makes every one scream! Now scream, loud! Louder!! We want ice cream! Please!!

Great place to get ice cream on an obscenely hot-as most are in Phoenix-evening. It's a real change from all the boring, self-serve fro-yo chains that make you do all the work and charge you $9 for toppings. I really liked the retro atmosphere and, despite it being a bit crowded on a Friday night, the line moved pretty fast. I ordered a Peanut Butter Freeze without knowing what to expect. The end result? A cup full of peanut butter chips, crumbled up Reese's cups and chocolate all smooshed together in a creamy concoction. Needless to say, I nearly polished it off on the ride home. One other thing I liked was the outdoor seating in the back, but you'd probably have to eat pretty fast considering the weather. Seemed like a real hang-out spot for all ages.

This place is great. It's completely unique and the customer service is super friendly and customer oriented. They all have wonderful attitudes and a can do mentality. Would recommend checking this place out.

We tried one of their new small locations right across the bridge and right in the entrance to the Venetian. We grabbed their version of the Nutter Butter, Oreo, a vanilla macaroon, and a chocolate croissant. $16.00 for the four pieces seemed a little high but after we ate everything, I would have to say it was totally worth every penny! The "Nutter Butter" and the "Oreo" were both "melt in your mouth" yummy. Spend the $4 a piece, you won't be sorry.

Love this place. They have a variety of unique flavors and nice decor. Any place that can serve homemade pistachio is an auto-fav for me. Seasonal flavors are also on the menu. Like other ice cream establishments, they serve by scoops and your choice of cups or cones. I asked for the large three scoops which is not necessarily on the menu b/c it's a lot of ice cream. I LIKE ICE CREAM. As for the place, they have a decent amount of seating indoors and some outdoors. Inside, you can see the kitchen through the windows in the hallway to the bathroom. They can host private events on the second floor and even have a model train going around on top in the seating area. I wish the train would serve the ice cream as it makes its rounds along the tracks. Definitely a great place for family, friends, or dates.

Delicious! Ice cream is not even one of my favorite desserts but Handel's is in a class by itself! Completely worth the 20 min drive for me. Coconut cream pie is amazing. Have also tried the chocolate cake batter (very good and super rich) buckeye (vanilla with peanut butter/chocolate, yummy!) and graham central station(I didn't think a graham cracker centered flavor could actually be so tasty!). Service was super slow and the girl did get one of my sampler flavors wrong but I am sure it is just because they just opened.

Mitchell's is amazing! I have never been disappointed. Their coffee with chocolate chunk ice cream and their cherry with chocolate chunk ice cream are my favorite but that's just because I can't try anything else new since I'm addicted!

Great idea! Cool space. Tasty shakes. I loved the cereal decor. It's a great unique idea for a place in a cool area of Uptown/ The staff was a little disengaged on the Friday night we visited. We watched them lock the doors 15 minutes before closing time and refuse any more service. It was a bit awkward being the last customers served that night and seeing others try to get in a locked door while we waited for our shakes

Worst experience ever. I ordered a dozen macaroons which was over $40 only to see the person behind the counter grab the display box and some sanitizer wipes from underneath the counter and go in the back room. When she came back out I asked her what she did with the wipes and the box that she put out macaroons in. She said that she wiped down the box and the plastic container because they ran out of boxes! As a customer that just spent over $70 on pastries the least I expect is a new box and not having to worry about whether or not I'm ingesting cleaning chemicals! This is an embarrassment! Tom Keller train your employees to have some common sense! On top of that when we asked for 3 cups of ice water the employee told us they are normally 50 cents each! Really, I just spent $70 on some pastries, you can't give me water? I'm surprised they didn't charge me for each napkin!

Really love this donut place for its uniqueness! They offer really creative creation for donuts like the pop tart one and the butterbeer. My favorite is the strawberry and whipped cream or the Boston creme. I have a really big sweet tooth but some of these donuts are too sweet even for me. The creme brulee donut was the reason I found out about this place but the donut itself is pretty decent mainly only for the aesthetic appeal. Recommend this place for donut heads cause their awesome!

I love the rotating flavors and have liked everything I've tried so far. I'm particularly fond of trying anything I can with the homemade waffle cone pieces on top--they're great! The shop is as cute as can be and I've never had a bad experience.

Absolutely delicious ice cream! And combining it with donuts and cereal almost isn't fair! I got the Cookie Monster ice cream with the donut and Cookie Crisp cereal. Definitely recommend this combo. The owner was so nice and welcoming in addition to the amazing dessert. We will definitely back, and soon!

This location is very small with only a handful of selections. There were 6 different macaroons to choose from. I got the coffee & pistachio, both had a great smell & taste. However, the texture was not the same. This place was not appetizing at all. Yountville, CA location definitely has everything to perfection & the selection is limitless.

Yes Please! It was the Leslie Knope for me and the Dough Melt for my son. Lovely owners, charming service and the little kitties outside were just so sweet. Even on a hot summer evening it was perfect eating outside on the patio. Well placed and well shaded for those summer evenings. We found a new favorite ice cream spot.

I have seen Milk Bar all over my Instagram feed. They're cups are trendy, the presentation is perfect for your feed (and for feeding). I was delighted when I visited Las Vegas and saw they had a location in the Cosmopolitan. The wannabe Instagram influencer came out in me and was ecstatic to try this cereal + milk ice cream combo. I've never been one to drink the milk at the bottom of my cereal bowl so I was didn't think I was going to enjoy this treat as much as I did. The corn cereal flavor really shined. It was creamy, sweet, and crunchy. A perfect treat for a warm Las Vegas afternoon. I would love to visit Milk Bar's other locations and try more of their creations.

If you are staying at the Venetian then a trip to the Bouchon Bakery is a must. As others have mentioned it's tucked away under an escalator near the main elevator banks for the hotel. Another has opened on the street between the Venetian and Palazzo on the Venetian side. The ham and cheese on french bread grilled with mustard is pretty tasty as a lunch option. Mango yogurt is nice for breakfast, be warned definitely on the sweet side. The baked goods, like croissants are great as is their coffee.

Conveniently 24hrs, awesome macaroons (I didn't try them all), but definitely a bit pricey. I haven't tried my salted caramel brownie yet, but I hear great things. The croissant was nothing special, to be honest, I wonder if I could've asked for it to be warmed up, now that I'm thinking about it.

Famous cupcakes shop, originally from LA area. It is just OK. Not even close to Nomelie Cupcakes of Parker, Colorado. These cupcakes are sprinkles (had vanilla, red velvet, chocolate, and snicker doodle) are Not moist and flavorful. Too much hype but nothing to back up. Disappointing

I have lived in the Old Brooklyn neighborhood for many years and Jack Frost donuts is a staple among all the locals. Ever since the remodel the prices have doubled in price. It's just not worth the product anymore. What a shame

On an unusually warm Fall day, I swung by here to see what Jeni's offered. I knew I wanted a scoop of milk chocolate and maybe try something else. The scoops look small but are deceiving, at least I think so. I got two scoops in a bowl and did not finish. I know. I'm sorry! I did get the milk chocolate and a cream ice cream with pound cake and caramel swirls in it. That was actually too sweet for my taste buds but I'm a girl that would prefer a hunk of cheese over something sweet. The mouth feel was right on; rich ingredients used to make a premium product. Nice job! It was clean too. Someone was outside scrubbing down the trash can for goodness sakes. I felt like I should have tipped him.

We went on a campus tour, they gave us coupons for the Daily Scoop, we went for ice cream. So we paid attention when we got there (before the tour) and learned quickly that the line gets backed up fast. When our tour was over, we belined it to the Daily Scoop and orders some ice cream - chocolate peanut butter to be specific. It was good.

One of the main reasons why I wanted to go for a weekend trip to Vegas is for this right here! Pictured is the cereal milk ice cream with corn flakes and a side of crack pie! This would make my top 10 favorite desserts of all time. There's just something about the simplicity of the salty and crunchy flakes with the cereal milk ice cream. The ice cream is not an overwhelming flavor and sweetness but just so creamy and dreamy. The crack pie is definitely on the sweet side but has this heath butterscotch flavor that I can't describe. It has this chewy texture and ohhh so buttery. I'm probably not doing a great job describing but it's just something you need to experience on your own. Seriously I went here two of the four days that I was in town. What I love about Milk Bar is they they have grab and go window or sit down at Momofuku all located in the Cosmopolitan. There are so many sweet treats to try! An array of cookies, cakes, shakes, and coffee are things you can take on the run with you. There is also baking mixes if you wanna try recreating in your own kitchen. I'll leave the baking up to experts.

WOW. Always worth it. How can you not love Jeni's Splendid ice cream?! Every time we're visiting the Charlotte area, we make sure to make room for some ice cream. There's a ton of different locations, some better than others due to the flavors at each. But let me tell you about the must-haves. Jelly donut and coffee ice cream is like having breakfast right? That jelly donut was to DIE FOR. I think it's a seasonal flavor so count yourself lucky if you've been able to get it. I love coffee ice cream and this one is just *chef kiss.* Hubs got the Gooey butter cake and Jelly donut - again, there's no disappointment here. Gooey butter will be on my next mix. Also, the Everything Bagel flavor is spot on to the bagel, seems strange but surprisingly delicious. It's a must try even if you don't buy a whole scoop!

So happy we finally got to check this place out. It was delicious! Matcha is a very interesting flavor and it is distinct. We can't wait to go back! Everything here is great. Happy Charlotte finally has Cafe Maiko.

There is always a line going out of 90's whenever I'm on the boardwalk. This past weekend my boyfriend, friends, and I decided to bite the bullet and wait in line for ice cream. The wait honestly wasn't bad since the line moves pretty fast and man was it worth the wait! Looking forward to visiting again in the future.
1st timer! I ordered the special Halo-Halo and it was amazing! Very friendly people and chill vibe! we're from Mesa, but we don't mind the drive. We'll be back...

We have had the birthday cake delivered to us (highly recommend) and had to come to the Vegas storefront. We got a slice of birthday cake and a cup of the cereal milk soft serve with corn flake topping. If you love sweets like we do, you can't go wrong here. Bring your dollars though!

I always order their cereal and milk soft serve. That's all I come here for. The only downside was that The Cosmopolitan was limiting their entry to hotel guests and guests with restaurant reservations only. However, once we informed the guard that we wanted to stop by the Milk Bar, he let us in. The line wasn't super long. My husband and I very much enjoyed our cereal and milk soft serve. We will be back!
Delicious ice cream in a cute shop near linq. They have a bunch of chocolates for sale as well.
There's food here I haven't seen since I went to France! Awesome. Legit.

This place has a wide variety of quaint desserts, sandwiches, coffee, and tea. However, the novelty of the decor (french decor, lots of artistic decor) quickly wears after a few visits. The pastries are totally overpriced, the service is pretty bad, and this place often seems to be the high school and stoner hang out.

They have the BEST butter pecan ice cream in the valley. It's always a treat to grab a cone on my way home from work. Super cute shop and always have good music playing. They also have homemade caramels which I LOVE! You are missing out if you don't try this place.
The best place in town, the best place to visit and the best donuts in town! I can't forget the great taste. Amazing staff!!!
This is the real deal. Handel's ice cream is the best!

One part ice cream parlor, one part chocolate shop; All parts very cool all the time! As I said in another one of my reviews, Ghirardelli Square was a legend of my youth and an icon in the world of chocolate confection and ice cream excellence. I was here when I was but a lad,. I came here as young man. And now as father, I still have a gleam in my eye when I see this place If you are doing a tour of the stirp, this is one of the must stop visits to one of the great shrines of sweets across the world. This place is smaller and more compact compared to the Original Ghirardelli Square Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop but it has all the important fixings of the original. The store is split right down the middle with chocolate on your right and the ice cream fountain on your left. Unlike the original, the lines are not super long and most of the time you can just order at the counter and find a seat without much competition. Be patient as some folks have never been to any Ghiradelli shops ever so this experience will be overwhelming to chocolate loving n00bs. They're going to gawk and talk and ooo and awe like we all did as they stand in front of the trying to make up their minds which ice cream or if they've gotten all the chocolates they can because they're probably from out of town and quite possibly not from this country. It is Vegas, baby! ;) The atmosphere is comfortable and clean. Sorry, no chocolate making show here. You'll have to make the trek to its Mecca in San Francisco for that. I shared a Crissy Field again. It's a big sundae and one their most prominent to date! The prices are steep for sure ($11 for a sundae!) but you come here expecting that because you're at Ghirardelli's and it's all part of the experience. The Crissy Field is an amazing sundae with three scoops of premium ice cream topped with cookie crumbles, whip cream and their famous milk chocolate squares. The presentation is beautiful and the taste still blows me away. When you're done with your ice cream treat, check out the chocolate section hanging out, filling the entire right side of the store. Their entire selection can be had at various quantities. The packaging and display is confectionery perfect, just like Ghirardelli Square. And because you're visiting, get flavors and treats that are not available in your neighborhood. You'll be glad you did. What's my bottom line? Good? Better than good! I'm coming back on my next visit. My actual rating is a solid 5.0 stars because a chocolate god with its own ice cream joint. No chocolate making show here but it's still the force of is strong in this one...

Visiting my sister out of state and reading so many great reviews about this place I was SO excited to grab some goodies with my sisters and niece. However while waiting in line from afar my sister was aggressively shouted out about the mask she was wearing. She was wearing a face shield from her nose below. Had she known she was wearing a face covering that wasn't up to standard she would have immediately corrected the issue. Instead she willingly stepped outside while I continued to order. At that time I let the cashier know how rude and inappropriate her approach was and had we known from the beginning it wouldn't have been a problem. She then let me know employees had been tested positive and they had to be shut down. That's no excuse for poor customer service. Once leaving the cafe we called to get her name which is Terry and she hung up the phone several times once asking to speak with the manager. Hopefully the food tastes better than the employees attitude.

Have to say this ice cream joint is great! This has been my 2nd visit since yesterday, 2 days in a row! Was born here but raised in the DMV & sad there isn't a cool ice cream joint in the DMV! Their ice cream is soft, full of flavor, reasonably priced & great for all members of the family. I will definitely come back when I visit Pgh again!

Wow. Can I just say...MIND BLOWN! These delectable morsels are far from your everyday mom and pop donuts. Depending on the type you get, you're definitely in for a sugar rush! These donuts are definitely too pretty to eat, but I'm happy to accept that challenge. I've tried a variety of them and the only one I don't think I'll be trying and kind of disappointed about is the Mexican Hot Chocolate (i think its called). All others are very worth the hour I waited in line and 5 blocks I walked yesterday due to the walk-a-thon happening in downtown LV. You should also try their house made strawberry milk. Soo smooth and soo good!

The ice cream was not bad, but I think I would've chosen to spend my $10 elsewhere. I was waiting in a cramped line when I noticed one of the workers in back of me said "I said excuse me 10 times" as she rushed to the cash register. Immediately my friends and I were turned off. In fact, I was scared she might spit in my food for not hearing her say excuse me 10 times. I made sure to keep a close eye on the workers, as ridiculous as that sounded. I normally wouldn't even bat an eye if someone couldn't hear me speak my order the first time. I don't even care if they ask me multiple times. I make sure to speak louder and clearer. And when my order comes up it wasn't even the correct order. And I just asked nicely that I ordered the chocolate dipped cone, not ice cream in a cup. He transfers my ice cream into a dipped cone instead of the cup, but he doesn't hand it to me. He pushes it across the counter so it'll reach me. There was no protective paper covering on the bottom of the waffle cone. Honestly not a big deal for some, but I thought it was a little unsanitary... especially after the bad experience we were already having. He could've just handed it to me. But hey, at least nobody spit in my food!

Perfect little date spot, to grab some ice cream and walk around downtown phoenix! Definitely some taste bud pleasing unique rotating flavors. Their signature touch is to serve up your ice cream in a little Chinese takeout box and top it with a fortune cookie!

Everything is delicious at the Batch House! I've ordered cakes from Cris for years but I love that I finally get to stop by and grab one off treats. The caramel apple cookie was delicious! My favorite is the oatmeal cream pie but really everything there is amazing including the coffee!!! Don't miss out on this special place!
Such an adorable ice cream shop! Our sundae was so yummy and the back patio seating area was fun to hang out while we ate!

Sinful Sweets is an adorable little chocolate and sweets places located in Downtown and is the perfect spot to satisfy and sweet craving. When I stopped by, personally, I felt bad. They closed at 8pm and I literally entered at 7:55pm, so I'm sorry about that but I was hungry! The main reason for wanting to stop was I noticed they sold raw cookie dough which is such a craze right now and something I never tried. In addition to cookie dough they sell regular ice cream as well, and many other different types of chocolate candy so you really can get it all here. Plus, the staff is super nice so although I came in there so close to closing, I could tell she really didn't care all that much. Now, sadly for me, I hated the cookie dough. It was red velvet which I normally find to be amazing, but this wasn't. Nothing against the shop, I'm just realizing that this raw cookie dough trend isn't for me. I thought it was too sweet, the consistency was odd and overall just wasn't something I'd ever want again. Next time I'll get ice cream, but even so I'd still make sure I came back to Sinful Sweets. It's amazing.
Awful experience. Guest specialist Alyssa had a horrible attitude. She should be fired. The cashier Akberet, however, was very polite. Thumbs down for bad service!

Love this place and so does our little ones! So yummy and so worth it for outdoor fun get away with anyone to enjoy some yummy soft serve. The employees are so helpful and sweet will be retiring again!

A unique treat in the CU area. The setting is quaint, the custard wonderfully creamy, and the toppings decadent...a perfect place to go with friends or on a date. I only wish it were closer to campus. I highly recommend the lemon custard.

This gets a big ole' Pennsylvania approval from me. Not just approval but... the BEST desert option I have EVER had. I love food, that is not a lie, what also isn't a lie is me literally saying "oh my god" after taking a bite. This is what happened with my cookie monster, doughnut with oreo topping concoction. To say it was incredible was a VAST understatement. I CANNOT stress enough how incredible the ice cream, doughnut, temperature and everything else about it. My original fear was that it would be too sweet, but.... Heres the deal, they have the doughnuts baked FOR them by a local doughnut maker (baker?), and they are purposely made sugary and not overly sweet, along with incredibly soft on the inside and perfectly warmed on the outside. Honestly, I cannot say enough good things. Food alone here is worth a 5/5 stars, but dare I say it they deserve more? Yes. Yes I do. We went on a Sunday morning around 1pm and there was no one in line. No wait, and no one else in the "Business". The owners were there and were so incredibly informative and friendly. Talking about everything from the uniqueness of the ice cream to the individual attention each doughnut gets. The owners love talking business, AND love hearing your story. They also informed me that they will typically have lines at busy times of the day, so maybe sneak in there earlier or at odd hours to avoid the rush. With that being said, this doughnut contraption is EASILY worth a hour + wait.

Villani's Bakery is the best bakery in and around the Charlotte area. If you are looking for specialty items like Lobster Tails and Sfogliatella look no further. Their lobster tails are the best I've ever had, anywhere. The filling is fresh and delicious and made from real cream and real cheese. Their Sfingi pastries are super delicious (also known as St. Joseph Cream Puffs or Sfingi di San Giuseppe.) I could go on and on about the many other delicious pastry items. They have excellent coffee and espresso as well. There are picnic tables so you may sit and enjoy your delicious finds. If you go in the evening, there are pretty lights for you to sit under. This is a great date spot. :-)

If I keep coming back to this place I'm going to turn into a Fatty Daddy! I mean why didn't I think to put my macaroon on top of my ice and then top it with a marshmallow? It's genius and oh so tasty! There are plenty of yummy ice cream and macaroon flavors to choose from too! But, I really don't think you can go wrong with any of the combinations. The lady behind the counter was very helpful my first time and gave some great recommendations! This ice cream is a must after dinner dessert!

Sweet Republic is a haven for frozen treat fiends. It is definitely one of the best ice cream parlors in the Valley, and according to the Food Network, creates one the Best Things I Ever Ate: Toffee Banofi sundae. Um, yes, I concur. I try to get a weekly sweet treat from Sweet Republic, and I am working on branching out from my favorite flavors to try all of their amazing creations. The Bananas Foster ice cream is just fantastic - sweet, subtle flavor of banana in ice cream form. I do not usually care for banana-flavored foods, but this is just so tasty. Of course, I also LOVE the Salted Butter Caramel, the Madagascar Vanilla, and Belgian Chocolate. The sorbet flavors are outstanding - for a huge pick me up, try the Basil Lime; for just fruity deliciousness, get the Coconut and Strawberry. Sweet Republic also does interesting flavor rotations, including Honey Blue Cheese, Bacon, White Truffle, and other holiday themed flavors. You could try a different flavor every week! Sweet Republic also has a menu full of amazing sundaes and ice cream creations. I love the ice cream sandwiches - my favorite flavor between two chocolate chip cookies - what could be better!? Now, be warned that Sweet Republic is not to be considered inexpensive. They have small servings and they aren't cheap. But, the extra money is worth it for those who enjoy fresh ingredients and local charm. If you can't make it to Scottsdale, check them out on Twitter to find out where their Chevy truck might be headed next!
I think I died an went to heaven the day I had my first Amelie's salted caramel nut brownie. The quiche is always delicious as well as the sandwiches. Must try the dirty chi. The best in town!
Good food long lines at night. The lines move fast though and the pastries are pretty tasty the macaroons are one of my favorite items there. Be prepared to spend money though.
Got donuts there this morning. Place wasn't to busy. Got a dozen donuts and they are amazing. Taste great and service was good
Best place for custard (Ice cream) around. If you're ever in the Danville area there is another location there that I am probably more partial too b/c I grew up there.

This place has the best selection of donuts for the donut aficionado. Alexia's personality is the perfect mix of sweetness and all around good karma to make this place a regular spot for that perfect donut you need in your life!

Wanted to try this place out since there was one at the cosmo and was craving ice cream!The employees were so friendly!The girl that helped me asked if I've ever tried their ice cream before I chose one and I said no,so she gave me samples of the cereal milk or fruity crunch.I liked the fruity crunch so I got that in a cup.It was really good! They put a layer of cereal on the bottom of the cup,then coated the sides with more cereal.It was just a lot for me so I ended up throwing half away I also got the chocolate chocolate cookie but I haven't had it just yet.

Yummy ice cream in a great spot right near quite a few restaurants. It is lovely to walk to after a nice dinner. The line can definitely get long, but it's worth it! Great flavors and tons of toppings (must try the home made cookies!)

I had the Canoli Cake the small one and it was pretty good as well as the triple chocolate chip cookie and some nut bar. The treats were quite delicious, but I think that for the price it's not really worth it. You're paying for the name of who's on it more than what you're getting.

From "Mind of a Chef" to cosmos of happiness. The cereal milk frozen yogurt with corn flakes lived up to the hype portrayed on the show and is the perfect 2am snack while youre partying it up in Las Vegas. I ended up getting the sample platter and loved errrthannnggg outside of the compost cookies and birthday truffle. Crack Pie was everything and more. #nojoke I was back at 215am for seconds.

I had the Dough Melt with honey lavender ice cream and added fruity pebbles. It was absolutely delicious. The service was great from all 3 of the employees that were present. We will be back and we look forward to trying more of their rotational flavors!

I started to go to Mitchell's in grade school when it first opened. 15 years later, I am still such a huge fan, including all their locations. The W 25th location is different then all the others because although it doesn't feel as homey as other locations, it does still have the amazing ice cream. What's cool about this location is they made it fit the feel of West 25. Industrial but still true to their brand. You can see how the Ice Cream is made, you're able for tours, and obviously, there are plenty of flavors to try! What's great about Mitchell's too is they offer a handful of ice cream that are dairy free, but don't lack flavor in one bit. Overall, this is just another great location of Mitchell's that offers delicious ice cream and customer service!

Having grown-up near the original Ghiradelli square in San Francisco, I knew that it wouldn't be the same experience going in. I love that they great you at the door with a free chocolate sample! I got to try the salted caramel chocolate square which was yummy and not something I would normally choose myself. My favorite chocolate there is the raspberry chocolate squares or seasonal peppermint chocolate bark. We went in for some late night ice cream and it was good despite the slight wait. The dessert/ ice cream prices are on the higher side but they do have a decent selection to choose from. The Linq location is great and would make a nice addition to a date night or pit stop when cruising the strip on a hot day. I'd definitely go back if I'm in the area again!

I though this place was just average. Although they have a ton of flavors and I like that they let you sample, it's not a memorable ice cream place for me. I didn't really care to try their ice cream sandwich. The price was not worth the protein and a dollar for a toasted marshmallow? Wow. It's a very small establishment so seating is quite limited. I had the ginger matcha and mint chip. I thought the double scoop was pricey.
Walked in and asked for a doppio. Response was 'Dope-what' and walked out.

Hopscotch is a small local bakery. Every day they feature different baked goods and have a selection of cake and seasonal beverages. The food tastes great but the opening time doesn't make sense. They open later in the morning and close at 5:30. This is the reason for the 4 stars...beyond that the food is great.

Why did I wait in line for this place? The donuts, cookies, and pastries were so bland. Everything looked so tempting in the display case too. I can see why it takes forever too...they first put the items on a tray and then transfer them to a box/bag. Then it all goes to a cashier who goes over your order again. Seems so inefficient. Instead, go to Bouchon Bakery or Paris Baguette, where you can taste delicious baked goods!!

Very "NoDa" type place. good amount of places to sit, but places is always packed so you might have to wait awhile for a seat. Prices are a bit high, but that is to be expected at a fresh french bakery. Leek soup and ham sandwich is awesome. baked goods are beautiful and good. haven't had anything spectacularly good but no actual complaints. I've been here a few times and will continue to come back.

When you have a line for ice cream when it's 40 degrees out you know it's good. Love the seasonal flavors. Tera was amazingly knowledgeable and helpful. I went with her recommendations of sweet potato pie and ginger bread (yes it's ice cream). I came back last night and brought my parents from tucson who loved everything as well.
I love Jeni's so much. I always have a hard time figuring out what favor to get because everything is so good.

10/10 bakery, vibes, food and service. I came here on a Monday during the day and it was very relaxing and not too busy. The service was amazing, I was stuck between what pastry to get and the woman patiently walked me through her favorites and helped me choose one. I ended up getting the espresso entrement (see pictures) which she recommended and it was delicious! It also looked so cool as a bubble kind of pastry and seemed too pretty to eat. The inside was huge, it had a lot of seating and the decor was nice to look at. I worked from here and it had a nice and relaxing vibe, definitely recommend checking it out!

This is one of many hidden gems here in the Burgh. Check it out, freaky good ice cream, better blizzards than Dairy Queen, shakes that would have Ronald McDonald spinning in his grave if he were dead. I love Page's dairy mart, and look forward to opening day every spring, then go at least every week on those warm summer nights and have a cone or my favorite, peanut butter chocolate ice cream with butterfingers and reeses peanut butter cups running through it. Then I go run for two hours to burn it off, but it's worth it. Why four stars? Bad intersection (Carson and Beck's Run) and parking can be a motherbucket. You're still sitting there reading this? GO TO PAGE'S NOW!

Maybe it was just the flavor I chose Vanilla but it was the most bland no flavor cupcake I have ever had. My friend had coconut lemon and liked hers. Doubt I will be back but I can say I have been and tried it.

Milk Bar has become synonymous with Foodie must-have while in any town that has one. Being a Vegas local, I have gotten several opportunities to make my way down to the Strip to stop here (and Momofuku, but that's another review in itself), both conveniently located withing Cosmopolitan. If you've seen Christina's episode on Netflix's 'Chef's Table,' you can't help BUT be excited to stop by and sample her genius and innovation! Firstly, the 'storefront.' This is NOT a sit-down restaurant, not is it like a cafe where you can place your order and hang out at a table. Think 'brick and mortar ice-cream truck. This, in my opinion, helps keep Milk Bar's philosophy of appearing approachable, not too pretentious despite the hype. You feel comfortable there in its casual-meets-foodie vibe. The food. OH GOD THE FOOD! I'll keep it brief. The Crack Pie defines itself, and it's accurate. The Compost Cookie is the best mix of flavors and textures, incorporating chew, crunch, and crisp with sweet, salty, coffee, etc. The Blueberry Cookie was a recent try that blew me away - so subtly sweet and soft, one was not enough. My personal favorite: The Birthday Truffles: Dense, moist, almost too sweet but dances along that line perfectly. I also chose to treat myself last birthday with their Birthday Truffle Birthday Cake: the cake itself was incredible, but because there is no frosting, anything past day one starts to dry out a bit. I personally was not a big fan of the 'truffles,' which I assumed were birthday truffles, but were more like hard (very hard) crumbles of the same material. It detracted from the birthday cake experience for me, but Milk Bar has so many more redeeming qualities that I couldn't justify removing a star for that. Finally, I recently got to try the soft serve cereal milk with the corn flake bits - mind blowing. It truly transported me to childhood breakfasts of frosted flakes. Again, the sheer innovation with these creations are enough to keep me coming back, but then you throw in the fact that it all tastes, looks, and balances incredibly well, and it's safe to say we all know why this is a must-have.

Donut Bar is a place you must experience. Not only are there numerous options of delicate, savory donuts-- but the staff and chef always make you feel special when you walk through the door. I would recommend the French toast donut. So soft, crunchy and delicious that it melts in your mouth. Served warm directly to you with syrup and butter. I call it the triple B: buttery, beautiful and breakfast donut! The times I've visited Chef Jeff welcomes me and recommends options-- he treats everyone the same and makes your visit special. Great place for healthy gains and not so healthy gains -- but let's face it? Donut calories do not count because they are at Donut Bar. Great place for indulging and calming your sweet tooth.

I can't eat gluten but the coffee here is amazing. The customer service is impeccable and they remember you each time you go. I always bring in people from out of town and local groups. They are fantastic two children and go above and beyond to help you find the donut that you want. If it's available the French toast donut is a must-try. If you get there at the end of the day they will give you a deal on Donuts which is great because you never get yesterday's Donuts.
Lack of covid compliance. Owner refused to put on a mask and told me to mind my own business until I pay his bills. Won't return.

Pure review: Donuts 4/4, Ambience 3/4, Social distance score 1/4, Price 2/4. So to recap everything. The place is trendy and all of the staff have a typical Socal vibe. Not to be confused with a dirty Seattle "CHOP" zone vibe. The prices are up there but the donuts are huge! I mean like unnecessarily big. Who would buy a dozen of these and bring back to a office and sabotage someone's Keto? I would but that's me. So if you like big donuts and don't mind waiting in long a line, just to see the person in front of you choose the last donut you wanted. Then you hold up the line because you didn't have a second choice, while the lady behind the counter just stares at you. So you pick one in a hurry and it has a calorie count 10x the one you wanted in the first place. And you gotta eat it in the car because if you take it back to the office, your coworkers are gonna see you in a different light. Then try it out! Enjoy!

I was excited when it was announced that Sprinkles was coming to Vegas. I used to frequent their Newport Beach location when I lived in California, and thought they were the best cupcakes ever!! So we waited a few months before coming here. I had heard from a few people that the lines were ridiculously long and that the cupcakes were not very good. I thought ok, maybe they just need some time to get their sh!t together. My husband and I finally stopped in after eating dinner at the Yard House and riding the High Roller. When you walk in, you will notice that cupcakes are on the left and ice cream is on the right. I ended up buying 4 cupcakes, but was kind of disappointed when I ate them at home. The cake wasn't as moist and the frosting wasn't as tasty as I remember. :( However, my husband ordered the sprinkles sundae, which was actually pretty good! Ok, so its just a cupcake cut in half with a scoop of ice cream in the middle. I don't know if the milk chocolate cupcakes were just fantastic that day, or if ice cream just makes them that much better. But I highly recommend the sundae if you are going to spend your $ here! Overall, I am disappointed that they are not as good as I remember. Customer service on the ice cream side needs improvement since none of them were greeting customers and it basically seemed like they didn't care. Plus, the location is inconvenient for us locals who don't really spend time on the strip!

We missed our connecting flight in Charlotte and ended up staying in a hotel for a night. We walked around the NoDa area and found this gem bakery/coffeehouse. They have a huge selection of hot/cold breakfast and lunch items and delicious specialty coffees. They will also customize your orders if you like your coffee a certain way. The tartine sandwiches were a huge hit for my boyfriend and me. It has a great atmosphere with a hip vibe. It is a fun stop whether you live in town or are just here for a few hours like us!
Fruity Pebbles ice cream changed my life. You can literally smell the waffle cones being made as you approach the street this little gem is located on. Can't wait to go back!

Eh.. Sweets were OK. No big deal to me. I bought cookies, a pecan pie, and some creme tower thingy. I've definitely had better. Cookies tasted store bought and not fresh. Not a place I will ever revisit when I return to Vegas.

We were on the hunt for a good dessert place after a show at the Talking Stick Resort Arena. We found this place by browsing yelp, and boy are we glad we stopped by! I got the honey lavender and lemon poppyseed side by side, between 2 European style waffles (aka Leslie Knope style!). My husband got the strawberry ice cream sandwiched in a doughnut. They were both sooo good!! My husband is very picky, but he seriously said it was the best thing he's ever eaten. The doughnut was not overbearingly sweet and went so well with the creamy ice cream. The owners were so friendly and welcoming! Would definitely come here again!

Hard to find - store still has old business name above the entrance, Open sign turned off. Limited selection, donuts on the small size, pricey compared to traditional donuts. Nice staff but they seemed unconcerned about their appearance and unenthusiastic about their donuts. Donuts are thick and heavy, soaked and drenched in sugar

These cupcakes are so soft, moist, and the dark chocolate one smells like heaven!!! Of course I like some more than others, but the ones I love I'm willing to drive 30 minutes to the strip from my house and suffer through the intoxicated people! My favs are pumpkin, lemon coconut, key lime, Neapolitan (secret cupcake you have to ask for), and dark chocolate (my absolute favorite and I don't even like chocolate cake, but it's THAT good!). Biggest complaint is that I absolutely love the s'more cupcake, but it's seasonal and I keep missing it!!! Grrrr! Not so favs: black and white, chai, and marshmallow (not as good as s'more). Won't get them again. CONFESSION: I only really like cream cheese and ganache frosting so I'm a lil biased. There's a nice lady outside making sure your in the right line...one for ice cream, second for cupcakes. I did try the ice cream and it was good...I made it better when I put my dark chocolate cupcake in it!!! (Did I mention I love that cupcake?) Finally: ask about their "secret cupcake" of the day, but don't be surprised if it's already gone :-/ it was the Neapolitan both times I asked...my mouth is watering as I think of it.
The best donuts you will ever eat. A little piece of heaven! I recommend Jack Frost to everyone!!!

I didn't know about this place until a bunch of my friends were excited to go. I went about a week after opening around 7pm. There was an outside line and then an inside line to pay. Together it took about 2 hours. It was insane but it's not really their fault. I seriously hope that the line gets better because I really want to go back The thing that shocked me the most is that I actually don't like sweet bread. Honestly I would say that I extremely dislike sweet breads. My mom buys conchas and pastries a lot and I just don't enjoy sweet things. I just got a few things from here because it was so popular and I wanted to try them. But I was completely shocked that I didn't just like everything but I ate all of it. I'm not really sure what is in their bread because they all just tasted so good. They must do something different than any other bakery I have gone to. But I got a few different to try and I liked every single one. They are also not that pricey. I was definitely expecting it to be more around $1-$3 each. I got the taro bread that is very popular. It was very good. I also got the mushroom bread because I wanted to taste the savory breads as well. Funny enough it ended up being my least favorite (still good though) but I've never picked something sweet over something savory. My favorite so far was the mangotale. It has cream cheese that tastes like mango inside. That was probably my favorite sweet bread I have had in my entire life. I really want to go taste some more. I wanted to try the hot dog and curry bread but they were out. I'll wait a bit more to go and I hope I can taste them all.

What I like most is that they can make most sandwiches Gluten Free and they have a few gluten free confections to satisfy my sweet tooth. The expanded area makes for more room for writers and cooperative work. Now for a cafe Mocha!

There's really nothing you can say bad about Amelie's. I even brought my dad's gf who is a French citizen and she loved the place. Raved about their pastries and croque monsieur. We'll always come here.

Yum! This place is super vintage chic decor with nice seating area and even a little outdoor seating area in the back. They have some of the cutest, most instagram worthy cakes and pastries that I've ever seen and they're just as delicious as they look! I love the cake so much that I got a slice of Lemon Poppyseed to bring home and my husband (who doesn't like cake) love it!! I didn't get a drink this time but would want Excited to go back!

Rule: if there is no line, go and grab ice cream! This was the original Jeni's location in Charlotte and still super popular. The staff are super friendly, masked-up and ready to go. The stand alone building only has counter seating and the line moves through pretty fast. Lots of outdoor tables to sit at or the large concrete steps behind the store. I really only went in here to get a few pints to take home, so I'm not sure how they are handling samples during Covid, but they always gave you separate sampling spoons and the the staff always wore gloves before the pandemic. Southend is pretty lucky to have a cool spot like Jeni's to enjoy after going to one of the many restaurants nearby.

This place was amazing! Service was spectacular, he let us try all the flavors we wanted! I tried several and had a hard time deciding because it was all great. Ended up going with the donut with vanilla ice cream and fruity pebbles. Best vanilla I've ever had.

My first time trying macaroons was at Bouchon! I work nearby & always hear everyone raving about how delicious they are so of course I had to try them for myself! I didn't know which kind to try so I got the variety box with six different flavors. I'm not entirely sure what those flavors were but they were delicious!
Was a very good hot fudge sundae. But it should be for 14 bucks. Little hard to find in the sea of shops.

I don't know if I am just not used to Vegan desserts but I definitely have better chocolate cakes than this one. I am really disappointed on their chocolate cake, However, the almond muffin that's served warm was pretty delicious.

I had really high hopes due to the reviews but for me it just didn't work. I had the creme brulee donut, birthday cake donut, chocolate, and blueberry pop tart. The creme brulee donut was interesting and well presented, but the flavor was missing something, can't put my finger on it. All the other donuts unfortunately we're far too sweet for me, the dough however was airy and dense, it just wasn't enough to keep my attention. Staff was awesome, and the place really cool, for my taste it was too sweet but YMMV.

After all the Hype we had to check this place out... I'm a total donut lover, and this place unfortunately was totally underwhelming. I was disappointed in the flavors of the donuts (from their simple cake donuts, to their Nutella speciality donut) the coffee wasn't great either. 3 donuts 2 cappuccinos and $14 later, we were thinking that Dunkin Donuts would have been a better option... at least their coffee is good!

Some of the best ice cream I've ever tasted. I'm from WI, so I've had many a great ice creams before, but this was fantastic! I had the mint chocolate chip, which seems a bit boring.
